text: Balik na sa normal ang alert status ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) ini matapos nga ginpasaka man bangud sa pagkaaresto ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) has returned to normal alert status after it was also raised due to the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga sang nagligad nga semana, antes pa man nag-weekend, ginbalik na sa normal ang alert level.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said that last week, before the weekend, the alert level was returned to normal.

text: Suno kay Solis, ang tikang ang ginsunod man sa direktiba sang national headquarters sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: Solis said the move was also in line with the directive of the national headquarters of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan sang masangkad nga operasyon sang PRO-6 apisar sang pagpanubo sang alert status.
english: He also assured the intensive operation of PRO-6 despite the lowering of the alert status.

text: Lakip na diri ang pagpatuman sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) check points kag sa pagsekyar sang mga lugar nga yara sa crime prone areas.
english: This includes the implementation of Commission on Elections (COMELEC) check points and the inspection of areas in crime prone areas.

text: Nagapati si former presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque nga protektado siya kag indi siya maaresto sang Philippine authorities samtang yara siya sa Netherlands.
english: Former presidential spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque said he is protected and will not be arrested by the Philippine authorities while he is in the Netherlands.

text: Gindagdagan sang korte si Roque sang arrest warrant bangud sa kaso nga qualified human trafficking.
english: The court added an arrest warrant against Roque for qualified human trafficking.

text: Didto siya subong sa Netherlands kag nag-apply na para sa asylum.
english: He is now in the Netherlands and has applied for asylum.

text: Kagab-i naman sang gindala pabalik sa Pilipinas ang anay congressman nga si Arnie Teves matapos ini gin-deport sang Timor Leste government.
english: Former congressman Arnie Teves was brought back to the Philippines last night after he was deported by the Timor Leste government.

text: Siya ang ginatudlo nga prime suspect sa Degamo massacre sang 2023 sa Pamplona, Negros Oriental.
english: He is the alleged prime suspect in the 2023 Degamo massacre in Pamplona, ​​Negros Oriental.

text: “Sa isipan ng mga bangag, gusto nila ako na ang sumunod….
english: “In the minds of the assholes, they want me to be next….

text: Hindi po mangyayari yun,” suno naman kay Roque.
english: That will not happen,” Roque said.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghulag na ang Department of Justice agud makanselar ang passport ni Roque.
english: The Department of Justice has already moved to cancel Roque's passport.

text: Nag-hingyo naman ang CIDG sa Interpol nga mag-isyu sang red notice.
english: The CIDG has requested Interpol to issue a red notice.

text: Ginapanginwala naman sang former palace official ang mga akusasyon sa iya nga naangot siya sa iligal nga POGO — bagay nga suno sa iya pagpanghingabot lamang sang Marcos administration bangud loyal siya sa mga Duterte.#
english: The former palace official denied accusations that he was involved in illegal POGO — something he said was only persecuted by the Marcos administration because he was loyal to the Dutertes.

text: Ginkumpirma ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Jaime Santiago nga subong nga aga, Mayo 30, dal-on sa New Bilibid Prison si former Negros Oriental 3rd District Rep.
english: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Jaime Santiago confirmed that this morning, May 30, former Negros Oriental 3rd District Rep.

text: Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves, Jr.
english: Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves, Jr.

text: Samtang didto sa Muntinlupa City, magatinir ang former lawmaker sa detention facility sang ahensya.
english: While in Muntinlupa City, the former lawmaker will remain in the agency's detention facility.

text: Pag-abot kagab-i halin sa Timor Lester, ginpatulog anay si Teves sa headquarters sang NBI sa Pasay City.
english: Arriving last night from Timor Lester, Teves was put to sleep at the NBI headquarters in Pasay City.

text: Duha ka maleta ang dala sini kun sa diin nalakip ang iya nga habol kag personal kit.
english: He was carrying two suitcases containing his blanket and personal kit.

text: Suno kay Santiago, yara sa maayo nga sitwasyon ang former congressman matapos ini nagpaidalom sa booking procedures kag sa medical examination.
english: According to Santiago, the former congressman is in good condition after he underwent booking procedures and medical examination.

text: Magluwas nga si Teves ang prime suspect sa pagpapatay kay Negros Oriental Gov.
english: Besides Teves being the prime suspect in the murder of Negros Oriental Gov.

text: Roel Degamo sang 2023, nagapangatubang man ini sang iban nga kaso lakip na ang ginaalegar nga pagpatay sa tatlo ka mga tawo sa Negros Oriental sang 2019.
english: Roel Degamo in 2023, he is also facing other cases including the alleged murder of three people in Negros Oriental in 2019.

text: Gin-tag man siya sang Anti-Terrorism Council bilang terorista bangud sa ginaalegar nga pagpamatay kag pagpang-harass sa Negros Oriental.
english: The Anti-Terrorism Council also tagged him as a terrorist for alleged killings and harassment in Negros Oriental.

text: Ginsipa siya halin sa Kamara sang Agusto 2024 bangud sa padayon nga pag-absent kag disorderly conduct.
english: He was kicked out of the House in August 2024 for persistent absences and disorderly conduct.

text: Nabalik na sa Pilipinas kag natalana nga mag-atubang sa iya sampaw-sampaw nga mga kaso ang anay kongresista sang third district sang Negros Oriental nga si Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves, Jr.
english: Former congressman of the third district of Negros Oriental, Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves, Jr., has returned to the Philippines and is scheduled to face his multiple cases.

text: Si Teves amo ang ginatudlo utok sa pagpatay kay anay Negros Oriental Gov.
english: Teves is the alleged mastermind behind the murder of former Negros Oriental Gov.

text: Roel Degamo sang Marso 4, 2023 sa iya mismo nga puluy-an sa Pamplona, Negros Oriental.
english: Roel Degamo on March 4, 2023 at his residence in Pamplona, ​​Negros Oriental.

text: Sa amo nga massacre nga ginhimo mismo sa tungang-adlaw, patay man ang siyam ka iban pa nga mga tawo nga natabuan nga didto sa area.
english: In the massacre, which took place at noon, nine other people who happened to be in the area were also killed.

text: 7:40 kagab-i sang naghugpa para sa stopover sa Davao City ang eroplano sang Philippine Air Force kun sa diin sakay si Teves halin sa Timor Leste.
english: 7:40 pm when the Philippine Air Force plane carrying Teves from Timor Leste landed for a stopover in Davao City.

text: Sang pasado 11:00 na sa gab-i, nag-abot ang eroplano sa Villamor Air Base sa Pasay City.
english: At around 11:00 pm, the plane arrived at Villamor Air Base in Pasay City.

text: Halin didto, gindala ang anay kongresista sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) headquarters sa Manila kun sa diin ginpaidalom ini sa booking procedure kag medical examination.
english: From there, the former congressman was taken to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) headquarters in Manila where he underwent a booking procedure and medical examination.

text: Subong nga aga, natalana ini nga dal-on sa detention facility sang NBI sa New Bilibid Prison sa Muntinlupa City.
english: This morning, he is scheduled to be taken to the NBI detention facility at New Bilibid Prison in Muntinlupa City.

text: Sa press statement ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: In a press statement, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: matapos gin-deport sang Timor Leste ang former lawmaker, ginpahayag sini nga ginasigurado sang iya administrasyon nga manabat ang tanan nga nagahimo sang krimen.
english: after Timor Leste deported the former lawmaker, he said his administration is ensuring that all perpetrators of crimes are held accountable.

text: Espesyal nga ginpasalamatan sang punong ehekutibo si Timor-Leste Prime Minister Xanana Gusmao kag si President Jose Ramos-Horta bangud natigayon nga napabalik sa pungsod si Teves.
english: The chief executive specially thanked Timor-Leste Prime Minister Xanana Gusmao and President Jose Ramos-Horta for bringing Teves back to the country.

text: “We would like to assure out citizens that such lawlessness will not go unpunished.
english: “We would like to assure out citizens that such lawlessness will not go unpunished.

text: It is now time for Arnie Teves to face justice,” kabahin sang video statement ni President Marcos.
english: It is now time for Arnie Teves to face justice,” President Marcos said in a video statement.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapangatubang man ang former lawmaker sang iban nga kaso lakip na ang ginaalegar pagpatay sa tatlo ka mga tawo sa Negros Oriental sang 2019.
english: The former lawmaker is also facing other cases including the alleged murder of three people in Negros Oriental in 2019.

text: Gin-tag man siya sang Anti-Terrorism Council bilang terorista bangud sa ginaalegar nga pagpamatay kag pagpang-harass sa Negros Oriental.
english: The Anti-Terrorism Council also tagged him as a terrorist for alleged killings and harassment in Negros Oriental.

text: Ginsipa siya halin sa Kamara sang Agusto 2024 bangud sa padayon nga pag-absent kag disorderly conduct.
english: He was kicked out of the House in August 2024 for persistent absences and disorderly conduct.

text: Gin-deklarar sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga indi na isa ka global health emergency ang mpox ukon kilala anay nga monkeypox.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared mpox or formerly known as monkeypox, no longer a global health emergency.

text: Suno kay WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, sa nagligad nga tatlo ka bulan, 90% nga mas manubo na ang na-report nga mga kaso ipaanggid sa nagligad pa gid nga tatlo ka bulan.
english: According to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in the past three months, 90% fewer cases have been reported compared to the previous three months.

text: Matandaan nga Hulyo sang nagligad nga tuig sang nag-deklarar ang WHO sang emergency bangud sa amo nga balatian.
english: It can be recalled that in July last year, the WHO declared an emergency due to the disease.

text: Kaangay man ini sa emergency declaration nga ginpaguwa sa seryoso nga mga disease outbreaks sa kalibutan kaangay sa coronavirus disease 2019, H1N1 flu, polio, kag Ebola.
english: This is similar to the emergency declaration issued in serious disease outbreaks in the world such as coronavirus disease 2019, H1N1 flu, polio, and Ebola.

text: Halin sang Enero 2022, masobra na sa 87,000 ka mga kaso sang mpox ang narekord sa 111 ka mga pungsod lakip na sa Pilipinas.
english: As of January 2022, more than 87,000 cases of mpox have been recorded in 111 countries including the Philippines.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 140 ang nagkalamatay.
english: Of this number, 140 died.

text: Ang mga nakaangkon sini nga balatian ang nag-develop sang rashes sa kamot, tiil, dughan, nawong ukon bisan sa baba, kag malapit sa genitals.
english: Those who contracted the disease developed rashes on the hands, feet, chest, face or even the mouth, and near the genitals.

text: Sa sini nga outbreak, ginpahayag nga masami ini maglapta paagi sa pagpakighilawas, kag mga lalaki ang reported nga kalabanan nga nalatnan sang sini nga balatian.
english: In this outbreak, it has been reported that it is often spread through sexual intercourse, and men are reported to be mostly infected with this disease.

text: Liwat nga nagpaguwa sang statement si Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.
english: Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) chief General Romeo Brawner Jr. once again issued a statement.

text: nga nagapanindugan nga wala sang kudeta nga matabo sa idalom sang iya liderato.
english: insisting that no coup would take place under his leadership.

text: Sa tunga ini sang pagtuhaw liwat sang mga espekulasyon kaangot sa internal unrest sa sulod sang militar.
english: This comes amid resurgent speculation about internal unrest within the military.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginsulit ni Brawner ang wala-punaw nga pagsunod sang organisasyon sa Konstitusyon amo man sa chain of command.
english: In a statement, Brawner reiterated the organization’s unwavering adherence to the Constitution as well as the chain of command.

text: Pahayag ni Brawner, tubtub nga siya ang chief of staff, wala sang kudeta nga matabo kag indi sila magpalingkang sa anuman nga rumor ukon gahod.
english: Brawner said that as long as he is the chief of staff, there will be no coup and they will not be distracted by any rumor or noise.

text: “As long as I serve as Chief of Staff, no coup shall happen.
english: “As long as I serve as Chief of Staff, no coup shall happen.

text: Not on my watch.
english: Not on my watch.

text: We will not be shaken by rumor, nor outmaneuvered by noise,” pahayag sini.
english: We will not be shaken by rumor, nor outmaneuvered by noise,” it said.

text: “Let me reassure our countrymen that the AFP remains strong, professional, and firmly loyal to the chain of command.
english: “Let me reassure our countrymen that the AFP remains strong, professional, and firmly loyal to the chain of command.

text:
We are a disciplined institution, grounded in respect for the Constitution, civilian authority, and the rule of law.”

Gindugang sini nga bug-os ang iya salig sa integridad, propesyonalismo, kag patriyotismo sang mga soldado.
english:
We are a disciplined institution, grounded in respect for the Constitution, civilian authority, and the rule of law.”

He added that he has full confidence in the integrity, professionalism, and patriotism of the soldiers.

text:
May mensahe man ini sa mga nagatuga sang ‘instability’ sa organisasyon:

“To those who persist in creating instability, I offer this not as a rebuke, but as a reminder.
english:
It also has a message to those who cause ‘instability’ in the organisation:

“To those who persist in creating instability, I offer this not as a rebuke, but as a reminder.

text: Do not sow doubt among the very ranks that safeguard our democracy.
english: Do not sow doubt among the very ranks that safeguard our democracy.

text:
Do not attempt to influence or mislead soldiers who serve quietly, honorably, and with steadfast loyalty to our Constitution and our country.”

Nagpaandam man si Brawner sang kunsekwensya sa mga tawo nga nagapalapta sang binutig kag sala-sala nga mga impormasyon sa tuyo nga gub-on ang institusyon.
english:
Do not attempt to influence or mislead soldiers who serve quietly, honorably, and with steadfast loyalty to our Constitution and our country.”

Brawner also warned of consequences for people who spread false and misleading information with the intention of destroying the institution.

text: Pahayag sini, gintukod ang militar agud nga depensahan ang Pilipinas, gani nga indi ini dapat pag-atakehon gamit ang wala-basehan nga mga naratibo.
english: He said the military was established to defend the Philippines, so it should not be attacked with baseless narratives.

text: “Let us not be adversaries in the same nation we all claim to love.
english: “Let us not be adversaries in the same nation we all claim to love.

text: Let us be better stewards of our words, platforms, and influence, because patriotism is not measured by how loudly we speak, but by how wisely we choose unity over division, and nation-building over disruption,” kabahin pa sang statement.
english: Let us be better stewards of our words, platforms, and influence, because patriotism is not measured by how loudly we speak, but by how wisely we choose unity over division, and nation-building over disruption,” the statement added.

text: Matandaan nga nagtunog liwat ang huring-huring sa internal unrest sa sulod sang military, ilabi na kasunod sang pagdakop anay kay former president Rodrigo Duterte sang Marso 11.
english: It can be recalled that rumors of internal unrest within the military have resurfaced, especially following the arrest of former president Rodrigo Duterte on March 11.

text: May panawagan anay si Duterte sa militar nga tadlungon ang “fractured governance” ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., apang nagsabat ang AFP chief nga indi military junta ang sabat sa mga problema sa pungsod.
english: Duterte had earlier called on the military to correct the “fractured governance” of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., but the AFP chief replied that the military junta is not the answer to the country's problems.

text: Natukiban sa autopsy nga kulang na ang mga organs sang mga biktima nga bangkay na sang nasapwan sa sulod sang kagulangan sa Kenya.
english: An autopsy revealed that the organs of the victims were missing when they were found dead in a forest in Kenya.

text: Ini nga mga biktima ang sumulunod sang Good News International Church cult, kag ginpahayag ginsugo sang ila lider nga si Paul Mackenzie nga magpagutom tubtub mapatay agud makakit-anay sila sang Ginuo.
english: The victims were followers of the Good News International Church cult, and were allegedly ordered by their leader, Paul Mackenzie, to starve to death so that they could meet the Lord.

text: Antes naaresto si Mackenzie, ginpahayag nga nagpromisa pa ini sa iya nga mga sumulunod nga makasaka sila sa langit antes matapos ang kalibutan sa Abril 15.
english: Before his arrest, Mackenzie reportedly promised his followers that they would go to heaven before the end of the world on April 15.

text: Sini lang nga semana sang ginkumpirma sang interior ministry nga natapos na ang post-mortem examinations sa 112 ka mga bangkay nga nakutkutan sang mga otoridad.
english: It was only this week that the interior ministry confirmed that post-mortem examinations had been completed on 112 bodies unearthed by the authorities.

text: Bangud sa kulang nga mga organs, isa sa ginapatihan suno sa pulis amo ang pagbaligya sini kag may yara pa sang involved nga mga suspek magluwas kay Mackenzie.
english: Due to the missing organs, one of the suspects, according to police, is the sale of them and there are other suspects involved besides Mackenzie.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan sang natukiban ang mass graves sa sulod sang kagulangan sa coastal town sang Malindi sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The mass graves were discovered last month inside the forest in the coastal town of Malindi in the country.

text: Apisar nga pagpagutom ang nagapanguna nga rason sang kamatayon sang mga biktima, naguwa man sa eksaminasyon suno kay chief government pathologist Johansen Oduor nga iban sa ila lakip na ang kabataan ang ginpangkuga, ginpangkastigo, kag ginpuot agud nga mapatay.
english: Although starvation was the main cause of death of the victims, chief government pathologist Johansen Oduor said the examination also revealed that some of them, including the children, were strangled, beaten, and strangled to death.

text: Magaimplementar sang ‘heat stroke break’ ang Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) sa ila katapo kasunod sang nagataas nga heat index sa syuadad.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) will implement a heat stroke break for its members following the rising heat index in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL.
english: PCOL.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Traffic Transportation and Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga ginapanan-aw na nga daan sang talatapan ang pagtaas sang heat index sa pagsulod sang ‘summer season’ sang pungsod.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Traffic Transportation and Management Office, said the office is already expecting an increase in the heat index as the country enters the summer season.

text: Naga-implementar ang talatapan sang amo nga tikang agud nga malikaw ang traffic enforcers sa heat stroke ukon heat related incidents.
english: The office is implementing the measure to prevent traffic enforcers from heat stroke or heat related incidents.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, vulnerable ang mga enforcers sa nasambit nga balatian bangud man sa inoras nga nagatrabaho sila sa tunga sang nagatagiti nga init.
english: According to Garbanzos, enforcers are vulnerable to the disease because of the hours they work in the scorching heat.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga nagapatuman sila sang ‘per shift’ kon sa diin, sugod alas-6 sa aga tubtob alas-2 sang hapon, may shifting sa ila pwesto.
english: He also explained that they are implementing 'per shift' where, from 6 am to 2 pm, there is shifting in their place.

text: Ginpasigurado man sini nga on duty ang enforcers sa tion sang rush hour.
english: He also assured that enforcers are on duty during rush hour.

text: Ginhingyo sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) sa International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) nga magpagwa sang red notice batuk kay anay Presidential Spokesman Atty. Harry Roque.
english: The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) has asked the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) to issue a red notice against former Presidential Spokesman Atty. Harry Roque.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirmar ni CIDG Director Major Gen.
english: This was confirmed by CIDG Director Major Gen.

text: Nicholas Torre III.
english: Nicholas Torre III.

text: Una na nga nagpadala sang tracker teams ang CIDG agud arestuhon ang mas o menos 50 ka iban pa nga mga kaupod nga akusado ni Roque, lakip na si Cassandra Li Ong nga gina-imbestigaran bangud sa ginaalegar kahilabtanan nila sa iligal nga operasyon sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO).
english: Earlier, the CIDG sent tracker teams to arrest about 50 other co-accused of Roque, including Cassandra Li Ong who is being investigated for their alleged involvement in the illegal operation of the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO).

text: Matandaan man nga nagpagwa sang arrest warrant ang Angeles City Regional Trial Court Branch 118 batok kay Roque sang Mayo 15 bangud sa ginapahayag paglapas sa Republic Act 9208 ukon Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act of 2003.
english: It can also be recalled that the Angeles City Regional Trial Court Branch 118 issued an arrest warrant against Roque on May 15 for alleged violation of Republic Act 9208 or Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act of 2003.

text: Ang kaso batok kanday Roque, Ong kag 49 ka iban pa ang nag-ugat sa reklamo nga ginpasaka sang Department of Justice sadtong Abril bangud sa ginaalegar kahilabtanan nila sa operasyon sang scam hub Lucky South 99 sa Porac, Pampanga.
english: The case against Roque, Ong and 49 others stems from a complaint filed by the Department of Justice in April for their alleged involvement in the operation of the scam hub Lucky South 99 in Porac, Pampanga.

text: Sang nagligad, ginpahayag ni anay tigpamaba sang former President nga pulitika ang inisyatibo sang Department of Justice nga kanselahon ang iya passport.
english: Earlier, the former President's spokesman said the Department of Justice's initiative to cancel his passport was political.

text: Ginpanindugan ni Roque nga ang plano sang administrasyon ni Marcos nga kanselahon ang iya pasaporte ang kabahin sang pagtinguha sini nga pahipuson siya bilang vocal critic sang administrasyon kag kaalyado sang mga Dutertes.
english: Roque insisted that the Marcos administration's plan to cancel his passport is part of its attempt to silence him as a vocal critic of the administration and an ally of the Dutertes.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Roque nga temprano pa nga istoryahan ang pagkanselar sang iya passport bangud sang iya pag-file sang motion for reconsideration sang nagligad nga semana nga nagahingyo sa DOJ nga ibasura ang iya kaso.
english: Roque also said it is too early to discuss the cancellation of his passport because he filed a motion for reconsideration last week asking the DOJ to dismiss his case.

text: Naguba sang atleta sang Western Visayas nga si Mico Villaran ang 15 ka tuig nga Palaro record sa secondary boys’ 110-m hurdles.
english: Western Visayas athlete Mico Villaran broke the 15-year-old Palaro record in the secondary boys’ 110-m hurdles.

text: Ini matapos siya nagrehistro sang 14.00 sa 2025 Palarong Pambansa.
english: This is after he registered at 14.00 in the 2025 Palarong Pambansa.

text: Gin-break niya ang record nga nahimo ni Patrick Unso nga 14.68 seconds sang 2010.
english: He broke the record set by Patrick Unso of 14.68 seconds in 2010.

text: Ang17-anyos nga si Villaran ang pride sang Romanito Maravilla National High School sa Bacolod City.
english: The 17-year-old Villaran is the pride of Romanito Maravilla National High School in Bacolod City.

text: ILOILO – Sa pihak sang pagtilaw sa kabuhi bangud sa pag-angkon sang breast cancer, maisog nga gin-aubang ni Bombo Rod Jaen Losbañes Gallarde ang balatian kag madinalag-on nga nalampuwasan bangud sa pagtuo sa Diyos.
english: ILOILO – Despite the trials of life due to breast cancer, Bombo Rod Jaen Losbañes Gallarde bravely faced the disease and successfully overcame it because of his faith in God.

text: Suno kay Bombo Rod Jaen, Abril 2021 sang nadiskubrehan sini nga may yara ini sang cancer.
english: According to Bombo Rod Jaen, he was diagnosed with cancer in April 2021.

text: Bangud may history na sang cancer ang ila pamilya, gilayon siya niya nagpaidalom sa ultrasound kag biopsy, kag diri natukiban nga malignant ang bukol sa iya dughan.
english: Because their family had a history of cancer, she immediately underwent an ultrasound and biopsy, and it was discovered that the tumor in her breast was malignant.

text: Tungod sa suporta sang iya bana kag pamilya, nagdesisyon siya nga magpaidalom sa operasyon kag pagpabulong.
english: With the support of her husband and family, she decided to undergo surgery and treatment.

text: Matapos ang madinalag-on nga operasyon, ginpangamuyo niya nga mangin negatibo ang iya biopsy result.
english: After the successful surgery, he prayed that his biopsy result would be negative.

text: Liwat nga ginapamatud-an sang Diyos ang iya kaayo matapos nagnegatibo, apang kinahanglan sa gihapon nga magpaidalom sa chemotherapy.
english: God again proves his goodness after testing negative, but still needs to undergo chemotherapy.

text: Sang Hunyo 4, 2021, gin-umpisahan sini ang iya chemotherapy treatment kag natapos ini sang Nobyembre 17, 2021.
english: On June 4, 2021, she started her chemotherapy treatment and it ended on November 17, 2021.

text: Sa subong, hilway na ini sa balatian kag padayon nga nagakabuhi nga may pagtuo kaupod ang iya bana kag isa ka anak.
english: Today, she is free of illness and continues to live in faith with her husband and one child.

text: Naghulag na ang Department of Justice (DOJ) agud nga mapakanselar ang mga passport ni former presidential spokesman Harry Roque.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has moved to cancel the passports of former presidential spokesman Harry Roque.

text: Suno kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, gin-file sang ahensya ang petisyon sa Angeles City Regional Trial Court sa Pampanga sang nagligad nga Byernes.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla said the agency filed the petition with the Angeles City Regional Trial Court in Pampanga last Friday.

text: Pananglitan ma-cancel ang mga pasaporte ni Roque, mahimo ini mangin undocumented alien.
english: If Roque's passports are cancelled, he could become an undocumented alien.

text: Kun ma-deny pa gid ang application ni Roque para sa asylum sa Netherlands, iga-deport ini suno kay Remulla.
english: If Roque's application for asylum in the Netherlands is denied, he will be deported, Remulla said.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) director Maj.
english: Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) director Maj.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III nga nakahingyo na sila sa International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) nga magpaguwa sang Red Notice para kay Roque.
english: Nicolas Torre III said they have already requested the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) to issue a Red Notice for Roque.

text: Ginhingyo ini insigida matapos nga nag-isyu ang korte sa Pampanga sang warrant of arrest para sa former presidential spokesperson bangud sa kaso nga qualified human trafficking — isa ka non-bailable case.
english: This was requested immediately after a court in Pampanga issued a warrant of arrest for the former presidential spokesperson for qualified human trafficking — a non-bailable case.

text: Ginatudlo si Roque nga involved sa operasyon sang iligal nga Pogo hub nga Lucky South 99 nga ginaakusaran sang trafficking kag iban pa nga scam activities.
english: Roque is allegedly involved in the operation of the illegal Pogo hub Lucky South 99 which is accused of trafficking and other scam activities.

text: Nagapanindugan naman ang former Palace official nga ginahingabot lang siya sang Marcos administration bangud loyal siya sa mga Duterte.
english: The former Palace official insists that the Marcos administration is only harassing him because he is loyal to the Dutertes.

text: Ginklaro sang public law expert nga ang kaso nga crime against humanity nga ginapangatubang subong ni former President Rodrigo Duterte ang sakop sang International Criminal Court (ICC) santo sa Rome Statue treaty.
english: The public law expert clarified that the case of crime against humanity now facing former President Rodrigo Duterte is within the jurisdiction of the International Criminal Court (ICC) based on the Rome Statue treaty.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Rodel Taton, Dean sang Graduate School of Law sang San Sebastian College-Recoletos, iya ginpahayag nga ang Rome Statute amo ang nagtukod nga kasugtanan sang International Criminal Court (ICC), nga gin-adoptar sang Hulyo 17, 1998, kag nagsugod sa pagpatuman sang Hulyo 1, 2002.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Rodel Taton, Dean of the Graduate School of Law of San Sebastian College-Recoletos, he stated that the Rome Statute is the founding treaty of the International Criminal Court (ICC), which was adopted on July 17, 1998, and entered into force on July 1, 2002.

text: Ini ang nagatukod sang hurisdiksyon sang korte sa genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, kag crime of aggression.
english: It establishes the court’s jurisdiction over genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, and crime of aggression.

text: Suno kay Taton, ang Pilipinas nangin myembro sini sang Nobyembre 1, 2011 tubtob nga nag-withdraw sang Marso 2019.
english: According to Taton, the Philippines became a member on November 1, 2011 until it withdrew in March 2019.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang katungdanan sang ICC sa isa ka pungsod amo ang pag-imbestigar kag pag-prosecute sa mga indibidwal nga gin-akusaran sang pinakamabug-at nga mga krimen nga may international concern.
english: He also made it clear that the duty of the ICC to a country is to investigate and prosecute individuals accused of the most serious crimes of international concern.

text: Nahibaluan nga may 125 ka mga pungsod ang States Parties to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.
english: It is known that there are 125 States Parties to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 33 diri ang mga African States, 19 ang Asia-Pacific States, 20 ang gikan sa Eastern Europe, 28 ang hali sa Latin American and Caribbean States, kag 25 ang gikan sa Western European kag other States.
english: In total, 33 of these were African States, 19 were Asia-Pacific States, 20 were from Eastern Europe, 28 were from Latin American and Caribbean States, and 25 were from Western European and other States.

text: Apisar sang malamig nga tyempo, naga-amat-amat na damo ang die-hard supporters nga nagatipon sa guwa sang Buckingham Palace sa London kag sa ruta sang prusisyon agud bantayan ang koronasyon ni King Charles III.
english: Despite the cold weather, more and more die-hard supporters are gathering outside London's Buckingham Palace and along the procession route to watch the coronation of King Charles III.

text: Dala sang Royal fans ang mga folding chairs, tents, sleeping bags kag snacks.
english: Royal fans brought folding chairs, tents, sleeping bags and snacks.

text: Ini nga loyal monarchists ang lunsay nagpili man sang maayo nga posisyon agud nga malantaw sang maayo ang prusisyon sang hari nga natalana pa sa buwas, Mayo 6.
english: These loyal monarchists also chose a good position to watch the king's procession scheduled for tomorrow, May 6.

text: Patigayunon ang maragtason nga seremonya para sa hari sa Westminster Abbey nga amo ang coronation church sang Britanya halin sang 1066.
english: The historic ceremony for the king will be held at Westminster Abbey which has been Britain’s coronation church since 1066.

text: Magluwas kay King Charles III, natalana man nga koronahan si Camilla bilang Queen Consort.
english: In addition to King Charles III, Camilla is also scheduled to be crowned Queen Consort.

text: Magluwas sa Royal Family, magatambong man sa event ang prime minister, representatives halin sa Houses of Parliament, heads of state, kag iban pa nga royals halin sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: Besides the Royal Family, the event will also be attended by the prime minister, representatives from the Houses of Parliament, heads of state, and other royals from other countries.

text: Ginabantayan man ini sang bilog nga kalibutan bangud ini ang labing-una nga koronasyon sa Britanya sa sulod sang pito ka dekada matapos nga nagtaliwan na si Queen Elizabeth II sang nagligad nga Septyembre 2022.
english: It is also being watched globally as it is the first British coronation in seven decades after Queen Elizabeth II passed away last September 2022.

text: MADASIG na ang pag-abot sang mga bakuna kag ang pagpangbakuna batok sa COVID-19 sa pungsod.
english: THE arrival of vaccines and vaccination against COVID-19 in the country is fast.

text: Gani ginapaabot man sang mga otoridad ang madale na nga pag-angkon naton sang “herd immunity” sa ini nga balatian sa madamo na nga mga lugar diri.
english: Therefore, the authorities are also expecting us to soon achieve “herd immunity” to this disease in many areas here.

text: Sa siyudad sang Iloilo, may mga 50% na ang fully vaccinated, samtang sige ang pag-abot man sang mga bakuna halin sa nagakalain-lain nga sources.
english: In Iloilo City, about 50% are fully vaccinated, while vaccines continue to arrive from various sources.

text: In fact, tungod sa padayon nga pag-abot sang mga bakuna, gin-share na gani ni Mayor Treñas ang pila sini sa pila ka banwa, samtang sige man ang pagpangbakuna diri sa siyudad.
english: In fact, due to the continuous arrival of vaccines, Mayor Treñas has even shared some of them in some towns, while the vaccination continues here in the city.

text: Una na dira sa Metro Iloilo sunod ang pila pa ka banwa sang Iloilo nga nangayo gid sini.
english: First in Metro Iloilo followed by several other towns in Iloilo that requested it.

text:
***

Ang “immunity”, sa wala pa makahibalo, nagatumod sa ikasarang sang lawas sang tawo sa paglutos ukon pagsagang sang pang-atake sang mga mikrobyo nga nagadulot sang balatian, katulad sang mga bacteria kag ang virus nga nagatuga sang COVID-19.
english:
***

Immunity, for those who don't know, refers to the ability of the human body to defeat or prevent the attack of disease-causing microbes, such as bacteria and the virus that causes COVID-19.

text: “Herd ommunity” ang tawag sini kon nagatumod na ini sa  “immunity” sang kadam-an, nga, in effect, naga-provide man sang proteksyon sa mga wala, ukon may mahina, sang “immunity”.
english: It is called “herd ommunity” when it refers to the “immunity” of the crowd, which, in effect, also provides protection to those who do not have, or have weak, “immunity”.

text: Sunu sa mga health expert, ining “herd immunity” batok sa COVID-19 maangkon sang at least mga 60-70% sang populasyon.
english: According to health experts, this “herd immunity” against COVID-19 will be achieved by at least 60-70% of the population.

text: Sa nahibal-an ta man, 80% ang “herd immunity” ang madulot sang anti-rabies vaccine kag mga 90% sa measles.
english: As we know, 80% of herd immunity is provided by anti-rabies vaccine and about 90% by measles.

text:
***

Ang pag-develop sang “immunity” mayor nga trabaho sang mga antibodies (warrior cells) nga yara na kag ma-produce pa dugang sa sulod sang lawas sang tawo agud awayon ang nagaatake nga mga mikrobyo.
english:
***

The development of immunity is the main function of antibodies (warrior cells) that are already present and can be produced in addition to the human body to fight invading microbes.

text: Makabulig man dira ang iban, katulad sang mga T-cells (white blood cells), ang “immunity” nga na-develop sang nag-alayo sa balatian, kag bisan pa ang “cross-reactive protective immunity” nga na-develop sa pagpakig-away sa “similar diseases”.
english: Others can also help, such as T-cells (white blood cells), the immunity developed when recovering from the disease, and even the cross-reactive protective immunity developed to fight similar diseases.

text: Ugaling kon indi na makasarang ang ining immune responses sa pagtapna ukon pagsagang sang mga mikrobyo, gina-rekomendar na ang bakuna (vaccine), katulad sang ginapatigayon sa karon batok sa COVID-19 sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: However, when these immune responses are no longer able to prevent or prevent microbes, a vaccine is recommended, as is currently being done against COVID-19 worldwide.

text: Ining bakuna sa karon ang ginasaligan na agud malab-ut ang “herd iImmunity” para sa madasig nga pagbalik na naton sa normal nga pangabuhi.
english: This vaccine is now being relied upon to achieve “herd iImmunity” for our rapid return to normal life.

text:
***

Sadto, sugod sang pag-igu sang COVID-19 sa kalibutan sadtong una nga bahin sang 2020 nga wala pa ang bakuna, “mild” kag “moderate” lang ang igu sini sa mga 95% sang mga pumuluyo, kag malaka lang ang may “severe” kag “critical” cases.
english:
***

In the past, since the outbreak of COVID-19 in the world in early 2020 before the vaccine, about 95% of the population was “mild” and “moderate” affected, and few had “severe” and “critical” cases.

text: In other words, ang igu sini sa tawo katulad lang sang ordinaryo nga trangkaso nga pwede marisguhan kag indi gawa kahadlukan sang may mabakud sing ikaayong lawas.
english: In other words, its impact on humans is like the ordinary flu that can be risked and not even feared by those in good health.

text: Ugaling lang kay ining COVID-19 may pinasahe nga kadasig sing pagpanglaton nga sobra-sobra sangsa iban nga “respiratory diseases”, katulad gani sang trangkaso.
english: However, this COVID-19 has a unique rate of transmission that is more than other respiratory diseases, such as the flu.

text: Tungod sini, daku nga perhwisyo ini sa pangabuhi.
english: As a result, it is a great loss of life.

text: In fact, tungod sa kadasig sang pagpanglaton sini, kon pabay-an lang, ma-overwhelm sini ang aton mga protective healthcare activities.
english: In fact, because of the speed of its spread, if left unchecked, it can overwhelm our protective healthcare activities.

text: In fact, ang una ta nga eksperyensya nagapakita sang pagsulobra sang mga pasyente sa mga ospital kag sang kinahanglan ma-quarantine kag ma-isolate.
english: In fact, our first experience shows an overcrowding of patients in hospitals and those who need to be quarantined and isolated.

text: Wala man sing segurado pa nga mga bulong batok sa mga “severe” kag critical” cases.
english: There are also no safe treatments against severe and critical cases.

text: Sa masami, ang ginahimo lang amo ang pagpatahaw sang mga sintoma tubtub magpuas kag pag-suporta sang ila pag-ginhawa paagi sa mga ventilators.
english: Often, all that is done is to alleviate the symptoms until they fast and support their breathing with ventilators.

text: Wala man ang aton mga health expert sing mapasalig kon san-o mag-untat ang pagpang-atake sang COVID-19 tungod bag-o lang ini nga balatian.
english: Our health experts cannot guarantee when the attack of COVID-19 will stop because it is a new disease.

text: Kon may pagpasalig man, tungod may bakuna na, ina lang ang ihibalo nga makaangkon ang nabakunahan sing mga 3-6 ka bulan nga “immunity”.
english: If there is any assurance, because there is a vaccine, that is the only knowledge that the vaccinated will have about 3-6 months of “immunity”.

text: Pagkatapos sina kinahanglan na ang mga “booster shot” kon bagay na ipatuman.
english: After that, booster shots are needed when appropriate.

text:
***

Tungod sini, importante nga masunod gid naton ang bagay nga “herd protection”, ukon ang pagpaseguro nga mapabilin ang aton “herd iImmunity” paagi sa paglikaw nga ma-infect kag maka-infect, kag sa liwat nga infection (breakthrough infection) sang mga bakunado.
english:
***

For this reason, it is important that we follow the “herd protection” approach, or ensuring that our “herd immunity” is maintained by avoiding infection and infection, and breakthrough infection of vaccinated people.

text: Mahimo naton ini paagi sa padayon nga pagtuman sang mga pumuluyo sang health protocols – sang mga bakunado man kag indi; ang pagpasanyog sang “infection control” sa mga balantayan nga mga lugar;  pagpasanyog man sang healthcare, labi na gid sa kaso sang mga “severe” kag “critical” cases; kag indi gid pagpasayang-sayang tubtub ma-lift na ang mga “restrictions”.
english: We can do this by ensuring that citizens continue to observe health protocols – both vaccinated and unvaccinated; the promotion of infection control in surveillance areas;  also improve healthcare, especially in the case of severe and critical cases; and don't waste it until the restrictions are lifted.

text: In fact, mas importante ang pagtutok sa karon sa “herd protection” tungod mas madamo na ang mga tawo ang yara sa gwa kag mas exposed sa infection./PN
english: In fact, it is more important to focus on herd protection because more people are outside and more exposed to infection.

text: Kabahin na sang kabuhi sang isa ka indibidwal ang magpamati sang mga ambahanon kag tunog nga nagahalin sa nature kag palibot.
english: It is part of an individual's life to listen to songs and sounds that come from nature and the environment.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, nagakadapat man nga mangin kabahin sang lifestyle sang isa ka indibidwal ang pag-angkon sang ”quiet time” ukon silent moments.
english: However, according to experts, having quiet time should also be part of an individual's lifestyle.

text: Suno kay clinical health psychologist Dr. Amy Sullivan, ang quiet moments ukon malinong nga palibot ang nagabulig sa pag-shut down sang physical response sang lawas sa stress.
english: According to clinical health psychologist Dr. Amy Sullivan, quiet moments help shut down the body's physical response to stress.

text:
Buot silingon, ang paghipos kag pagkalma ang makabulig sa:

Pahayag ni Dr. Sullivan, ang silence ukon kalinong ang nagubilig man sa isa ka indibidwal sa pag-develop sang skills kaangay sang masanyog nga creativity kag communication skills.
english:
This means that silence and calmness will help to:

Statement by Dr. Sullivan, silence also helps an individual develop skills such as creativity and communication skills.

text: Dugang pa sang doktor, natukiban sa isa ka pagtuon sang 2013 nga ang duha ka oras nga kalinong ang nagatuga sang bag-o nga cells sa hippocampus region sang utok nga naangot sa learning, remembering, kag emotions.
english: The doctor added that a 2013 study found that two hours of silence creates new cells in the hippocampus region of the brain associated with learning, remembering, and emotions.

text: Daku nga tyempo sa closing statement ni Atty. Nicholas Kaufman sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang iya ginpain agud i-istorya sa bilog nga kalibutan ang kahimtangan ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Great time in the closing statement of Atty. Nicholas Kaufman at the International Criminal Court (ICC) he set aside to tell the world about the situation of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno sa iya, nabaton na ni Duterte ang iya nga kapalaran kag pati ang posibilidad nga mapatay na lamang ini sa presuhan.
english: He said Duterte has accepted his fate and the possibility of dying in prison.

text: Suno pa sa defense counsel, nagpahayag ang 80-anyos nga anay presidente nga isa siya ka tampad nga alagad sang mga Pilipino, kag luyag niya nga dumdumon siya sa amo nga kinaiya.
english: According to the defense counsel, the 80-year-old former president said he is a faithful servant of the Filipino people, and he wants to be remembered for that character.

text: “I was a faithful servant of the people, and that is how I wish to be remembered.
english: “I was a faithful servant of the people, and that is how I wish to be remembered.

text: I have now accepted my fate, and I realize I could die in prison,” kabahin sang gin-quote ni Kaufman nga ginhambal ni Duterte.
english: I have now accepted my fate, and I realize I could die in prison,” Kaufman quoted Duterte as saying.

text: Sandig pa sa ginsugid ni Kaufman, nag-istorya si Duterte nga nahimo na sini ang iya nga katungdanan kag nabilin na ang iya nga legasiya ukon marka.
english: According to Kaufman, Duterte talked about doing his duty and leaving his legacy.

text: Dugang ni Kaufman, ginsugo siya ni Duterte: “Go to court and do your job, but I can never help you.
english: Kaufman added that Duterte ordered him: “Go to court and do your job, but I can never help you.

text:
I no longer remember much at all, and I can’t comment on people whom I do not know and on statistics that mean nothing to me.”

Gintapos naman ni Kaufman ang iya closing statement sa confirmation hearing paagi sa pagpangabay sa judges nga indi pag-i-confirm ang bisan isa sa mga kaso batok kay Duterte.
english:
I no longer remember much at all, and I can’t comment on people whom I do not know and on statistics that mean nothing to me.”

Kaufman concluded his closing statement at the confirmation hearing by asking the judges not to confirm any of the cases against Duterte.

text: Gin-apelar sini sa chamber nga tugutan na nga makapauli ang former president sa iya puluy-an sa Davao City.
english: He appealed to the chamber to allow the former president to return to his home in Davao City.

text:
‘NONE OF THAT WAS RESPONSIVE TO ARGUMENTS’

Antes nagtakop ang confirmation hearing, nagtindog naman si senior trial lawyer Julian Nicholls kag nag-apelar sa judges nga indi na pag-ilakip sa records ang closing statement nga gin-deliver sang defense counsel.
english:
‘NONE OF THAT WAS RESPONSIVE TO ARGUMENTS’

Before the confirmation hearing ended, senior trial lawyer Julian Nicholls stood up and appealed to the judges not to include in the records the closing statement delivered by the defense counsel.

text: Ang ginapakakas sini sa record amo ang parte sang statement ni Kaufman nga ginpahayag sini nga ginhambal ni Duterte.
english: What he is removing from the record is part of Kaufman's statement that he said Duterte said.

text: “None of that was responsive to arguments, which is what this last 30 minutes were about,” suno sa prosekusyon.
english: “None of that was responsive to arguments, which is what this last 30 minutes were about,” according to the prosecution.

text: Pahayag pa ni Nicholls, indi dapat mag-testify si Kaufman para kay Duterte, bangud nagpamalibad na gani ini nga magkadto sa korte agud magtambong sa proceedings.
english: Nicholls said Kaufman should not testify for Duterte, as he has already refused to go to court to attend the proceedings.

text: “If he wanted to come here, he didn’t want to come here.
english: “If he wanted to come here, he didn’t want to come here.

text: He could have come here and talked about what he wanted to, but he chose not to.
english: He could have come here and talked about what he wanted to, but he chose not to.

text: Mr. Kaufman’s conveying this, he’s been complaining about hearsay all day,” dugang sang senior trial lawyer.
english: Mr. Kaufman’s conveying this, he’s been complaining about hearsay all day,” the senior trial lawyer added.

text: Nagsabat naman si Kaufman nga indi man testimonya ang iya ginhambal, kundi isa lang ka paathag kun ngaa wala nagkadto sa hearing ang former president.
english: Kaufman responded that his statement was not a testimony, but an explanation for why the former president did not attend the hearing.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa pagtakop sang confirmation hearing, may 60 ka adlaw ang judges agud magdesisyon kun ano ang himuon kasunod sang mga argumento kag presentasyon sang defense, prosecution, kag common legal representatives sang drug war victims.#
english: At the end of the confirmation hearing, the judges will have 60 days to decide what to do following the arguments and presentations of the defense, prosecution, and common legal representatives of the drug war victims.

text: Tuman nga nga kalipay ang nabatyagan sang actress nga si Janice De Belen matapos nakaupod sa stage ang iya gina-idolo nga si Korean superstar Song Joong Ki sa iya sini nga ginpatigayon nga fan meet sa isa ka mall sa Pasay.
english: Actress Janice De Belen was overjoyed after her idol Korean superstar Song Joong Ki joined her on stage at her fan meet at a mall in Pasay.

text: Ginpakigbahin sang actress ang mga laragway sa iya social media kun sa diin makita nga gintagaan siya sang bulak kag gin-kup-an ni Joong Ki sa atubang sang mga linibo ka mga supporters.
english: The actress shared pictures on her social media where she was seen being given flowers and hugged by Joong Ki in front of thousands of supporters.

text: Ginpabutyag man ni Janice nga isa si Joong Ki sa iya gina-idolo nga Korean actor, sa diin gin-ako sini nga dako nga bahin sang iya emotional recovery ang K-drama nga ‘Descendants of the Sun’ matapos nga nagtaliwan ang iya iloy.
english: Janice also said that Joong Ki is one of her favorite Korean actors, admitting that the K-drama 'Descendants of the Sun' was a big part of her emotional recovery after her mother passed away.

text: Matandaan nga si Song Joong Ki ang nagsikat bilang Captain Yoo Shi Ji sa Descendants of the Sun kag nagbida man sa mgaK-drama nga Vincenzo kag Reborn Rich, kag amo man sa pelikula nga Space Sweepers.
english: Song Joong Ki became famous as Captain Yoo Shi Ji in Descendants of the Sun and also starred in K-dramas Vincenzo and Reborn Rich, as well as the film Space Sweepers.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang fan meet nga ginpatigayon sa Manila ang labing una nga pagbisita ni Joong ki sa pungsod.
english: The fan meet held in Manila was Joong ki's first visit to the country.

text: Patay ang mag-utod matapos ginpangtiro samtang nagapauli sa ila balay halin sa namatyan sa Brgy.
english: Brothers were shot dead while returning home from a funeral in Brgy.

text: Isit, Dolores, Abra.
english: Isit, Dolores, Abra.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Michael Galera Millare, 29-anyos kag manghod nga si Sherwin Galera Millare, 25-anyos.
english: The victims were identified as Michael Galera Millare, 29, and younger brother Sherwin Galera Millare, 25.

text: Pareho nga nag-angkon sang madamo nga igo sang bala sa lawas ang mag-utod.
english: Both brothers suffered multiple gunshot wounds to the body.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sakay sa motorsiklo ang mag-utod sang ginbanggaan sang mga armado nga lalaki.
english: According to the investigation, the brothers were riding a motorcycle when they were hit by armed men.

text: Nabatian pa sang mga residente ang serye sang lupok sang pusil.
english: Residents even heard a series of gunshots.

text: Isa ka pumuluyo naman ang nakalabay sa lugar kag nadiskubrehan ang lawas sang mga biktima.
english: A resident passed by and discovered the bodies of the victims.

text: Wala pa sang natumod nga possible may kahimuan sang krimen.
english: No possible suspects have been identified.

text: Nagapati ang kilala nga boxing analyst nga si Atty. Ed Tolentino nga kinahanglan magpangibabaw si 8-Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao sa mga una nga round sang iya kompetisyon kay Mario Barrios subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 20, agud may daku siya nga posibilidad nga magdaog.
english: Well-known boxing analyst Atty. Ed Tolentino said 8-Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao needs to dominate the first rounds of his competition with Mario Barrios today, July 20, to have a good chance of winning.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, bisan ara gihapon kay Pacquiao ang kadasig kag kusog sang iya mga sumbag, indi na malikawan ang epekto sang edad nga posible magpabudlay sa iya performance sa ring.
english: According to Tolentino, although Pacquiao still has the speed and strength of his punches, the effects of age cannot be avoided that may complicate his performance in the ring.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang analyst nga apat ka tuig nga nagpahuway si Pacquiao, samtang si Barrios nakasugata na sang mga bantog nga boksidor pareho kanday Gervonta Davis, Keith Thurman, kag Yordenis Ugas, nga amo man ang nagdaog batok sa iya paagi sa unanimous decision sang 2021.
english: The analyst also revealed that Pacquiao took a four-year break, while Barrios has already faced famous boxers like Gervonta Davis, Keith Thurman, and Yordenis Ugas, who also won against him by unanimous decision in 2021.

text: Ginpunto ni Tolentino nga kinahanglan ipabatyag ni Pacquiao ang iya kusog sa umpisa pa lang, kag indi na pagpaabuton nga maglab-ot sa madugay nga mga round ang kompetisyon.
english: Tolentino pointed out that Pacquiao needs to show his strength from the beginning, and not expect the competition to go to long rounds.

text: Ginpahanumdom man sang analyst ang iya kampo nga amligan ang mga tiil ni Pacquiao, ilabi na ang problema niya sa leg cramps, nga may daku nga epekto sa iya footwork, isa sa iya signature nga abilidad sa sulod sang masobra 70 ka mga laban.
english: The analyst also reminded his camp to protect Pacquiao's legs, especially his problem with leg cramps, which have had a significant impact on his footwork, one of his signature skills during more than 70 fights.

text: Posible nga aprubahan ang provisional fare hike para sa tanan nga pampubliko nga transportasyon pananglitan maglab-ot sa P60 kada litro ang presyo sang diesel ukon krudo.
english: It is possible to approve a provisional fare hike for all public transportation if the price of diesel or crude oil reaches P60 per liter.

text: Suno ini kay Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Chairman Vigor Mendoza samtang nga ginaantisipar na ang epekto sang nagapadayon nga gyera sa Middle East.
english: This was stated by Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Chairman Vigor Mendoza while anticipating the impact of the ongoing war in the Middle East.

text: Suno kay Mendoza, ini nga tikang ang makabulig nga mapahagan-hagan ang palas-anon sang public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers kag operators, samtang ginakonsiderar man ang ikaayo sang mga pasahero.
english: According to Mendoza, this move will help ease the burden of public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers and operators, while also considering the welfare of passengers.

text: Pananglitan magtahaw na ang tension sa Middle East kag magnubo naman ang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo, iga-withdraw man ukon bawion gilayon ang pagpasaka sa plete.
english: If tensions in the Middle East ease and the price of petroleum products falls, the fare increase will be withdrawn or withdrawn immediately.

text: Gin-athag sini nga indi man nila luyag nga sukton sang mahal ukon i-overcharge ang mga pasahero.
english: He explained that they do not want to overcharge passengers.

text: Ginpasalig man sang chairman nga ang una nga himuon sang ahensya amo ang paghatag sang fuel subsidies sa PUVs sa baylo nga magpasaka sang plete.
english: The chairman also assured that the first thing the agency will do is to provide fuel subsidies to PUVs instead of raising fares.

text: Handa na ang LTFRB suno sa iya sa pag-umpisa sa pag-release sang subsidiya kun maglab-ot na ang presyo sang Dubai crude oil sa $80 per barrel.
english: He said the LTFRB is ready to start releasing subsidies when the price of Dubai crude oil reaches $80 per barrel.

text: “We are more ready than before, in the sense na ang dami na nating prep work na ginagawa, not only here in the central office, but even down to the ground, yung regional offices natin, na masama lahat ng dapat isama,” suno kay Mendoza.
english: “We are more ready than before, in the sense that we have a lot of prep work that we are doing, not only here in the central office, but even down to the ground, our regional offices, that everything should be included,” Mendoza said.

text: “As soon as the funds are out, ibaba na kaagad namin yan.
english: “As soon as the funds are out, we will lower it immediately.

text: Ang hinihintay lang nila, araw, hindi lingo.”#
english: They're just waiting for a day, not a lingo.”#

text: Mamangkot anay si Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla sa International Criminal Court (ICC) kun pasugtan sini ang Pilipinas nga magpadala sang consul agud makapanumpa si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla will first ask the International Criminal Court (ICC) if it will allow the Philippines to send a consul to swear in former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ini bangud naka-detain gihapon ang anay president sa The Hague, Netherlands apang nagdaog ini sa 2025 elections bilang alkalde sang Davao City batok sa kasumpong nga si Karlo Nograles.
english: This is because the former president is still detained in The Hague, Netherlands but won the 2025 elections as mayor of Davao City against his opponent Karlo Nograles.

text: Pahayag ni Remulla, ginakilala nila ang pagdaog ni Duterte kag naproklamar na gani ini sang Commission on Elections (Comelec).
english: Remulla said they recognize Duterte's victory and the Commission on Elections (Comelec) has already proclaimed it.

text: Apang dugang sini, antes maka-assume sa opisina, kinahanglan nga maka-sumpa gid ang former president.
english: However, he added that before assuming office, the former president must be sworn in.

text: Samtang wala pa ang amay nga Duterte, ang iya anay bata nga si Sebastian Duterte nga outgoing mayor subong kag na-eleher bilang vice mayor sa 2025 elections amo ang magaserbe nga acting mayor sa Davao.
english: In the absence of Duterte's father, his former son Sebastian Duterte, who is now outgoing mayor and elected vice mayor in the 2025 elections, will serve as acting mayor of Davao.

text: Marso 11 sang gindala sa Europa si Duterte matapos gindakop sa Pilipinas sa alegasyon nga nakakomiter ini sang crimes against humanity bangud sa iya pagpatuman sang drug war.
english: Duterte was brought to Europe on March 11 after being arrested in the Philippines on allegations of committing crimes against humanity for his implementation of the drug war.

text: Natalana ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23.#
english: Confirmation of charges is scheduled for September 23.#

text: Tatlo ka mga opisyal sang barangay ang napatay samtang isa ka pamatan-on nga opisyal ang pilason sa nagluntad nga pagpangluthang sa flag ceremony sa Barangay Salitran, Dasmariñas, Cavite.
english: Three barangay officials were killed while a young official was wounded in a shooting incident at a flag ceremony in Barangay Salitran, Dasmariñas, Cavite.

text: Ang mga napatay ang ginalakipan sang Barangay Kapitan, duha ka miyembro sang konseho, kag ang Sanguniang Kabataan (SK) Secretary nga critically injured.
english: The dead included the Barangay Captain, two council members, and the Sanguniang Kabataan (SK) Secretary who was critically injured.

text: Ginkilala ang suspek kay Alyas Ariel.
english: The suspect was identified as Ariel.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, natabo ang insidente pasado alas 8 sang aga, samtang ginahiwat ang regular nga flag raising ceremony sa barangay hall.
english: According to the investigation, the incident occurred around 8 am, while the regular flag raising ceremony was being held at the barangay hall.

text: Sa video, makit-an nga hinali lang nga naggwa ang suspek kag ginpangtiro ang pila ka opisyal sang barangay.
english: In the video, the suspect can be seen suddenly coming out and shooting several barangay officials.

text: Nahibaluan nga pagkatapos sang krimen, gilayon man niya nga gintiro ang iya kaugalingon.
english: It was learned that after the crime, he immediately shot himself.

text: Ginbuhinan sang 15-minutos ang klase sa elemetarya sa Brgy.
english: Elementary classes in Brgy.

text: Bitoon, Jaro, Iloilo City bangud sa tuman ka init nga tyempo nga nagadala sang mataas nga heat index.
english: Bitoon, Jaro, Iloilo City due to the extremely hot weather that brings high heat index.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Amy Rafio Buenafe, principal sang Bitoon Elementary School, iya ginpahayag nga ang halin Kinder tubtob Grade 3, nagasugod ang klase alas-7 sa aga tubtob sa ala-11 sa udto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Amy Rafio Buenafe, principal of Bitoon Elementary School, said that from Kinder to Grade 3, classes start at 7 am until 11 pm.

text: Samtang, ang halin Grade 4 tubtob Grade 6, nagasugod ang klase,a alas-7 sa aga tubtob alas-11:30 sang udto.
english: Meanwhile, from Grade 4 to Grade 6, classes start at 7 am until 11:30 pm.

text: Suno kay Buenafe, ang tikang nakasanto sa man department order sang talatapan.
english: According to Buenafe, the move is in line with the man department order of the office.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kon maglab-ot na sa 42 degrees Celsius ang heat index, naga-shift na sila sang modular modality.
english: He also explained that when the heat index reaches 42 degrees Celsius, they shift to the modular modality.

text: Nagpasigurado man ang natungdan nga wala sang ma-miss nga lessons ang mga estudyante apisar sang pag-shift sang learning mode.
english: He also assured that the students will not miss any lessons despite the shift of learning mode.

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nga nagpaguwa sang executive order si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga mahimo magakanselar sang klase kon magalab-ot sa 40 degrees Celsius.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas has already issued an executive order that may cancel classes if the temperature reaches 40 degrees Celsius.

text: Masobra 600 ka mga buluthuan sa Western Visayas ang nag-shift sa alternative delivery mode (ADM) kasunod sang mataas nga heat index sa rehiyon.
english: More than 600 schools in Western Visayas have shifted to alternative delivery mode (ADM) following the high heat index in the region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar, Jr., iya ginpahayag nga 5 division ang nagkanselar sang klase sa rehiyonkon sa diin, masobra 381,000 ang apektado nga learners.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar, Jr., he said that 5 divisions have canceled classes in the region where, more than 381,000 learners are affected.

text: Santo sa data, 93 ang nagpatuman sang hybrid learning; 101 ang Dynamic Learning Program, kag 458 naman ang nagapatuman sang Self-Learning Modules (SLMs).
english: According to the data, 93 implemented hybrid learning; 101 are Dynamic Learning Program, and 458 are implementing Self-Learning Modules (SLMs).

text: Suno kay Escullar, ang sitwasyon sang tagsa ka eskwelahan ang gina-report sa school heads kag magakoordinar sa school superintendent agud mahatagan sang intervention.
english: According to Escullar, the situation of each school is reported to the school heads and will coordinate with the school superintendent to provide intervention.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang nabalhag nga health related incident ang talatapan.
english: So far, the office has not recorded any health related incidents.

text: Dako nga bulig para sa mga tricycle drivers and operators ang ginhatag nga P5,000 nga cash assistance sang Department of Social Welfare and Development diri sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The P5,000 cash assistance given by the Department of Social Welfare and Development here in Iloilo City is a big help for tricycle drivers and operators.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jaime Balbino, isa ka tricycle driver kag isa sa mga nakabaton sang cash assistance, iya ginpahayag nga makapiyan-piyan ang amo nga kwarta para sa ila nga pang-gatong amo man sa ila iban nga galastuhon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jaime Balbino, a tricycle driver and one of the recipients of the cash assistance, said the money will be enough for their fuel as well as their other expenses.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga umpisa nga nagtaas ang presyo sang gatong nabudlayan na sila nga magpangita sang pasahero bangud nga nagtaas man ang presyo sang plete.
english: He said that since the price of fuel increased, they have had difficulty finding passengers because the price of fares has also increased.

text: Nagapanawagan ini sa gobyerno nga kuntani mapanubuan ang presyo sang gatong bangud ngakun magapadayon pa ini nga krisis ang mga pigado gid ang tuman nga mabudlayan kag ang makaluluoy.
english: He called on the government to reduce the price of fuel because if this crisis continues, the poorest will suffer the most and the poor.

text: Nahibaluan nga target sang Department of Social Welfare and Development diri sa syudad sang Iloilo nga matagaan ang 1,983 ka tricycle drivers and operators.
english: It is known that the Department of Social Welfare and Development here in Iloilo City targets to provide 1,983 tricycle drivers and operators.

text: Ginhiwat ang pagtagtaganay sa M.H. Del Pilar Gym sa Jaro, sa Lapaz gym sa Lapaz, Iloilo City kag gym sa Brgy.
english: The award ceremony was held at M.H. Del Pilar Gym in Jaro, Lapaz gym in Lapaz, Iloilo City and gym in Brgy.

text: Zamora-Melliza.
english: Zamora-Melliza.

text: Nagnubo ang kaso sang Violence Against Women and Children (VAWC) sa Western Visayas suno sa Women and Children Protection Desk (WCPD) sang Police Regional Office 6.
english: The number of cases of Violence Against Women and Children (VAWC) in Western Visayas has decreased, according to the Women and Children Protection Desk (WCPD) of the Police Regional Office 6.

text: Santo sa data sang talatapan, sang Enero tubtob Pebrero 2024, may yara sang 233 ka mga kaso sang Violence against Children (VAC) nga nagnuba sa 136 subong nga tuig.
english: According to the office's data, from January to February 2024, there were 233 cases of Violence against Children (VAC) which decreased to 136 this year.

text: Sa bahin sang Violence Against Women, 215 ka mga kaso ang na-record sang nagligad nga tuig kag 127 naman subong nga tuig.
english: In terms of Violence Against Women, 215 cases were recorded last year and 127 this year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Rado kay Police Captain Jolly Baylon Canindo, chief sang WCPD 6, iya ginpahayag nga sa amo nga mga kaso sang VAWC, nagapanguna diri ang physical, emotional and psychological abuse.
english: In an interview with Bombo Rado, Police Captain Jolly Baylon Canindo, chief of WCPD 6, said that in such cases of VAWC, the main ones are physical, emotional and psychological abuse.

text: Suno kay Canindo, sa pag-conduct sang prevention sa VAWC sa bahin sang mga kapulisan, nagapatuman sang awareness campaign online, community engagement kag simultaneous implementation sang warrant of arrest under RA 8353 ukon Anti-Rape Law of 1997 kag other related cases.
english: According to Canindo, in conducting the prevention of VAWC on the part of the police, implementing awareness campaign online, community engagement and simultaneous implementation of warrant of arrest under RA 8353 or Anti-Rape Law of 1997 and other related cases.

text: Sa amo nga tikang, may ara sang 51 ka mga wanted person ang naaresto nga may kaso nga rape sa bilog nga rehiyon.
english: In this move, a total of 51 wanted persons were arrested with rape cases in the entire region.

text: Lakip man diri ang padayon nga advocacy program kag pag presentar sang best practices sang WCPD investigators.
english: This also includes the ongoing advocacy program and presentation of best practices by WCPD investigators.

text: Dugang ni Canindo, sa bulig sang social media, sa mga nabaton nila nga reports natuhoy sa missing minors, isa ini ka pamaagi nga magadugang sa ila ihibalo kag pagpatuman sang immediate investigation.
english: Canindo added that with the help of social media, in the reports they received regarding missing minors, this is a way to increase their knowledge and implementation of immediate investigation.

text: Posible nga ma-umpisahan na subong nga adlaw, Abril 25, ang amat-amat nga pag-evacuate sa nabilin nga mga overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) halin sa Sudan.
english: The gradual evacuation of the remaining overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) from Sudan is likely to begin today, April 25.

text: Kun basehan ang pahayag sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) kahapon, umpisahan ang evacuation sa sulod sang 24 oras.
english: Based on the statement of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) yesterday, the evacuation will begin within 24 hours.

text: Suno kay Foreign Affairs Undersecretary Eduardo Jose De Vega, kada batch ang pag-evacuate — pwede mag-byahe sakay sa bus padulong sa Egypt, ukon pwede man nga mag-agi sa dagat padulong naman sa Port of Sudan.
english: According to Foreign Affairs Undersecretary Eduardo Jose De Vega, the evacuation will be done in batches — either by bus to Egypt, or by sea to the Port of Sudan.

text: Suno pa sa DFA, may yara na sang gin-arkilahan nga evacuation buses kun sa diin posible maglawig sang 15 ka oras ukon mas malawig pa ang byahe padulong sa southern Egypt.
english: According to the DFA, evacuation buses have already been chartered which could take 15 hours or longer to travel to southern Egypt.

text: Dal-on ang evacuees sa syudad sang Aswan kun sa diin may airport pa-Cairo.
english: The evacuees will be taken to Aswan City where there is an airport to Cairo.

text: Gin-update man sang ahensya nga may 696 ka mga rehistrado nga Pinoy sa Sudan, kag 156 diri ang may yara na sang travel documents kag handa na nga i-evacuate sa bisan ano nga oras.
english: The agency also updated that there are 696 registered Filipinos in Sudan, and 156 of them already have travel documents and are ready to be evacuated at any time.

text: Suno sa Philippine embassy sa Cairo, Egypt, 300 Filipinos ang nagpangayo sang bulig agud nga ma-rescue.
english: According to the Philippine embassy in Cairo, Egypt, 300 Filipinos asked for help to be rescued.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag nga may tatlo ka Pinoy nga naga-trabaho sa airline sang Saudi nga naka-base sa Sudan ang una na nga nadala sa evacuation paagi sa bulig sang Saudi Arabia.
english: Earlier, it was reported that three Filipinos working for the Saudi airline based in Sudan were evacuated with the help of Saudi Arabia.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginatos na ang patay kag linibo ang nasamaran bangud sa nagapadayon nga away sa tunga sang Sudanese forces kag paramilitary groups sa kapital nga syudad nga Khartoum.
english: Hundreds have been killed and thousands injured in ongoing fighting between Sudanese forces and paramilitary groups in the capital city of Khartoum.

text: Pito na ka indibidwal ang napatay bangud sa dengue sa Iloilo Province.
english: Seven individuals have died of dengue in Iloilo Province.

text: Base sa data sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office, 935 ang kabug-usan nga kaso sang dengue sa probinsya humalin sang Enero 1 tubtob Marso 8, 2025.
english: Based on data from the Iloilo Provincial Health Office, the total number of dengue cases in the province from January 1 to March 8, 2025 is 935.

text: Ang San Joaquin amo ang nagapanguna sa may pinakamataas nga kaso sang dengue nga may 69.
english: San Joaquin has the highest number of dengue cases with 69.

text: Ginasundan sang Oton nga may 58; Leon nga may 56; Cabatuan nga may 45 kag San Dionisio nga may 40 nga kaso sang dengue.
english: Followed by Oton with 58; Leon with 56; Cabatuan with 45 and San Dionisio with 40 dengue cases.

text: Nahibaluan nga naglab-ot na sa 942 ang kabug-usan nga kaso sang dengue sa probinsiya sang Iloilo base sa record PHO sa ika-10 nga morbidity week halin Enero 1 tubtob Marso 8, 2025.
english: The total number of dengue cases in Iloilo province has reached 942 based on PHO records in the 10th morbidity week from January 1 to March 8, 2025.

text: Kon balikan sa nauna nga lima ka narekord nga napatay amo ang duha ka tuig nga bata nga babaye halin sa Tigbauan; isa ka anum ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki gikan sa Pototan, isa ka 11 ka bulan nga lapsag nga lalaki nga taga-Oton, isa ka 67-anyos nga babaye nga taga-Pototan, kag isa ka 71-anyos nga lalaki nga taga-Carles.
english: Looking back at the previous five recorded deaths were a two-year-old girl from Tigbauan; a six-year-old boy from Pototan, an 11-month-old infant boy from Oton, a 67-year-old woman from Pototan, and a 71-year-old man from Carles.

text: Suportado ni Mamamayang Liberal (ML) Partylist representative Leila de Lima ang tikang sang aktres nga si Nadine Lustre nga mag-file sang complaint kasunod sang iya gin-alegar nga mga atake sa iya online.
english: Mamamayang Liberal (ML) Partylist representative Leila de Lima supported actress Nadine Lustre's move to file a complaint following her alleged attacks on her online.

text: Nangin target ang singer-actress sang mga pagpang-harass kag malain nga komento sa social media kaangot sa iya political views sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga eleksyon sa Pilipinas.
english: The singer-actress has been the target of harassment and negative comments on social media regarding her political views in the recently concluded Philippine elections.

text: Isa siya sa mga nagapanguna nga naga-endorso sang ML Partylist.
english: He is one of the main endorsers of the ML Partylist.

text: Pahayag ni De Lima, tuman ka importante ang pag-file sang reklamo kaangay sini bangud naandan na nga ginagamit ang social media subong agud nga pahipuson ang mga nagahambal para sa hustisya kag reporma.
english: De Lima said it is very important to file a complaint like this because it is common to use social media to silence those who speak for justice and reform.

text: Ginagamit man suno kay De Lima ang plataporma para gub-on ang kuntani maayo nga diskurso kag bayluhanay sang opinion.
english: De Lima said the platform is also being used to destroy what should be good discourse and exchange of opinions.

text: Bisan pa may yara sang freedom of expression suno sa representative-elect, dapat nga indi ini paggamiton sa pagtapak sa kinamatarong, dignidad, kag demokrasya.
english: Even if there is freedom of expression according to the representative-elect, it should not be used to trample on rights, dignity, and democracy.

text: “This is a necessary step in a time when social media is being used to silence voices that speak for justice and reform.
english: “This is a necessary step in a time when social media is being used to silence voices that speak for justice and reform.

text: Ginagamit ang mga plataporma para buwagin ang makabuluhang diskurso at palitan ito ng galit at paninira,” kabahin sang statement ni De Lima.
english: Platforms are used to divide meaningful discourse and replace it with anger and destruction,” De Lima said in a statement.

text: Wala pa sang dugang nga statement nga ginpaguwa si Nadine kun sanday sin-o ang iya gin-reklamo.
english: Nadine has not yet issued a further statement on who she complained about.

text:
Apang may impormasyon nga nahatag ang boyfriend sini nga si Christophe Bariou kun ano nga klase sang harassment ang nahimo kay Nadine: “Imagine if your girlfriend, wife, sister, mother, or daughter were publicly threatened with rape for simply expressing her opinion.”

Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang Safe Spaces Act, ukon sa Republic Act No.
english:
But her boyfriend, Christophe Bariou, gave information about the kind of harassment Nadine suffered: “Imagine if your girlfriend, wife, sister, mother, or daughter were publicly threatened with rape for simply expressing her opinion.”

Under the Safe Spaces Act, or Republic Act No.

text: 11313, ang gender-based sexual harassment (GBSH) sa public spaces, online, workspaces, kag educational institutions ang mahimo madagdagan sang penalidad sa idalom sang layi.#
english: 11313, gender-based sexual harassment (GBSH) in public spaces, online, workspaces, and educational institutions may be subject to increased penalties under the law.#

text: Nabali gid ang isa ka Grade 6 pupil matapos ginkuga sang iya classmate sa sulod mismo sang ila classroom sa Bugasong, Antique.
english: A Grade 6 pupil was seriously injured after being stabbed by his classmate inside their classroom in Bugasong, Antique.

text: Base sa report, ginpasibangdan sang bata nga nagkuga nga ginsipa siya sang biktima.
english: According to the report, the child claimed that the victim kicked him.

text: Hinali lang nga ginsaruso sang bata ang biktima, kag ginkuga ini tubtob natumba kag nabali ang siko.
english: The child suddenly grabbed the victim, and strangled him until he fell and broke his elbow.

text: Nagtambag naman ang iban nga mga classmates kag nangayo sang bulig agud madala sa ospital ang biktima.
english: Other classmates consulted and asked for help to take the victim to the hospital.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang pamunuan sang eskwelahan nga magabulig sa gasto sang naospital nga estudyante.
english: The school administration promised to help with the expenses of the hospitalized student.

text: Ginpangayuan naman sang DepEd Schools Division Office sang paathag ang principal kag district supervisor sang Bugasong.
english: The DepEd Schools Division Office asked the principal and district supervisor of Bugasong for an explanation.

text: Ginpatawag man ang mga ginikanan sang duha ka mga involved nga estudyante.
english: The parents of the two involved students were also summoned.

text: Kun gintukso sang defense counsel nga si Atty. Nicholas Kaufman ang mainstream media sa Pilipinas sa iya opening statement, wala pa ini natapos, bangud ginpuntariya sini liwat ang media sa iya closing statement sa ulihi nga adlaw sang confirmation hearing.
english: If tempted by defense counsel Atty. Nicholas Kaufman the mainstream media in the Philippines in his opening statement, it is not over, because he targeted the media again in his closing statement on the last day of the confirmation hearing.

text: Ginmuno sang abogado kun paano gina-report sang media ang iya presentasyon sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
