english: The lawyer criticized how the media reported his presentation at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Pahayag sini, ginapaguwa sang journalists nga nagahimo siya sang iya nga “political speech” kag kulang sa “substance” ang iya nga mga argumento.
english: He said journalists are making it appear that he is making political speeches and that his arguments lack substance.

text: “When I argue that there has been interference in this case at the highest level, relying not on documentation that I have invented, but on documentation given to me by the prosecution as exonerating, they say I’m making a political speech, and that my defense lacks substance,” suno kay Kaufman.
english: “When I argue that there has been interference in this case at the highest level, relying not on documentation that I have invented, but on documentation given to me by the prosecution as exonerating, they say I’m making a political speech, and that my defense lacks substance,” according to Kaufman.

text: “And when I devote more time than the prosecution and the victims together to legal arguments and challenging the evidence, they say I’m nitpicking,” dugang niya.
english: “And when I devote more time than the prosecution and the victims together to legal arguments and challenging the evidence, they say I’m nitpicking,” he added.

text: Pahayag sini, maayo na lang bangud may yara sang Pre-Trial Chamber I nga amo suno sa iya ang naga-apresyar sang “presumption of innocence” kag amo ang naga-usisa sang maayo sa mga ebidensya.
english: He said it is good that there is a Pre-Trial Chamber I which he said appreciates the presumption of innocence and examines the evidence carefully.

text: Matandaan nga sa iya imbukada nga statement sang Lunes, nagpahayag si Kaufman nga ginapili lang sang media ang kontrobersyal nga mga parte sang speeches ni Duterte, kag gina-utod naman ang mga porsyon sang iya pahayag nga indi na interesante.
english: In his opening statement on Monday, Kaufman said the media is only selecting the controversial parts of Duterte's speeches, and cutting the portions of his statement that are no longer interesting.

text: Pebrero 28 sang nagtakop ang confirmation of charges hearing batok kay Duterte.
english: The confirmation of charges hearing against Duterte ended on February 28.

text: May 60 ka adlaw ang judges agud magdesisyon kun ano ang himuon kasunod sang mga argumento kag presentasyon sang defense, prosecution, kag common legal representatives sang drug war victims.#
english: The judges have 60 days to decide what to do following the arguments and presentations of the defense, prosecution, and common legal representatives of the drug war victims.

text: Dehydrated, indi halos makahambal, maluya, kag tuman ka niwang.
english: Dehydrated, barely able to speak, weak, and extremely emaciated.

text: Ina ang sitwasyon sang 50-anyos nga manugpangisda sang nakit-an ini sa tunga sang dagat nga sakop sang Batanes matapos nga 46 ka adlaw nga na-report nga missing.
english: That's the situation of a 50-year-old fisherman who was found in the middle of the sea in Batanes after being reported missing for 46 days.

text: Ini amo si Robin Dejillo nga nakasakay pa sa gamay sini nga sakayang-pandagat sang tion nga nakit-an siya sang crew sang isa ka cargo boat.
english: This is Robin Dejillo who was still aboard his small boat when he was found by the crew of a cargo boat.

text: Nakalampuwas ini sa masobra isa ka bulan nga pagtinir sa dagat paagi sa pag-inom sang tubig-ulan kag pagmantinir sa isda nga iya nahulik.
english: It survived more than a month at sea by drinking rainwater and maintaining the fish it caught.

text: Ginkaon man sini ang bunga sang niyog nga nakit-an niya nga nagalutaw sa dagat.
english: He also ate a coconut fruit that he found floating in the sea.

text: Base sa incident report sang Coast Guard District Southern Tagalog sang Agusto 12, ginpahayag nga kaupod si Dejillo sa crew sang fishing boat nga FBca Leah June nga naghalin sa Purok Rosas, Brgy.
english: According to the incident report of the Coast Guard District Southern Tagalog on August 12, Dejillo was among the crew of the fishing boat FBca Leah June from Purok Rosas, Brgy.

text: Dinahican, Infanta, Quezon sang Hulyo 16 para magpangisda sa Pacific Ocean.
english: Dinahican, Infanta, Quezon on July 16 to go fishing in the Pacific Ocean.

text: Sang Agusto 4 sang aga, nagsakay si Dejillo sa gamay nga support boat nga FBca Leah June para magpangita sang lain nga fishing ground.
english: On August 4 morning, Dejillo boarded the small support boat FBca Leah June to look for a different fishing ground.

text: Wala na ini nakabalik sa mother boat apisar nga ginpaabot kuntani ini sang iya mga kaupdanan nga magbalik sang hapon sang amo man nga adlaw.
english: He did not return to the mother boat although his companions expected him to return in the afternoon of the same day.

text: Sang ulihi, sang Agusto 10, nagbalik ang iya mga kaupdanan sa Infanta kag gindeklarar nga missing ang ila kaupod.
english: Finally, on August 10, his companions returned to the Infanta and declared their companion missing.

text: Insigida nga nagpatigayon ang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) sang search and rescue operation sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Quezon kag Aurora kun sa diin ulihi siya nakit-an antes na-missing.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) immediately conducted a search and rescue operation in the waters of Quezon and Aurora where he was later found before going missing.

text: Sini lang nga Huwebes, nakaagi ang isa ka cargo boat nga nagabyahe sa Batanes kag gilayon nga nagbulig ang crew sang nakit-an nila ang nagapalangluya nga lalaki nga nagasakay sa gamay sini nga baroto.
english: This past Thursday, a cargo boat sailing to Batanes passed by and the crew immediately came to the rescue when they saw the weak man riding in his small boat.

text: Gindala ini sa Batanes General Hospital kag gindapatan sang medikasyon bangud man sa indi maayo nga kondisyon tunga sang malawig nga sinemana nga pagtinir sa tunga sang dagat.#
english: He was brought to the Batanes General Hospital and was given medication due to his poor condition after a long week in the middle of the sea.

text: Pasok sa itinakdang weight limit sina Manny Pacquiao at Mario Barrios para sa kanilang nalalapit na WBC welterweight title fight.
english: Manny Pacquiao and Mario Barrios will enter the weight limit for their upcoming WBC welterweight title fight.

text: Ginawa ang opisyal na weigh-in sa Las Vegas, Nevada, USA pasado alas-kuwatro ng madaling araw (oras sa Pilipinas) ngayong araw.
english: The official weigh-in was held in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA around 4:00 pm (Philippine time) today.

text: Timbang ni Pacquiao ay 146.8 pounds, habang 146.2 pounds naman ang timbang ng kanyang makakalaban na si Barrios.
english: Pacquiao weighs 146.8 pounds, while his opponent Barrios weighs 146.2 pounds.

text: Alinsunod sa regulasyon, kinakailangang hindi lalampas sa 147 pounds ang timbang ng mga boksidor para sa kanilang 12-round world championship bout.
english: According to the regulations, boxers must weigh no more than 147 pounds for their 12-round world championship bout.

text: Inaabangan ng buong sambayanang Pilipino ang pagbabalik sa ring ng nag-iisang eight-division world champion na si Manny Pacquiao.
english: The entire Filipino nation is looking forward to the return of the only eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao to the ring.

text: Muli siyang lalaban kontra sa kasalukuyang WBC welterweight champion na si Mario Barrios bukas ng umaga (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: He will fight again against current WBC welterweight champion Mario Barrios tomorrow morning (Philippine time).

text: Isa ka bala sa mahilig magpalaba sang imo buhok, kaangay ni Rapunzel?
english: Are you one who likes to let your hair grow long, like Rapunzel?

text: May mga tawo nga tinuig pa antes makapagunting sang ila nga buhok.
english: Some people take years to cut their hair.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, ang tuman nga pagpalaba sang buhok ang makahatag sang negatibo nga resulta sa ikaayong lawas.
english: However, according to experts, excessive hair growth can have negative health consequences.

text: Suno kay Dr. Cynthia Cobb, nurse practitioner in women’s health, aesthetics and cosmetics, kag skin care sa Estados Unidos, nagakadapat nga kada duha tubtob apat ka bulan, gina-trim ang mga buhok agud nga malikawan ang breakage ukon split ends nga nagaresulta sa pagkaguba sang buhok.
english: According to Dr. Cynthia Cobb, nurse practitioner in women’s health, aesthetics and cosmetics, and skin care in the United States, it is recommended that every two to four months, hairs are trimmed in order to prevent breakage or split ends that result in hair breakage.

text: Isa man suno kay Cobb sa ginahalinan sang stress hormones amo ang ”frustration” ilabi na kun wala sang kumpyansa ang isa ka indibidwal sa iya nga hairstyle kag masami ini nga nagakadugayan kag nabudlayan sa paghusay sang malaba nga buhok.
english: Cobb said one of the sources of stress hormones is frustration especially when an individual is not confident in his hairstyle and it often takes longer and is difficult to fix long hair.

text: Ini ang rason pahayag ni Cobb kun ngaa nagakadapat tipigan sang maayo ang buhok bangud dako ang epekto sini sa emosyonal kag pisikal nga aspeto sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: Cobb said this is the reason why hair should be well maintained because it has a great impact on the emotional and physical aspects of an individual.

text: Dugang pa sang doktor, mas healthy ang tubo sang mga buhok kun regular ini nga ginapaguntingan.
english: The doctor added that hair growth is healthier if it is cut regularly.

text: Naga-release man ang lawas sang mga “feel-good” hormone, kaangay sang dopamine kag serotonin nga nagapasanyog sang mood kag motor system function kun kuntento ang isa ka indibidwal sa iya nga ”looks” kag hairstyle.
english: The body also releases feel-good hormones, such as dopamine and serotonin, which promote mood and motor system function when an individual is satisfied with his or her looks and hairstyle.

text: MALAPIT na ang eleksyon sang 2022, kag mapuno naman ang aton mga dulunggan sa mga pangako sang mga pulitiko.
english: THE 2022 election is just around the corner, and our ears will once again be filled with promises from politicians.

text: Ang pamangkot: Mapatuman bala nila ining mga pangako para sa interes sang mga pumuluyo?
english: The question is: Can they deliver on these commitments in the interest of citizens?

text: Unfortunately, ang aton experyensya nagasiling nga kalabanan sa ining mga pangako indi gid matuman.
english: Unfortunately, our experience says that most of these commitments will never be fulfilled.

text: Kag kon matuman man sang pila nga masaligan ang ila pangako, sa masami indi man lubos matigayon tungod sa ini ukon ina nga rason.
english: And even if some can reliably keep their promise, it is often not fully available for one reason or another.

text: Pwede man ma-justify ini sang pila ka pumuluyo.
english: Some residents can justify it.

text: Pwede man ugaling nga indi.
english: However, it may not be.

text: On the other hand, may mga pangako man nga indi bagay tagaan sing kabilinggan sang aton matarong nga mga pumuluyo kay indi man matarong ang pagpatuman sini.
english: On the other hand, there are also promises that should not be given importance by our righteous citizens because they are not right to implement.

text: Sa English pa, “the end does not justify the means”, nga ginatindugan sang isa ka matarong nga sosyedad katulad sang aton Demokrasya kon diin dapat ipadaug ang “rule of law”, Kahilwayan, kag moral victory sang aton Christian life.
english: In English, “the end does not justify the means”, which is built on a just society like our Democracy where the rule of law, freedom, and moral victory of our Christian life must prevail.

text: Indi mabaton sang konsyensya, por ejemplo, ang pagpatigayon sang isa ka “good” nga kahimtangan sa sosyedad paagi sa malain (evil) nga pamaagi.
english: It is not acceptable to conscience, for example, to achieve a “good” social status through evil means.

text: Katulad sang pagpamilit nga mapalinong ang komunidad paagi sa pagpatay sang mga suspetsado nga indi man lang mabatian ang ila bahin.
english: It is like insisting on pacifying the community by killing suspects whose side is not even heard.

text: Labi na gid nga indi ini matarong kon magwa nga inosente pa gani ini kon mapaatubang sa “fair trial”.
english: It is especially unfair if it turns out that he is innocent even if he faces a “fair trial”.

text: Kon may grupo nga amo sina ang pamatasan, abaw indi gid kamo magboto sa ila!
english: If there is a group that behaves like that, don't vote for them!

text: Mahadlok man kamo sa Diyos sa pagboto sa sining klase nga mga tawo!
english: Fear God by voting for these kinds of people!

text: Makasala pa kamo sa Diyos by complicity.
english: You can still sin against God by complicity.

text:
***

Indi na kandidato si VP Leni Robredo sang Liberal Party para Presidente sa iya desisyon nga magdalagan na gid lang nga wala sing Partido kag bilang isa na lang ka kandidato Independiente.
english:
***

VP Leni Robredo of the Liberal Party is no longer a candidate for President in her decision to run without a party and as an Independent candidate.

text: In effect, bukas na siya sa pagpili sang tanan nga mga pumuluyo regardless kon ano man nga Partido ang huyog nila.
english: In effect, he is open to the choice of all citizens regardless of their party affiliation.

text: In fact, indi oso sa mga Filipino ang block voting, ukon ang magboto straight halin sa linyada sang Partido.
english: In fact, block voting, or voting straight from the Party line, is not a bear for Filipinos.

text: Personality oriented sila sa ila pagboto, kag bisan may huyog sila nga palabihon ang isa ka Partido agud suportahan, may pila gid dira nga luyag nila nga mas “nahagugmaan” nga botohon.
english: They are personality oriented in their voting, and although they tend to prefer one party to support, there are some that they would like to vote for more “loved”.

text: In other words, GUGMA ang ila daku nga talaksan sang ila boto upod ang KAISUG agud pangapinan ang ila interes.
english: In other words, LOVE is their great criterion of their vote along with COURAGE to defend their interests.

text: Bilang Independiente nga kandidato, ginabuksan ni VP Leni ang kahigayunan nga matun-an siya “higugmaon” sang mga pumuluyo over and above sa kon ano man nga konsiderasyon pang-partido, kag, sa iya bahin, patungdan sing may kaisug ang katumanan sang kaayuhan sang tanan.
english: As an Independent candidate, VP Leni opens up the opportunity to learn to be “loved” by the people over and above any party considerations, and, for her part, to boldly pursue the fulfillment of the common good.

text: Bukas man siya sa mga may luyag makig-guest candidate upod sa iya kay may daku siya nga ganhaan sa ila tungod gani wala siya sing Partido.
english: He is also open to those who want to guest candidate with him because he has a big door for them because he does not have a party.

text: Bukas man siya sa luyag magbulig nga mga grupo, lakip na ang sadto ginapangunahan nga Liberal Party.
english: He is also open to groups that want to help, including the then-led Liberal Party.

text: Nagpahayag na gani ini sing full support sa iya.
english: It has even expressed full support for him.

text: Masaligan man niya ang bulig pinansyal kag simpatiya sang nagapati sa iya kilala na nga panindugan social, moral, kag pang-ekonomiya.
english: He can also count on the financial support and sympathy of those who believe in his well-known social, moral, and economic stand.

text: Etcetera!
english: Etcetera!

text:
***

Kon maisyu man ang problema sang pag-kampanya sang Independiente nga kandidato, indi ini problem kay VP Leni.
english:
***

If the problem of campaigning for an Independent candidate is raised, it is not a problem for VP Leni.

text: Kilala na siya kag yara man ang madamo nga outlet, nga madamo sini libre, katulad sang social media kag VP Leni for Presidente nga mga grupo sa nagakalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: She is well known and has many outlets, many of which are free, such as social media and VP Leni for Presidente groups in various parts of the country.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Gin-kondena sang duha ka senador ang bag-o nga insidente sang agresyon sang China Coast Guard (CCG) batuk sa duha ka barko sang Pilipinas nga yara malapit sa Pag-asa Cay 2 sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The two senators condemned the recent incident of aggression by the China Coast Guard (CCG) against two Philippine ships near Pag-asa Cay 2 in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Nagakatabo ang insidente samtang nagapadayon sang routine mission ang mga sakayan sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) kaupod ang scientific team agud magkuha sang sampol sang balas sa lugar.
english: The incident occurred while the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) vessels were conducting a routine mission with the scientific team to take sand samples in the area.

text: Ginpahayag ni Senador Jinggoy Estrada, Chairman sang Senate Committee on National Defense nga indi na kahibalo ang publiko sa madugay na nga pagpanghilabot sang China sa maritime scientists kag mga uniformed personnel.
english: Senator Jinggoy Estrada, Chairman of the Senate Committee on National Defense, said the public is no longer aware of China's long-standing interference in maritime scientists and uniformed personnel.

text: Iya pa ginpanugyan nga magpasaka ang Pilipinas sang isa ka mabaskug kag klaro nga diplomatiko nga protesta batuk sa padayon nga paglapas sang China sa mga internasyonal nga layi.
english: He also suggested that the Philippines file a strong and clear diplomatic protest against China's continued violation of international law.

text: Dugang pa ni Estrada, kinahanglan sang Pilipinas nga palaparon kag pabaskugon pa ang alyansa sini sa mga pungsod nga pareho sang panindugan para sa kalinong, kag pagrespeto sa layi sa rehiyon.
english: Estrada added that the Philippines needs to expand and strengthen its alliances with countries that share a commitment to peace and respect for the rule of law in the region.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagapanawagan man si Senador Joel Villanueva sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga tun-an ang tanan nga posible nga tikang agud dayon makapasaka sang bag-o nga diplomatiko nga protesta kontra sa China.
english: Meanwhile, Senator Joel Villanueva also called on the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to study all possible steps to immediately file a new diplomatic protest against China.

text: Lakip ang pila ka mga Pinoy sa 157 ka mga tawo nga gin-evacuate halin sa Sudan sa tunga sang away sang Sudanese forces kag paramilitary groups.
english: Some Filipinos are among the 157 people evacuated from Sudan amid fighting between Sudanese forces and paramilitary groups.

text: Suno sa Saudi Arabian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, ang evacuation ang ginpatigayon sang Royal Saudi Naval Forces.
english: According to the Saudi Arabian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the evacuation was carried out by the Royal Saudi Naval Forces.

text: Lakip sa mga ginpang-evacuate amo ang 91 ka Saudi citizens kag 66 nationals halin sa 12 ka mga pungsod lakip na ang Kuwait, Qatar, United Arab Emirates, Egypt, Tunisia, Pakistan, India, Bulgaria, Bangladesh, Canada, Burkina Faso, kag Pilipinas.
english: Among those evacuated were 91 Saudi citizens and 66 nationals from 12 countries including Kuwait, Qatar, United Arab Emirates, Egypt, Tunisia, Pakistan, India, Bulgaria, Bangladesh, Canada, Burkina Faso, and the Philippines.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga naga-preparar ang gobyerno nga ma-repatriate ang nabilin nga mga Pinoy sa Sudan apisar nga wala naga-operate ang mga airports halin sang nagsugod ang inaway sang Abril 15.
english: that the government is preparing to repatriate the remaining Filipinos in Sudan despite the fact that the airports have not been operating since the war began on April 15.

text: Kun basehan ang latest data halin sa Philippine Embassy sa Cairo, may ginabanta 400 ka Filipinos sa Sudan samtang suno naman sa Department of Foreign Affairs, 86 na ka mga Pinoy ang nag-request sang repatriation.
english: Based on the latest data from the Philippine Embassy in Cairo, there are about 400 Filipinos in Sudan while according to the Department of Foreign Affairs, 86 Filipinos have already requested repatriation.

text: Masobra naman sa 400 ang nagkalamatay kag masobra 3,000 ang nasamaran bangud sa amo nga ginamo.
english: More than 400 people were killed and more than 3,000 injured in the riots.

text: Mangin ang pwersa-militar sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag sang United Kingdom ang naghulag na kag gin-evacuate ang embassy staff halin sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Even the military forces of the United States of America and the United Kingdom have already acted and evacuated embassy staff from that country.

text: Samtang, sa tradisyonal nga pangamuyo sa Saint Peter’s Square sa Rome, naghingyo naman si Pope Francis sang dayalogo sa tunga sang magkaaway nga military factions sa Sudan.
english: Meanwhile, in a traditional prayer in Saint Peter's Square in Rome, Pope Francis called for dialogue between the warring military factions in Sudan.

text: Nag-apelar man ini sa mga tumuluo nga magpangamuyo para sa mga residente sang amo nga pungsod nga naipit sa kinagamo.
english: He also appealed to the faithful to pray for the residents of that country caught in the conflict.

text: Ginapatuman ang half day classes sa pila ka mga buluthuan sa Iloilo City bangud sa tuman ka init sang tyempo nga dala sang dry season.
english: Half day classes are being implemented in some schools in Iloilo City due to the extreme heat brought about by the dry season.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ma.

text: Leeyan Dasmariñas, Grade 2 teacher, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, may yara sang 35 ka mga estudyante nga gina-handle sa isa ka classroom.
english: Leeyan Dasmariñas, Grade 2 teacher, said that currently, there are 35 students being handled in one classroom.

text: Suno kay Dasmariñas, bangud sa gamay ang hulot, nagatuga man ini sang tuman ka init nga heat index sa mga kabataan apisar nga may mga electric fan.
english: According to Dasmariñas, due to the small size of the room, it also causes a very hot heat index for the children despite the electric fans.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kon maglab-ot sa 40 degree celsius ang heat index forecast, halin alas-7 sang aga tubtob alas-11 lamang ang ila ginapatuman nga klase.
english: He also said that if the heat index forecast reaches 40 degrees Celsius, they will only implement classes from 7 am to 11 am.

text: Blended learning naman ang ginapatuman mag-abot sang hapon kon sa diin, paagi sa modular learning kag online learning ang klase.
english: Blended learning is implemented in the afternoon where classes are conducted through modular learning and online learning.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakadependi naman sa school heads ang implementation sang oras sang klase kasunod sang mataas nga heat index.
english: It is known that it is up to the school heads to implement the class hours following the high heat index.

text: Malapit 100 ka mga Pinoy sa Sudan ang nagapangayo sang bulig sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas sa tunga sang inaway sa tunga sang Sudanese army kag paramilitary forces sa Khartoum.
english: Nearly 100 Filipinos in Sudan are seeking assistance from the Philippine government amid fighting between the Sudanese army and paramilitary forces in Khartoum.

text: Suno kay Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega, 39 ang nag-request nga magapauli sa Pilipinas, samtang 47 naman ang naghingyo sang relocation.
english: According to Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega, 39 requested to return to the Philippines, while 47 requested relocation.

text: Kun ang ahensya lang ang papilion suno sa opisyal, mas maayo nga papulion na lamang ang mga Pinoy sa Pilipinas bangud indi estable ang sitwasyon sa Sudan.
english: If the agency is the only one to choose, the official said, it is better to send the Filipinos back to the Philippines because the situation in Sudan is not stable.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang ahensya nga may isa ka Pinoy nga injured matapos naigu sang bala apang amat-amat na ini subong nga naga-recover.
english: The agency also confirmed that one Filipino was injured after being hit by a bullet but is now slowly recovering.

text: Ginabanta may masobra 500 ka mga overseas Filipino workers sa Sudan nga ang kalabanan professors sa international schools, company executives, engineers, kag may yara man sang domestic helpers.
english: There are estimated to be more than 500 overseas Filipino workers in Sudan, most of whom are professors in international schools, company executives, engineers, and domestic helpers.

text: Ginaplanuhan man subong sang ahensya kun paano mabuligan ang mga Filipinos bangud wala pa subong sang flights sa Khartoum.
english: The agency is also planning how to help Filipinos as there are no flights to Khartoum.

text: Kun basehan ang report sang World Health Organization, malapit na sa 300 ang patay kag malapit 3,000 ang injured bangud sa ginamo sa tunga sang army kag paramilitary Rapid Support Forces sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to the World Health Organization, nearly 300 people have been killed and nearly 3,000 injured in clashes between the army and paramilitary Rapid Support Forces in the country.

text: Malapit na sa 100 ang patay sa ikatatlo nga adlaw sang ginamo kag pagsinigabong sa Khartoum nga kapital nga syudad sang Sudan.
english: Nearly 100 people have been killed in a third day of rioting and arson in Khartoum, Sudan's capital city.

text: 97 ang nakumpirma nga nagtaliwan samtang ginpahayag naman sang World Health Organization nga nagakawad-an na sang critical supplies ang mga ospital agud nga mabulong ang mga pilason.
english: 97 have been confirmed dead while the World Health Organization said hospitals are running out of critical supplies to treat the injured.

text: Suno sa doctors’ union sa amo nga pungsod, ginatos ka mga sibilyan ang nagkalapilasan bangud sa amo nga away.
english: According to the doctors' union in the country, hundreds of civilians were injured in the fighting.

text: Pareho naman nga ginbasura sang rival government factions ang panawagan sang iban nga pungsod lakip na sang Amerika nga magpatuman sang ceasefire.
english: Both rival government factions have rejected calls by other countries, including the United States, to implement a ceasefire.

text: Sabado sang aga sang nagsugod ang amo nga patyanay kasunod sang sinemana na nga tensyon sa tunga ni army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan kag sang deputy nga si Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, commander sang daku kag armado nga grupo nga paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.
english: The killings began on Saturday morning following weeks of tension between army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan and deputy Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, commander of the large and armed paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.

text: Una naman nga gin-abisuhan sang embahada sang Pilipinas sa Egypt ang mga Pinoy sa Sudan nga magpabilin anay sa sulod sang balay sa tunga sang nagakatabo nga kinagamo kag away sa Khartoum nga ginpangunahan sang rival generals nga amo ang nakaangkon sang gahum sang 2021 coup.
english: Earlier, the Philippine embassy in Egypt advised Filipinos in Sudan to stay indoors amid the ongoing unrest and fighting in Khartoum led by rival generals who gained power in the 2021 coup.

text: Maraming, maraming salamat sa ating Kalihim ng Department of Education, Education Secretary Edgardo Angara.
english: Many, many thanks to our Secretary of the Department of Education, Education Secretary Edgardo Angara.

text:
[Magsiupo po tayo para puwede kong patagalin ‘yung aking speech.]

Ilocos Norte 1st District Representative Sandro Marcos; Ilocos Norte 2nd District Representative Angelo Barba; Ilocos Norte Provincial Governor Matt Manotoc; the Philippine Sports Commission Chairman Richard Bachmann; mga kalahok ng Palarong Pambansa ng 2025; mga kagalang-galang na mga panauhin; mga kasama ko sa lingkod-bayan; mga binibini at ginoo.
english:
[Let's whistle so I can extend my speech.]

Ilocos Norte 1st District Representative Sandro Marcos; Ilocos Norte 2nd District Representative Angelo Barba; Ilocos Norte Provincial Governor Matt Manotoc; the Philippine Sports Commission Chairman Richard Bachmann; the 2025 National Games; honorable guests; my fellow servants; ladies and gentlemen.

text: [Ilocano] Good evening po sa inyong lahat.
english: [Ilocano] Good evening to you all.

text:
[palakpakan]

Una po sa lahat, sa lahat ng mga ating atleta, sa ating mga coach, lahat ng ating mga trainer, lahat ng ating mga magulang, at mga mahal sa buhay ng ating mga atleta, welcome po sa inyong lahat sa aming ipinagmamalaking probinsya na Ilocos Norte.
english:
[applause]

First of all, to all our athletes, to our coaches, all our trainers, all our parents, and loved ones of our athletes, welcome to all of you in our proud province of Ilocos Norte.

text:
[palakpakan]

Sa ating mga atleta, masaya akong makasama kayo dito ngayon sa Palarong Pambansa.
english:
[applause]

To our athletes, I am happy to be with you here today at the Palarong Pambansa.

text: Alam kong excited at kinakabahan ang ating mga atleta.
english: I know our athletes are excited and nervous.

text: Eh baka pa ‘yung mga iba, hindi na makatulog at hindi makakain.
english: Maybe the others, can't sleep and can't eat.

text: Matapos ang ilang buwan na paghahanda, nandito na kayo upang ipakita ang galing ninyo sa pagsusubok ng sports.
english: After several months of preparation, you are here to show your skills in sports testing.

text: Hindi madali ang inyong pinagdaanan.
english: Your journey was not easy.

text: ‘Yung oras na ipapahinga ninyo na lang dapat, eh gagamitin ninyo pa sa practice at saka sa training.
english: 'The time you should be resting, you will use it for practice and training.

text: Mag-aaral sa umaga, tapos ensayo sa hapon.
english: Study in the morning, then practice in the afternoon.

text: Minsan kulang pa sa gamit o sa panggastos.
english: Sometimes there is a lack of equipment or expenses.

text: Ngunit, wala sa inyo ang sumuko.
english: But, none of you gave up.

text: Araw-araw, nagsisikap kayong tumakbo nang mas mabilis, lumangoy nang mas mabilis at mas mahaba, tumalon nang mas mataas.
english: Every day, you try to run faster, swim faster and longer, jump higher.

text: Kaya naman, kaming lahat bilib sa inyo, sa inyong galing, sa inyong tibay, at sa inyong dedikasyon.
english: So, we all admire you, your skill, your strength, and your dedication.

text:
[palakpakan]

Nakakatiyak ako na kayong lahat ay ninanais niyo, gusto niyo na magkaroon ng medal.
english:
[applause]

I'm sure you all are dreaming, you want to have a medal.

text: Ngunit tandaan niyo, lahat kayo ay kinikilala ng kampeon.
english: But remember, you are all recognized as champions.

text: Kayo ang pinakamagaling sa inyong paaralan.
english: You are the best in your school.

text: Kayo ang pinakamagaling sa inyong probinsya.
english: You are the best in your province.

text: Kayo ang pinakamagaling sa inyong rehiyon.
english: You are the best in your region.

text: Magandang halimbawa kayo sa kabataang Pilipino—na may pangarap sa buhay at determinasyon upang matupad ito.
english: You are a good example to the Filipino youth—with dreams in life and determination to make them come true.

text: Kami naman sa pamahalaan, hangga’t sa abot ng aming makakaya, ginagawa po namin ang lahat para matulungan kayong maging mahusay na manlalaro.
english: We in the management, as much as we can, we do everything to help you become a good player.

text: Ngayong araw, dito sa Palarong Pambansa kayo naman ang kasali.
english: Today, here in the Palarong Pambansa, you are the participant.

text: Sa susunod, kayo na ang kinatawan ng Pilipinas sa Asian Games at saka sa Olympics.
english: Next time, you will represent the Philippines in the Asian Games and then the Olympics.

text: Kaya paghusayan ninyo.
english: So settle it.

text:
[palakpakan]

Puwedeng kayo mayroon… Malay natin dito sa mga kasama natin na ito mayroon diyan na lilitaw na Manny Pacquiao, na Hidilyn Diaz, na Carlos Yulo, na Aira Villegas, na Nesthy Petecio, na EJ Obiena, o Alex Eala.
english:
[applause]

You can have... We know here in our comrades that there will be Manny Pacquiao, Hidilyn Diaz, Carlos Yulo, Aira Villegas, Nesthy Petecio, EJ Obiena, or Alex Eala.

text: Si Hidilyn, nandito pa tayo, kasama natin dito ngayon.
english: Hidilyn, we're still here, she's with us now.

text: Idol Hidilyn!
english: Idol Hidilyn!

text: Mabuhay ka!
english: Long live!

text: Malaki ang dangal na dinala mo sa ating minamahal na bansa.
english: You have brought great honor to our beloved country.

text:
[palakpakan]

Tulad nila, ipagpatuloy lang ninyo ang inyong pangarap.
english:
[applause]

Like them, just pursue your dreams.

text: Mag-training araw-araw, mag-aral nang mabuti, sumunod kayo sa inyong mga magulang, at alagaan ninyo ang inyong kalusugan.
english: Train every day, study hard, obey your parents, and take care of your health.

text: Ang gobyerno ay laging nasa likod ninyo.
english: The government is always behind you.

text: Tutulungan namin kayong maabot ang inyong mga pangarap.
english: We will help you achieve your dreams.

text: Dahil ang panalo ninyo panalo na rin namin.
english: Because your victory is our victory.

text: Pero higit sa pagkapanalo, mas mahalagang matutunan ninyo ang disiplina, ang halaga ng pakikipagkaibigan, at ang mag-enjoy naman sa inyong favorite sport—manalo man o matalo.
english: But more than winning, it's more important to learn discipline, the value of friendship, and to enjoy your favorite sport—win or lose.

text: Tandaan ninyo: Ang taong lumalaban, hindi natatalo.
english: Remember: The person who fights, does not lose.

text: Losers are those who fail to try.
english: Losers are those who fail to try.

text: Winners are those who try, and maybe they fail, but then try again and do not stop trying until they win and succeed.
english: Winners are those who try, and maybe they fail, but then try again and do not stop trying until they win and succeed.

text: Kaya napakahalaga ng papel ng mga magulang ninyo, mga guro, mga coach na nagbibigay sa inyo ng payo at pagmamahal sa bawat hamon na inyong hinaharap.
english: So the role of your parents, teachers, coaches who give you advice and love in every challenge you face is very important.

text: Binibigyang-pugay ko rin ang inyong mga magulang, ang mga lolo, ang mga lola, ninong, ninang, tiyuhin, tiyahin at lahat nang gumabay sa inyo.
english: I also congratulate your parents, grandparents, grandmothers, grandfathers, aunts, uncles, aunts and all who have guided you.

text: Nag-ambag sila ng oras, pera, at panalangin upang suportahan ang inyong pangarap.
english: They contributed time, money, and prayers to support your dream.

text: Kaya’t bago tayo magtapos, nais kong pasalamatan ang lahat ng tumulong na maisakatuparan ang Palarong ito.
english: So before we finish, I want to thank everyone who helped make this Palarong a reality.

text: At ngayon, sa bisa ng kapangyarihang ipinagkaloob sa akin bilang Pangulo ng Republika ng Pilipinas, opisyal kong idinideklara ang pagbubukas ng Palarong Pambansa para sa 2025!
english: And now, by virtue of the power vested in me as President of the Republic of the Philippines, I officially declare the opening of the Palarong Pambansa for 2025!

text: Maraming salamat!
english: Thank you very much!

text: Mabuhay ang mga atleta!
english: Long live the athletes!

text: Mabuhay ang Bagong Pilipinas!
english: Long live the New Philippines!

text:
[palakpakan]

(Transcript: Presidential Communications Office)
english:
[applause]

(Transcript: Presidential Communications Office)

text: Pwedi na maka-enrol ang mga Pilipino nga nagaestar sa Japan sa University of the Philippines Open University (UPOU) paagi sa programa nga UP Ventures for Innovative Transnational Academia ukon UP VINTA.
english: Filipinos living in Japan can now enroll at the University of the Philippines Open University (UPOU) through the UP Ventures for Innovative Transnational Academia or UP VINTA program.

text: Ginapahanagutan sang UP VINTA ang transnational education nga nagahatag kahigayunan sa mga estudyante nga Pilipino sagwa sang pungsod nga makakuha sang degree halin sa pinakauna unibersidad sa Pilipinas.
english: UP VINTA enables transnational education that gives Filipino students abroad the opportunity to earn a degree from the premier university in the Philippines.

text:
Ang UP VINTA ang naga-offer sang lima (5) ka 2-year associate degree programs nga ginalakipan sang, Associate of Arts in Digital Entrepreneurship, Associate of Science in Information Technology, Associate of Science in Instructional Design and Technology, kag Associate in Arts

Ang programa ang naga-gamit sang Open and Distance e-Learning (ODeL), isa ka flexible nga plataporma nga nagahatag kahigayunan sa mga estudyante nga ma malayo sa Pilipinas nga magpadayon sang ila pag-eskwela.
english:
UP VINTA offers five (5) 2-year associate degree programs which include, Associate of Arts in Digital Entrepreneurship, Associate of Science in Information Technology, Associate of Science in Instructional Design and Technology, and Associate in Arts

The program uses Open and Distance e-Learning (ODeL), a flexible platform that allows students who are far away from the Philippines to continue their education.

text: Hindi lang sa Japan bukas ang UP VINTA, kundi pati man sa mga lugar nga United Arab Emirates (UAE), Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, Singapore, kag Qatar, para sa mga Pilipino nga luyag magkuha sang kalidad nga edukasyon bisan sagwa sang pungsod.
english: UP VINTA is not only open in Japan, but also in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Qatar, for Filipinos who want to get quality education even abroad.

text: Wala nadayon ang committee hearing subong nga adlaw sang Committee on Engineering, Construction, and Public Works sang Iloilo City Council kaangot sa pag-veto ni Mayor Jerry Treñas sa road closure para sa proyekto sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: The committee hearing of the Committee on Engineering, Construction, and Public Works of the Iloilo City Council was canceled today regarding Mayor Jerry Treñas' veto of the road closure for the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) project.

text: Ini sa idalom man sa regulation ordinance 2025-045.
english: This is also under regulation ordinance 2025-045.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang rason sa pag-veto sang ordinansa amo bangud sa department order 110 kag ang local government code.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the reason for vetoing the ordinance was due to department order 110 and the local government code.

text: Nagaguwa sa pag-review sang legal sang City Mayor’s Office nga wala nakapatigayon sang pre-construction kag consultation sa local chief executive ang Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) nga isa sa requirement para sa mga proyekto sang syudad.
english: The legal review of the City Mayor's Office revealed that the Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) failed to conduct pre-construction and consultation with the local chief executive which is one of the requirements for the city's projects.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, ang nasambit nga pagsulundan ang wala natuman sang nasambit nga talatapan rason nga wala man mahatagan sang pahanugot para sa road closure.
english: According to Fantilaga, the said rule was not complied with by the said office which is why it was not given permission for the road closure.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga indi pamulitika ang ginahimo sang city government bangud nagasunod lamang sila sa rekisitos.
english: He also explained that the city government is not doing politics because they are only following the requirements.

text: Ginpili ni Pope Leo XIV si Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle bilang bag-o nga titular bishop sang Albano sa Italya.
english: Pope Leo XIV chose Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle as the new titular bishop of Albano in Italy.

text: Antes sini, si Pope Leo XIV mismo ang nagauyat sang amo nga posisyon antes siya nangin Santo Papa.
english: Previously, Pope Leo XIV himself held the position before he became Pope.

text: Ang Diocese sang Albano nga nahamtang malapit sa Roma, isa sa pito ka suburbicarian sees nga tradisyonal nga ginahatag sa mga cardinal bishops ang pinakamataas nga ranggo sa sulod sang College of Cardinals.
english: The Diocese of Albano located near Rome, is one of seven suburbicarian sees that traditionally give cardinal bishops the highest rank within the College of Cardinals.

text: Antes siya ginpili sa Suburbicarian Church sang Albano, si Cardinal Tagle naga-serbi bilang presidente sang Interdicasterial Commission for Consecrated Religious humalin pa sang Disyembre 8, 2019.
english: Prior to his election to the Suburbicarian Church of Albano, Cardinal Tagle had been serving as president of the Interdicasterial Commission for Consecrated Religious since December 8, 2019.

text: Nagserbe man siya sadto bilang ika-32 nga Arsobispo sang Manila halin 2011 tubtob 2020.
english: He also served as the 32nd Archbishop of Manila from 2011 to 2020.

text: Sa subong, si Tagle ang nagserbe man bilang Presidente sang Catholic Biblical Federation, Grand Chancellor sang Pontifical Urbaniana University, kag miyembro sang nagakalain-lain nga departamento kag dicasteries sa Roman Curia.
english: Today, Tagle has also served as President of the Catholic Biblical Federation, Grand Chancellor of the Pontifical Urbaniana University, and member of various departments and dicasteries in the Roman Curia.

text: Ginkilala si Tagle bilang isa sa mga “papabile”, ukon posible nga mangin kahalili ni Pope Francis.
english: Tagle has been identified as one of the “papabiles”, or potential successors of Pope Francis.

text: Isa siya ka karismatikong moderate nga wala nagapangduha-duha sa pagbatikos sa mga kakulangan sang Simbahan, lakip na ang isyu sang sekswal nga abuso sa mga menor de edad.
english: He is a charismatic moderate who does not hesitate to criticize the shortcomings of the Church, including the issue of sexual abuse of minors.

text: Si Tagale ang ginkilala sa bansag nga “Chito,” gin-appoint siya bilang cardinal ni Pope Benedict XVI sang tuig 2012.
english: Tagale, known by the nickname “Chito,” was appointed cardinal by Pope Benedict XVI in 2012.

text: Nagguwa sa pagpangusisa sang independent panel sang medical experts nga makasarang pa si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga mag-atubang kag magpartisipar sa pre-trial proceedings sang International Criminal Court ukon ICC.
english: An independent panel of medical experts has found that former President Rodrigo Duterte is still able to appear and participate in the pre-trial proceedings of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sandig sa findings sang panel, “competent” ang anay presidente para magpakigbahin sa proceedings.
english: According to the panel's findings, the former president is “competent” to participate in the proceedings.

text: Sa siyam ka pahina nga obserbasyon ni ICC deputy prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang, ginpanawagan sini sa ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I nga maghimo na sang konklusyon nga may ikasarang ukon kapasidad pa si Duterte sa mga proceedings sang ICC lakip na sa confirmation hearing.
english: In a nine-page observation, ICC deputy prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang called on the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I to draw a conclusion that Duterte still has the capacity to participate in ICC proceedings including the confirmation hearing.

text: Suno kay Niang, sandig sa medical experts, nakahangop si Duterte sa kaso kag sa mga ebidensya.
english: According to Niang, based on medical experts, Duterte understands the case and the evidence.

text: Nahangpan sini ang pagpatigayon, ang katuyuan, kag ang kunsekwensya dala sang pre-trial proceedings.
english: It understands the conduct, purpose, and consequences of pre-trial proceedings.

text: Makahatag man ini sang instruction sa iya nga abogado para sa preparasyon sa pagdepensa sa iya.
english: It can also give instructions to his lawyer for the preparation of his defense.

text: Ginsiling man sang prosecutor nga nagapakuno-kuno lang si Duterte sang gin-assess ini sang mga eksperto, kag indi mapatihan ang mga reklamo sini kaangot sa iya ikaayong lawas.
english: The prosecutor also said that Duterte was just pretending when he was assessed by experts, and his complaints about his health were not credible.

text: Bangud sini nga findings, ginduso sang deputy prosecutor nga mag-resume na ang proceedings batok sa former president.
english: Based on these findings, the deputy prosecutor proposed that the proceedings against the former president resume.

text: Ginbali naman sang abogado ni Duterte nga si Nicholas Kaufman ang joint report sang panel.
english: Duterte's lawyer, Nicholas Kaufman, rejected the panel's joint report.

text: Nag-request si Kaufman sang “evidentiary hearing”.
english: Kaufman requested an “evidentiary hearing”.

text: Ini agud nga may kahigayunan ang magtimbang nga partido nga maathagan sa konklusyon sang mga eksperto, ang ila rason sa amo nga mga konklusyon, kag ang paagi nga gingamit sang sila ang nag-interview.
english: This is so that both parties have the opportunity to be clarified on the conclusion of the experts, their rationale for such conclusions, and the method used when they interviewed.

text: Matandaan nga una na nag-petisyon ang kampo ni Duterte nga i-adjourn ukon tapuson na ang proceedings bangud malipaton na si Duterte gani nga “unfit” na ini ukon indi makasarang nga mag-atubang sa trial.
english: It can be recalled that Duterte's camp had earlier petitioned to adjourn or end the proceedings because Duterte was forgetting that he was “unfit” or unable to face the trial.

text: Kun balikan, nagtukod ang ICC sang panel nga ginabug-usan sang tatlo ka mga eksperto nga may espesyalisasyon sa forensic psychiatry, neuropsychology, kag geriatric kag behavioral neurology.
english: Looking back, the ICC established a panel consisting of three experts with specializations in forensic psychiatry, neuropsychology, and geriatric and behavioral neurology.

text: Sila ang ginsugo nga mag-determinar kun naga-suprer bala si Duterte sa anuman nga medical condition nga maka-apekto sa iya nga abilidad nga magsunod ukon magpakigbahin sa nagapadayon nga pre-trial proceedings.
english: They are tasked with determining whether Duterte is suffering from any medical condition that would affect his ability to follow or participate in the ongoing pre-trial proceedings.

text: Napilasan sa liog ang isa ka construction worker matapos gin-gulgulan sang iya man kaupod matapos nanghukirap sa Sitio Moning, Barangay Cabadiangan, Sipalay City.
english: A construction worker sustained injuries to his neck after being stabbed by his colleague after begging in Sitio Moning, Barangay Cabadiangan, Sipalay City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Mark Talaver, 37-anyos, residente sang Barangay 5, Sipalay City.
english: The victim was identified as Mark Talaver, 37, resident of Barangay 5, Sipalay City.

text: Ang suspek naman amo si Christopher Ma-alat, 26-anyos, residente sang Barangay Cabadiangan sa amo nga syudad.
english: The suspect was identified as Christopher Ma-alat, 26, resident of Barangay Cabadiangan in the same city.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nag-ugat ang krimen matapos nagpanugid ang asawa sang suspek nga ginhurikap siya sang biktima.
english: According to the investigation, the crime stemmed after the suspect's wife told him that the victim had touched her.

text: Sang gab-i sang Enero 11 kun san-o natabo ang krimen, nagainom-inom sanday Talaver kag Ma-alat.
english: On the night of January 11 when the crime occurred, Talaver and Ma-alat were drinking.

text: Didto na nagkuha ang suspek sang binangon kag gin-gulgulan ang biktima sa liog.
english: The suspect then took out a binangon and stabbed the victim in the neck.

text: Matapos ang insidente, nagsungka man sa otoridad ang suspek.
english: After the incident, the suspect surrendered to the police.

text: Nadala naman sa balay- bululngan ang biktima kag yara na sa hilway nga kahimtangan.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital and is in stable condition.

text: Bisan ano pa ang imo nga rason, sala gid ang pagpangawat.
english: Whatever your reason, stealing is wrong.

text: Piso man ukon minilyon, basta indi imo kag ginkuha mo, pagpangawat man gihapon ang tawag dira.
english: Whether it's pesos or millions, as long as it's not yours and you took it, it's still stealing.

text: Sang damlag lang, may isa ka tawo nga nagtandog sang balatyagon sang kadam-an bangud sa iya ginpakita nga paghinulsol sa iya pagpangawat halos tatlo ka dekada na ang nagligad.
english: Recently, a man touched the hearts of many because of the remorse he showed for his theft almost three decades ago.

text: Sang natabo ang Asian financial crisis sang 1997, may isa ka bata nga nagsaka sa bukid kag nagtaklas sa isa ka templo sa Gyeongsang, South Korea agud nga kuhaon ang ginabanta P1,200 nga donasyon.
english: When the Asian financial crisis occurred in 1997, a child climbed a mountain and climbed a temple in Gyeongsang, South Korea to collect an estimated P1,200 donation.

text: Matapos sadto, nagbalik pa gid siya sa templo agud mangawat liwat, apang nadakpan siya sang monghe, kag ginpunggan ang iya tuyo.
english: After that, he went back to the temple to steal again, but the monk caught him, and stopped his intention.

text: Sa baylo nga magpangakig, nagpiyong lang ang monghe nga daw kaangay nga nagpangamuyo.
english: Instead of becoming angry, the monk simply closed his eyes as if in prayer.

text: Natandog gid ang balatyagon sang bata bangud sa ginhimo sang monghe kag nagpromisa siya nga indi na maghilabot sa mga bagay nga wala niya ginapanag-iyan.
english: The boy was deeply moved by the monk's actions and promised not to interfere in things that did not belong to him.

text: Subong nga 2024, matapos ang 27 ka tuig, nagbalik ang lalaki sa templo, gin-uli niya ang iya ginkawat nga P1,200 kag naghatag pa sang donasyon nga masobra P80,000.
english: In 2024, after 27 years, the man returned to the temple, returned his stolen P1,200 and donated more than P80,000.

text: May ginbilin man ini nga sulat sa donation box sang Tongdo Temple sa Jajangam Hermitage kun sa diin ginsugid sini ang istorya, kag nag-sorry man bangud sa iya nahimo sang bata pa.
english: He also left a letter in the donation box of the Tongdo Temple at Jajangam Hermitage where he told the story, and also apologized for what he did as a child.

text: Dugang sini, manugbata na ang iya asawa kag nagalaum siya nga mangin isa siya ka matarong nga amay paagi sa sini nga bagay.
english: He added that his wife is about to give birth and he hopes that he will be a good father through this.

text: “I’m sorry I didn’t come back earlier.
english: “I’m sorry I didn’t come back earlier.

text: I hope you can think of it as a temporary loan.
english: I hope you can think of it as a temporary loan.

text: I’m expecting a baby soon, and I want to be a proud and honorable father to my child.
english: I’m expecting a baby soon, and I want to be a proud and honorable father to my child.

text: Thank you so much, monk.
english: Thank you so much, monk.

text: I’m sorry again,” kabahin sang apology letter.
english: I’m sorry again,” the apology letter said.

text: Ang gintumod sini nga monghe nga nakadakop sa iya ang nagatinir pa gihapon sa templo kag isa sa pinakanalipay bangud sa iya ginhimo nga pag-uli sang kuwarta.#
english: The monk who arrested him is still staying at the temple and is one of the happiest because of his return of the money.

text: SO FAR, samtang ginasulat naton ining kolum, pila pa lang ka bilog ang naka-file sang ila kandidatura sa palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2022.
english: SO FAR, as we write this column, only a handful have filed their candidacies in the upcoming May 2022 elections.

text: Pero nangin makawiwili na sa publiko ang mga panindugan sang pila sa ila.
english: But the positions of some of them have become of public interest.

text: Nauna gid file diri sa Iloilo City ang aton abyan nga si Mel Carreon sa iya luyag nga magdalagan sa pagka-konsehal sang siyudad.
english: Our friend Mel Carreon filed earlier here in Iloilo City in his desire to run for city councilor.

text: Hambalon mo na ang luyag mo hambalon kay Mel, pero bilib gihapon ang madamo sa iya padayon nga pagdalagan sa sulod sang sobra na sa 10 ka eleksyon bisan pirme lang pierde.
english: Say what you want about Mel, but many still admire his continued running for more than 10 elections despite always losing.

text: As always, ginapahayag niya nga siya “wala partido kag wala partida”.
english: As always, he states that he is “nonpartisan and nonpartisan”.

text: Wala man siya kuno kwarta agud igasto sa kampanya.
english: He said he had no money to spend on the campaign.

text: Matuod man kay ikaw pa gani ang maagda sa iya sing pamahaw sa inyo pagkit-anay.
english: It is also true that you can even invite him to breakfast on your date.

text: Wala siya mag-athag sang iya programa del gobierno.
english: He did not explain his government program.

text: Basi ugaling ang pag-insure (insurance salesman siya) sang tanan batok sa gutom kag kon mawad-an trabaho.
english: Maybe the insurance (he's an insurance salesman) of everything against hunger and unemployment.

text: Indi bala, Mel?
english: Right, Mel?

text: Nagdalagan siya sa pagka-konsehal kag pagka-meyor.
english: He ran for councilor and mayor.

text: Diutayan pa gani magdalagan sa pagka-presidente.
english: Let alone run for president.

text: Napunggan lang siya ugaling sang isa ka abyan nga nagsiling nga imposible ini para sa iya kay wala siya inuggasto sa paglagaw sa bug-os nga pungsod agud mag-kampanya.
english: However, he was stopped by a friend who said that it was impossible for him because he did not have the money to travel across the country to campaign.

text: Nonetheless, ginapabugal gid niya nga siya ang naga-hold sang record sang pinakalawig nga pagpang-kampanya sa kasaysayan sang kalibutan bisan wala ini gina-recognize sang Believe it or Not.
english: Nonetheless, he is proud to hold the record for the longest campaign in the history of the world even though Believe it or Not does not recognize it.

text: Man, pagkatapos pa lang sang isa ka eleksyon, yara na siya nga nagabulad sang iya kandidatura nga nakasulat sa nawong sang iya portpolyo samtang nagalagaw.
english: Man, just after an election, he is already unveiling his candidacy written on the face of his briefcase while walking.

text: “Hala bira!” Toto Mel a!
english: “Have a beer!” Uncle Mel!

text: By the way, sadtong isa ka eleksyon para konsehal sang siyudad, nagkuha man si Mel sang sobra 3,000 ka boto.
english: By the way, in one city councilor election, Mel also received more than 3,000 votes.

text: Natabo ato sang may nagpusta nga indi siya makakuha sing sobra 3,000 nga boto.
english: That happened when someone bet that he wouldn't get more than 3,000 votes.

text: Pero nagboto ang iban indi man lang tungod sa pusta.
english: But others voted not just because of the bet.

text: Madamo man sing abyan si Mel nga nagapati nga mas masadya ang konseho kon yara siya.
english: Mel also has many friends who believe the council would be more fun with her around.

text:
***

Tumalagsa man ang plano sang isa nga nag-file sa pagka-presidente.
english:
***

The plan of the one who filed for president is also unusual.

text: Himuon niya kuno performe ang ihi sang mga lalake kag organic fertilizer ang ihi sang mga babaye.
english: He said he would turn men's urine into performance and women's urine into organic fertilizer.

text: Ugaling basi sa lugar nga performe kag organic fertilizer ang mahatag sini sa mga pumuluyo, ang kapangsot lang ang maghari sa palibut.
english: However, instead of providing performance and organic fertilizer to the residents, only poverty will reign in the environment.

text: May isa man ka kandidato sa pagka-senador nga nag-propose butangan sing mataas nga pader ang kilid sang mga suba agud malikawan ang pag-awas sini sa mga nagapuyo dira nga mga imol kon malain ang panahon.
english: There is also a senatorial candidate who proposed to build a high wall along the rivers to prevent them from overflowing the poor people living there during bad weather.

text: Daw pader ini seguro ni Trump sa tunga sang USA kag Mexico agud ma-kontrol ang illegal entry sa USA.
english: Trump is probably building a wall between the USA and Mexico to control illegal entry into the USA.

text: Indi ta man seguro kinahanglan ini kay wala man kita sing problema sa dulunan sa iban nga pungsod.
english: We probably don't need it because we don't have any border problems with other countries.

text: Arkepelago man kita.
english: Archipelago for us.

text: Kag diin ta abe maagi kon mamunit ukon maligo sa suba?
english: And where do we go to fish or bathe in the river?

text: Ang nakita nga solusyon dira sang isa man ka tarso amo ang pagpatindug sang madamo nga mga suba agud magsalo sang tubig halin sa madamol nga ulan kag kabukiran pakadto sa dagat.
english: The solution found by another tarso was to build many rivers to collect water from heavy rains and mountains to the sea.

text: Mas maayo kuno ini kay mangin City of Rivers kita, nga daan City of Bridges na gani kita nga naluyagan sang mga turista.
english: This is better because we will become a City of Rivers, which is already a City of Bridges that is popular with tourists.

text:
***

Samtang, naga-dramatics man ang iban nga mga kandidato.
english:
***

Meanwhile, other candidates are also being dramatic.

text: Sa Dumangas nag-file pagka-meyor si 4th D Congressman Biron kag pagka-Bise Meyor na lang ang first-timer nga Mayor Golez.
english: In Dumangas, 4th D Congressman Biron filed for mayor and first-timer Mayor Golez for Vice Mayor.

text: Meyor ka na Onal, ma-Bise Meyor ka na lang?
english: You're already Mayor Onal, you're just going to be Vice Mayor?

text: Oh no!
english: Oh no!

text: Si Senador Bong Go, nga ginaduso sang PDP-Laban Cusi-wing sa pagka-presidente nag-file lang sa pagka-Vice President.

english: Although some Maranaos contend that this is part of the tradition known as “Parental Marriage”, some sectors have expressed concern about its impact on children.

text: Ginsiling sang mga child rights advocates nga apisar kabahin ini sang kultura, may maathag nga limitasyon ang tradisyon.
english: Child rights advocates say that although it is part of the culture, the tradition has obvious limitations.

text: Magabuhin sang senintimos ang presyo sang gasolina samtang magasaka naman ang diesel kag kerosene sa masunod nga semana.
english: The price of gasoline will fall by a penny while diesel and kerosene will rise next week.

text:

Gasoline – more or less rollback of P0.05 per literDiesel – more or less increase of P0.50 per literKerosene – more or less increase of P0.25 per liter

english:

english: Official price adjustments are announced every Monday and implemented by oil companies every Tuesday morning.

english: Last Tuesday, September 30, the price of gasoline also rolled back by P0.20, while the price of diesel and kerosene rose by P0.90 per liter.

english: Castro added that if Kaufman presents any evidence or basis for his allegation, the authorities should investigate it.

text: Madumduman nga subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 27, ang ika-apat ukon ulihi nga adlaw sang Confirmation of Charges hearing ni Duterte sa International Criminal Court nga maga-umpisa ala-5 subong nga hapon.
english: Today, February 27, is the fourth or last day of Duterte's Confirmation of Charges hearing at the International Criminal Court which will begin at 5 pm today.

text: Magaatubang sa media sa The Hague sa Netherlands si Vice President Sara Duterte, bwas, Marso 14.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte will address the media in The Hague, Netherlands, tomorrow, March 14.

english: This comes after his father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, was transferred to The Hague Penitentiary Institution to face a hearing at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Ginkumpirma sang Office of the Vice President nga naghugpa ang eroplano nga ginasakyan sang bise presidente las 9:27 p.m. sa Amsterdam, Netherlands ukon pasado alas-2:00 kaina sang kaagahon sa Pilipinas.
english: The Office of the Vice President confirmed that the plane carrying the vice president landed at 9:27 p.m. in Amsterdam, Netherlands or past 2:00 this morning in the Philippines.

text: Natalana naman nga makigsapol ang bise presidente sa mga abogado kag naghingyo sang access sa iya amay nga sa subong preso sa The Hague samtang nagahulat sang iya hearing sa International Criminal Court para sa kaso nga “crimes against humanity” nga may kaangtanan sa war on drugs sang iya administrasyon.
english: The vice president is scheduled to meet with lawyers and requested access to his father, who is currently imprisoned in The Hague while awaiting his hearing at the International Criminal Court for crimes against humanity related to his administration's war on drugs.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagbyahe ang bise presidente sa Netherlands kahapon sang aga sakay sang Emirates Airlines.
english: The vice president flew to the Netherlands yesterday morning on Emirates Airlines.

text: Samtang ang iya utod naman nga si Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte ang ginhatagan man sang travel clearance para sa personal nga byahe sa Japan kag Netherlands.
english: Meanwhile, his brother, Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte, was also given travel clearance for personal trips to Japan and the Netherlands.

english: Their father, former President Duterte, was arrested on Tuesday morning upon his arrival in the Philippines from Hong Kong.

english:

text: Ginklaro ni Department of Education (DepEd) Secretary Sonny Angara nga wala sang na-report nga injuries ukon anuman nga kahalitan kasunod sang linog nga nagtay-og sa Laoag City, Ilocos Norte nga amo ang host sang Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: Department of Education (DepEd) Secretary Sonny Angara clarified that there were no reported injuries or any damage following the earthquake that shook Laoag City, Ilocos Norte which is the host of the Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Pasado alas dies kaina sang aga sang nagtay-og ang magnitude 5.2 nga linog sa La Union kag nabatyagan man sa kaiping nga mga syudad kaangay sang Laoag City kun sa diin masako sa pagpanghanda para sa opening ceremony sang hinampang.
english: The magnitude 5.2 earthquake struck La Union around 10 am yesterday and was also felt in neighboring cities such as Laoag City where they were busy preparing for the opening ceremony of the games.

text: Suno pa sa DepEd, napalapta na sang Incident Command Post ang mga personnel nagikan sa Bureau of Fire Protection kag Regional Safety Office agud nga mag-inspect sa playing venues amo man sa mga lugar kun sa diin nagatinir ang mga delegado sa hinampang.
english: According to the DepEd, the Incident Command Post has already deployed personnel from the Bureau of Fire Protection and Regional Safety Office to inspect the playing venues as well as the areas where the delegates are staying.

text: Lakip man sa gin-check amo ang Ferdinand E. Marcos Memorial Stadium kun sa diin hiwaton ang opening rites karon sa gab-i. Sa stadium man patigayunon sa masunod nga inadlaw ang nagkalain-lain nga sport events kaangay sang football, tennis, athletics, kag swimming.
english: Also checked was the Ferdinand E. Marcos Memorial Stadium where the opening rites will be held tonight. The stadium will also host various sporting events such as football, tennis, athletics, and swimming in the coming days.

text: Ginpasiguro sang DepEd nga preparado ang ila nga Regional Incident Management Team kag ginasunod gid ang earthquake response protocols.
english: DepEd assured that its Regional Incident Management Team is prepared and following the earthquake response protocols.

text: Sandig sa schedule nga ginhatag sang Schools Division of Ilocos Norte, alas otso karon sa gab-i ang keynote message ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: According to the schedule given by the Schools Division of Ilocos Norte, the keynote message of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will be delivered at 8 pm today.

text: nga amo man ang pormal nga proklamasyon sang pagbukas sang Palarong Pambansa.

text: Nahibaluan nga bisan subong nga gab-i ang opening ceremony, magasugod ang regular sports sa Mayo 26 tubtub 30.
english: It is known that even tonight the opening ceremony, regular sports will start on May 26 to 30.

text: Nagalaom si former Banat Party-list Representative Salvador ‘Buddy’ Britanico nga mahatagan na gid man sang hustisya ang pagpatay sa iya anak nga isa sa mga biktima sang extrajudicial killings sa idalom sang Duterte administration.
english: Former Banat Party-list Representative Salvador 'Buddy' Britanico hopes that justice will be done to the killing of his son who is one of the victims of extrajudicial killings under the Duterte administration.

english: His son is Delfin Britanico, a businessman who was shot dead on Iloilo River Boulevard in Bgy.

text: Nabitasan, La Paz, Iloilo City sang Enero 19, 2020.
english: Nabitasan, La Paz, Iloilo City on January 19, 2020.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay former Representative Britanico, iya ginpahayag ang pag-aresto kay anay presidente Rodrigo Duterte agud mag-atubang sa International Criminal Court bangud sa ginaalegar crime against humanity ang panugod sang pag-angkon sang hustisya para sa tanan nga biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, former Representative Britanico said the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte to face the International Criminal Court for alleged crimes against humanity is the beginning of justice for all victims.

text: Apang suno kay Britanico, sa iya nga bahin, mas maayo kun masilutan gid ang mga katapo sang kapulisan nga nangamot kag may papel man sa pagpatay sa iya anak.
english: However, Britanico said, for his part, it would be better if the police officers who took root and played a role in the murder of his son were punished.

text: Matandaan nga isa ka ranking police officer kag lima ka iban pa nga pulis ang naangot sa kamatayon sang negosyante.
english: It can be recalled that a ranking police officer and five other policemen were involved in the death of the businessman.

text: Ini amo sanday Colonel Martin Defensor nga director sang Iloilo City Police Office sang amo nga tion, Police Corporal Joseph Andrew Joven, Master Sergeant Vernie Escorial, Staff Sergeant Michael De Felipe, Staff Sergeant Ricardo Morante,kag Staff Sergeant Freddie Libo-on.
english: They were Colonel Martin Defensor, director of the Iloilo City Police Office at the time, Police Corporal Joseph Andrew Joven, Master Sergeant Vernie Escorial, Staff Sergeant Michael De Felipe, Staff Sergeant Ricardo Morante, and Staff Sergeant Freddie Libo-on.

text: Si Joven ang nagserbe driver sang Mitsubishi Adventure nga gingamit sa pagpatay kay Delfin, si Morante ang gintudlo nga nagtiro, kag ang nag-finishing shot amo si Escorial.
english: Joven served as the driver of the Mitsubishi Adventure used to kill Delfin, Morante was the alleged shooter, and Escorial fired the finishing shot.

text: Si Defensor naman ang gin-akusahan nga “Accessory to a Crime” bangud sa pagdepensa kag pag-apin sa iya mga tinawo.
english: Defensor was charged with “Accessory to a Crime” for defending and protecting his men.

text: Nagmandu si Chinese President Xi Jin Ping sa militar sang amo nga pungsod nga pabaskugon pa ang training kag preparasyon sang militar.
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping has ordered the country's military to step up military training and preparation.

text: Kasunod ini sang tatlo ka adlaw nga war games sang China sa palibot sang Taiwan nga ila gina-claim nga ila pa nga teritoryo.
english: This follows China's three-day war games around Taiwan, which it claims as its own territory.

text: Ang military exercises nga ginhimo sang Beijing — pagpadala sang jets kag warships — ang kasunod sang pagpakigkita ni Taiwan President Tsai Ing Wen kay US House Speaker Kevin McCarthy.
english: The military exercises carried out by Beijing — sending jets and warships — follow Taiwan President Tsai Ing Wen’s meeting with US House Speaker Kevin McCarthy.

text: Ginsiling sang Chinese president sa Southern Theatre Command Navy sang People’s Liberation Army nga dapat depensahan gid ang territorial sovereignty kag maritime interests sang China kag himuon man ang tanan agud protektahan ang kabug-usan nga peripheral stability.
english: The Chinese president told the People's Liberation Army's Southern Theater Command Navy that China's territorial sovereignty and maritime interests must be firmly defended and everything must be done to protect overall peripheral stability.

text: Ginpakamalaot man ni Xi ang plano sang US forces nga padamuon pa ang base militar sa Pilipinas lakip na ang isa nga nakaposisyon malapit sa Taiwan.
english: Xi also condemned US forces' plans to increase the number of military bases in the Philippines, including one positioned near Taiwan.

text: Subong nga semana nagapadayon ang pinakadaku nga joint military drills sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag sang Pilipinas kun sa diin nagkomiter pa si US Secretary of State Antony Blinken nga apinan ang Pilipinas batok sa anuman nga pagpamahog nga mabaton lakip na ang matabo sa West Philippine Sea.
english: This week continues the largest joint military drills between the United States of America and the Philippines where US Secretary of State Antony Blinken has committed to defend the Philippines against any threat received including those in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Indi kontento ang Bagong Alyansang Makabayan – Panay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte lang ang gin- aresto kag natalana nga mag-atubang sa International Criminal Court bangud sa ginaalegar nga nakumiter nga crimes against humanity.
english: The Bagong Alyansang Makabayan-Panay is not satisfied that only former President Rodrigo Duterte has been arrested and is scheduled to face the International Criminal Court for allegedly committing crimes against humanity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Elmer Forro, Secretary General sang Bagong Alyansang Makabayan – Panay, iya ginpahayag nga dapat nga mapasabat man sa layi ang iban nga mga kaupod ni Duterte nga naangot man sa extra-judicial killings kag red-tagging.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Elmer Forro, Secretary General of the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan – Panay, said that other Duterte associates who are also involved in extra-judicial killings and red-tagging should also be held accountable.

text: Gintumod ni Forro sanday former PNP chief Debold Sinas, Lorraine Badoy nga former spokesperson sang National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict, kag Jeffrey Celiz nga self-proclaimed former member sang New People’s Army (NPA).
english: Forro referred to former PNP chief Debold Sinas, Lorraine Badoy, former spokesperson of the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict, and Jeffrey Celiz, self-proclaimed former member of the New People's Army (NPA).

text: Suno kay Forro, ang natabo kay Duterte ang kuntani magserbe nga paandam sa masunod nga mga lider sang pungsod agud ang mga ini magkumiter sang mga sahi sang krimen nga nahimo sang administrasyon ni Duterte.
english: According to Forro, what happened to Duterte should serve as a warning to the next leaders of the country so that they do not commit the kinds of crimes committed by the Duterte administration.

english: He said it is important that the President has the opportunity to review the performance of the agencies to expand and strengthen services for Filipinos.

english: Rubio also expressed that it is a great honor for him to serve as head of Customs.

english: He also assured his continued support for the policies and reforms of President Marcos Jr.

english: It is hoped that these measures will give more credibility and public trust to government agencies.

text: Naka-heightened alert ang kapulisan sa Western Visayas para sa ano man nga posible matabo kasunod sang pag-aresto kay anay Presidente Duterte kag pagdala sa iya sa The Hague, Netherlands bangud sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity nga nakumiter sini sang tion sang iya drug war.
english: Police in Western Visayas are on heightened alert for anything that might happen following the arrest of former President Duterte and his taking to The Hague, Netherlands for alleged crimes against humanity committed during his drug war.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radoy kay Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, director sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga ginalantaw nila ang posibilidad nga hingalitan sang iban nga mga grupo ang sitwasyon subong sa Pilipinas agud magsabwag sang kalakasan gani dapat handa diri ang kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radoy, Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, director of the Police Regional Office 6, said they are looking into the possibility that other groups will take advantage of the current situation in the Philippines to spread violence so the police should be prepared.

english: Wanky explained that there is nothing to alarm the public.

text: Gindala ni Pope Francis sa iya nga Holy Mass kag “Urbi et Orbi” ukon “To the City and to the World” message kag blessing ang pagpangamuyo para sa mga pumuluyo sa Ukraine kag ang pag-apelar nga kuntani buksan na ang pagpanghuna-huna sang Russians sa invasion nga ginhimo sang Moscow masobra isa ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: Pope Francis brought in his Holy Mass and “Urbi et Orbi” or “To the City and to the World” message and blessing a prayer for the people of Ukraine and an appeal to open the minds of Russians to the invasion carried out by Moscow more than a year ago.

english: The Pope also called for the return of those imprisoned during the war to their homes and families.
