english: As he does every Easter, the 86-year-old Pope also called for peace in the Middle East.

text: Partikular man nga gintumod ang ginamo sa Jerusalem kag amo man sa Israel, Lebanon, kay Syria.
english: He also specifically addressed the unrest in Jerusalem as well as in Israel, Lebanon, Syria.

text: Matandaan nga nagsaka pa ang tensyon sa tunga sang Israelis kag Palestinians halin sang ginpatigayon ang Israeli police raids sang nagligad nga semana sa Al-Aqsa mosque sa Jerusalem.
english: Tensions between Israelis and Palestinians have risen since Israeli police raids last week on the Al-Aqsa mosque in Jerusalem.

text: Sa iya mensahe, gin-mensyonar man sang Santo Papa ang sitwasyon sa Lebanon; ang martir nga mga Rohingya sa Myanmar nga ginpangabay nga kuntani makaangkon na sang hustisya; kag ang apelar sa dugang nga bulig para sa mga biktima sang linog sa Turkey kag Syria kun sa diin malapit 56,000 ka mga tawo ang nagkalamatay.
english: In his message, the Pope also mentioned the situation in Lebanon; the martyred Rohingya in Myanmar who asked for justice; and the appeal for more aid for the victims of the earthquakes in Turkey and Syria where nearly 56,000 people have died.

text: Gin-mensyonar man sini ang mga tumuluo sa Nicaragua matapos nga nag-lala pa ang relasyon sa tunga sang gobyerno kag sa Simbahang Katolika sa amo nga pungsod.
english: He also mentioned the faithful in Nicaragua after relations between the government and the Catholic Church in that country deteriorated.

text: Ini nga mensahe kadungan sang Easter Sunday ang ginpangunahan ni Pope Francis sa St.
english: This message coincides with Easter Sunday led by Pope Francis at St.

text: Peter’s Square matapos napilitan ini nga ipaiway ang pagtambong sa outdoor service sang Byernes Santo bangud sa tuman ka lamig nga panahon.
english: Peter's Square after he was forced to postpone attending the outdoor service on Good Friday due to extreme cold weather.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga semana lang nakaguwa sa ospital ang Santo Papa bangud sa ginsuprer nga bronchitis.
english: The Pope was discharged from the hospital last week due to bronchitis.

text: Ginkalipay apang may kabalaka ang nabatyagan si Former Congressman Gary Alejano matapos nga na-issue ang International Criminal Court (ICC) sang warrant of arrest batok kay Former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Former Congressman Gary Alejano was happy but worried after the International Criminal Court (ICC) issued a warrant of arrest against Former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alejano, iya ginpahayag nga una na siya nga nagpasaka sang kaso, apang gilayon man nga ginbasura bangud sa amo nga tion, wala sang plano ang administrasyon nga pasabton ang anay presidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alejano said he had already filed a case, but it was immediately dismissed because at that time, the administration had no plans to hold the former president accountable.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga indi dapat magkabalaka ang supporters ni Duterte bangud maga-agi sang insakto nga due process ang kaso.
english: He also explained that Duterte's supporters should not worry because the case will go through the proper due process.

text: Ginpunto man sang natungdan nga indi matabo kay Duterte ang natabo sa mga biktima sang extra judicial killings sa tion sang iya administrasyon bangud wala sang ‘due process’ ang mga ginpamatay bangud sa war on drugs.
english: He also pointed out that what happened to the victims of extra judicial killings during his administration will not happen to Duterte because there is no due process for those killed because of the war on drugs.

text: Suno kay Alejano, sakop sa gihapon sang ICC ang kaso ni Duterte bangud na-file ini antes pa man nga nagkalas ang Pilipinas sa ICC sang 2019.
english: Alejano said Duterte's case is still under the jurisdiction of the ICC because it was filed before the Philippines withdrew from the ICC in 2019.

text: Para sa iya, dapat mangin malipay ang Pilipino bangud isa ini ka palaagyan agud nga mas mapabaskog ang sistema sang demokrasya sang Pilipinas.
english: For him, Filipinos should be happy because it is a way to strengthen the Philippine democratic system.

text: Nagpanindugan man ini nga wala sang pamulitika sa nangin proseso kag lunsay legal ang natabo.
english: He also insisted that there was no politics in the process and everything was legal.

text: Nagpasalig ang Malacañang nga indi maapektuhan ang serbisyo sang gobyerno apisar sang courtesy resignations nga ginpasa sang mga Cabinet Secretaries.
english: Malacañang assured that government services will not be affected despite the courtesy resignations submitted by the Cabinet Secretaries.

text: As of press time, 33 officials na ang naka-file sang courtesy resignations kag may anum nga nagpahayag man sang intensyon nga magpasa sini kasunod mismo sang panawagan sang presidente.
english: As of press time, 33 officials have already filed their courtesy resignations and six have also expressed their intention to submit them following the president's call.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, magapadayon gihapon sila sa ila nga trabaho sa administrasyon gani nga wala sang pending projects nga maapektuhan.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, they will continue their work in the administration so that no pending projects will be affected.

text: “Maliwanag din po ang sinabi ng Pangulo, hindi po maaapektuhan kung anuman po ang pending at existing projects habang po ito ay may transition at tuloy-tuloy lamang po ang pagtratrabaho ng mga Cabinet secretaries at mga tao sa gobyerno,” pahayag sang undersecretary.
english: “The President is also clear that any pending and existing projects will not be affected while there is a transition and the work of the Cabinet secretaries and government officials will continue,” the undersecretary said.

text: Importante ini nga tikang suno kay Castro agud nga mapamatud-an sang mga opisyal nga nagakabagay sila nga magpabilin sa Marcos administration.
english: Castro said this is an important step for officials to prove that they are worthy of staying in the Marcos administration.

text: Nagpahayag man ini nga wala sang lugar sa administrasyon ang mga tamadan kag mga kurap nga tiglikom sang Gabinete.
english: He also said that there is no place in the administration for lazy and corrupt Cabinet secretaries.

text: “Mas maganda po ito na mapakita rin ng ating mga heads of agencies, Cabinet secretaries na sila ay naaayon sa goal ng Pangulo.
english: “It is better that our heads of agencies, Cabinet secretaries can also show that they are in line with the President's goal.

text: Ipakita nila na sila ay dapat manatili bilang parte ng administrasyon ng ating Pangulo,” dugang sini.
english: They will show that they should remain as part of our President's administration,” he added.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kaangot sa metrics sang evaluation, ginsiling sini nga iga-base ini sa performance sang secretary kag kun may yara sang isyu sang kurapsyon sa sulod sang ahensya.
english: When asked about the metrics of the evaluation, he said it will be based on the performance of the secretary and whether there are issues of corruption within the agency.

text: Sa nauna nga press release, ginsiling sang presidente nga tuyo sang pagpa-pasa sang courtesy resignations sa Cabinet secretaries nga ma-“recalibrate” ang administration kasunod sang 2025 elections.
english: In an earlier press release, the president said the purpose of submitting courtesy resignations to Cabinet secretaries is to “recalibrate” the administration following the 2025 elections.

text: Nagdangat sa anom ka mga indibidwal ang napatay matapos magtibusok sang eroplano sa North Carolina.
english: At least six people have died after a plane crashed in North Carolina.

text: Nagtibusok ang Cessna C550 samtang nagahilapit na sa Statesville Regional Airport.
english: The Cessna C550 crashed while approaching the Statesville Regional Airport.

text: Suno kay Statesville Airport director John Ferguson nga ang nasambit nga eroplano ang ginapanag-iyahan sang negosyante kag anay NASCAR driver nga si Greg Biffle.
english: Statesville Airport director John Ferguson said the plane was owned by businessman and former NASCAR driver Greg Biffle.

text: Bangud sa insidente, temporaryo ginsarado ang airport tubtob makuha ang nasunog nga eroplano.
english: Due to the incident, the airport was temporarily closed until the burning plane was recovered.

text: Padayon ang ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad ang nasambing insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text:
Nakitaan sang paglitik ang facade sang Iloilo Central Market matapos ang magnitude 4.8 nga linog kagab-i.

Nagalab-ot sa ginabulubanta isa ka metro ang kalabaon sang amo nga litik, lakip na ang mga hairline cracks nga makit-an sa nauna nga bahin sini.
english:
The facade of the Iloilo Central Market was damaged after a magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck last night.

The crack is about one meter long, including hairline cracks in the front.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Eduardo Elito, isa ka helper sa isdaan sang central market, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa sang mga litik nga nakit-an ang mga ini kahapon nga adlaw sa amo nga bahin sang central public market.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Eduardo Elito, a helper at the fish market of the central market, said that no fish were found yesterday in that part of the central public market.

text: Matapos ang mabaskog nga linog kagab-i, natalupangdan lang nila ang amo nga mga litik kaina sang aga samtang ang mga ini ang nagapangape sa isa ka bakery sa tabok sang amo nga merkado.
english: After the strong earthquake last night, they only noticed the cracks yesterday morning while they were having coffee at a bakery across the market.

text: Sa karun, ginbutangan na lamang sang barikada sa amo nga bahin sang nasambit nga merkado, agud malikawan ang mga kahalitan nga possible dala sang amo nga mga litik.
english: At present, a barricade has been erected in that part of the market, to avoid the damage possible caused by the cracks.

text: Madumdoman nga ginbuksan ang nasambit nga merkado sang Oktubre 30,2025.
english: The market was opened on October 30, 2025.

text: NAGSUGOD ang mga klase (SY 2021-2022) sa tanan nga eskwelahan, publiko kag pribado, sa bug-os nga Filipinas sadtong Setyembre 13, kon diin padayon pa ang pagpatuman sang online kag blended (online kag modular) classes nga una ginpatuman sadtong Oktubre 2020.
english: Classes (SY 2021-2022) began in all schools, public and private, across the Philippines on September 13, with the implementation of online and blended (online and modular) classes that were first implemented in October 2020 continuing.

text: In the meantime, gina-propose naman sang mga stakeholders, katulad sang pila ka eskwelahan, mga negosyante kag sang industriya sa transportasyon ang “Limited Face-to-Face” classes.
english: In the meantime, stakeholders, such as some schools, businessmen and the transportation industry are proposing “Limited Face-to-Face” classes.

text: Ginpasugtan ini sang Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) sa “infectious diseases” sa mga lugar kon diin may “minimal risk” batok sa COVID-19.
english: This was approved by the Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) on “infectious diseases” in areas where there is “minimal risk” against COVID-19.

text: Gani gin-rekomendar na ini sang Department of Education (DepEd) sa kay Presidente Duterte.
english: The Department of Education (DepEd) has recommended it to President Duterte.

text: Finally, gin-aprubahan na ni Presidente Duterte ining pilot testing sa “face-to-face classes” (FFC) sa mga 120 ka mga eskwelahan – 100 halin sa public schools kag 20 sa private schools – nga may “minimal risk” nga infection.
english: Finally, President Duterte has approved this pilot testing in face-to-face classes (FFC) in about 120 schools – 100 from public schools and 20 from private schools – with “minimal risk” of infection.

text: Sunu sa approved guidelines, 12 ka estudyante lang ang mapasugtan sa Kindergarten level, 16 sa Grade 1-3, kag 20 sa Senior High School upod sa Technical Vocational students.
english: According to the approved guidelines, only 12 students will be allowed in Kindergarten level, 16 in Grades 1-3, and 20 in Senior High School along with Technical Vocational students.

text: Ang tugot nga kalawigon sang klase amo and tatlo (3) lang ka oras sa Kindergarten tubtub Grade 3, kag tubtub apat (4) ka oras para sa Senior High School.
english: The allowed class length is only three (3) hours for Kindergarten through Grade 3, and up to four (4) hours for Senior High School.

text: Boluntaryo ang pag-participar diri sa FFC kag dapat may pagpahanugot gid sang mga ginikanan.
english: Participation in the FFC is voluntary and must be accompanied by parental consent.

text: Ang DepEd naka-identify na sang 26 ka eskwelahan sa Western Visayas agud mangin pilot schools.
english: The DepEd has already identified 26 schools in Western Visayas to become pilot schools.

text: Lakip diri ang apat (4) ka eskwelahan sa Iloilo – Tomas Confesor Elementary School sa Cabatuan; Granada National High School Ballesteros Campus sa Carles; ang Palanguia National High School sa Pototan; kag ang Cabacanan Elementary School sa Alimodian.
english: These include four (4) schools in Iloilo – Tomas Confesor Elementary School in Cabatuan; Granada National High School Ballesteros Campus in Carles; the Palanguia National High School in Pototan; and the Cabacanan Elementary School in Alimodian.

text: Tungod gani pilot schools lang ang mga ini, iga-monitor dayon ini sila sa sulod sang duha (2) ka bulan samtang ginapatuman man sa ila ang minimum health protocols, labi na gid ang paggamit sang face mask, social distancing kag handwashing agud malikawan ang close contact.
english: Since these are pilot schools, they will be monitored for two (2) months while they are also implementing minimum health protocols, especially the use of face masks, social distancing and handwashing to avoid close contact.

text: Kag, kon matabo nga magtaas ang “risk assessment” sang ila lugar ukon munisipyo, pauntaton ang natungdan nga pilot schools.
english: And, if the risk assessment of their area or municipality increases, the pilot schools will be stopped.

text:
***

Samtang, ginatugyan man sang DepEd ang pagpatuman sining pilot schools sa mga local government unit (LGU).
english:
***

Meanwhile, the DepEd is also leaving the implementation of these pilot schools to the local government units (LGUs).

text: Gin-stress ni DepEd-6 public information officer (PIO) Leonil Savilla nga ang implementasyon sang FFC sa Iloilo ginatugyan sa mga LGU tungod sang ila familiaridad sa ila mga lugar.
english: DepEd-6 public information officer (PIO) Leonil Savilla stressed that the implementation of the FFC in Iloilo is left to the LGUs because of their familiarity with their areas.

text: Sa Iloilo, ginsiling ni San Enrique Mayor Trixie Fernandez, nga presidente man sang League of Municipalities of the Philippines, Iloilo Chapter (LMP-Iloilo), nga indi pa mapasugtan ining “Face-to-Face” classes sa Iloilo tungod mataas pa ang mga kaso sang COVID-19 diri.
english: In Iloilo, San Enrique Mayor Trixie Fernandez, who is also president of the League of Municipalities of the Philippines, Iloilo Chapter (LMP-Iloilo), said that these “Face-to-Face” classes will not be allowed in Iloilo because of the high number of COVID-19 cases here.

text: Si DepEd-Iloilo City Schools Division Superintendent Ma.
english: DepEd-Iloilo City Schools Division Superintendent Ma.

text: Luz de los Reyes nagpahibalo man nga wala anay sing FFC sa tanan nga public kag private schools sa siyudad kay wala pa ini ginapasugtan ni Mayor Jerry Treñas tungod man kay mataas pa ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa siyudad.
english: Luz de los Reyes also announced that there will be no FFC in all public and private schools in the city because Mayor Jerry Treñas has not yet allowed it because of the high number of COVID-19 cases in the city.

text: Isa pa nila ka rason amo nga wala pa mabakunahan ang mga kabataan (17 anyos panubo), nga sa karon napa-rehistro na ni Mayor Treñas.
english: Another reason they give is that the children (under 17 years old) have not yet been vaccinated, which Mayor Treñas has now registered.

text:
***

Luas sa indi pa mabakunahan ang mga kabataan sa eskwelahan batok sa COVID-19, ano ayhan ang pagtan-aw sang mga health authorities sa gina-require nga “minimal  risk”?
english:
***

Besides the fact that school children are not yet vaccinated against COVID-19, what is the view of the health authorities on the required “minimal risk”?

text: Wala kita sing lubos nga paathag halin sa DepEd, pero tungod ini seguro kay “less likely” mag-contract ang mga kabataan sang COVID-19.
english: We do not have a full explanation from the DepEd, but this is probably because children are “less likely” to contract COVID-19.

text: Ang “findings” sang mga health experts nagapamatuod nga “less likely” mag-contract ang mga kabataan sang COVID-19.
english: The findings of health experts prove that children are less likely to contract COVID-19.

text: Ina tungod kay “efficient” sila sa pagtabog sang mga ACE2 kag TMPRSS2 nga proteins nga naga-unlock, ukon nagabukas, sang host cells para ma-infect sang virus.
english: That’s because they are “efficient” at expelling the ACE2 and TMPRSS2 proteins that unlock, or open, host cells for virus infection.

text: Kag tungod indi man nila lubos matabog ining invading pathogens, sa masami naga-asymptomatic ini sila nga wala nagapakita sing sintoma kag, sa masami man, nagaayo lang sila tungod sa ila natural immunity (antibodies) kag sa bulig man sang ila adaptive immunity katulad sang mahatag sang T-cells (white blood cells) sa bulig sang mga interferon.
english: And because they cannot completely repel these invading pathogens, they often become asymptomatic without showing symptoms and, often, they recover only because of their natural immunity (antibodies) and with the help of their adaptive immunity such as that provided by T-cells (white blood cells) with the help of interferons.

text: Indi man gani mag-problema kon gina-sip-on man lang ang bata.
english: It doesn't even matter if the child is just coughing.

text: Physical barrier pa ina sa magasulod nga virus.
english: That's a physical barrier to the incoming virus.

text: Makabulig man ang paglikaw sa mga negatibo nga “environmental factors”, katulad sang crowd gathering kag cerrado kag wala sing “infection control” nga mga lugar.
english: It is also helpful to avoid negative environmental factors, such as crowd gatherings and closed and uninfection control areas.

text: Gani importante nga maggamit gid sila sang face mask agud maseguro nga indi sila makalaton ukon malatnan man sang mga virus nga makasulod sa ila kon mag-ubo, mangatsi, ukon maghambal sa eskwelahan./PN
english: It is therefore important that they wear face masks to ensure that they do not get infected or infected with viruses that can enter them when they cough, sneeze, or talk at school./PN

text: Makaluluoy subong ang sitwasyon sang isa ka lapsag matapos ginpaliguan sang nagaindakal nga tubig sang iya yaya sa Marikina City.
english: A baby is in a pitiful condition after being bathed in boiling water by his nanny in Marikina City.

text: Ang lapsag amo si alyas “Marcus”, isa ka tuig ang edad samtang ang yaya sini amo si alyas “Ruby”, 57-anyos.
english: The baby was identified as “Marcus”, one year old while his nanny was identified as “Ruby”, 57 years old.

text: Gilayon nga gindala ang lapsag sa Amang Rodriguez Memorial Medical Cen­ter.
english: The baby was immediately taken to the Amang Rodriguez Memorial Medical Center.

text: Makaligad ang duha ka adlaw, ginkinahanglan nga ipaidalom sa scraping ang nasunog nga panit kag kinahanglan man nga tuslukan sang pampatulog ang bata.
english: Two days later, the burned skin had to be scraped and the child had to be given a sleeping pill.

text: Nagdugang pa gid ang kabalaka sang mga ginikanan matapos ginsiling sang ospital nga indi nila masarangan ang nasambit nga procedure.
english: The parents' concerns grew after the hospital said they could not afford the procedure.

text: Suno sa ospital, tubtob sa 30% degree burn lang ang masarangan nila.
english: According to the hospital, they can only treat up to a 30% degree burn.

text: Nahibaluan nga 40% degree burns ang naangkon ni Marcus.
english: Marcus sustained 40% degree burns.

text: Nadismaya pa gid ang ospital nga ginhambalan sila nga mangita na lang sang lain nga ospital.
english: The hospital was even more disappointed that they were told to find another hospital.

text: Bisan sa damgo, indi gid naton gusto ang eksperyensya nga ginakagat kita sang sapat kaangay abi sang man-og.
english: Even in a dream, we do not like the experience of being bitten by an animal such as a snake.

text: Pat-od nga nagakurog-kurog ka gid sa imo pagbugtaw!
english: You must have been shaking so much when you woke up!

text: Apang may isa ka babaye nga naka-eksperyensya sini sa Phra Samut Chedi district, Thailand.
english: But one woman experienced it in Phra Samut Chedi district, Thailand.

text: Natabo ini sang nagligad gid lamang nga gab-i sa balay sang biktima nga si Arrom Arunroj, nagaedad sang 64-anyos.
english: The incident occurred last night at the house of the victim, Arrom Arunroj, aged 64 years.

text: Naga-isahanon siya sa puluy-an, nagpanyapon sang 8:30 sang amo nga gab-i, kag nagpanghugas sang pinggan sa guwa sang ila balay sang gulpi lang may nagkagat sa iya tiil.
english: He was home alone, had dinner at 8:30 that night, and was washing dishes outside his house when suddenly something bit him on the leg.

text: Ini amo ang apat ka metros nga python nga nagabug-at sang ginabanta 20 -kilos.
english: It was a four-meter python weighing about 20 -kilos.

text: Sunod siya sini nga ginburambudan kag apisar sang iya pagwaras, indi siya makasarang sa kakusog sang sapat.
english: He was next beaten and despite his efforts, he could not withstand the strength of the animal.

text: Nagsinggit ang tigulang apang alas dies na kag nabatian sang kasilingan ang iya pagpangayo sang tabang kag nakapangayo sang bulig sa otoridad.
english: The old man screamed but it was already ten o'clock and the neighbors heard him crying for help and called the authorities for help.

text: 30 minutos pa gid ang ginlawig antes nakakas sang rescuers ang man-og.
english: It took another 30 minutes for rescuers to remove the snake.

text: May mga pilas na ang tigulang sa duha ka oras nga engkwentro sini batok sa sapat kag nagpalangluya na ini sa kakapoy gani gindala ini sa ospital.
english: The elderly man had sustained injuries from his two-hour encounter with the animal and was rushed to the hospital.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi man venomous ang pythons apang ang ila kagat ang mahimo makatuga sang infection.
english: Pythons are not venomous but their bites can cause infection.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa sa pag-recover ang biktima sa ospital.
english: The victim is still recovering in the hospital.

text: ILOILO – May ipahamtang nga machine repair hubs sa kada probinsya sa pungsod para sa May 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: ILOILO – Machine repair hubs will be set up in every province in the country for the May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Election Director sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang labing una nga tion nga may yara sang technical repair hub nga ipahamtang ang poll body ang kada probinsya sa Pilipinas sa diin nalakip diri ang Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Election Director of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Region 6, said that this is the first time that there is a technical repair hub to set up the poll body in each province in the Philippines including Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Ausan, ang nasambit nga inisyatibo ang may katuyuan nga mas mapadasig ang pagkaayo sang automated counting machines kun ini ang nag-malfunction.
english: Ausan said the initiative aims to speed up the repair of automated counting machines if they malfunction.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga tuig 2022 ginadala pa sa Cebu ang mga nagguba ukon naaberya nga machines sang Western Visayas rason nga mas mabudlay kag madugay ini.
english: He said that in 2022, the damaged machines of Western Visayas will be brought to Cebu, which will make it more difficult and time-consuming.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang isa ka machine sa kada clustered precinct apang pahayag ni Ausan, may mga ipain man nga mga contingency machines sa tion nga mag-malfunction ang iban sa mga ini.
english: It is known that there is one machine in each clustered precinct but Ausan said there will also be separate contingency machines in case some of them malfunction.

text: Sa Western Visayas, may yara sang 20,077 established precincts para sa 3.1 million nga mga registered voters.
english: In Western Visayas, there are 20,077 established precincts for 3.1 million registered voters.

text: Ginalauman naman nga magaabot ang automated machine sa Abril, 2025.
english: The automated machine is expected to arrive in April, 2025.

text: Sa idalom sang resolution sang COMELEC, nagakadapat nga makapatigayon pa sang final testing and sealing sang automated machine sa Mayo 2 tubtob Mayo 7 ukon antes ang aktwal nga adlaw sang piniliay.
english: Under the COMELEC resolution, the final testing and sealing of the automated machine should be conducted from May 2 to May 7 or before the actual election day.

text: Isa naman ka makasaysayan nga kadungganan ang ginbuksan ni Marina Summers matapos siya mangin una nga Filipina drag queen nga nakalakat sa red carpet sang 2025 Cannes Film Festival.
english: Marina Summers opened another historic honor after she became the first Filipina drag queen to walk the red carpet of the 2025 Cannes Film Festival.

text: Si Marina, isa ka kilala nga personalidad sa drag community, matapos niya i-share sa social media ang iya pagpasalamat kag pagselebrar sang milestone nga nagatindog bilang representante sang Filipino drag kag queer community sa isa ka global event .
english: Marina, a well-known personality in the drag community, after sharing on social media her gratitude and celebration of the milestone of standing as a representative of the Filipino drag and queer community in a global event .

text: Nagpanginbulahan man siya sa iya glam team nga nangin kabahin sang “herstory” nga ila ginhimo.
english: She also congratulated her glam team for being part of the “herstory” they created.

text: Sa iya pagpabugal sa Filipino fashion kag artistry, si Marina nagpasundayag sang isa ka elegante nga one-shoulder, sequined black gown, may upod nga chain-link earrings, isa ka kombinasyon nga nagpabaskug sang iya confident kag glamorous nga panindugan sa red carpet.
english: Taking pride in Filipino fashion and artistry, Marina showcased an elegant one-shoulder, sequined black gown, accompanied by chain-link earrings, a combination that reinforced her confident and glamorous stance on the red carpet.

text: Daku ang paghangop kag suporta nga nabaton ni Marina halin sa LGBTQ+ community kag mga Pinoy sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: Marina has received a lot of understanding and support from the LGBTQ+ community and Filipinos around the world.

text: Ang iya presenya sa Cannes indi lamang isa ka fashion statement, kundi isa ka panawagan para sa pagkilala, pagrespeto, kag pagbaton sa LGBTQ+ sa international level.
english: Her presence at Cannes is not just a fashion statement, but a call for LGBTQ+ recognition, respect, and acceptance on an international level.

text: Magluto ka sang utanon, pabor ka bala nga overcooked ini ukon raw?
english: You cook a vegetable, do you favor it overcooked or raw?

text: Suno kay Shayna Komar, licensed kag registered dietitian sa Thomas F. Chapman Family Cancer Wellness sa Italya, tuman ka dako ang bentaha sa ikaayong lawas kun raw ukon hilaw nga kaunon ang paborito naton nga utanon.
english: According to Shayna Komar, licensed and registered dietitian at Thomas F. Chapman Family Cancer Wellness in Italy, there are many health advantages to eating our favorite vegetables raw.

text: Ang raw vegetables ang manggaranon sa enzymes, vitamins kag minerals nga kinahanglan sang lawas agud malikawan ang nanuhay-tuhay nga bacteria ukon virus nga nagaresulta sa mga balatian.
english: Raw vegetables are rich in enzymes, vitamins and minerals that the body needs to prevent various bacteria or viruses that result in diseases.

text: Pahayag sang dietician, nagakadula ang water-soluble vitamin B kag vitamin C sang mga utanon kun masobrahan ini ka luto rason nga mas bentaha nga laga-on ukon lutuon lang ini nga wala sang buttery sauces kag mantika.
english: According to the dietician, the water-soluble vitamin B and vitamin C of vegetables are lost when they are overcooked, so it is more advantageous to boil or cook them without buttery sauces and oil.

text: Kun masobrahan man sa asin, kalamay kag saturated fats ang aton linuto nga utan, dako ang risgo nga makaangkon ang isa ka indibidwal sang inflammation sa blood vessels kag cardiovascular disease.
english: If our cooked vegetables are too high in salt, sugar and saturated fats, there is a high risk of developing inflammation in the blood vessels and cardiovascular disease.

text: Dugang pa ni Komar, kun luyag sang isa ka indibidwal nga buhinan ang iya kabug-aton, dako man ang mabulig sang pagkaon sang hilaw nga utanon bangud manubo ang calories sang raw vegtables kag mataas ang fiber content.
english: Komar added that if an individual wants to lose weight, eating raw vegetables can also help because raw vegtables are low in calories and high in fiber content.

text: Ginpakita ni Pope Francis ang pagkamapa-inubuson paagi sa paghugas kag paghalok sa tiil sang 12 ka mga preso sa isa ka juvenile facility sa Roma.
english: Pope Francis showed humility by washing and kissing the feet of 12 inmates at a juvenile facility in Rome.

text: Ini nga Casal del Marmo facility amo man ang juvenile prison nga ginkadtuan ni Pope Francis sang una sini nga ginhimo ang feet-washing ritual bilang isa na ka Santo Papa.
english: The Casal del Marmo facility is also the juvenile prison that Pope Francis visited when he first performed the foot-washing ritual as Pope.

text: Kaangay man ini sa ginpakita ni Hesukristo sa iya mga apostoles sang gab-i antes ang iya nga kamatayon.
english: This is similar to what Jesus Christ showed his apostles on the night before he died.

text: Subong nga Byernes Santo natalana nga magpanguna si Pope Francis sa duha ka Good Friday services kadungan sang adlaw nga ginadumdom sang mga Kristyano ang paglansang kay Hesus sa Krus.
english: This Good Friday, Pope Francis is scheduled to lead two Good Friday services as Christians commemorate the crucifixion of Jesus.

text: Pangunahan man sini ang Easter vigil Mass sa Sabado sang gab-i kag ang “Urbi et Orbi” (ukon ang “To the City and the World”) blessing kag message sa St.
english: He will also lead the Easter vigil Mass on Saturday night and the “Urbi et Orbi” (or the “To the City and the World”) blessing and message at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Easter Sunday.
english: Peter’s Square on Easter Sunday.

text: Nakapalagyo ang subject kag arestado naman ang live-in partner sini sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) sa Alta Tierra Village, Brgy.
english: The suspect fled the scene and his live-in partner was arrested in a drug buy bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) in Alta Tierra Village, Brgy.

text: Balabago, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Balabago, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang nakapalagyo amo si alias Ronald, 47, residente sang Pavia, Iloilo; samtang ang nadakpan naman amo si alias Nene, 25, kag ginapahayag nga taga-Guimaras.
english: The suspects were identified as alias Ronald, 47, resident of Pavia, Iloilo; while the arrested was alias Nene, 25, and allegedly from Guimaras.

text: Ang duha ang lunsay gintumod sang CDEU nga high-value individuals.
english: The two were both designated by the CDEU as high-value individuals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head sang CDEU, iya ginpahayag nga si alias Ronald amo ang una nga ka-transaksyon sang pulis apang namutikan sini nga mga otoridad ang iya ka-istorya, gani gulpi ini nagdalagan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head of the CDEU, said alias Ronald was the first transaction partner of the police but he noticed that the authorities were talking to him, so he suddenly ran away.

text: Yara naman sa sulod sang balay ang babaye, kag nadakpan ini bangud ginaalegar nga siya kuntani ang magakuha sang suplay nga ginasugo sang lalaki.
english: The woman was inside the house, and she was arrested because she was allegedly going to get the supplies ordered by the man.

text: Naglab-ot sa 100 gramos sang suspected shabu ang nakumpiskar nga katumbas sang balor nga P680,000.
english: A total of 100 grams of suspected shabu worth P680,000 were seized.

text: Suno kay Inot, nakaagi na anay preso si alias Ronald sa New Bilibid Prison kag nakaguwa lang paagi sa plea bargaining agreement, apang sang tion nga ginpatigayon ang drug buy bust, under probation pa ang subject.
english: According to Inot, alias Ronald was previously incarcerated in the New Bilibid Prison and was released through a plea bargaining agreement, but at the time of the drug buy bust, the subject was still under probation.

text: Ginpahayag nga gina-arkilahan lang nila ang balay sa Alta Tierra — isa ka strategic area para sa ila operasyon kun sa diin ginapakadto lang nila ang ila mga suki kag parokyano.
english: They reportedly rent the house in Alta Tierra — a strategic area for their operation where they only send their customers and parishioners.

text: Nakahunong na sa custodial facility sang police station 9 ang babaye kag natalana nga mag-atubang sang panumbungon nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon ang Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.#
english: The woman is currently detained at the custodial facility of police station 9 and is scheduled to face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.#

text: Ginbasura sang Department of Justice (DOJ) ang mga reklamo nga ginpasaka ni former President Rodrigo Duterte batok kay former Interior Secretary Benhur Abalos kag iban pa nga mga opisyal nga naangot sa pag-aresto anay kay Pastor Apollo Quiboloy.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has dismissed complaints filed by former President Rodrigo Duterte against former Interior Secretary Benhur Abalos and other officials in connection with the arrest of Pastor Apollo Quiboloy.

text: Suno sa ahensya, two counts sang malicious mischief ang ginpasaka batok kanday Abalos, Philippine National Police chief Police General Rommel Marbil, kag iban pa bangud sa pagguba sang gate sang compound sang ginserbe ang arrest warrant batok kay Quiboloy sang Agusto sang 2024.
english: According to the agency, two counts of malicious mischief were filed against Abalos, Philippine National Police chief Police General Rommel Marbil, and others for destroying the gate of the compound when the arrest warrant against Quiboloy was served in August of 2024.

text: Nagdesisyon naman ang DOJ nga wala sang nakit-an nga malisya sa amo nga akto.
english: The DOJ ruled that it found no malice in the act.

text: Magluwas diri, gin-dismiss man ang reklamo sa violation of domicile nga gin-file man kanday Abalos, Marbil, kag iban nga mga pulis.
english: In addition, the complaint of violation of domicile filed against Abalos, Marbil, and other policemen was also dismissed.

text: Santo sa alegasyon ni Duterte, ginpwersa sang mga pulis nga magsulod sa compound kag sa residential quarters nga wala sang search warrant gani nga makabig ini nga domicile right.
english: According to Duterte's allegation, the police forced them to enter the compound and residential quarters without a search warrant so that it would be considered a domicile right.

text: Apang sabat sang DOJ, wala sang ebidensya nga napresentar nga nagsulod ang pulis sa premises sang propiedad nga nagalapas sila sa layi.
english: However, the DOJ responded that there was no evidence presented that the police entered the premises of the property in violation of the law.

text: Ginsiling nga ang hulag sang pulis ang bangud sa ila performance of duty kag protektado sang presumption of regularity sa official functions.
english: It was said that the action of the police was due to their performance of duty and protected by the presumption of regularity in official functions.

text: Ang nag-dismiss sang complaint amo si Davao Acting City Prosecutor Angelica Laygo-Francisco.
english: The complaint was dismissed by Davao Acting City Prosecutor Angelica Laygo-Francisco.

text: Matandaan nga mataas ang tensyon sa tunga sang mga pulis kag Kingdom of Jesus Christ sang ginserbehan si Quiboloy sang arrest warrant.
english: Tensions between the police and the Kingdom of Jesus Christ were high when Quiboloy was served with an arrest warrant.

text: Ang ginapangatubang sini nga kaso amo ang paglapas sa Republic Act 7610 ukon sa Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation, and Discrimination Act; kag ang non-bailable qualified human trafficking charge.
english: The charges against him are violations of Republic Act 7610 or the Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation, and Discrimination Act; and a non-bailable qualified human trafficking charge.

text: Hugot ang monitoring sang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) sa ila katapo kasunod man sang mahimo mangin epekto sang tuman ka init nga tyempo sa kapulisan.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) is closely monitoring its members following the possible impact of the extremely hot weather on the police.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga kon may deployment, pamatyagan gid ang ila nabatyagan kag kon may shift lang man nga makapasilong sila, ubrahon gid agud nga mapalayo sa epekto sang mainit nga panahon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said that if there is a deployment, they will feel it and if there is a shift that they can take shelter, they will do it to avoid the effects of the hot weather.

text: Suno kay Solis, nakadependi na man sa tagsa ka unit ang pagpasuksok sang komportable nga uniform sa mga kapulisan.
english: Solis said it is up to each unit to provide comfortable uniforms to the police.

text: May naka-assign naman nga health desk ang talatapan agud masekyar ang mga ginabatyag sang ila katapo.
english: The office has assigned a health desk to check the health of its members.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga ‘per station’ may naga-monitor sa ila ikaayong-lawas.
english: He also explained that 'per station' there is a monitor of their health.

text: Tinutuyo sang tikang amo ang malikaw ang kapulisan sa heat stroke, hypertension, kag iban pa nga heat related conditions nga posible maangkon sa tuman ka dugay nga exposure sa adlaw.
english: The measure aims to prevent police from heat stroke, hypertension, and other heat related conditions that can be caused by prolonged exposure to the sun.

text: Ginpasumiter ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. submitted.

text: sang courtesy resignation ang tanan niya nga Cabinet secretaries.
english: of courtesy resignation all his Cabinet secretaries.

text: Ang pangabay para sa courtesy resignations nagatuyo sa paghatag sa Presidente sang elbow room sa pag-ebalwar sang performance sang tagsa ka departamento kag pagdeterminar kon sin-o ang magapadayon sa pag-alagad suno sa gin-recalibrate nga mga prayoridad sang administrasyon.
english: The request for courtesy resignations is intended to give the President elbow room to evaluate the performance of each department and determine who will continue to serve in accordance with the administration’s recalibrated priorities.

text: Ini nga tikang nagamarka sang maathag nga pagbalhin gikan sa temprano nga hugna sang pagdumala pakadto sa mas nasentro kag ginatuytuyan sang performance nga pamaagi.
english: This move marks a clear shift from early-stage management to a more focused and performance-driven approach.

text: Ginhatagan pagtamod sang Presidente nga samtang madamo ang nag-alagad nga may dedikasyon kag propesyonalismo, ang nagabag-o nga mga kinahanglanon sang pungsod nagakinahanglan sang isa ka bag-o nga pag-align, mas madasig nga pagpatuman, kag isa ka results-first mindset.
english: The President noted that while many have served with dedication and professionalism, the changing needs of the country require a renewed alignment, faster execution, and a results-first mindset.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga ang mga serbisyo sang gobyerno magapabilin nga wala sang untat kasunod sang amo nga transisyon, kag ginsulit sang Presidente nga ang kalig-on, pagpadayon, kag meritocracy magagiya sa pagporma sang iya leadership team nga nagapadayon.
english: He also assured that government services will remain uninterrupted following such a transition, and the President reiterated that stability, sustainability, and meritocracy will guide the formation of his leadership team going forward.

text:
Lakip sa mga nakapasa na sang resignations amo sanday:

Executive Secretary Lucas BersaminForeign Affairs Sec.
english:
Among those who have already submitted their resignations are:

Executive Secretary Lucas BersaminForeign Affairs Sec.

text: Enrique ManaloFinance Sec.
english: Enrique ManaloFinance Sec.

text: Ralph RectoDefense Sec.
english: Ralph RectoDefense Sec.

text: Gilbert TeodorJustice Sec.
english: Gilbert TheodoreJustice Sec.

text: Boying RemullaInterior Sec.
english: Boying RemullaInterior Sec.

text: Jonvic RemullaAgriculture Sec.
english: Jonvic RemullaAgriculture Sec.

text: Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr.Tourism Sec.
english: Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr.Tourism Sec.

text: Christina FrascoSocial Welfare Sec.
english: Christina FrascoSocial Welfare Sec.

text: Rex GatchalianEducation Sec.
english: Rex GatchalianEducation Sec.

text: Sonny Angara, kag iban pa.
english: Sonny Angara, and others.

text: Kaangot diri, si President Marcos Jr., ang nag-joke pa nahanungod sa iya “resign-all” nga mando sa mga sekretaryo sang Gabinete sa tion sang pagpresentar sang bag-o nga ginpirmahan nga mga kasuguan sa mga nagapatuman nga mga ahensya kag mga stakeholders.
english: In this regard, President Marcos Jr., even joked about his “resign-all” order to Cabinet secretaries during the presentation of the newly signed laws to implementing agencies and stakeholders.

text: Nagasuprer sang kasakit kag kahapdi ang isa ka vlogger sa Brgy.
english: A vlogger in Brgy.

text: Simsiman, Calinog, Iloilo matapos nga ginsindihan ang kaugalingon sini para sa isa ka vlog.
english: Simsiman, Calinog, Iloilo after he set himself on fire for a vlog.

text: Ini amo si Isaganijudyan Camare Canja ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga “Boy Negro”, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The suspect was identified as Isaganijudyan Camare Canja or better known as “Boy Negro”, resident of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Canja, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa vlog, napaso gid ang iya lawas kon sa diin, naglab-ot sa 3rd degree burn.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Canja said that because of the vlog, his body was severely burned, reaching 3rd degree burn.

text: Suno kay Canja, tunga sa litro ang iya ginbakal nga gasolina agud nga ipaligo kag imnon para sa iya content.
english: According to Canja, he bought half a liter of gasoline to take a bath and drink for his content.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala ini naglaum nga maglab-ot sa amo nga sitwasyon ang iya ginhimo bangud nagpreparar man ini sang tubig agud langoyan.
english: He also said that he did not expect to reach such a situation because he also prepared water to swim.

text: Bangud sa naagum nga paso, gilayon ini gindala sa ospital kag tubtob subong, nagapabilin nga ginabulong.
english: Due to the burns sustained, he was immediately taken to the hospital and is still undergoing treatment.

text: Nagpangayo man ini sang bulig sa iya mga supporters agud mabuligan siya sa iya sitwasyon subong.
english: He also asked for help from his supporters to help him in his current situation.

text: Ginakasubo naman sang iloy ni Boy Negro ang natabo sa iya anak.
english: Boy Negro's mother is saddened by what happened to her son.

text: Suno kay Lucia Canja, iloy sang vlogger, iya ginpahayag nga madugay na sini nga ginasaway ang iya anak apang indi man sini mapunggan bangud sa iya kaugalingon nga desisyon.
english: According to Lucia Canja, the mother of the vlogger, she said that she has been reprimanding her son for a long time but he cannot stop it because of his own decision.

text: Nahibaluan nga Grade 2 lamang ang gintapos ni Boy Negro kag antes nag-vlog, nagatrabaho ini bilang tricycle driver.
english: Boy Negro only finished Grade 2 and before vlogging, he worked as a tricycle driver.

text: Bukas si Senator Risa Hontiveros nga mangin standard bearer sang oposisyon sa 2028 presidential elections.
english: Senator Risa Hontiveros is open to becoming the standard bearer of the opposition in the 2028 presidential elections.

text: Sabat ini sang senadora sang ginpamangkot kun ginakonsiderar bala niya ang pagpadalagan sa pagka-presidente tatlo ka tuig halin subong.
english: The senator said this when asked if she was considering running for president three years from now.

text: Pahayag ni Risa, wala siya nagapangindi, kag kun amo sini ang hingyuon sang iya kaupdanan sa oposisyon ukon independent bloc, bukas siya sa tanan nga posibilidad alang-alang para sa mga Pilipino kag sa iya kaupdanan.
english: Risa said she does not refuse, and if this is what her colleagues in the opposition or independent bloc ask, she is open to all possibilities for the sake of the Filipinos and her colleagues.

text: “I am not saying no, I am open to all possibilities and that’s what I have been asking my fellow members in the opposition or independent bloc: to be open to all possibilities for the sake of the opposition as well as the masses,” pahayag sang senadora kadungan sang Kapihan sa Senado forum, Mayo 21.
english: “I am not saying no, I am open to all possibilities and that’s what I have been asking my fellow members in the opposition or independent bloc: to be open to all possibilities for the sake of the opposition as well as the masses,” the senator said during Kapihan at the Senate forum, May 21.

text: Sa pagtakop sang 2025 elections, ginpahayag man sang senadora nga indi ang 2028 elections ang iya ginatutukan, kundi ang pag-isa sa mga kaalyado nga nagasuporta sa Akbayan kag amo man kanday senators-elect Francis Pangilinan kag Bam Aquino sa masunod nga siyam ka bulan.
english: At the close of the 2025 elections, the senator also said that she is not focused on the 2028 elections, but on uniting with allies who support Akbayan as well as senators-elect Francis Pangilinan and Bam Aquino in the next nine months.

text: Pananglitan madayon si Risa sa pagpadalagan sa pagka-presidente sa 2028, ginalantaw nga makasumpong sini si Vice President Sara Duterte nga apisar wala pa sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon, apang may mga clue na nga ginahatag kaangot sa iya pagpadalagan.
english: If Risa continues to run for president in 2028, it is expected that Vice President Sara Duterte will oppose him, although there is no official confirmation, but there are clues given regarding his run.

text: Nagapangayo subong sang hustisya ang isa ka pamilya matapos napatay ang ila duha ka mga poodles sa isa ka dog training facility sa Marikina.
english: A family is now seeking justice after their two poodles died at a dog training facility in Marikina.

text: Napatay ang mga ido kag ginlubong nga wala ginpahibalo ang tag-iya.
english: The dogs died and were buried without informing the owner.

text: Nagligad pa ang isa ka semana antes sila ginsugiran sa natabo sa mga ido.
english: Another week passed before they were told what had happened to the dogs.

text: Ginsiling sang trainer nga heatstroke ang rason sang kamatayon sang mga ido apang nakit-an sa itsura sang mga ido nga gin-abuso ini.
english: The trainer said the dogs died of heatstroke but the appearance of the dogs showed that they were abused.

text: Ginpahayag man nga nautod pa ang ulo sang isa ka ido.
english: A dog was also reportedly beheaded.

text: Natalana naman nga magpasaka sang criminal charges ang Philippine Animal Welfare Society (PAWS) kun sa diin natukiban man nga indi rehistrado ang pasilidad.
english: The Philippine Animal Welfare Society (PAWS) is scheduled to file criminal charges against the facility.

text: Ginbulgar ni reelected Senator Bong Go nga pareho nga nagapangaluyag sanday Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero kag Senator-elect Tito Sotto sa Duterte bloc kaangot sa posisyon sang pagka-Senate President.
english: Reelected Senator Bong Go revealed that both Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero and Senator-elect Tito Sotto are in love with the Duterte bloc over the position of Senate President.

text: Ini matapos nagguwa ang pangalan ni Sotto nga amo ang matunog nga ginabati-bati nga isunod kay Escudero kun magbukas na ang 20th Congress.
english: This comes after Sotto's name came out as the loudly rumored successor to Escudero when the 20th Congress opens.

text: Suno kay Go, madamo pa sang iban nga naga-istorya sa ila kag bukas man sila sa sini nga mga istoryahanay.
english: Go said there are many others talking to them and they are open to these conversations as well.

text: Simple lang ang ila criteria suno kay Go nga amo ang pag-una sa interes sang Pilipinas, interes sang kada Pilipino, kag ipabilin nga independent ang Senado.
english: Go said their criteria are simple, namely to put the interests of the Philippines first, the interests of every Filipino, and keep the Senate independent.

text: Kun si Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa ang pahamblon, lima sila ang myembro sang Duterte bloc nga amo siya, si Go, si Robin Padilla, si Imee Marcos, kag si Senator-elect Rodante Marcoleta.
english: As for Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, there are five members of the Duterte bloc, namely him, Go, Robin Padilla, Imee Marcos, and Senator-elect Rodante Marcoleta.

text: Pahayag naman ni Go, wala pa sila sang desisyon kun sin-o ang ila suportahan nga mangin senate president, ukon magabutang sila sang kaugalingon nila nga kandidato para sa amo nga posisyon.
english: Go said they have not yet decided who they will support to become senate president, or they will put forward their own candidate for the position.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagpahayag si Sotto nga tatlo tubtub apat na ka mga senador ang nag-istorya sa iya agud nga iduso ini nga magpamuno sa upper chamber.
english: Sotto earlier said that three to four senators have already spoken to him to propose him to lead the upper chamber.

text: May mga nakit-an na nga senyales sang improvement sa kondisyon ni Pope Francis samtang nagapabilin ini gihapon sa ospital sa Roma bangud sa gina-suprer nga respiratory infection.
english: There are signs of improvement in Pope Francis' condition while he remains in a hospital in Rome due to a respiratory infection.

text: Suno kay Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, nakapahuway sang maayo ang 86-anyos nga Santo Papa matapos gin-admit sa Gemelli hospital kag pagkatapos sang pamahaw, nagbasa na ini kag nagbalik na sa trabaho.
english: According to Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, the 86-year-old Pope rested well after being admitted to the Gemelli hospital and after breakfast, he read and returned to work.

text: Sang panyaga naman, nagpadulong na ini sa gamay nga chapel sang isa ka private apartment kun sa diin ini nagpangamuyo.
english: In the afternoon, he went to the small chapel of a private apartment where he prayed.

text: Mangin si Pope Francis ang nagpalab-ot man sang pagpasalamat sa mga tumuluo nga nagpangamuyo para sa iya kondisyon.
english: Pope Francis also expressed his gratitude to the faithful who prayed for his condition.

text: “I am touched by the many messages received in these hours and I express my gratitude for the closeness and prayer,” suno sa iya nga tweet.
english: “I am touched by the many messages received in these hours and I express my gratitude for the closeness and prayer,” he tweeted.

text: May ginpaguwa man nga video message si Apostolic Nuncio to the Philippines Archbishop Charles Brown nga nagahingyo sa Filipino faithfuls nga magpangamuyo para sa Argentine Pope para sa maayo nga lawas kag madasig nga pag-ayo.
english: Apostolic Nuncio to the Philippines Archbishop Charles Brown also released a video message urging the Filipino faithful to pray for the Argentine Pope for good health and speedy recovery.

text: Matandaan nga antes gindala sa ospital, nakit-an pa sang iya weekly audience sa Vatican nga maayo ang pamatyag ni Pope Francis apang nakit-an man sang ulihi nga nagkuriit ini kag ginbululigan na nga makasulod sa salakyan kag gindala sa ospital.
english: It can be recalled that before being taken to the hospital, his weekly audience at the Vatican saw that Pope Francis was feeling well but later saw that he was writhing and was helped into the car and taken to the hospital.

text: Nahibaluan nga naga-suprer man ang Argentine pontiff sang chronic knee pain rason nga nagasakay ini sa wheelchair.
english: The Argentine pontiff also suffers from chronic knee pain and is confined to a wheelchair.

text: Ang Gemelli Hospital sa Rome amo man ang ospital kun sa diin nagpaidalom ang Santo Papa sa operasyon sa iya nga colon sang 2021 matapos nagsuprer sang diverticulitis, isa ka inflammation sang pockets nga naga-develop sa lining sang intestine.
english: The Gemelli Hospital in Rome is also the hospital where the Pope underwent surgery on his colon in 2021 after suffering from diverticulitis, an inflammation of the pockets that develop in the lining of the intestine.

text: Ginpamangkot sang lead defense counsel nga si Atty. Nicholas Kaufman ang prosekusyon sa International Criminal Court (ICC) kun imbestigaran man bala si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Lead defense counsel Atty. Nicholas Kaufman asked the prosecution in the International Criminal Court (ICC) whether to investigate President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: Ini bangud base sa presentasyon ni Kaufman, nagpadayon ang mga pagpamatay sang state forces bisan nga natapos na ang termino ni former President Rodrigo Duterte kag gindala na ini sa The Hague.
english: This is because based on Kaufman's presentation, the killings of state forces continued even after the end of the term of former President Rodrigo Duterte and it was brought to The Hague.

text: Kabahin ini sang ginmuno ni Kaufman sa ikatatlo nga adlaw sang confirmation of charges hearing batok kay Duterte nga nagapangatubang sang three counts of crimes against humanity bangud sa iya drug war.
english: This is part of what Kaufman said on the third day of the confirmation of charges hearing against Duterte who is facing three counts of crimes against humanity for his drug war.

text: Gingamit ni Kaufman sa iya nga presentasyon ang pagtuon halin sa University of the Philippines nga naangot sa drug-related killings sa idalom sang administrasyon ni Marcos.
english: Kaufman used in his presentation a study from the University of the Philippines on drug-related killings under the Marcos administration.

text: Ang hearing sa ICC naga-cover lamang sa hurisdiksyon sang korte halin sang November 1, 2011 tubtub March 16, 2019.
english: The ICC hearing covers only the court's jurisdiction from November 1, 2011 to March 16, 2019.

text: Apang ang gingamit nga report ni Kaufman nagasiling nga sa 342 killings sang 2022, may yara sang 162 nga ginkomiter sang state agents sa idalom na sang una nga tuig ni Marcos sa pwesto.
english: But the report used by Kaufman says that of the 342 killings in 2022, there were 162 committed by state agents already under Marcos' first year in office.

text: Ini nga numero nagsaka sang 2024 suno pa kay Kaufman.
english: This number has risen in 2024 according to Kaufman.

text: “The conclusion is that there is no reason to believe that Duterte’s disappearance from the political scene would have frustrated the ongoing incidents of murder at the hands of state agents or vigilantes,” suno sa abogado ni Duterte.
english: “The conclusion is that there is no reason to believe that Duterte’s disappearance from the political scene would have frustrated the ongoing incidents of murder at the hands of state agents or vigilantes,” Duterte’s lawyer said.

text: Diri na kag nagpamangkot si Kaufman kun may yara man bala sang naga-imbestigar sini halin sa ICC prosecution.
english: Kaufman asked if anyone from the ICC prosecution was investigating.

text: “Clearly, I’m forced to ask myself whether anyone on the other side of this room has thought of investigating the Marcos regime and the related phenomenon and holding someone accountable,” suno pa sa iya.
english: “Clearly, I’m forced to ask myself whether anyone on the other side of this room has thought of investigating the Marcos regime and the related phenomenon and holding someone accountable,” he added.

text: Ginkwestyon man sini ang prosekusyon kun ngaa wala na sang nagapanawagan sang “accountability” sa mga napatay sa Marcos administration.
english: He also questioned the prosecution why no one is calling for “accountability” for those killed in the Marcos administration.

text: “Or is it of no consequence now that Mr. Duterte is sitting in the ICC detention center?” pamangkot sini.
english: “Or is it of no consequence now that Mr. Duterte is sitting in the ICC detention center?” it asked.

text: Ini ang katapusan nga bahin sang presentasyon ni Kaufman antes nagtakop ang Session 2 sa Day 3 sang confirmation hearing para sa 90-minute break sang Pre-Trial Chamber I.#
english: This was the last part of Kaufman's presentation before Session 2 ended on Day 3 of the confirmation hearing for the 90-minute break of Pre-Trial Chamber I.#

text: WALA na seguro sing mas masakit kag mas makahalanusbo pa nga nadangtan sang isa ka pasyente sangsa natabo sa kay Renee “Alon” dela Rosa, ang composer kag singer sang OPM hit nga “Pusong Bato”.
english: THERE is probably nothing more painful and tragic for a patient than what happened to Renee “Alon” dela Rosa, the composer and singer of the OPM hit “Pusong Bato”.

text: Nakuhaan ang bantog nga singer sang malahalon niya nga kabuhi, sunu sa Yahoo News, sadtong Setyembre 15 sa edad nga 61 bangod sa “respiratory complications” (lack of oxygen) nga wala na ma-admit sa sulod sang ospital agud tabangan pa.
english: The famous singer died on September 15 at the age of 61 due to respiratory complications (lack of oxygen) and was not admitted to the hospital for further treatment.

text: Gindeklarar siya nga wala na sa Novaliches District Hospital sa Quezon City pagkatapos nga gin-reject siya nga batunon sang 35 ka mga ospital sa NCR bag-o makaabot diri.
english: He was declared dead at the Novaliches District Hospital in Quezon City after he was rejected by 35 hospitals in the NCR before arriving here.

text: Sunu gani sa anak nga si Justine, gin-mistreat pa sila sang pila ka health professionals.
english: According to her daughter, Justine, they were even mistreated by some health professionals.

text: As of press time, sadtong Setyembre 14, sunu sa iya balo nga si Raquel Hernandez, ginahulat pa ang resulta sang iya RT-PCR test agud mahibal-an kon bala COVID-19 positive siya ukon indi.
english: As of press time, on September 14, according to his widow, Raquel Hernandez, he is still waiting for the result of his RT-PCR test to know whether he is COVID-19 positive or not.

text: Ang masakit pa gid kay ang natabo sa iya daw prediksyon pa sang iya kanta ang masubo niya nga nadangtan sa kuko sang may pusong bato (stone-cold heart) nga 35 ka ospital nga nag-reject sa iya.
english: The painful thing is that what happened to him was like a prediction of his song that he sadly ended up in the claws of the stone-cold heart of 35 hospitals that rejected him.

text:
Katulad sang kasubo sang iya kanta ang iya nadangtan: “Di mo alam dahil sa yo ako’y hindi makakain, di rin makatulog buhat ng iyong lokohin; kung ako’y muling iibig sana’y di maging katulad mo, tulad mo na may pusong bato.”

Wala kita nagasiling nga daw nabiktima siya sang isa ka stone-cold killer nga wala konsyensya, although nagapati kita nga nasugpunan tani ang iya kabuhi kon  namedyosan anay nga matakdan siya sang oxygen tank, nga ginpangayo gid sang iya anak, nga wala mahimo sang bisan isa sa mga ospital nga nag-reject sa iya.
english:
Like the sadness of his song, he felt: “You don't know that because of you I can't eat, I can't sleep because of your foolishness; if I were to be loved again, I wouldn't be like you, like you with a stone heart.”

We are not saying that he was the victim of an unconscious stone-cold killer, although we believe that his life could have been saved if he had been given an oxygen tank, which his son had requested, which none of the hospitals that rejected him could have done.

text:
***

Isa ini ka daku nga kapaslawan sang ginapabugal nga “pandemic response” sang gobyernong Duterte agud mag-provide, at least sang bastante nga mga health facilities, katulad sang dugang ng mga ospital,  agud matatapan sing maayo kag matabangan ang malahalon nga kabuhi sang pasyente batok sa COVID-19 kag mga “mutations” sini.
english:
***

This is a major failure of the Duterte government's vaunted “pandemic response” to provide, at least enough health facilities, such as additional hospitals, to properly care for and help the precious lives of patients against COVID-19 and its mutations.

text: Pamatuod man ini, sa kabug-usan, sang “incompetence” sini sa paghibalo sang bagay nga mga forecast nga maka-anticipar sang masunod nga mga hitabo – kada semana ukon binulan halin sadtong Marso 2020 – partikular sa kadamuon sang mga kaso sang COVID-19, kon pila ang napatay, kon pila ang na-ospital, kag kon pila kag ano ang health facilities nga kinahanglanon.
english: This is also evidence, overall, of its “incompetence” in knowing the right forecasts to anticipate future events – weekly or monthly since March 2020 – particularly in terms of the number of COVID-19 cases, how many have died, how many have been hospitalized, and how many and what health facilities are needed.

text: Pamatuod man ini sang sala nga prioridad sa paggamit sang pondo para sa problema nga dala sang COVID-19, lakip na, sunu sa mga akusasyon, kay may P8.7 ka bilyon nga naremedyuhan sing daku kag ginpalapaw sang pila ka matakab sa pagbakal sang pandemic supplies.
english: This is also evidence of the wrong priority in the use of funds for the problem brought about by COVID-19, including, according to the accusations, because there is P8.7 billion that has been largely remedied and exaggerated by some corrupt in the purchase of pandemic supplies.

text: Hamak mo ran!
english: Hammock and blood!

text:
***

Pero ano gid bala ang natabo kay Pusong Bato dela Rosa?
english:
***

But what really happened to Pusong Bato dela Rosa?

text:
Ini ang panaysayon sang iya anak nga si Justine sa iya Facebook post, sunu sa Yahoo News, sadtong Setyembre 14, samtang nagapangayo sang bulig pinansyal kag pagpangamuyo para sa iya amay:

“Any amount will do po and prayers na rin po.
english:
This is what his daughter Justine said in her Facebook post, according to Yahoo News, on September 14, while asking for financial help and prayers for her father:

“Any amount will do and prayers na rin po.

text:
Salamat.”

“ASAP: Need Oxygen Tank na may laman.
english:
Thank you."

“ASAP: Need Oxygen Tank filled.

text: at Private Hospital na rin po around QC na may avail na room po, please,” she wrote.
english: and Private Hospital around QC with available room, please,” she wrote.

text: 3 hours later around 7 p.m., the singer-dancer posted once again that her father is still in the ambulance because there are no available rooms in the hospitals.
english: 3 hours later around 7 p.m., the singer-dancer posted once again that her father is still in the ambulance because there are no available rooms in the hospitals.

text: “Badly needed, private hospital with available room.
english: “Badly needed, private hospital with available room.

text: Or baka may kakilala po kayo na tao na marrefer nyo po sa amin.
english: Or maybe you know someone who can refer you to us.

text: Please po need ma-admit sa ospital ng papa ko.
english: Please need to be admitted to my father's hospital.

text: We need your help po.
english: We need your help too.

text: According to Justine, they already inquired 35 hospitals, but all of them rejected her father.
english: According to Justine, they already inquired 35 hospitals, but all of them rejected her father.

text: “35 hospitals na nalibot namin, bakit po puro reject?
english: “We visited 35 hospitals, why are they all rejected?

text: Lord, tulungan nyo po kami,” she said.
english: Lord, help us,” she said.

text: But around 9 am, she sadly announced that her father already passed on.
english: But around 9 am, she sadly announced that her father had already passed on.

text: “Wala na po si Papuy Renee Alon,” she posted along with crying emojis.
english: “Papuy Renee Alon is gone,” she posted along with crying emojis.

text: “Grabe po yung mga ospital na pinuntahan po namin.
english: “The hospitals we went to were terrible.

text: Nagmamakaawa na nga po kami kahit sa labas na lang po kami, pero ayaw po nila.
english: We've been begging even if we're outside, but they won't.

text: “Yung iba po tinataboy pa po kami at sinusungitan po.
english: “The others are still chasing us and teasing us.

text: Na-record po namin yung ibang trato po sa amin ng mga ospital, kung paano kami sinungitan,” she said.
english: We recorded the other treatment we received from the hospitals, how we were treated,” she said.

text: (Ang sakit naman!)/PN
english: (The pain!)/PN

text: Nagatunog ang espekulasyon nga mahimo mag-atubangay liwat si Manny Pacquiao kag si Floyd Mayweather Jr.
english: Speculation is ringing out that Manny Pacquiao and Floyd Mayweather Jr. could face each other again.

text: kun magdaog ang Pinoy boxing icon sa title fight sini sa Domingo sang aga (PST).
english: if the Filipino boxing icon wins his title fight on Sunday morning (PST).

text: Nag-umpisa ini sa reports nga magalantaw ang 48-anyos nga retired undefeated boxing champion sa away ni Pacquiao batok kay Mario Barrios sa MGM Grand Arena sa Las Vegas, Nevada para sa World Boxing Council welterweight crown.
english: It started with reports that the 48-year-old retired undefeated boxing champion will watch Pacquiao fight Mario Barrios at the MGM Grand Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada for the World Boxing Council welterweight crown.

text: Duha sa mga boksidor nga magahampang sa undercard sa Domingo ang napaidalom sa Mayweather Promotions.
english: Two of the boxers who will fight on Sunday’s undercard are under Mayweather Promotions.

text: Nag-post man si anay Los Angeles Times reporter Lance Pugmire sang posibilidad sang ikaduha nga Pacquiao-Mayweather slugfest.
english: Former Los Angeles Times reporter Lance Pugmire also posted the possibility of a second Pacquiao-Mayweather slugfest.

text:
“Conversations are already happening … If Manny wins, this (rematch) could be worth billions,” I was told,” suno kay Pugmire sa X.

Matandaan nga ang American boxer ang nagdaog sa ila nga welterweight unification bout paagi sa unanimous decision nga naglab-ot sa record nga 4.6 million pay-per-view buys kag masobra sa $410 million nga revenue.
english:
“Conversations are already happening … If Manny wins, this (rematch) could be worth billions,” I was told,” according to Pugmire on X.

The American boxer won their welterweight unification bout by unanimous decision, reaching a record of 4.6 million pay-per-view buys and more than $410 million in revenue.

text: Kasunod sadto, duha ka beses pa nga naghampang si Mayweather lakip na ang blockbuster game batok kay MMA superstar Conor McGregor antes siya nag-retiro sa boksing nga may undefeated record nga 50-0 lakip na ang 27 knockouts.
english: Following that, Mayweather fought two more times including a blockbuster game against MMA superstar Conor McGregor before retiring from boxing with an undefeated record of 50-0 including 27 knockouts.

text: 2021 naman sang nag-retiro ang nagaisahanon nga eight-division world champion nga bugal sang Pilipinas nga may 62-8- record lakip na ang 39 KOs.
english: In 2021, the only eight-division world champion, the pride of the Philippines, retired with a 62-8 record including 39 KOs.

text:
Matuod ang hambalanon nga ”When life gives you lemons, make lemonade.” Apang suno naman sa mga eksperto, ”don’t ever throw the lemon peel.”

Suno kay Ariane Lang, registered dietician sa San José, Costa Rica, ang panit sang lemon ang manggaranon sa bioactive compounds nga tuman ka bentaha sa ikaayong lawas.
english:
The saying ”When life gives you lemons, make lemonade” is true. But according to experts, "don't ever throw away the lemon peel."

According to Ariane Lang, registered dietician in San José, Costa Rica, lemon peel is rich in bioactive compounds that are very advantageous for health.

text: Pahayag sang dietician, ang flavonoids, fiber, vitamin C, kag D-limonene nga yara sa panit sang lemon, ang naga-stimulate sa immune system kag nagaproteher sa lawas batok sa nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian.
english: According to the dietician, the flavonoids, fiber, vitamin C, and D-limonene contained in lemon peel, stimulate the immune system and protect the body against various diseases.

text: Bangud man sa powerful antibacterial properties sang panit sang lemon, makabulong ini sa mga oral-disease.
english: Due to the powerful antibacterial properties of lemon peel, it can cure oral-diseases.

text: Magluwas diri, manggaranon man sa antioxidants ang panit sang lemon nga nagapanami sang supat sa diin mahimo ini nga gamiton bilang face mask.
english: In addition, lemon peel is also rich in antioxidants that improve the skin and can be used as a face mask.

text: Gin-revise sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) ang impormasyon nga ginpaguwa sini kaangot sa linog nga nabatyagan sa Iloilo kag sa kaiping nga mga probinsya kagab-i, Marso 2.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) has revised the information it released regarding the earthquake felt in Iloilo and neighboring provinces last night, March 2.

text: Sa Earthquake Information 2 sang ahensya, ginklaro nga ang sentro sang linog amo ang Guimbal, Iloilo — baliskad sa nauna sini nga gin-report nga Tigbauan.
english: In the agency's Earthquake Information 2, it was clarified that the epicenter of the quake was Guimbal, Iloilo — contrary to its previous report of Tigbauan.

text: Ginpanubo man sang ahensya ang magnitude sa 4.8 halin sa nauna sini nga data nga magnitude 5.0 ang kabaskugon sang pagtay-og.
english: The agency also lowered the magnitude to 4.8 from its previous data of magnitude 5.0.

text: 6:13 sang nagluntad ang linog kag tectonic in origin.
english: 6:13 when the quake occurred and was tectonic in origin.

text:
