The agency also clarified that no more aftershocks and damages are anticipated following the quake.

text: Nakakadto ka na bala sa ginakabig pinakamalinong nga airport sa kalibutan?
english: Have you ever been to what is considered the quietest airport in the world?

text: Kun wala pa, ilagaw ko ikaw didto subong nga aga.
english: If not, I'll take you there this morning.

text: Ini amo ang Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport sa Sri Lanka kag nahamtang mga apat ka oras nga byahe ang kalayuon gikan sa capital city sang Colombo.
english: It is the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport in Sri Lanka and is located about a four-hour drive away from the capital city of Colombo.

text: Ang paluparan may yara sang tuman ka diutay nga flights sa pihak sang dako nga size sang airport.
english: The airport has very few flights despite the large size of the airport.

text: Makit-an sa Hambantota, ang Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport ang may yara lang sang pito ka tawo nga nagaagi sa terminal sini sa isa ka adlaw.
english: Located in Hambantota, the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport has only seven people passing through its terminal a day.

text: Ang paluparan napalibutan sang kagulangan kag gagmay nga villages.
english: The airport is surrounded by forest and small villages.

text: Ang airport ginbuksan sang 2013 kag tubtob subong, nagamantinir lang ini sang pito ka pasahero kada adlaw bisan pa nga isa ini ka international airport.
english: The airport was opened in 2013 and to date, it only maintains seven passengers per day despite being an international airport.

text: May plano bala ikaw nga magbyahe sa Hunyo?
english: Are you planning a trip in June?

text: Lauman nga mas manubo ang airfare sa masunod nga bulan kasunod sang anunsyo sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) nga nag-us-os ang fuel surcharge level para sa domestic kag international flights.
english: Airfare is expected to be lower next month following the announcement by the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) that the fuel surcharge level for domestic and international flights has been reduced.

text: Sa advisory sang CAB, ginsiling nga ang passenger kag cargo fuel surcharge para sa flights diri sa Pilipinas kag pakadto sa luwas sang pungsod ang na-set sa Level 3.
english: In the CAB advisory, it was said that the passenger and cargo fuel surcharge for flights here in the Philippines and to foreign countries is set at Level 3.

text: Halin ini sa June 1-30, 2025 nga mas manubo sa current Level nga 4.
english: This is from June 1-30, 2025 which is lower than the current Level 4.

text: Sa idalom sang Level 3, ang mga pasahero sa domestic flights ang magadugang sang bayad nga P80 tubtub sa P300, kag P273.36 tubtub sa P2,032.54 naman sa flights nga halin sa Pilipinas kag pakadto na sa iban nga mga nasyon.
english: Under Level 3, passengers on domestic flights will pay an increase of P80 to P300, and P273.36 to P2,032.54 for flights from the Philippines to other countries.

text: Tandaan nga ang fuel surcharge isa ka optional fee, magluwas pa sa base fare, nga amo ang ginapasa sang airlines sa mga pasahero agud nga maka-recover sa gasto nga nakuha sa volatility sang jet fuel.
english: Keep in mind that the fuel surcharge is an optional fee, in addition to the base fare, which is what airlines pass on to passengers in order to recoup the cost incurred in the volatility of jet fuel.

text: Ang price movement sa sini nga jet fuel amo man ang salandigan kun may adjustments nga himuon ang CAB sa fuel surcharges.
english: The price movement of this jet fuel will also be the basis for any adjustments to be made by the CAB in fuel surcharges.

text: Sandig pa sa abiso sang CAB, dapat nga mag-file na sang application ang airlines nga gusto mag-kolekta sang fuel surcharge para sa Hunyo — antes ukon mismo sa effectivity period nga nakasaad sa advisory.
english: According to the CAB notice, airlines that want to collect the fuel surcharge for June must file an application before or during the effectiveness period stipulated in the advisory.

text: (RUSSELL PALMA/PHOTO)
english: (RUSSELL PALMA/PHOTO)

text: Ginpatay sang isa ka 28-anyos nga babayi ang tatlo ka kabataan kag tatlo ka staff sang isa ka private elementary school sa Nashville, Tennessee sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: A 28-year-old woman killed three children and three staff members of a private elementary school in Nashville, Tennessee in the United States of America.

text: Matapos ang pagpang-atake, natigayon man nga napatay sang mga pulis ang suspek.
english: After the attack, the police also managed to kill the suspect.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga impormasyon, dala sang suspek ang duha ka assault rifles kag handgun sang nagsulod ini sa Christian Covenant School kag sunod nga nagpinangluthang sa iya mga nakit-an.
english: According to initial information, the suspect was carrying two assault rifles and a handgun when he entered the Christian Covenant School and then opened fire on those he saw.

text: Nagbato pa ini sa mga nagresponde nga pulis sa insidente rason nga naiguan man sang bala kag napatay.
english: He even threw stones at the police who responded to the incident and was shot dead.

text: Ginapahayag nga residente man sang Nashville ang suspek apang gina-imbestigaran pa subong ang motibo sang krimen.
english: The suspect is also a resident of Nashville but the motive of the crime is still being investigated.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Metro Nashville Police Chief John Drake nga na-identify nila ang assailant apang wala pa gin-release ang pangalan.
english: Metro Nashville Police Chief John Drake also said they have identified the assailant but have not released his name.

text: Ginkumpirma man nga former student man ini sang Covenant School nga iya ginsulod kag gin-atake.
english: It was also confirmed that he was also a former student of the Covenant School that he entered and attacked.

text: Ini nga hitabo ang pinakaulihi sa serye sang pagpangluthang sa campuses sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: This incident is the latest in a series of campus shootings in the United States of America.

text: Madumduman nga ginmanduan sang korte ang prosekusyon nga tapuson ang pag-disclose sang arrest warrant materials nga may kahilabtanan sa mga testigo antes mag-abot ang Hulyo 1.
english: The court ordered the prosecution to complete the disclosure of arrest warrant materials related to the witnesses before July 1.

text: Ginpahibalo man nga sa Hunyo 16 ang deadline para sa Prosekusyon nga magsumiter sang mga aplikasyon para sa pag-redact sang kinahanglanon sang mga testigo ukon indi pagpagwa sang bug-os nga mga ebidensiya.
english: It was also announced that June 16 is the deadline for the Prosecution to submit applications for redacting the need for witnesses or not releasing full evidence.

text: Amo man ini ang deadline para sa Victims and Witness Unit nga magsumiter sang ila mga obserbasyon sa nasambit nga aplikasyon.
english: This is also the deadline for the Victims and Witness Unit to submit its observations on the said application.

text: Samtang, sa Hunyo 20 ginplano nga deadline para sa pagsumiter sang mga sabat ukon tugon sa tanan nga submissions nga nalakipan sang mga ginpahayag nga application.
english: Meanwhile, June 20 is the planned deadline for submitting responses to all submissions included in the announced applications.

text: Aprubado na ni US President Joe Biden ang emergency declaration sa Mississippi kasunod sang buhawi sa amo nga estado sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga nagpatay sang 25 ka mga residente kag isa sa Alabama.
english: US President Joe Biden has approved an emergency declaration in Mississippi following a tornado in the state in the United States of America that killed 25 residents and one in Alabama.

text: Nagmandu man si Biden sang federal aid agud mabuligan ang state kag ginpatigayon man ang tribal kag local recovery efforts sa apektado nga areas.
english: Biden also ordered federal aid to help the state and launched tribal and local recovery efforts in the affected areas.

text: Nagapadayon man subong ang operasyon sang search and rescue teams.
english: Search and rescue teams are also conducting operations.

text: Ini nga buhawi ang pinakamakamamatay nga buhawi nga natabo sa amo nga estado sa masobra isa na ka sekada.
english: The tornado was the deadliest tornado to hit the state in more than a decade.

text: Nagpaandam man si Governor Tate Reeves sa posible epekto sang mas malala pa nga tyempo sa Mississippi.
english: Governor Tate Reeves also warned of the potential impact of more severe weather in Mississippi.

text: 20 ka mga Pinoy ang nawad-an sang ilistaran kasunod sang pag-collapse sang pito ka panalgan nga residential building sa Mansoura, Doha, Qatar.
english: 20 Filipinos were left homeless following the collapse of a seven-story residential building in Mansoura, Doha, Qatar.

text: Isa ang kumpirmado nga patay as of press time kag siyam ang na-rescue apang padayon pa nga ginahibalo ang nationalities.
english: One person was confirmed dead as of press time and nine were rescued but their nationalities are still unknown.

text:
Suno kay Bombo Joseph Rivera, international correspondent sa Qatar, gintatap gilayon sang embahada sang Pilipinas ang apektado nga mga Pinoy kag gin-book sang mga kuwarto sa hotel agud makapaligad sang gab-i.

Mangin ang Filipino community ang naghulag man agud maghatag sang pagkaon, panapton, kag iban pa nga mga bulig sa mga na-displace nga mga Pinoy.
english:
According to Bombo Joseph Rivera, international correspondent in Qatar, the Philippine embassy immediately took care of the affected Filipinos and booked hotel rooms to spend the night.

Even the Filipino community has stepped up to provide food, clothing, and other assistance to the displaced Filipinos.

text: Magluwas sa Filipino families, ginapahayag nga madamo man sang Egyptian kag Pakistani sa amo nga building.
english: Besides Filipino families, there are also reportedly many Egyptians and Pakistanis in the building.

text: Nagpakigkita si Chinese President Xi Jinping kay Russian leader Vladimir Putin sa iya una nga adlaw sang pagbisita sa Moscow.
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Russian leader Vladimir Putin on his first day of a visit to Moscow.

text: Magalawig sang tatlo ka adlaw ang pagtinir ni Xi sa Russia.
english: Xi's stay in Russia will last three days.

text: Ini ang iya una nga bes nga pagtapak sa amo nga pungsod halin sang gin-invade sang Russia ang Ukraine.
english: This is his first time setting foot in that country since Russia invaded Ukraine.

text: Natabo man ini pila ka adlaw lang matapos nagpaguwa ang International Criminal Court sa Hague ang arrest warrent batok sa Russian President bangud sa ginpahayag pagkomiter sang war crimes sa Ukraine.
english: This also happened just days after the International Criminal Court in The Hague issued an arrest warrant against the Russian President for allegedly committing war crimes in Ukraine.

text: Sa amo nga meeting, ginpahayag ni Xi nga nagalaum siya nga malantaw ang proposal sang China para sa resolution sa Ukraine conflict.
english: During the meeting, Xi said he hoped to consider China's proposal for a resolution to the Ukraine conflict.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang China nga ini nga byahe ni Xi ang makabig nga “journey of friendship, cooperation and peace”.NIni ang sa tunga sang katuyuan sang Beijing nga ipakita ang kaugalingon bilang isa ka “key proponent” para masolbar ang mga away sa kalibutan.
english: China has previously said that Xi's trip will be considered a "journey of friendship, cooperation and peace". It is part of Beijing's goal to present itself as a "key proponent" to resolve world conflicts.

text: Bisan amo sini ang pahayag sang China, para naman sa Western capitals, isa ini ka “endorsement” sa Russian leader sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga Russia-Ukraine conlict.
english: Despite China's statement, for Western capitals, it is an endorsement of the Russian leader amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conlict.

text: Sa isa ka portion sang meeting nga ginpabati sa publiko, ginpahayag ni Xi nga handa siya kag bukas sa anuman nga negotiation process.
english: In a portion of the meeting that was made public, Xi said he was ready and open to any negotiation process.

text: Baliskad ini sa iya sulit-sulit nga pagpamalibad sa hingyo sang Kyiv nga mag-withdraw na sang ila tropa sa duta nga sakop sang Ukraine.
english: This is in contrast to his repeated refusal to ask Kyiv to withdraw its troops from Ukrainian territory.

text: Suno naman kay Ukrainian foreign ministry spokesman Oleg Nikolenko, nagalaum ang Kyiv nga gamiton ni Xi ang iya impluwensya agud nga matapos na ang agresibo nga pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: Ukrainian foreign ministry spokesman Oleg Nikolenko said Kyiv hopes Xi will use his influence to end Russia's aggressive attacks on Ukraine.

text: Nagpakita na sa publiko ang aktres nga si Karen Lopez matapos naglapta ang impormasyon sa publiko nga missing ini sang masobra na isa ka semana.
english: Actress Karen Lopez has appeared in public after information spread to the public that she was missing for more than a week.

text: Ginpaagi ni Karen sa isa ka Facebook Live ang pagpahibalo sa iya pamilya nga buhi siya kag wala sang malain nga natabo sa iya.
english: Karen told her family through a Facebook Live that she is alive and well.

text: Nagguwa si Karen sa social media matapos nga nagpaguwa na sang statement ang Quezon City Police District (QCPD) nga nagsiling nga wala pa sila sang nabaton nga formal missing-person report.
english: Karen appeared on social media after the Quezon City Police District (QCPD) issued a statement saying they had not yet received a formal missing-person report.

text: Nangayo sang pasaylo ang aktres kun napuhag man ang mga tawo sa iya pagkadula.
english: The actress apologized if people were shocked by her disappearance.

text:
Pahayag sini, ginkinahanglan lang niya ang pahuway kag ang space, bangud sa mga bagay nga iya naagyan nga sunod sa iya, “mentally and emotionally draining.”

“Pasensya na talaga kung bigla akong nawala nitong mga nakaraang araw.
english:
He said he just needed the rest and the space, because of the things he went through that were next to him, “mentally and emotionally draining.”

“I’m really sorry for my sudden disappearance these past few days.

text: Kailangan ko lang munang magpahinga at mag-focus sa sarili ko.
english: I just need to take a break and focus on myself first.

text: Dumaan ako sa mga bagay na medyo mabigat mentally and emotionally, at napagtanto kong kailangan kong unahin ang well-being ko- even if that meant stepping back for a while,” pahayag sini.
english: I went through some things that were pretty heavy mentally and emotionally, and I realized that I needed to prioritize my well-being- even if that meant stepping back for a while,” she said.

text: “Alam kong may ilan sa inyo ang nag alala o nagtaka, at sobrang na-appreciate ko ang messages at support ninyo.
english: “I know some of you are worried or wondering, and I really appreciate your messages and support.

text: Slowly, I’m getting better and trying to comeback stronger, one step at a time.
english: Slowly, I’m getting better and trying to comeback stronger, one step at a time.

text: Salamat sa mga nakaintindi, sa mga nag-reach out, at sa mga patuloy na nandyan.
english: Thank you to those who understood, to those who reached out, and to those who continue to be there.

text: Slowly but surely, I’m getting back on track.
english: Slowly but surely, I’m getting back on track.

text:
Appreciate you all so much!”

Matandaan nga base sa nauna nagguwa nga report, Mayo 5 sang ulihi nakit-an si Karen matapos nga nagbiya siya kag ang iya boyfriend sa iya condominium unit.
english:
Appreciate you all so much!”

According to previous reports, Karen was later found on May 5 after she and her boyfriend left her condominium unit.

text: Si Karen ukon Iris Abraham sa matuod nga pangalan ang naka-sign up sa idalom sang Viva Artists Agency nga amo ang nagadumala sang VMX (ukon kilala anay nga Vivamax).#
english: Karen or Iris Abraham by real name is signed up under Viva Artists Agency which manages VMX (or formerly known as Vivamax).#

text: TUBTUB sa sining ulihi, mabaskug pa gihapon ang popularidad ni Presidente Duterte.
english: UNTIL recently, President Duterte's popularity is still strong.

text: Amat-amat na ugaling nagalus-aw ini tungod sa “political fatigue”, ukon “kakapoy”na sa bahin sang madamo na nga pumuluyo sa pag-upod sa iya, kag tungod sa “disillusionment” ukon pagkadula sang pagsalig sang madamo man sa ikasarang sang gobyernong Duterte agud masabat ang mga problema nga ginaatubang sang mga pumuluyo, labi na gid  sa sining panahon sang COVID-19.
english: However, it is slowly fading due to political fatigue on the part of many people to join him, and due to disillusionment or loss of confidence in the Duterte government's ability to address the problems faced by the people, especially during this time of COVID-1

text: Sadtong kampanya sang Mayo 2016, todo suporta gid ang mga pumuluyo sa kay anay Davao City Mayor Duterte.
english: During the May 2016 campaign, the people fully supported former Davao City Mayor Duterte.

text: In fact, nagdaug siya nga may daku nga boto – mga 16 ka milyon sang mga 40 ka milyon nga botante sadto.
english: In fact, he won with a huge vote – about 16 million of about 40 million voters then.

text: Tungod ina sang pagpati sang nagboto sa iya nga masabat niya ang padayon nga problema sa krimen, droga kag korapsyon nga nagapugong sang pag-ugwad sang pungsod paagi sa isa ka masaligan nga liderato.
english: This is because of the belief of those who voted for him that he can address the persistent problems of crime, drugs and corruption that hinder the country's development through a reliable leadership.

text: Pero masaligan gid bala ato nga liderato?
english: But is that leadership really trustworthy?

text: Sang meyor pa si Duterte sang Davao City, ginkilala siya nga wala kaluoy sa mga kriminal.
english: When Duterte was mayor of Davao City, he was known to have no mercy on criminals.

text: Ginkilala gani siya bilang “Punisher” kag “Duterte Harry”, ang bansag nga ginhatag sa iya sang mga fans ni Clint Eastwood sa iya pelikula nga Dirty Harry.
english: He was even known as the “Punisher” and “Duterte Harry”, the nickname given to him by fans of Clint Eastwood in his film Dirty Harry.

text:
Si Dirty Harry, sa pelikula, isa ka detektib nga pulis nga wala sing patawad sa mga kriminal kag ang iya lang personal nga kasuguan ang iya ginatuman, nga sa

masami nagatapos sa kamatayon sang suspetsado.
english:
Dirty Harry, in the movie, is a detective cop who has no mercy on criminals and only follows his personal law, which in

often ending in the death of the suspect.

text: Sa bahin ni Duterte, sang Presidente na, ginpamahog gid niya nga pamatyon niya ang mga kriminal kag ang mga drug pusher kag druglord.
english: For Duterte's part, when he became President, he threatened to kill criminals and drug pushers and druglords.

text: In fact, sa rekord lang sang kapulisan, nagalab-ut sa mga 6,000 – sobra 10,000 sa report sang mga human rights advocates – ang napatay sang mga pulis sugod sang pagpungko niya sa poder sadtong 2016.
english: In fact, according to police records alone, about 6,000 – more than 10,000 according to human rights advocates – have been killed by police since he took office in 2016.

text: Nagbatu kuno sa mga otoridad, apang wala nagapati sini ang mga human rights advocates.
english: He allegedly resisted the authorities, but human rights advocates do not believe this.

text: Hungod kuno nga ginpatay paagi sa “extrajudicial killings” nga labag sa “due process” kag “rule of law”.
english: He was allegedly killed in extrajudicial killings against due process and rule of law.

text: May nag-file na gani sing kaso nga “crime against humanity” kontra sa kay Duterte sa International Criminal Court.
english: Some have even filed a case of “crime against humanity” against Duterte in the International Criminal Court.

text: Bale wala man gani sa iya mga botante ang salawayon nga pamatasan ni Duterte.
english: Duterte's reprehensible behavior is not even among his voters.

text: Gintawag sini nga “stupid” ang Diyos.
english: It called God “stupid”.

text: Gintawag man niya si Pope Francis nga “son of a whore” (Anak ng puta).
english: He also called Pope Francis a “son of a whore”.

text: Ginkalipay man gani niya nga tani naka-partisipar siya sa paglugos sang isa ka “beautiful Australian nun”.
english: He even wished he had participated in the rape of a beautiful Australian nun.

text: Kag sa gihapon mataas ang trust rating niya!
english: And yet he has a high trust rating!

text:
***

Sa nasiling ta na, amat-amat na gid man nagabatyag sing “political fatigue” ang mga pumuluyo sa liwat-liwat nga “pagpamahog” kag “pamuyayaw” si Duterte sa kon sin-o lang luyag niya paukpan.
english:
***

As we have already said, the people are slowly feeling “political fatigue” with Duterte's repeated “threats” and “insults” to whomever he wants to silence.

text: Labi na gid kay wala man naaputan ang iya mga pangako sadtong kampanya batok sa krimen, droga kag korapsyon.
english: Especially since his promises during the campaign against crime, drugs and corruption were not fulfilled.

text: “Naglala gani!” tugda gani sang sadto supporter niya.
english: “It got worse!” even his former supporter suggested.

text:
Kag pwede na makasiling ang iban: “Tama na, kapoy na kami sa pag-suporta sa imo dramatics!”

Puro man lang kuno laway ini kon ang involved ang iya mga langga-langga.
english:
And others can say: “Enough, we are tired of supporting your dramatics!”

It's just spit when his loved ones are involved.

text: Ginahinabunan pa gani niya ang mga kasaypanan nila tungod wala man sing may napasaka nga kaso sa bisan isa sang iya corrupt nga sumulunod.
english: He even covers up their mistakes because no case has been filed against any of his corrupt followers.

text: Nagapabaskug pa gani ini sang suspetso nga kahimbon pa si Presidente sa kamalamalahan sa pagbakal sang binilyon ka pesos nga  pandemic supplies, sunu kay Senador Gordon.
english: This even reinforces the suspicion that the President is still involved in the purchase of billions of pesos in pandemic supplies, according to Senator Gordon.

text:
***

Yara man ang “disillusionment” sang mga pumuluyo sa mga negatibo nga development katulad sang isyu sang korapsyon sa pagbakal sang pandemic supplies.
english:
***

There is also the “disillusionment” of the people with negative developments such as the issue of corruption in the purchase of pandemic supplies.

text: Imagine, P625,000 lang ang kapital pero nakakuha kontrata nga sobra P8 ka bilyon!
english: Imagine, P625,000 capital but got a contract of more than P8 billion!

text: Yara pa gid ang halos wala pagkabalaka sa mga kahimtangan kag kinahanglanon sang mga health workers nga sa tion-tion  nagataya sang ila kabuhi.
english: There is also the almost indifference to the conditions and needs of health workers who sometimes risk their lives.

text: Gina-reklamo man ang pagpabaya sa pag-provide sang bagay nga pagtatap kag mga bulong sa mga “severe” kag “critical” nga mga pasyente nga tani naluas pa.
english: It also complains of negligence in providing appropriate care and medicines to “severe” and “critical” patients who should have been saved.

text: Kulang man ang suporta sa mga ginagutman kag mga negosyo nga makabulig pabangon tani sang aton ekonomiya.
english: There is also a lack of support for the hungry and businesses that could help boost our economy.

text:
***

Tungod sini, amo man gihapon bala nga klase sang suporta nga ihatag sang mga botante kay Presidente Duterte kon magdalagan siya sa pagka-Bise Presidente upod sang mga kandidato niya sa 2022 nga eleksyon?
english:
***

Because of this, will voters give the same kind of support to President Duterte if he runs for Vice President with his candidates in the 2022 elections?

text: “Laban-laban seguro indi na,” tugda sang observer naton.
english: “Most probably not,” suggested our observer.

text: Kinahanglan lang sang oposisyon, siling niya, ang isa ka alternative proposition nga mas madinalag-on para sa pagsabat sang problema sang mga pumuluyo batok sa kriminalidad, droga, korapsyon, kag kaimolon sa isa ka pungsod nga makatao kag maka-Diyos./PN
english: The opposition just needs, he said, an alternative proposition that is more successful for addressing the problem of the people against crime, drugs, corruption, and poverty in a humane and godly country./PN

text: Ang kada iloy makapanugid gid kun ano kabudlay ang eksperyensya kun sila ang nagabata.
english: Every mother can tell you how difficult the experience is when they give birth.

text: Apang imagine kun ano kabudlay ini para sa mga nanay nga nagbata sa tion mismo sang emerhensya kaangay sang sunog.
english: But imagine how difficult it is for mothers who give birth during an emergency such as a fire.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, natabo ang isa ka daku nga sunog sa residential area sa Tondo, Manila.
english: The other day, a massive fire broke out in the residential area of ​​Tondo, Manila.

text: Nagsugod ang kalayo 11:00 sa aga sang Sabado kag nagmakot ini sa mga building nga may light materials kag madasig man nga naglapta pati sa kaiping nga mga komunidad.
english: The fire started at 11:00 am on Saturday and spread to buildings with light materials and quickly spread to neighboring communities.

text: Pasado ala una sang hapon sang amo nga adlaw, gin-raise na ang Task Force Bravo nga buot silingon malapit 30 na ka fire trucks ang kinahanglan.
english: Around 1 pm that day, Task Force Bravo was raised which means nearly 30 fire trucks are needed.

text: Nakit-an man mangin ang helicopter sang Philippine Air Force (PAF) 505th Search and Rescue Brigade nga nagbulig, apang apisar sang pagbinuligay, 2,000 gid ka mga pamilya ang nawad-an sang puluy-an.
english: Even the helicopter of the Philippine Air Force (PAF) 505th Search and Rescue Brigade was also found to help, but despite the cooperation, 2,000 families were left homeless.

text: Sa tunga sining kasakuon, ginpatawag naman ang Philippine Red Cross (PRC) bangud may isa ka bata nga napilasan.
english: In the midst of this busyness, the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) was called because a child was injured.

text: Nagresponde ang team kag samtang nagaparik-parik ang tanan sa sunog, isa naman ka 41-anyos nga babaye ang ila nakit-an nga manugbata na gid kag nagakinahanglan sang bulig.
english: The team responded and while everyone was struggling with the fire, they found another 41-year-old woman who was about to give birth and needed help.

text: Ginpasa sa lain nga crew ang pilason nga bata, kag wala man pagpangduha-duha ang Red Cross nga buligan ang nanay nga mapaguwa ang isa ka baby girl.
english: The injured child was handed over to another crew, and the Red Cross did not hesitate to help the mother get a baby girl out.

text: Sa subong, ang nanay kag ang baby ang pareho nga ginatatap sa Tondo Medical Center.
english: Both the mother and the baby are currently being treated at the Tondo Medical Center.

text: Malipayon naman ang Red Cross nga samtang masako ang tanan nga luwason ang kabuhi sa sunog, may “new life” pa gid nga nagdugang sa kalibutan.
english: The Red Cross is happy that while everyone is busy saving lives from the fire, there is a “new life” added to the world.

text: “As lives were being saved from the flames, a new life was born,” kabahin sang post sang Red Cross.#
english: “As lives were being saved from the flames, a new life was born,” the Red Cross said in a post.

text: Ginapanan-aw sang Boxing Hall of Fame inductee nga si Juan Manuel Marquez nga si Manny Pacquiao ang ideklarar nga bag-o nga World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight champion.
english: Boxing Hall of Fame inductee Juan Manuel Marquez expects Manny Pacquiao to be declared the new World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight champion.

text: “This fight is dangerous.
english: “This fight is dangerous.

text: It’s dangerous for both fighters.
english: It’s dangerous for both fighters.

text: Manny Pacquiao is 46 years old but he’s professional.
english: Manny Pacquiao is 46 years old but he’s professional.

text: He’s training hard every day,” suno sa Mexican boxer nga isa sa nangin pinakabakod nga kasumpong sang Pinoy boxing icon.
english: He’s training hard every day,” said the Mexican boxer who has been one of the strongest opponents of the Pinoy boxing icon.

text: “Let me tell you something.
english: “Let me tell you something.

text: I think Manny Pacquiao is the new world champion.
english: I think Manny Pacquiao is the new world champion.

text:
I think so.”

Dugang sini, ang pinakadako nga magamit ni Pacquiao amo ang iya nga eksperyensya sa ring.
english:
I think so.”

He added that Pacquiao's biggest asset is his experience in the ring.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa iya power kag speed ikumparar sa mas bataon nga si Marrio Barrios nga may yara man sang height advantage.
english: This is in addition to his power and speed compared to the younger Marrio Barrios who also has a height advantage.

text: “Barrios is a young and strong fighter.
english: “Barrios is a young and strong fighter.

text: But I think the most important thing in this fight is the experience.
english: But I think the most important thing in this fight is the experience.

text: The experience is with Manny Pacquiao.
english: The experience is with Manny Pacquiao.

text:
Experience is the key here.”

Matandaan nga ini nga boksidor ang apat ka beses gid nga naatubang ni Pacquaio kag pareho sila nga nabutang sa Hall of Fame.
english:
Experience is the key here.”

It can be recalled that this boxer has faced Pacquaio four times and both of them have been placed in the Hall of Fame.

text: Sa Domingo na sa aga oras sa Pilipinas ang hampang ni Pacquiao batok kay Barrios nga amo ang una nga propesyunal nga sambuwa sang eight-division champion matapos gin-anunsyo ang iya pag-retiro apat ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: Pacquiao will fight Barrios on Sunday morning, the eight-division champion's first professional fight since announcing his retirement four years ago.

text: Nahibal-an na sang kadam-an nga may benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas ang pagkaon sa dahon sang saging.
english: Most people already know that there are health benefits to eating banana leaves.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka man bala nga ang pagluto kag pagkaon sa coconut shells ukon paya sang lubi ang makabig nga healthy kag beneficial man sa ikaayong lawas?
english: But did you know that cooking and eating coconut shells or coconut husks is considered healthy and beneficial to health?

text: Suno kay Anne Danahy registered dietitian sa Arizona sa Estados Unidos, dako ang bentaha sa ikaayong lawas kun gamiton nga pinggan kag lulutuan ang paya sang lubi bangud ini ang environment friendly, nagabulig nga malikawan ang overeating, nagapabuhin sang cholesterol level kag nagahatag sang mahamot nga aroma sa pagkaon.
english: According to Anne Danahy registered dietitian in Arizona in the United States, there are many health advantages to using coconut husk as a dish and cooking because it is environment friendly, helps prevent overeating, reduces cholesterol levels and gives a fragrant aroma to food.

text: Pahayag ni Danahy, may yara sang aroma ukon natural fibre content ang paya sang lubi nga nagasaylo sa linuto.
english: Danahy said the coconut husk has an aroma or natural fiber content that transfers to the dish.

text: Ini nga fiber content ang nagapabuhin sang cholesterol level sa lawas sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: This fiber content reduces the cholesterol level in the body of an individual.

text:
Bentaha man suno sa eksperto nga gamiton bilang pinggan ukon yahong ang paya sang lubi bangud manggaranon ini sa vitamins, A, D, E kag K.

Dugang pa ni Danahy, mataas ang fiber content sang paya sang lubi gani maayo ini sa digestive system sang isa ka indibidwal.
english:
According to experts, it is also advantageous to use the coconut shell as a dish or bowl because it is rich in vitamins, A, D, E and K.

Danahy added that the fiber content of coconut husks is high and is good for the digestive system of an individual.

text: Ginbasol ni U.S. President Donald Trump si anay U.S. President Joseph R. Biden sa padayon nga pagtaas sang presyo sang balaklon sa Estados Unidos.
english: U.S. President Donald Trump has blamed former U.S. President Joseph R. Biden for continued inflation in the United States.

text: Ginhimo ni Trump ang pahayag matapos ang evening address sa White House sa diin ginpadayaw sini ang mga nahimo sang iya administrasyon, lakip ang pagbuhin sang illegal border crossings kag pagpanubo sang presyo sang pila ka produkto.
english: Trump made the statement after an evening address at the White House in which he touted his administration’s accomplishments, including reducing illegal border crossings and lowering the price of certain products.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sini ang pagpanagtag sang warrior dividend” nga $1,776 para sa 1.45 million nga myembro sang US military kag ang pagsuporta sini sa ginaproponer nga bulig-pinansyal sa publiko para sa ila galastuhan sa ikaayong lawas.
english: It also announced the distribution of a warrior dividend” of $1,776 for 1.45 million members of the US military and its support for the proposed financial assistance to the public for their health expenses.

text: Apisar nga gin-ako sang presidente sang Amerika nga nagapadayon nga mataas ang presyo sang balaklon, ginpanindugan ni Trump nga “poised” ang ekonomiya sa pagpataas sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Although the American president acknowledged that commodity prices remain high, Trump insisted that the economy is “poised” to increase next year.

text: Ini bangud sang iya pagsulondan sa buwis, taripa kag plano nga pagbag-o sang pamunuan sang US Federal Reserve.
english: This is due to its tax policy, tariffs and planned changes in the leadership of the US Federal Reserve.

text: Samtang, ginpakamalaot naman sang mga Democrat ang ginhimo nga speech ni Trump, sa diin ginsiling sang mga ini nga kulang sa konkreto nga solusyon sa problema sang affordability, ilabi sa samtang nagapahilapit ang midterm elections sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Meanwhile, Democrats condemned Trump's speech, saying it lacked a concrete solution to the affordability problem, especially as next year's midterm elections approach.

text: Kalabanan sa aton, tubtob lang sa paghandom nga makasaka kita sa Mt.
english: Most of us, just to the point of wishing we could climb Mt.

text: Apo nga amo ang pinakamataas nga bukid sa Pilipinas.
english: Apo which is the highest mountain in the Philippines.

text: Gani pat-ud nga mahisa ka gid sa isa ka 70-anyos nga lola nga natuman ang iya handom nga masaka ang bukid nga nagataas sang malapit sa 3,000 meters above sea level.
english: So you must be very jealous of a 70-year-old grandmother who fulfilled her dream of climbing a mountain that rises close to 3,000 meters above sea level.

text: Siya amo si Letecia Sobebe sang Misamis Occidental.
english: She is Letecia Sobebe of Misamis Occidental.

text: Pag-abot sa ibabaw sang Mt.
english: Arriving at the top of Mt.

text: Apo, nag-ilis pa ini sang iya hiking gear kag ginsuksok ang isa ka pink nga Filipiniana kag may pearl necklace pa.
english: Grandson, she even changed her hiking gear and put on a pink Filipiniana with a pearl necklace.

text: Ang Mt.
english: The Mt.

text: Apo nahamtang sa borders sang Davao kag North Cotabato sa Mindanao.
english: Apo is located on the borders of Davao and North Cotabato in Mindanao.

text: Sa masami, nagalawig sang tatlo ka adlaw bag-o makompleto ang pagsaka diri.
english: It usually takes three days to complete the climb here.

text: Plano ni Mamamayang Liberal Rep.-elect Leila De Lima nga mangin parte sang minority bloc sang kamara bilang miyembro ukon minority leader.
english: Mamamayang Liberal Rep.-elect Leila De Lima plans to be part of the minority bloc of the chamber as a member or minority leader.

text: Ginhimo ni De Lima ang pahayag kadungan sang proklamasyon sang mga nagdaug nga party-lists sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: De Lima made the statement in conjunction with the proclamation of the winning party-lists for the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Apang gin-athag naman ni De Lima nga kinahanglan anay niya nga tun-an ang dynamics sang mga mamalidha sa 20th Congress kag tun-an kun ano nga komitiba ang pinakamaayo nga pamunuan niya bilang chairperson.
english: However, De Lima explained that he needs to study the dynamics of the lawmakers in the 20th Congress and study which committee is best for him to lead as chairperson.

text: Natalana nga makigsapol si De Lima sa kaalyado nga grupo sang partido nga kalakip sa oposisyon para planuhan ang ila nga mangin masunod nga tiikang sa Kongreso.
english: De Lima is scheduled to meet with allied groups of opposition parties to plan their next steps in Congress.

text: Patay ang 52-anyos nga manugpangisda matapos mabungguan sang modernized jeep sa Barangay Atabayan, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: A 52-year-old fisherman was killed after being hit by a modernized jeep in Barangay Atabayan, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Pablo Titular Malaga, soltero, manugpangisda, kag residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Pablo Titular Malaga, single, fisherman, and resident of the said barangay.

text: Ang driver naman sang modernized Jeep amo si Kim Andrew Fariolan Tunay, 40, kasado, kag residente sang Barangay Banuyao, Miag-ao, Iloilo.
english: The driver of the modernized Jeep was identified as Kim Andrew Fariolan Tunay, 40, married, and resident of Barangay Banuyao, Miag-ao, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, hepe sang Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Miagao ang jeep kag padulong kuntani sa syudad sang Iloilo dala ang pila ka mga pasahero.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, chief of the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, said the jeep was heading from Miagao to Iloilo City with several passengers.

text: Lakip man sa mga pasahero ang mga estudyante kag manunudlo sang University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV) High School.
english: Also among the passengers were students and teachers of the University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV) High School.

text: Suno sa hepe, nagtabok sa karsada si Malaga apang malayo ini sa pedestrian lane kag madulom man ang lugar.
english: According to the chief, Malaga crossed the road but it was far from the pedestrian lane and the place was dark.

text: Nag-angkon naman sang pilas sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang lawas kag ulo si Malaga nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: Malaga sustained multiple gunshot wounds to his body and head.

text: Samtang, preso naman sa Tigbauan Municipal Police Station ang driver sang modernized jeep.
english: Meanwhile, the driver of the modernized jeep is detained at the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station.

text: Kaangot sini, nagpalab-ot man sang simpatiya ang si UP Visayas Chancellor Dr. Clement Camposano sa pamilya sang napatay.
english: In this regard, UP Visayas Chancellor Dr. Clement Camposano to the family of the deceased.

text: Ginkumpirma man sini nga ipaidalom sa debriefing session ang ila mga estudyante sa UP High School nga sakay sang modernized jeep.
english: He also confirmed that their students at UP High School will be subjected to a debriefing session aboard a modernized jeep.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮

text: Bukas si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Tomorrow President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga mag-ayo liwat ang relasyon sini sa pamilya ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga runningmate niya anay sang 2022 elections.
english: to restore relations with the family of Vice President Sara Duterte, who was his runningmate in the 2022 elections.

text: Kabahin ini sang na-istoryahan sa una nga episode sang podcast sang president nga ginpaguwa kasunod sang resulta sang midterm elections kun sa diin anum lang halin sa Alyansa senatorial candidates ang nagdaog.
english: This is part of what was discussed in the first episode of the president's podcast released following the results of the midterm elections where only six Alyansa senatorial candidates won.

text: Pahayag sang presidente, indi man niya gusto ang away, bangud ang gusto niya amo nga maghangpanay lang ang tanan nga mga tawo.
english: The president said he does not want a fight, because he wants all people to understand each other.

text: “Oo.
english: “Yes.

text: Ayoko ng gulo.
english: I don't want mess.

text: Gusto ko makasundo sa lahat ng tao.
english: I want to get along with everyone.

text: Mas maganda.
english: More beautiful.

text: Marami na akong kaaway.
english: I've got a lot of enemies.

text: Hindi ko kailangan ng kaaway, kailangan ko kaibigan,” pahayag sini samtang nagakadlaw.
english: I don't need enemies, I need friends,” he said with a laugh.

text: Ginpahangop man sini nga ang ginalagas niya amo ang kalinong para nga mahimo lang ang trabaho.
english: He also implied that what he was chasing was peace so that the job could be done.

text: “Ewan ko.
english: “This is Ewan.

text: Hangga’t maaari, ang habol ko yung stability, peaceful, para magawa namin ang trabaho namin.
english: As much as possible, I want stability, peaceful, so we can do our job.

text: Lagi akong bukas sa ganiyan.
english: I'm always open to that.

text: I’m always open to any approach,” dugang niya.
english: I’m always open to any approach,” he added.

text: “Halika, magtulungan tayo.
english: “Come on, let’s help each other.

text:
Kahit na hindi tayo magkasundo sa polisiya, hindi tayo magkasundo, tanggalin natin ang gulo.”

Madumduman nga temprano nga bahin sang 2024 sang nag-umpisa nga nagtunog ang away sang mga Duterte kag Marcos kun sa diin mismo si former President Rodrigo Duterte kag iya anak nga si Davao Mayor Sebastian Duterte ang nag-akusar kay Marcos nga bangag, adik, kag maluya nga klase sang lider.
english:
Even if we don't agree on policy, we don't agree, let's get rid of the mess.”

It can be recalled that in early 2024, the Dutertes and Marcos began to fight where former President Rodrigo Duterte and his son, Davao Mayor Sebastian Duterte, accused Marcos of being a fool, an addict, and a weak leader.

text: Nadugangan ini sa paghalin ni VP Sara sa Gabinete, pagbukad sang mga iregularidad sa opisina sang vice president, pag-imbestigar sang quad comm sa war on drugs, pag-impeach kay Sara, kag pagdakop kay former President Duterte kag pagdala sa iya sa The Hague kag madamo nga iban pa nga nagpasaka sang tensyon sa tunga sang duha ka pamilya.#
english: This was compounded by the resignation of VP Sara from the Cabinet, exposure of irregularities in the office of the vice president, investigation of the quad comm on the war on drugs, impeachment of Sara, and arrest of former President Duterte and transportation to The Hague and many others that raised tensions between the two families.#

text: Naga-guwa sa isa ka Chinese study nga mahimo makalab-ot sa mainland United States of America ang intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) nga ipalupad sang North Korea sa sulod lamang sang 33 minutos.
english: A Chinese study suggests that an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) launched by North Korea could reach the mainland United States of America in just 33 minutes.

text: Suno kay Open Nuclear Network analyst Tianran Xu, nagpatigayon ang Chinese scientists sang simulation sang North Korean missile attack sa US kag base sa resulta, mahimo maka-igu ang missile sang Pyongyang sa central US sa sulod lamang sang 1,997 seconds kun mapaslawan ang missile defence systems nga maintercept ini.
english: According to Open Nuclear Network analyst Tianran Xu, Chinese scientists conducted a simulation of a North Korean missile attack on the US and based on the results, Pyongyang's missile could hit the central US in just 1,997 seconds if the missile defense systems fail to intercept it.

text: Ang pinakahapos nga target suno kay Xu amo ang west coast kag ang east coast.
english: The easiest targets according to Xu are the west coast and the east coast.

text: Sa amo nga pagtuon, ginbasehan ang paglupad sang Hwasongpho-15 missile halin sa central North Korean city nga Sunchon padulong sa Columbia, Missouri.
english: The study was based on the flight of the Hwasongpho-15 missile from the central North Korean city of Sunchon to Columbia, Missouri.

text: Ang Hwasongpho-15 isa ka two-stage, nuclear-capable missile nga may operational range nga tubtub sa 8,000 miles.
english: The Hwasongpho-15 is a two-stage, nuclear-capable missile with an operational range of up to 8,000 miles.

text: Ginpahayag man sa pagtuon sang Beijing Institute of Electronic System Engineering nga mahimo maalerto ang US missile defense system 20 seconds matapos nga napalupad na sang North Korea ang missile.
english: The study by the Beijing Institute of Electronic System Engineering also said that the US missile defense system could be alerted 20 seconds after North Korea launched the missile.

text: Apisar ginakabig nga masangkad ang kapasidad sang missile defense network sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika, may ginplastar man nga mga kakulangan sa satellite-aided system para sa pag-track sang missiles nga posible rason nga may makalusot.
english: Although the capacity of the missile defense network of the United States of America is considered to be extensive, there are also shortcomings in the satellite-aided system for tracking missiles that could lead to escape.

text: Gin-release ini nga report antes ginkumpirma sang North Korea nga nagpalupad ini sang intercontinental ballistic missile nga Hwasong-17 ukon ang ginatawag nga “monster missile”.
english: This report was released before North Korea confirmed that it had launched an intercontinental ballistic missile Hwasong-17 or the so-called “monster missile”.

text: Ang paglunsar sini nga ginadumilian nga missile ang kadungan man sang ginapatigayon nga Freedom Shield ukon ang large-scale joint military exercises nga ginahimo sang United States kag South Korea nga nag-umpisa sang Lunes.
english: The launch of the banned missile also coincides with the ongoing Freedom Shield or large-scale joint military exercises being conducted by the United States and South Korea that began on Monday.

text: Naghingyo ang Office of the Prosecutor sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa pre-trial chamber nga maghatag sang extension sa deadline sa pagpasa sang mga materyales halin sa mga testigo batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has asked the pre-trial chamber to grant an extension to the deadline for submitting materials from witnesses against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ini nga request ang ginhimo sang Mayo 14 kag pirmado ni ICC chief prosecutor Karim Khan.
english: This request was made on May 14 and signed by ICC chief prosecutor Karim Khan.

text: Base sa pangabay sang prosecution, ginapalawig ang disclosure deadline sa July 1, 2025 nga amo ang petsa nga gintalana sang korte agud nga makumpleto ang disclosure process.
english: Based on the request of the prosecution, the disclosure deadline is extended to July 1, 2025 which is the date set by the court to complete the disclosure process.

text: Sa amo man nga request, nagpahayag man ang prosecution nga i-isol man sa Hunyo 20, 2025 ang pinal nga deadline agud maka-apply sa chamber nga hawidan ang identity sang witnesses.
english: In the same request, the prosecution also said that the final deadline to apply to the chamber to withhold the identity of witnesses will be postponed to June 20, 2025.

text: Ginarason sini nga delikado ang pagbulgar sang identity sang mga testigo.
english: He argues that it is dangerous to reveal the identity of the witnesses.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ang ila nga request para sa extensions ang rasonable man kag consistent sa kinamatarong ni Duterte kag kinamatarong sang mga magapungko nga witnesses.
english: He said their request for extensions is reasonable and consistent with Duterte's rights and the rights of the witnesses.

text: Matandaan nga gin-schedule sang chamber ang confirmation of charges batok kay Duterte sa Septyembre 23, 2025.
english: The chamber scheduled the confirmation of charges against Duterte for September 23, 2025.

text: Marso 11 siya gindakop kag gindala sa The Hague bangud sa kaso nga crimes against humanity nga nag-ugat sa extrajudicial killings sang ginpatuman sini ang drug war.
english: On March 11, he was arrested and brought to The Hague on charges of crimes against humanity stemming from extrajudicial killings during his drug war.

text: Nagalapas sa international law kag ginatawag na nga “war crime” ang ginhimo sang Russia nga pagpwersa agud masaylo kag ma-deport ang kabataan halin sa Ukraine padulong sa areas nga kontrolado na sang Moscow.
english: Russia's forced relocation and deportation of children from Ukraine to areas already controlled by Moscow violates international law and is already being called a “war crime”.

text: Lakip ini sa una nga report sang high-level investigation team matapos gintukod ini sang United Nations Human Rights Council sang nagligad nga tuig agud matumod ang violations sang Russia sa invasion sini sa Ukraine.
english: It is among the first reports of a high-level investigation team after it was set up by the United Nations Human Rights Council last year to identify Russia's violations in its invasion of Ukraine.

text: Suno pa sa report sang Commission of Inquiry, kadam-an sang violations sang Moscow ang katumbas na sa war crimes.
english: According to the report of the Commission of Inquiry, most of Moscow's violations amount to war crimes.

text: Kun basehan ang Kyiv, nagdangat sa 16,221 ka Ukrainian children ang gin-deport sa Russia as of last month.
english: Based on Kyiv, 16,221 Ukrainian children were deported to Russia as of last month.

text: Indi ma-verify sang mga imbestigador ini nga numero apang may ginpatpat nga mga indikasyon nga ginpangsaylo na sang Russia ini nga mga bata sa institutions kag foster homes kag ginpanghatagan man sila sang Russian citizenship.
english: Investigators cannot verify this figure but there are indications that Russia has already transferred these children to institutions and foster homes and granted them Russian citizenship.

text: Ini nga report ang nagatudlo sa decree nga ginpirmahan ni Russian President Vladimir Putin nga naga-facilitate sang pag-grant sang Russian citizenship sa pila ka mga kabataan halin sa Ukraine ead 4-18 anyos.
english: This report points to the decree signed by Russian President Vladimir Putin facilitating the granting of Russian citizenship to some children from Ukraine ead 4-18 years old.

text: Nagdangat sa 17,646 ka mga applicants ang nagkuha sang Admission Exam sa nagkalain-lain nga campus sang West Visayas State University (WVSU) subong nga adlaw.
english: A total of 17,646 applicants took the Admission Exam at various campuses of West Visayas State University (WVSU) today.

text: Sa nasambit nga numero, 10,491 ang nagkuha sa main campus kag 7,155 sa satellite campuses.
english: Of these, 10,491 took the course at the main campus and 7,155 at the satellite campuses.

text: Ang first batch ang nagkuha sang pasinawan las 9:00 sa aga, samtang ang 2nd batch naman sang examination ang ginpatigayon 1:00 sang hapon.
english: The first batch took the exam at 9:00 am, while the 2nd batch of examination was conducted at 1:00 pm.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Liezel Aurora sang Barangay Inamyungan, Bingawan, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga gin-updan gid niya ang iya anak sa pagkuha sang pasinawan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Liezel Aurora of Barangay Inamyungan, Bingawan, Iloilo, said she accompanied her son to take the exam.

text: Suno kay Aurora las 3:00 pa lang sang kaagahon, nagbugtaw na sila kag las 5:00 sang kaagahon sang nagpadulong sa unibersidad.
english: According to Aurora, they woke up at 3:00 am and went to the university at 5:00 am.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga handom gid sang iya anak nga maka-eskwela sa WVSU bangud magluwas nga libre ang tuition, de kalidad ang education system.
english: She said her son really wants to study at WVSU because besides the free tuition, the education system is quality.

text: Nagalaom man ang iya anak nga magkuha sang pre-med kag sa ulihi, makuha sang medisina.
english: Her daughter also hopes to pursue pre-med and eventually, medicine.

text: ‘Dasuuurv’ sang Duterte Youth nga ma-suspinde ang proklamasyon bilang isa sa mga nagdaog sa 2025 partylist elections.
english: Duterte Youth 'dasuuurv' to suspend proclamation as one of the winners in 2025 partylist elections.

text: Ini ang komento ni Kabataan party-list Representative-elect Atty. Renee Co matapos nga wala nadala ang nasambit nga grupo sa ginproklamar sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) kahapon, Mayo 19, bangud sa pending nga mga kaso.
english: This is the comment of Kabataan party-list Representative-elect Atty. Renee Co after the said group was not included in the proclamation of the Commission on Elections (Comelec) yesterday, May 19, due to pending cases.

text: Ini nga termino nga nagakahulugan “deserving” amo ang nagakabagay lang sa grupo suno kay Co ilabi na bangud madugay na ang panawagan para sa ila nga disqualification.
english: The term, which means “deserving,” is appropriate for the group, according to Co, especially since the call for their disqualification has been going on for a long time.

text: Halin sang 2019 suno kay Co, madamo na sang anomaliya sa rehistrasyon sang grupo nga makabig nga iligal kag unconstitutional.
english: Since 2019, Co said, there have been many anomalies in the registration of groups that are considered illegal and unconstitutional.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi man representasyon sang kabataan ang Duterte Youth, bangud wala gid sini gina-address ang kinahanglanon sang sector kaangay sang ila kinamatarong, edukasyon, kag kasiguruhan sa trabaho.
english: He also said that the Duterte Youth is not a representation of the children, because it does not address the needs of the sector such as their rights, education, and job security.

text: Para naman kay Representative-elect Leila De Lima, sulod sa pagsulundan sang Comelec nga kun may pending nga kaso batok sa anuman nga grupo, isuspinde anay ang proklamasyon.
english: For Representative-elect Leila De Lima, it is within the Comelec's rules that if there is a pending case against any group, the proclamation will be suspended.

text: Nahibaluan nga may tatlo ka seats nga nadag-an ang Duterte Youth; samtang may isa ka seat naman ang Bagong Henerasyon (BH) nga isa man sa nasuspinde ang proklamasyon.
english: The Duterte Youth won three seats; while the New Generation (BH) has one seat which is also one of the suspended proclamations.

text: Ginsiguro naman ni Comelec chairman George Garcia nga ma-resolba ang kaso sang duha ka partylist antes ang Hunyo 30 ukon ang pagbukas sang 20th Congress.
english: Comelec chairman George Garcia assured that the case of the two partylists will be resolved before June 30 or the opening of the 20th Congress.

text: Ginpaathag man sini nga ang desisyon sang poll body sa suspension ang wala ginbase sa anuman nga motion ukon manifestation to suspend sa proclamation.
english: He also explained that the poll body's decision on the suspension was not based on any motion or manifestation to suspend the proclamation.

text: Pahayag sini, kaugalingon ini nga discretion sang National Board of Canvassers kaupod sa Comelec divisions nga naga-uyat sang kaso.
english: He said it is the discretion of the National Board of Canvassers along with the Comelec divisions handling the case.

text: Sa baylo nga mangin malipayon, tuman ang pagkanugon sang tag-iya sang bag-o nga minivan nga nadaugan sa raffle matapos nga nahulog ini sa dagat halin sa barko kun sa diin ini ginsakay sa Baybay City Port, Leyte.
english: Instead of being happy, the owner of the new minivan that won the raffle was devastated after it fell into the sea from the ship where it was boarded at Baybay City Port, Leyte.

text: Naghalin ang minivan sa Cebu kag ginsakay sa roll on-roll off (ro-ro) vessel agud dal-on pauli sa Leyte sang natabo ang insidente samtang nagadungka sa pantalan sang Baybay City ang barko.
english: The minivan was leaving Cebu and was boarded by a roll on-roll off (ro-ro) vessel to be taken back to Leyte when the incident occurred while the ship was docking at the port of Baybay City.

text: Suno sa mga nakakita, ginapaatras ang salakyan apang nangin madasig ang pag-andar sini tubtob nga nahulog ini sa dagat.
english: According to witnesses, the vehicle was being driven backwards but gained speed until it fell into the sea.

text: Nakagwa naman sa minivan ang driver kag nakaluwas.
english: The driver got out of the minivan and survived.

text: Gilayon naman nga nakuha ang minivan gamit ang backhoe apang madamo ini sang naangkon nga damage.
english: The minivan was immediately recovered using a backhoe but sustained heavy damage.

text: Masobra sa 7,000 trabaho ang ginpain sang Taiwan para sa mga Pilipino.
english: Taiwan has set aside more than 7,000 jobs for Filipinos.

text: Mismo ang mga employer ang magapadulonh sa Pilipinas para sa job fair sa Ilocos region.
english: The employers themselves will travel to the Philippines for the job fair in the Ilocos region.

text: Patigayunon ang job fair sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte sa September 9, kag sa Vigan, Ilocos Sur sa September 11, 2024.
english: The job fair will be held in Laoag, Ilocos Norte on September 9, and in Vigan, Ilocos Sur on September 11, 2024.

text: Suno kay Silvestre Bello III, chairman sang Manila Economic Culture Office (MECO), kinahanglan sang Taiwan ang 7,000 factory workers kag 300 caregivers.
english: According to Silvestre Bello III, chairman of the Manila Economic Culture Office (MECO), Taiwan needs 7,000 factory workers and 300 caregivers.

text: Kadam-an sa mga mabaton nga aplikante ang magatupa sa food ukon information technology industry.
english: Most of the accepted applicants will fall into the food or information technology industry.

text: Suportado sang pila ka mga opisyal sang Iloilo ang payoridad sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) nga privatization sang Iloilo International Airport.
english: Some Iloilo officials support the Department of Transportation's (DOTr) priority of privatization of the Iloilo International Airport.

text: Subong nga adlaw nagbisita si DOTr Sec.
english: Today, DOTr Sec.

text: Vivencio Dizon sa Iloilo agud malantaw ang sitwasyon sang nasambit nga paluparan.
english: Vivencio Dizon in Iloilo to see the situation of the said airport.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga mas madasig maghulag ang pribado nga kompanya ilabi na sa pagpatukod sang mga proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor said that private companies are moving faster especially in the construction of projects.

text: Suno kay Defensor, ang manami sa privatization amo nga indi maggasto sang dako ang gobyerno ilabi na kon manami ang operator.
english: According to Defensor, the good thing about privatization is that the government does not have to spend a lot especially if the operator is good.

text:
Ginpahayag man sini nga kon may mga problema, mas madasig nga magkay-o ang private entity kon ikumpara sa gobyerno

Ginkalipay naman ni USWAG Ilonggo Partylist Representative Jojo Ang sa paghatag igtalupangod ni Secretary Vivencio Dizon sa privatization sa Iloilo International Airport.
english:
He also said that if there are problems, the private entity can fix them faster than the government

USWAG Ilonggo Partylist Representative Jojo Ang welcomed Secretary Vivencio Dizon's attention to the privatization of the Iloilo International Airport.

text: Suno kay Ang, madugay na nga handom sang mga lideres sang Iloilo ang amo nga tikang agud ma-modernize ang paluparan.
english: According to Ang, the leaders of Iloilo have long dreamed of such a move to modernize the airport.

text: Para sa natungdan, isa ini ka kahigayonan nga mapalapad ang airport kag maka-akomodar sang mas madamo nga turista.
english: For him, it is an opportunity to expand the airport and accommodate more tourists.

text: Nagaplano si Chinese President Xi Jinping nga personal nga magpadulong sa Russia sa masunod nga semana agud makit-an kag maistorya ang iya counterpart nga si Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping plans to personally travel to Russia next week to meet and talk with his counterpart Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Wala sang sabat ang foreign ministry sang Beijing kun san-o ang pag-atubangay sang duha ka dalagku nga lider kag nagpamalibad man ang Kremlin nga mag-anunsyo sini.
english: Beijing's foreign ministry has not answered when the two top leaders will meet and the Kremlin has refused to announce it.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, gin-abi abi man ni Putin sa Russia ang top diplomat sang China nga si Wang Yi.
english: Last month, Putin also welcomed China's top diplomat Wang Yi to Russia.

text: Matandaan nga may yara sang “no limits” partnership ang Russia kag China sang February 2022 sang nagbisita si Putin sa Beijing para sa pagbukas sang Winter Olympics kag sinemana lang antes ang pag-umpisa sang Russian invasion sa Ukraine.
english: It can be recalled that Russia and China had a “no limits” partnership in February 2022 when Putin visited Beijing for the opening of the Winter Olympics and just weeks before the start of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 39 ka beses na nga nagkit-anay ang duha ka lider halin sang nangin presidente si Xi.
english: In total, the two leaders have met 39 times since Xi became president.

text: Nagpaandam naman ang Britanya sang nagadalom pa nga partnership sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod kag sa ginapahayag kooperasyon sang Iran sa Russia sa ginahimo sini nga invasion sa Ukraine.
english: Britain warned of the deepening partnership between the two countries and Iran's alleged cooperation with Russia in its invasion of Ukraine.

text:
Ginsuspende sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) ang proklamasyon sang Duterte Youth kag Bagong Henerasyon party-lists bangud sa mga petisyon angot sa ila disqualification

Suno sa resolusyon sang National Board of Canvassers, “seryoso ang alegasyon” sang paglapas sa mga layi sang eleksyon nga ginpasaka batok sa nasambit nga mga party-list.
english:
The Commission on Elections (Comelec) suspended the proclamation of Duterte Youth and Bagong Generasyon party-lists due to petitions regarding their disqualification

According to the resolution of the National Board of Canvassers, “serious allegations” of violation of electoral laws were filed against the said party-lists.

text: Ginpahayag nga may duha ka petisyon nga ginpasa kontra sa Duterte Youth.
english: Two petitions were reportedly filed against the Duterte Youth.

text: Ang una ginpasa ni Reeva Magtalas kag iban pa sang Mayo 15, kag ang ikaduha naman ginpasaka sang Youth Advocates for Climate Action Philippines kaupod ang mga student regents sang PUP kag UP sang Mayo 8.
english: The first was filed by Reeva Magtalas and others on May 15, and the second was filed by the Youth Advocates for Climate Action Philippines together with the student regents of PUP and UP on May 8.

text: Samtang, si abogado Russel Stanley Geronimo naman ang nagpasaka sang kaso batok sa Bagong Henerasyon.
english: Meanwhile, lawyer Russel Stanley Geronimo filed a case against the New Generation.

text:
Ginreklamo sang Duterte Youth ang suspensyon kag ginbuyagyag nga ini amo ang isa ka “grave abuse of discretion.”

Sa pihak nga bahin, nagtuad ang Bagong Henerasyon nga wala sila nakabaton sang pormal nga abiso angut sa kaso kag nagapanawagan sa Comelec nga ipadayon ang ila proklamasyon bilang representante sang kapin 319,000 ka mga botante.
english:
The Duterte Youth complained about the suspension and revealed that it was a “grave abuse of discretion.”

Meanwhile, the Bagong Generacion admitted that they have not received any formal notice regarding the case and called on the Comelec to continue their proclamation as representatives of more than 319,000 voters.

text: Base sa naproseso nga boto, nakakuha sang 5.6% ang Duterte Youth nga kun sayuron tatlo ka puwesto sa Kongreso, samtang isa ka puwesto naman ang nakuha sang Bagong Henerasyon matapos makakuha sang 0.8% nga boto.
english: Based on the processed votes, the Duterte Youth won 5.6%, which means three seats in Congress, while the New Generation won one seat after getting 0.8% of the vote.

text: Kun ikaw may ka-relasyon, mahangpan mo gid kun ano ka-importante ang pag-update sa isa kag isa kada adlaw.
english: If you are in a relationship, you will understand how important it is to update each other every day.

text: Apang nakaagi ka na bala nga feeling mo daw na-harass ka na bangud sa sobra-sobra nga pagpanawag nga daw indi na gid insakto?
english: But have you ever felt like you were being harassed because of the excessive calls that seemed inappropriate?

text: Amo ina ang nabatyagan sang isa ka 31-anyos nga babaye Amagasaki sa Hyogo Prefecture sa Japan.
english: That is how a 31-year-old woman from Amagasaki in Hyogo Prefecture in Japan felt.

text: Nagsugod ini sang nagligad nga Hulyo subong nga tuig sang nakabaton siya sang masobra 100 ka tawag kada adlaw halin sa isa ka tawo nga wala man gani nagahambal.
english: It started last July this year when he received more than 100 calls a day from someone who didn’t even speak.

text: Puerte nga kulba ang nabatyagan sang babaye bangud sa makatilingala nga tawag, kag ginahulat man siya sang caller nga patyon ang tawag apang maga-call man ini gihapon liwat sang sulit-sulit.
english: The woman was very nervous because of the strange call, and the caller was waiting for her to hang up but he would call again and again.

text: Lain-lain kag anonymous ang phone number kag indi ma-block sang babaye.
english: The phone numbers are different and anonymous and cannot be blocked by the woman.

text: Sang ulihi, nagsobra na ini sa isa ka bulan, kag nag-amat-amat siya sa pagsuspetsa bangud ang tion lamang nga wala naga-tawag ang stalker amo kun naga-higda na siya sa kuwarto kag kun naga-uyat siya sang cellphone sang iya bana agud maghampang sang video games.
english: Eventually, it went on for more than a month, and she slowly grew suspicious because the only time the stalker didn’t call was when she was lying in bed and when she grabbed her husband’s cellphone to play video games.

text: Indi na gid siya makaagwanta kag gindangop niya sa pulis ang reklamo tubtub nga sini lang nga Septyembre, nakumpirma ang iya pagpang-duha-duha kasunod sang imbestigasyon sang otoridad.
english: He couldn't take it anymore and filed a complaint with the police until this September, his suspicions were confirmed following an investigation by the authorities.

text: Sunod nga gin-aresto ang 30-anyos sini nga bana bangud sa paglapas sa anti-stalker law sang Japan.
english: Her 30-year-old husband was subsequently arrested for violating Japan's anti-stalker law.

text: Sang gin-usisa siya kun ngaa gin-harass niya ang asawa paagi sa tawag, simple lang ang sabat sang lalaki nga palangga niya ang iya asawa gani nag-call siya nga wala man sang ginahambal.
english: When asked why he harassed his wife over the call, the man simply replied that he loved his wife so he called without saying anything.

text: Nahibaluan nga common man sa Japan nga lain-lain ang balay sang kasado nga mga indbidwal ilabi na kun malayo ang trabaho, apang ini ang una nga tion nga may na-rekord ang pulis sa Amagasaki nga naghimo pa ang bana sang phone stalking apisar nga updanay man sila sang iya asawa sa sulod sang balay.
english: It is common in Japan for married individuals to live in different houses especially when they work far away, but this is the first time that police in Amagasaki have recorded a husband committing phone stalking despite being with his wife inside the house.

text: Naglingin ang ulo kag ginkulbaan ang isa ka mall goer sa syudad sang Iloilo matapos nga ma-eksperyensyahan ang linog nga nagluntad kagab-i Marso 2.
english: A mall goer in Iloilo City was shocked after experiencing the earthquake that occurred last night, March 2.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Regina Lencioco, isa ka mall goer, iya ginpahayag nga natingala na lang ini nga nagtay-og ang palibot sini kag gilayon na lang ini nga nagpungko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Regina Lencioco, a mall goer, said she was surprised when the earthquake shook her surroundings and she immediately sat down.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga mabatyagan gid ang linog bangud naga-uyog gid ini.
english: He said the earthquake was felt because it was shaking.

text: Dugang pa sini nga apisar nga wala ini nagdugay ginhadlukan man ini bangud basi marusdak ang building nga iya nahamtangan kun magdugay pa.
english: He added that although it did not last long, he was also afraid that the building he was in might collapse if it lasted longer.

text: Nahibaluan nga gintay-og ang Iloilo kahapon nga adlaw Marso 2 kaupod ang kaipi man sini nga mga probinsya bangud sa Magnitude 5 nga linog sa Tigbauan, Iloilo suno pa PHIVOLCS.
english: Iloilo was shaken yesterday, March 2, along with its neighboring provinces by a Magnitude 5 earthquake in Tigbauan, Iloilo, according to PHIVOLCS.

text: Apang, sang ulihi gin-islan sang DOST-PHIVOLCS nga ang natabo kagab-i nga linog ang magnitude 4.8 lamang kag indi magnitude 5 kag ang tectonic origin sini amo ang naghalin sa Guimbal kag indi sa banwa sang Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: However, DOST-PHIVOLCS later changed that last night's earthquake was magnitude 4.8 and not magnitude 5 and its tectonic origin was from Guimbal and not from Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Sa pagbukas sang mga presinto subong Lunes, Mayo 12, para sa Halalan 2025, ginpakita sang pila ka mga kilalang personalidad ang ila suporta sa demokratikong proseso paagi sa maaga nga pagboto kag pagpanghagad sa publiko nga magboto man.
english: With the opening of polling stations on Monday, May 12, for Election 2025, several prominent personalities showed their support for the democratic process by voting early and urging the public to vote as well.

text: Si Ogie Alcasid kag Regine Velasquez nagpaambit sang ila pagboto sa social media.
english: Ogie Alcasid and Regine Velasquez shared their vote on social media.

text: Si Ogie nag-post sang litrato nga may caption nga “Good morning po,” samtang si Regine nagpanghagad sa mga botante nga magboto sang may kaalam.
english: Ogie posted a photo with the caption “Good morning po,” while Regine urged voters to vote wisely.

text: Si Kim Chiu, actress kag host, nagpahanumdom man sa mga botante nga magpili sang maalam nga kandidato.
english: Kim Chiu, actress and host, also reminded voters to choose a smart candidate.

text: Sa iya Instagram Stories, ginpahayag ni Darren Espanto nga nakaboto na siya kag nagpanghagad sa publiko nga gamiton sang husto ang ila katungdanan sa pagboto.
english: In his Instagram Stories, Darren Espanto said he has already voted and urged the public to exercise their right to vote.

text: Nagpaambit man sang mensahe si Heaven Peralejo matapos siya magboto: “We showed up.
english: Heaven Peralejo also shared a message after she voted: “We showed up.

text: Now it’s your turn.
english: Now it’s your turn.

text: Vote with your heart, vote for what matters.
english: Vote with your heart, vote for what matters.

text:
Vote wisely.”

Si Sharon Cuneta, kaupod ang iya bana nga si Kiko Pangilinan nga nagapadalagan bilang senador, nagboto man subong nga adlaw.
english:
Vote wisely.”

Sharon Cuneta, along with her husband Kiko Pangilinan who is running for senator, also voted today.

text: Ginpaambit man ni Senador Robin Padilla sa social media ang litrato sang iya tudlo nga may tinta, bilang ebidensya sang iya pagboto.
english: Senator Robin Padilla also shared on social media a photo of her inked finger, as evidence of her vote.

text: Ang ila aktibo nga partisipasyon sa eleksyon nagapakita sang ila suporta sa demokratikong proseso kag nagpanghagad sa publiko nga magboto sang may kaalam kag responsibilidad.
english: Their active participation in the elections showed their support for the democratic process and invited the public to vote wisely and responsibly.

text: NAMAHOG naman si President Duterte nga pauntaton ang iya gabinete sa pagtambong sa padayon nga mga hearing sang Blue Ribbon Committee sang Senado.
english: President Duterte has threatened to suspend his cabinet from attending the ongoing hearings of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Angot ini sa “2020 report” sang COA kon diin gina-kwestyon sang naulihi ang mga transaksyon sa pagbakal sang pandemic supplies sang Dept.
english: This is in connection with the “2020 report” of the COA where the latter questions the transactions in the purchase of pandemic supplies by the Dept.

text: of Health kag sang Procurement Service sang Dept.
english: of Health and the Procurement Service of the Dept.

text: of Budget and Management (PS-DBM).
english: of Budget and Management (PS-DBM).

text: Ginatudlo sang COA kag, sang ulihi, sang Senado man ang kwestyonable nga pagpatigayon sang pondo nga binilyon ka pesos sa pagbakal sining mga supplies, nga dapat tani natigayon sa “shortest possible time” tungod life-saving ang mga ini kag dapat indi man “overpriced” sandig sa prevailing prices.
english: The COA and, later, the Senate also point to the questionable allocation of billions of pesos to purchase these supplies, which should have been obtained in the “shortest possible time” because they are life-saving and should not be “overpriced” based on prevailing prices.

text: Ang natabo ugaling kay sa lugar nga gamiton dayon ining pondo ginpasa-pasa pa ini sang DOH sa kon diin pa nga ahensya tubtub nagtupa sa PS-DBM kon diin nag-parking anay ini.
english: What happened, however, is that instead of using the fund, the DOH passed it on to other agencies until it landed at the PS-DBM where it parked.

text: Kon madayon ining pamahog ni Presidente, isa ini ka “big mistake” ni Presidente, sunu sa kay Senador Gordon, ang tsirman sang Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: If the President's threat goes ahead, it will be a “big mistake” by the President, according to Senator Gordon, the chairman of the Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Nagahatag lang ini, sunu sa iya, sing suspetso nga may ginatagu nga baho si Presidente kag kahimbon pa niya ang iya mga salaligan kag pila ka negosyante nga may kahilabtanan diri.
english: This, he said, only gives rise to suspicion that the President is hiding a smell and that he is still involved with his confidants and some businessmen involved.

text: Isa sining mga negosyante amo ang Chinese (ukon Singaporean) nga pharmaceutical nga Pharmally.
english: One of these entrepreneurs is the Chinese (or Singaporean) pharmaceutical Pharmally.

text: Nadiskubrihan nga ang mga nagapadalagan sini may warrant of arrest gali sa kaso nga “fraudulent business transaction” sa Taiwan.
english: It was discovered that the operators had a warrant of arrest for fraudulent business transaction in Taiwan.

text: Na-awardan ini sang pagbaligya sang pandemic supplies, katulad sang face masks, face shields, PPEs kag iban pa, nga nagabalor sang mga P8.7 ka bilyon, samtang ang paid-up capital sini tubtub gid lang sa P625,000.
english: It was awarded the sale of pandemic supplies, such as face masks, face shields, PPEs and others, worth about P8.7 billion, while its paid-up capital is only up to P625,000.

text: Gani, “fraudulent” kuno ining transaksyon, kag “overpriced” man, nga dapat kasuhan na ang mga natungdan, sunu kay Senador Drilon.
english: Therefore, this transaction is allegedly “fraudulent”, and “overpriced”, which should be prosecuted, according to Senator Drilon.

text: Daw may “backer” pa sila, dugang niya.
english: They still seem to have a “backer,” he added.

text: Si Presidente Duterte ayhan ang sa pensar ni Drilon?
english: Is President Duterte on Drilon's mind?

text: Kumporme sa sini nga panghuna-huna ni Drilon si Senador Pacquiao.
english: Senator Pacquiao agrees with Drilon's view.

text: “Planado talaga!” siling gani ni Pacquiao kon ngaa gin-transfer pa ang pondo halin sa DOH sa PS-DBM sa idalom ni Christopher Lao, nga ginasiling tinawo ni Senador Bong Go.
english: “It was really planned!” Pacquiao even said why the funds were transferred from the DOH to the PS-DBM under Christopher Lao, who is said to be a servant of Senator Bong Go.

text: Indi man kuno dapat magsulod diri ang “Dilawan” nga isyu, nga nagatumod sa grupo political ni anay Presidente NoyNoy.
english: The “Yellow” issue, which refers to former President NoyNoy's political group, should not be included.

text: Tapos na atong isyu sang nagligad pa nga eleksyon!
english: The issue of the last election is over!

text: Isyu na ini sang mga pumuluyong Pilipinhon nga ang kwarta gina-waldas sang mga matakab.
english: This is the issue of the Filipino people whose money is being wasted by the greedy.

text:
***

Nagapadumdum sa aton ining alleged anomalies sa gobyerno ang kaso ni business mogul nga si Harry Stonehill (Steinberg) sa panahon ni Presidente Diosdado Macapagal (1961-1965).
english:
***

The case of business mogul Harry Stonehill (Steinberg) during the time of President Diosdado Macapagal (1961-1965) reminds us of these alleged anomalies in government.

text: Gina-atubang sadto sang Amerikano nga si Stonehill sa Congressional hearing ang iya kwestyonable nga mga negosyo ($50-million Empire) sa Filipinas kon diin nagpuyo siya upod sa iya ikaduha nga asawa nga isa ka Filipina.
english: American Stonehill was facing a congressional hearing about his questionable businesses ($50-million Empire) in the Philippines where he lived with his second wife, a Filipina.

text: Si Stonehill kag iya business associate nga si Robert Brooks gindakop sadtong Marso 3, 1962, sa akusasyon nga tax evasion, economic sabotage, blackmail kag corruption of public officials, kag iban pa.
english: Stonehill and his business associate Robert Brooks were arrested on March 3, 1962, on charges of tax evasion, economic sabotage, blackmail and corruption of public officials, among others.

text: Sadtong Agosto 3, 1962, gin-order ugaling ni Macapagal nga ang duha “be deported by the first available transportation out of the Philippines”.
english: On August 3, 1962, however, Macapagal ordered that the two “be deported by the first available transportation out of the Philippines”.

text: Gin-kritikar si Macapagal tungod sining pagpa-deport sa duha ka akusado.
english: Macapagal was criticized for deporting the two defendants.

text: Samtang sa United States na, gin-atubang man sang duha ang kasubong nga mga akusasyon – tax evasion, unfair business practices, illegal dollar export, kag economic sabotage.Isa sang nag-kritikar sa pag-deport sang duha si Justice Secretary Jose Diokno.
