english: While in the United States, the two faced similar charges – tax evasion, unfair business practices, illegal dollar export, and economic sabotage. One of those who criticized the deportation of the two was Justice Secretary Jose Diokno.

text: Ginsiling niya: “Paano  na karon ma-prosecute sang gobyerno ining duha kay ginpa-deport na paggwa sa pungsod?” Gin-dismiss ni Macapagal si Diokno tungod sining iya panugdaon.
english: He said: “How can the government prosecute these two now that they have been deported out of the country?” Macapagal fired Diokno for his suggestion.

text: Samtang, naglapta na ang sugilanon nga nakabaton ang madamo nga mga myembro sang Kongreso, kag bisan si Presidente Macapagal, sing bulig halin kay Stonehill para sa ila kampanya sa eleksyon.
english: Meanwhile, rumors have spread that many members of Congress, and even President Macapagal, received help from Stonehill for their election campaigns.

text: Nalista kuno ini sila sa “Blue Book” ni Stonehill.
english: They are said to be listed in Stonehill’s “Blue Book”.

text: In fact, disgustado man ang mga pumuluyo sa sining pag-deport kay Stonehill kag Brooks.
english: In fact, the residents are also disgusted with the deportation of Stonehill and Brooks.

text: Kag amo ini ang isa sa mayor nga kabangdanan kon ngaa nalutos si Macapagal sa iya pagpadalagan liwat kontra kay Senador Marcos.
english: And this is one of the main reasons why Macapagal lost his re-run against Senator Marcos.

text: Napatay si Stonehill sa Chicago sadtong 2002 sa edad nga 84 nga halos wala sing magbaton nga pungsod sa iya.
english: Stonehill died in Chicago in 2002 at the age of 84 with almost no country to accept him.

text: Subong man bala ini ang matabo sa pagbakal sang gobyerno sang pandemic supplies, kon diin indi pagtugutan ni Duterte ang iya gabinete sa pagtambong sa padayon nga mga hearing pa sang Senado?
english: Will the same happen with the government's purchase of pandemic supplies, where Duterte will not allow his cabinet to attend the ongoing Senate hearings?

text: Mangin kabangdanan man bala ini sa pagkapierde sa 2022 Election sang mga kandidato ni Presidente?/PN
english: Will this also cause the loss of the 2022 Election of the Presidential candidates?/PN

text: Dako nga palas-anon sa mga pamatan-on ang panahon sang pandemya bangud indi sila makalagaw, indi makapakigkita sa ila mga abyan kag indi makakadto sa eskwelahan.
english: The pandemic is a big burden on the youth because they can't go out, see their friends and go to school.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dra.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dra.

text: Linda Mae Chin-Balajadia, adolescent medicine specialist, iya iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang sang negatibo nga epekto ang panibag-o nga pamaagi sang pagpangabuhi subong sa tunga sang pandemya bangud wala sang pautwasan ang mga kabataan nga mahimo magtuga sang paglala sang ila nga mental health.
english: Linda Mae Chin-Balajadia, adolescent medicine specialist, said that the new way of life in the midst of the pandemic has a negative impact because there is no outlet for children which can lead to the deterioration of their mental health.

text: Kun kaisa, ini ang magresulta sa kadulaan sang paglaom kag pagdumdom sang pag-utas sang kabuhi.
english: Sometimes, this can result in hopelessness and thoughts of suicide.

text: Subong nga bulan sang Septyembre, ginaselebrar ang “Suicide Prevention month” kag dako ang katungdanan sang mga ginikanan kag mangin sang mga doctor nga lab-uton ang mga pamatan-on.
english: This month of September, Suicide Prevention month is celebrated and parents and doctors have a great responsibility to reach out to young people.

text: Suno kay Dra.
english: According to Dra.

text: Balajadia, ‘pag-istorya’ ang isa sa mga pamaagi agud nga mahagan-hagan ang ginabatyag sang isa ka teenager.
english: Balajadia, 'talking' is one of the ways to ease the feelings of a teenager.

text: Dapat hatagan ang kabataan sang environment sa diin mabatyagan sini nga komportable siya sa pagpabutyag sang iya ginabatyag.
english: Children should be given an environment where they feel comfortable expressing their feelings.

text: Panugyan sang natungdan sa mga ginikanan, kun ma-obserbahan ang kabataan nga may yara sang nagbag-o sa iya ukon masami ini nga naga-isahanon kag nasubu-an , indi gid maghuya-huya nga magpalapit sa doctor.
english: He advised parents, if you observe your children that something has changed in him or he is often alone and sad, do not hesitate to approach the doctor.

text: Isa na ka registered criminologist ang ginbansagan “ICE CANDY MAN” sang Passi City nga si Jeson Gustilo Jagorin.
english: Jeson Gustilo Jagorin, nicknamed “ICE CANDY MAN” of Passi City, is now a registered criminologist.

text: Si Jagorin ang una nga na-interview sa Bombo Radyo bangud sa dalayawon nga ginahimo nga pamaagi agud makapadayon sa iya pagtuon bilang criminology student sa pihak sang kapigaduhon sa kabuhi.
english: Jagorin was first interviewed by Bombo Radyo for his commendable efforts to continue his studies as a criminology student despite the hardships of life.

text: Si Jagorin ang subang sa walo ka mag-utod.
english: Jagorin was the youngest of eight children.

text: Suno kay Jagorin, pagpanguma ang trabaho sang iya amay sa Anilao, samtang wala na ini sang ihibalo sa iya nahamtangan sang iya iloy nga ginapahayag yara nagatrabaho sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: According to Jagorin, his father works as a farmer in Anilao, while he does not know the whereabouts of his mother who is allegedly working abroad.

text: Sang high school, gin-ako ni Jagorin nga dungol ini nga estudyante.
english: In high school, Jagorin admitted that this student was deaf.

text: Agud maka-eskwela naman sa kolehiyo, naga-istar ini sa isa ka pamilya sa diin nagabulig ini sa pagpang-garab sa uma sa tion sang weekend.
english: In order to attend college, he lives with a family where he helps mow the fields on weekends.

text: Kada adlaw, nagalibod naman ini sang ice candy agud nga may ibalon sa iya pag-eskwela.
english: Every day, she sells ice candy to pay for her schooling.

text: Nagapasalamat man ini sa mga indibidwal nga nagabulig sa iya kag naga-intindi sang iya sitwasyon.
english: She is also grateful to the individuals who help her and understand her situation.

text: Gin-promote ni President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: Promoted by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: si Christine Pauline Bergaño-Diciano, ang una nga babayi nga piloto sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), sa mas mataas nga ranggo nga Commodore, pagkatapos sang rekomendasyon ni Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon.
english: Christine Pauline Bergaño-Diciano, the first female pilot of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), to the higher rank of Commodore, after the recommendation of Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon.

text: Si Commodore Bergaño-Diciano isa ka proud nga miyembro sang Coast Guard Officer’s Course (CGOC) “A” Matatag Class 02-2001 kag kabahin sang pinakauna nga batch sang mga babayi nga opisyal sa maragtas sang PCG.
english: Commodore Bergaño-Diciano is a proud member of the Coast Guard Officer’s Course (CGOC) “A” Matatag Class 02-2001 and part of the first batch of women officers in the history of the PCG.

text: Nangin una siya nga babayi nga Coast Guard Pilot sang 2005 kag nagsugod sang iya pinakauna nga flight mission sang 2006.
english: She became the first female Coast Guard Pilot in 2005 and started her very first flight mission in 2006.

text: Isa man siya sa mga nanguna sa mga aerial missions nga nagdala sang importante nga medical supplies sa mga malayo nga komunidad sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: He was also one of the leaders of the aerial missions that brought vital medical supplies to remote communities amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Sa idalum sang West Philippine Sea (WPS) Oplan Matatag sang 2010, siya man ang una kag bugtong nga babayi nga nangin PCG Air Station Commander.
english: Under the West Philippine Sea (WPS) Oplan Matatag in 2010, she was also the first and only woman to become PCG Air Station Commander.

text: Sang 2022, ginhatagan siya sang responsibilidad bilang Coast Guard Aviation Force (CGAF) Commander.
english: In 2022, he was given the responsibility of Coast Guard Aviation Force (CGAF) Commander.

text: Bilang lider sang PCG Gender and Development (GAD) unit, ginduso ni Commodore Bergaño-Diciano ang pag-apil sang “hijab” sa uniporme sang mga babayi nga Muslim nga personnel sang Coast Guard, isa ka tikang nga ginpasidunggan sang United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC).
english: As leader of the PCG Gender and Development (GAD) unit, Commodore Bergaño-Diciano pushed for the inclusion of “hijab” in the uniform of female Muslim Coast Guard personnel, a move that was honored by the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC).

text: Nagpakigbato man siya para sa pagduso sang babayi nga rescue swimmers kag drivers.
english: She also fought for the promotion of female rescue swimmers and drivers.

text: Nagserbisyo man siya sa nagkalain-lain nga unit sang Coast Guard, lakip na ang Coast Guard Education, Training and Doctrine Command (CGETDC), Deputy Chief of Coast Guard Staff for Human Resource Management (CG-1), Coast Guard Flag Office, Coast Guard Internal Audit (CGIA), Coast Guard Procurement Service (CGPS), kag Coast Guard Logistics Systems Command (CGLSC).
english: He has also served in various units of the Coast Guard, including the Coast Guard Education, Training and Doctrine Command (CGETDC), Deputy Chief of Coast Guard Staff for Human Resource Management (CG-1), Coast Guard Flag Office, Coast Guard Internal Audit (CGIA), Coast Guard Procurement Systems (CGPS), and Coast Guard Logistics Services Command (CGLSC).

text: Sang 2014, nangin una siya nga babayi nga Asian Vice-President sang Women’s Association sang World Maritime University (WMU) sa Malmö, Sweden.
english: In 2014, she became the first female Asian Vice-President of the Women’s Association of the World Maritime University (WMU) in Malmö, Sweden.

text: Ginkilala man siya sang PCG sa selebrasyon sang National Women’s Month 2025 paagi sa “Pilak Award”.
english: She was also recognized by the PCG during the celebration of National Women’s Month 2025 with the “Pilak Award”.

text: Pasakaan pa sang China ang ila budget para sa militar bangud sa ila ginpahayag nga nabaton nga mga pagpamahog halin sa iban nga pungsod.
english: China will increase its military budget because of threats it says it has received from other countries.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sa meeting sang rubber-stamp parliament kun sa diin natalana man nga i-confirm ang ikatatlo nga termino para kay Chinese leader Xi Jinping bilang presidente.
english: This was announced at a meeting of the rubber-stamp parliament where the third term for Chinese leader Xi Jinping as president is also scheduled to be confirmed.

text: Hingadlan man ang bag-o nga premier ukon ang second-in-command kasunod kay Xi bangud magahalin na ang incumbent nga si Premier Li Keqiang.
english: The new premier or second-in-command after Xi will also be named as incumbent Premier Li Keqiang is stepping down.

text: Ang $225 billion ukon P12.5 trillion nga defense budget sang China amo ang ikaduha sa pinakadaku sa kalibutan.
english: China's $225 billion or P12.5 trillion defense budget is the second largest in the world.

text: Nagapanguna sa gihapon ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga may $800 billion ukon P44.42 trillion nga pondo para sa militar subong nga tuig.
english: The United States of America still leads with $800 billion or P44.42 trillion in military funding this year.

text: Suno kay outgoing Premier Li Keqiang sa iya speech sa National People’s Congress, nakit-an nga may pagsaka sa external attempts agud nga pahugon ang China gani kinahanglan man nga pabaskugon ang prepasyon kag amo man ang training sa militar.
english: According to outgoing Premier Li Keqiang in her speech at the National People's Congress, there is an increase in external attempts to intimidate China so it is necessary to strengthen preparations as well as military training.

text: Sang kasagsagan sang Covid-19, indi halos magduot ang aton kamot sa iban nga mga tawo sa kahadlok nga maglapta ang virus.
english: During the height of Covid-19, we hardly touched other people for fear of spreading the virus.

text: Dumduman mo pa ang tion nga may mga plastic barrier sa jeep kag halos duha ka face mask ang suksukon mo sa kada adlaw?
english: Remember the time when there were plastic barriers in the jeep and you had to wear two face masks every day?

text: Sa India, may isa ka tumalagsahon nga kaso sang Covid-19 paranoia kun sa diin tatlo ka tuig gid nga gin-lock sang isa ka iloy ang iya kaugalingon kag ang iya anak nga lalaki sa ila balay sa kahadlok nga mapatay sila sa Covid-19 kun maguwa sila sa ila nga puluy-an sa city of Gurugram, south-west sang New Delhi.
english: In India, there is a rare case of Covid-19 paranoia where a mother locked herself and her son in their house for three years for fear of dying from Covid-19 if they left their home in the city of Gurugram, south-west of New Delhi.

text: Ginapahayag nga 7-anyos pa lamang ang anak sang nag-umpisa ang Covid-19, kag lakip man anay ang mister sa gin-lock sang misis nga si Mrs. Majhi, 33.
english: The daughter was reportedly only 7 years old when Covid-19 began, and the husband was also among those locked by his wife, Mrs. Majhi, 33.

text: Sang naghalog na ang lockdown restrictions, nagpamilit ang bana nga isa ka engineer nga maguwa bangud maga-trabaho na ini, apang sang nagguwa ini sa balay, indi na ini pagpabalikon sang iya misis.
english: When the lockdown restrictions lifted, the husband, an engineer, insisted on going out because he was going to work, but when he left the house, his wife would not let him back.

text: Bangud sini, napilitan ang bana nga mag-renta na lamang sang apartment apang nagpabilin ang kahangawa sini sa iya misis kag anak gani nga nagadala siya gihapon sang pagkaon sa guwa sang balay kag siya man ang nagabayad sang utility bills.
english: As a result, the husband was forced to rent an apartment but he remained worried about his wife and child so he still brought food outside the house and he also paid the utility bills.

text: Sang ulihi, subong lang nga Pebrero, nanugid na ini sa pulis agud may makabulig sa iya asawa kag anak.
english: Finally, this February, he reported to the police so that someone could help his wife and child.

text: Sang nag-responde ang pulis, nakit-an nga puno sang nagatangkas nga basura kag mga wala-tuo nga drawings sang bata ang balay.
english: When police responded, they found the house full of garbage and the child's drawings.

text: Ginpahayag nga wala man sang ihibalo ang mga kasilingan nga gin-isolate ni Mrs. Majhi ang iya kaugalingon kag ang iya anak.
english: The neighbors who were isolated by Mrs. Majhi himself and his son.

text: Gindala na sila nga duha sa psychiatric ward para sa treatment kag nagalaum naman ang bana nga makabalik sa normal ang ila nga kabuhi.
english: They were both taken to the psychiatric ward for treatment and the husband hopes that their lives will return to normal.

text: Ginkilala sanday Elaine Jhon Panganiban kag Miguel Angelo Mapalad, nga nakalab-ot sa tuktok sang Mt.
english: Elaine Jhon Panganiban and Miguel Angelo Mapalad, who reached the summit of Mt.

text: Everest nga may kataason nga 8,848.86 metros.
english: Everest with an altitude of 8,848.86 meters.

text: Ini nga kadalag-an nagasunod lang pagkatapos nga si Rhisael “Ric” Rabe, isa man ka Filipino mountaineer, ang una nga nakasaka sa tuktok subong nga tuig.
english: This achievement comes just after Rhisael “Ric” Rabe, also a Filipino mountaineer, was the first to summit this year.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang Seven Summit Treks nga sanday Elaine Jhon Panganiban kag Miguel Angelo Mapalad sang Pilipinas ang nakalabot sa tuktok sang Mt.
english: Seven Summit Treks confirmed that Elaine Jhon Panganiban and Miguel Angelo Mapalad of the Philippines reached the top of Mt.

text: Everest bilang kabahin sang Seven Summit Treks expedition team.
english: Everest as part of the Seven Summit Treks expedition team.

text: Ang duha ka climbers amo ang mga miyembro sang Philippine 14 Peaks Expedition Team.
english: Both climbers are members of the Philippine 14 Peaks Expedition Team.

text:
(PILIPINAS)

Madumduman nga si Ric Rabe ang una nga Filipino sa sulod sang kapin duha ka dekada nga nakaabot liwat sa tuktok sang Everest, kag karon, padayon ini nga kadalag-an sang duha ka mga Pinoy.
english:
(PHILIPPINES)

Ric Rabe is the first Filipino in more than two decades to reach the top of Everest again, and now, this is a continued victory for two Filipinos.

text: Ginaselebrar sang mountaineering community ang ila mga kadalag-an bilang simbolo sang kusog, determinasyon, kag bugal sang mga Pilipino.
english: The mountaineering community celebrates their achievements as a symbol of Filipino strength, determination, and pride.

text: Gingamit sang Philippine Army ang Sabrah light tanks kadungan sang live fire phase sang Combined Arms Training Exercise nga “Katihan” sa Capas, Tarlac.
english: The Philippine Army used Sabrah light tanks during the live fire phase of the Combined Arms Training Exercise “Katihan” in Capas, Tarlac.

text: Ini nga light tanks nga human sa Israel ang armado sang 105 mm cannons.
english: These Israeli-made light tanks are armed with 105 mm cannons.

text: Pormal ini nga ginbaton sang Philippine Army sang nagligad nga tuig, kag parte sang Horizon 2 sang modernization program sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
english: It was formally adopted by the Philippine Army last year, and is part of Horizon 2 of the modernization program of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).

text: Ang iban pa nga major assets sang army nga gingamit kadungan sang exercise amo ang ATMOS 105 mm Howitzers, kag ang 81 mm kag 60 mm mortars.
english: Other major army assets used in conjunction with the exercise were ATMOS 105 mm Howitzers, and the 81 mm and 60 mm mortars.

text: Ini nga live fire drills ang nagatuyo nga matilawan ang kapasidad sang Army sa combined arms operations.
english: These live fire drills aim to test the Army's capacity in combined arms operations.

text: “A combined arms live fire exercise is where we schedule all the indirect fire and direct fire weapons prior to the assault.
english: “A combined arms live fire exercise is where we schedule all the indirect fire and direct fire weapons prior to the assault.

text: So, as part of the overarching scenario before the infantry assaults objective, we subject the targets to both indirect and direct fire —it’s a combination of artillery, mortars and guns from our tanks,” suno kay Brig.
english: So, as part of the overarching scenario before the infantry assaults objective, we subject the targets to both indirect and direct fire —it’s a combination of artillery, mortars and guns from our tanks,” according to Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Michael Logico, CATEX Katihan exercise director.
english: Michael Logico, CATEX Katihan exercise director.

text: Ginalauman man nga ini nga drills ang makadugang pa sa pagpanghanda sang Army nga batuan ang mga pamahog kag paayuhon pa gid ang precision kag tactical proficiency sang nanuhay-tuhay nga units.
english: These drills are also expected to further enhance the Army's preparedness to counter threats and further improve the precision and tactical proficiency of the various units.

text: Ang CATEX Katihan ang kabahin man sang preparasyon sa partisipasyon sang Army sa Salaknib Exercise kaupod sa US Army amo man sa Balikatan Exercise nga tuigan nga ginahimo sang armadong kusog sang Pilipinas kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The CATEX Katihan is also part of the preparation for the Army's participation in the Salaknib Exercise with the US Army as well as the Balikatan Exercise annually conducted by the armed forces of the Philippines and the United States of America.

text: Ang Balikatan subong nga tuig ang magalakip sang full-scale battle test kag maritime strike exercise kun sa diin palugdangon sang tropa sang Pilipinas kag America ang barko nga amo ang naga-representar sang pwersa sang kasumpong.
english: This year's Balikatan will include a full-scale battle test and maritime strike exercise where Philippine and American troops will sink the ship representing the opposing force.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, ang ginpalugdang amo ang “made in China” nga barko nga BRP Lake Caliraya sa Laoag City sa Ilocos Norte.
english: Last year, the “made in China” ship BRP Lake Caliraya in Laoag City in Ilocos Norte was sunk.

text:
Ginkondenar ni anay Senador Leila de Lima ang pahayag ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga luyag niya sang isa ka “bloodbath” sa impeachment trial sa Senado

Madumduman nga naghatag sang pahayag si VP Sara nga bisan pa nga nagahimo na sang pamaagi ang iya mga abogado nga malikawan ang impeachment trial, mas gustuhon pa niya nga madayon ini bangud luyag niya sang madugo nga proseso.
english:
Former Senator Leila de Lima condemned Vice President Sara Duterte's statement that she wants a “bloodbath” in the impeachment trial in the Senate

It can be recalled that VP Sara gave a statement that although his lawyers are already making ways to avoid the impeachment trial, he would rather it go ahead because he wants a bloody process.

text: Suno kay De lima, bilang isa ka myembro sang panel sang mga prosecutor kag representante sang Mamamayang Liberal (ML) party-list sa ika-20th Congress, wala sang ‘bloodbath’ nga matabo sa impeachment trial.
english: According to De Lima, as a member of the panel of prosecutors and representative of the Mamamayang Liberal (ML) party-list in the 20th Congress, there will be no bloodbath in the impeachment trial.

text: Ginpasiguro man niya nga kun may dugo man nga mag-awas, amo lang ina sa gin-impeach, indi sa mga prosecutor, indi sa mga senador nga mga huwes, indi sa administrasyon, kag indi man sa pumuluyo.
english: He also assured that if there is bloodshed, it will be for the impeached, not for the prosecutors, not for the senators and judges, not for the administration, and not for the people.

text: Gindugang pa sang anay senador nga ang impeachment trial isa ka seryoso nga proseso salabton sa idalom sang Konstitusyon, kag indi dapat himuon nga entablado sang gamo ukon drama.
english: The former senator added that the impeachment trial is a serious process under the Constitution, and should not be turned into a stage for chaos or drama.

text: Ginpaandaman man niya ang kampo ni Duterte nga posible sila magapangatubang sang contempt kun ila gamuhon ang proceedings.
english: He also warned the Duterte camp that they may face contempt if they disrupt the proceedings.

text: Sa katapusan, gin-challenge ni De Lima si Duterte nga atubangon ang proseso sang impeachment nga may pagrespeto sa layi.
english: Finally, De Lima challenged Duterte to face the impeachment process with respect for the law.

text: Nagpadala sang sulat ang Iloilo City Government sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 nga naga-ayo sa Iloilo City District Engineering Office nga magpasa sang financial standing sang mga ‘unfinished project’ sa syudad.
english: The Iloilo City Government has sent a letter to the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 asking the Iloilo City District Engineering Office to submit the financial standing of the unfinished projects in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang nangin tikang sang syudad matapos man nga wala nag-attend si ICDEO Head Roy Pacanan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, said this was the city's move after ICDEO Head Roy Pacanan did not attend.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagpatawag sang city government sang pagsinapol nga patigayunon kuntani kahapon, Byernes, Marso 7, 2025.
english: This follows the city government's convening of a meeting to be held yesterday, Friday, March 7, 2025.

text:
Naghulat naman ang city government sa mga ipadala nga staff sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office, apang wala gid sang may nag-abot

Suno kay Fantilaga, ginkadismaya gid sang alkalde ang nangin lihok sang talatapan.
english:
The city government waited for the staff to be sent by the Iloilo City District Engineering Office, but no one arrived

Fantilaga said the mayor was disappointed with the office's action.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Treñas nga gapamangkot lang man siya kon may budget pa gidman agud nga mapadayon sang syudad ang wala natapos nga mga pasilidad.
english: Earlier, Treñas said he was just asking if there is still a budget for the city to continue the unfinished facilities.

text: Gina-imbistigaran na sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) ang gina-alegar nga anomaliya nga P1.4 billion land and acquisition deal sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) nga wala sang pahanugot sang Board of Trustees.
english: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is investigating the alleged anomaly of the P1.4 billion land and acquisition deal of the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) without the approval of the Board of Trustees.

text: Ginkumpirmar ni OWWA Administrator Patricia Caunan ang ginahiwat nga imbestigasyon amo nga hatagan ligwa ang due process kun sa diin kalakip sa gina-imbestigaran amo ang gintal-usan niya nga si anay OWWA Administrator Arnell Ignacio.
english: OWWA Administrator Patricia Caunan confirmed that the investigation is being conducted to facilitate the due process where among those under investigation is her successor, former OWWA Administrator Arnell Ignacio.

text:
Suno pa sa bag-o nga OWWA Administrator, ang ginbakal nga duta ang pagapatindugan kuntani sang halfway house ukon dormitory-type accomodation para sa overseas Filipino workers (OFW’s)

Ginpat-od naman sang opisyal nga bilang bag-o nga administrator sang ahensya nga magahiwat sila sang nagakaigo nga audit, magapangayo- man sila sang legal opinion sa Department of Justice (DOJ), kag magakooperar sa Commission on Audit.
english:
According to the new OWWA Administrator, the purchased land was supposed to be used for the construction of a halfway house or dormitory-type accommodation for overseas Filipino workers (OFW's)

The official assured that as the new administrator of the agency, they will conduct a proper audit, seek legal opinion from the Department of Justice (DOJ), and cooperate with the Commission on Audit.

text: Ginpunto man ni Caunan nga sagrado ang kaban sang banwa kag sang mga Overseas Filipino Workers kabangdanan seryoso sila sa ginahimo nga imbestigasyon.
english: Caunan also pointed out that the city treasury and the Overseas Filipino Workers are sacred so they are serious about the investigation.

text: Gin-athag man ni Caunan nga ang P1.4 billion nga pondo ang wala naghalin sa trust fund.
english: Caunan also clarified that the P1.4 billion fund did not come from the trust fund.

text: Aprubado na sa United Nations General Assembly ang nonbinding resolution nga nagapanawagan sa Russia nga mag-withdraw na sang tropa sang militar sa Ukraine.
english: The United Nations General Assembly has approved a nonbinding resolution calling on Russia to withdraw military troops from Ukraine.

text: 141-7 ang resuta sang binotohay nga may 32 ka abstentions.
english: The result of the vote was 141-7 with 32 abstentions.

text: Lakip sa 141 nga nag-boto pabor sa resolusyon amo ang Pilipinas.
english: Among the 141 who voted in favor of the resolution was the Philippines.

text: Ang mga nagpamatok naman amo ang Russia, Belarus, North Korea, Syria, Mali, Eritrea kag Nicaragua.
english: The opponents were Russia, Belarus, North Korea, Syria, Mali, Eritrea and Nicaragua.

text: Sa 32 nga nag-abstain, lakip sa talalupangdon amo ang China, India, South Africa, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, kag iban pa nga yara sa Africa kag Central Asia.
english: Of the 32 who abstained, notably China, India, South Africa, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and others in Africa and Central Asia.

text: Ang General Assembly amo ang pinaka-importante nga U.N. body nga may makahambal kaangot sa isyu sa Ukraine bangud kun matandaan, na-paralyze ang Security Council paagi sa veto power sang Russia.
english: The General Assembly is the most important U.N. body. body that can speak on the issue of Ukraine because if you remember, the Security Council was paralyzed by Russia's veto power.

text: Matandaan nga Pebrero 24, 2022 ukon eksakto isa ka tuig na sang nagpadala si Russian President Vladimir Putin sang 200,000 ka mga Russian soldiers sa Ukraine kag gintawag ini nga special military operation.
english: It will be recalled that it was February 24, 2022 or exactly one year ago when Russian President Vladimir Putin sent 200,000 Russian soldiers to Ukraine and called it a special military operation.

text: Ang amo nga hitabo ang ginakabig pinakadaku nga invasion sa Europa halin sang natapos ang World War II.
english: The event is considered the largest invasion of Europe since the end of World War II.

text: 7,199 ang napatay kag linibo ang pilason sa away sang duha ka pungsod suno sa United Nations, apang ginapatihan nga mas mataas diri ang matuod nga numero.
english: 7,199 have been killed and thousands injured in the fighting between the two countries, according to the United Nations, but the real figure is believed to be much higher.

text: Sa syudad sang Mariupol sa Ukraine kun sa diin gin-alegar natabo ang mass execution, ginpahayag sang alkalde nga 21,000 ang nagkalamatay bangud sa pagpang-atake sang Russia.
english: In the Ukrainian city of Mariupol where the mass execution allegedly took place, the mayor said 21,000 people were killed by Russian attacks.

text: Suno naman sa militar sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika, ginabanta 100,000 ka mga soldado halin mismo sa Ukraine kag Russia ang napatay sa away halin sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the US military, an estimated 100,000 soldiers from Ukraine and Russia have died in the fighting since last year.

text: Natumod na sang Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) ang pila ka fire prone areas sa Iloilo City.
english: The Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) has identified several fire prone areas in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark Macoco, Acting Chief sang Intelligence and Investigation Unit sang Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang 165 ka mga barangay sa syudad ang na-identify nga fire prone areas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark Macoco, Acting Chief of the Intelligence and Investigation Unit of the Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection, said there are 165 barangays in the city that have been identified as fire prone areas.

text: Suno kay Macoco, sa 165 ka mga lugar, may tagsa ini ka klasipikasyon kaangay sang red zone kag orange zone.
english: According to Macoco, of the 165 areas, they have each classification such as red zone and orange zone.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang red zone amo ang may high risk sa sunog ukon mas mabudlay nga sudlon sang bombero.
english: He also explained that the red zone is the high risk of fire or more difficult for firefighters to enter.

text: Samtang, ang orange zone naman ang may minimal nga risgo ukon yara sa medium risk.
english: Meanwhile, the orange zone has minimal risk or is at medium risk.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga laban sa red zone ang narekord sa City Proper, sa Distrito sang Molo, kag ginasundan sang La Paz.
english: He also said that fighting in the red zone was recorded in City Proper, in Molo District, followed by La Paz.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 (BFP-6) nga magpahamtang sang fire hydrants sa fire prone areas sa pila ka lugar sa rehiyon.
english: Earlier, the Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 (BFP-6) announced that it will install fire hydrants in fire prone areas in some areas in the region.

text: Naalarma si ang actress-turned-politician nga si Angelika Dela Cruz matapos nga nakabaton liwat sang death threat nga may upod nga tatlo ka bala kag sulat nga nagahingyo sa mag-atras siya sa iya kandidatura bilang bise alkalde sang Malabon.
english: Actress-turned-politician Angelika Dela Cruz was alarmed after she received another death threat with three bullets and a letter requesting her to withdraw from her candidacy as vice mayor of Malabon.

text: Ginpakita ni Dela Cruz ang litrato sang papel nga may sulat nga nagainganyo sa iya nga mag-atras sa eleksyon, upod sang mga bala nga ginpadala sa iya.
english: Dela Cruz showed a photo of the paper with a letter urging him to withdraw from the election, along with the ammunition that had been sent to him.

text: Madumduman nga si Dela Cruz ang nagapungko man bilang Brgy.
english: It can be recalled that Dela Cruz is also sitting as Brgy.

text: Captain sang Longos, Malabon.
english: Captain of Longos, Malabon.

text: Nahibaluan man nga ang actress kag kapitan sang nasambit nga Barangay ang nagapangtubang man sang kaso nga plunder nga may kaangtanan sa ginbasehan nga corruption sa pondo sang barangay kun sa diin naglab-ot sa kantidad nga P70 million.
english: The actress and barangay captain are also facing charges of plunder in connection with the alleged corruption in the barangay funds amounting to P70 million.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagapangatubang man ini sang administrative charges, lakip na ang kapabayaan sa iya obligasyon, wala sang opisyal nga leave sa iya mga pag-absent, kag hindi awtorisado nga pagpatugyan sang iya mga responsibilidad sa iya utod nga si Kagawad Erick Dela Cruz.
english: On the other hand, he is also facing administrative charges, including negligence of his obligations, no official leave for his absences, and unauthorized handover of his responsibilities to his brother Kagawad Erick Dela Cruz.

text: Sa pihak sang tanan, nagapabilin nga mabakod si Dela Cruz kag ginalantaw ini nga mga isyu bilang higko nga estilo sang politika.
english: Despite everything, Dela Cruz remains strong and sees these issues as dirty political style.

text: Nagalibog bala ang imo ulo bangud gusto mo na mag-date kag magpangita sa imo soulmate apang daw indi mo gid mabayaan ang nagatambak mo nga trabaho?
english: Are you confused because you want to date and find your soulmate but you can't seem to leave your pile of work?

text: Siling sang iban, dapat nga tun-an mo gid ang healthy work-life balance para nga kahibalo ka sang imo himuon sa mga amo sini nga sitwasyon.
english: Some say that you should study a healthy work-life balance so that you know what to do in such situations.

text: Sa isa ka kumpaniya sa Thailand, ang management na mismo ang nagatanyag sang paagi agud nga maka-date ang ila ginatos ka empleyado… apang siyempre, sa responsable nga paagi.
english: In one company in Thailand, management itself offers a way for their hundreds of employees to date… but of course, in a responsible way.

text:
Madamo gid ang interesado bangud sa pinasahi nga benepisyo nga gin-offer nga amo ang “paid date leave.”

Partikular ini nga ginatawag nga “paid Tinder leave” nga isa ka unique benefit sa idalom sang Whiteline Group nga isa ka marketing agency sa Thailand.
english:
There was a lot of interest because of the special benefit offered that was “paid date leave.”

This is specifically called “paid Tinder leave” which is a unique benefit under the Whiteline Group which is a marketing agency in Thailand.

text: Daw kaangay man ini sa sick leave ukon vacation leave, kag ang employee nga gusto mag-avail sini ang dapat nga maghatag man sang one-week advance notice para nga indi man mabutang sa alang-alang ang trabaho.
english: It is similar to sick leave or vacation leave, and the employee who wants to avail of it must also give one-week advance notice so that the job is not put at risk.

text: Wala ginhinambit sa reports kun tubtub pila ka adlaw ang pwede gamiton apang limitado lamang halin Hulyo tubtub Disyembre 2024 ang benepisyo nga ini.
english: The reports did not specify how many days it can be used but the benefit is limited from July to December 2024.

text: Suno sa kumpaniya, ang ila mayor nga tuyo amo nga i-boost ang well-being sang ila 200 ka mga empleyado.
english: The company says its main aim is to boost the well-being of its 200 employees.

text: Magluwas sa paid date leave, may yara man sila sang paid Tinder Platinum kag Tinder Gold subscriptions sa sulod sang anum ka bulan para sa mga gusto mag-avail.
english: In addition to paid date leave, they also have paid Tinder Platinum and Tinder Gold subscriptions for six months for those who want to avail themselves.

text: Nahibaluan man nga santo sa reports sang The Straits Times, may kaangay man nga benepisyo nga ginahatag ang influencer marketing agency nga Gushcloud International.
english: According to reports by The Straits Times, influencer marketing agency Gushcloud International offers similar benefits.

text: May one-day Tinder leave man ini para sa 300 employees sa mga offices sini sa Indonesia, Malaysia, Pilipinas, Singapore, South Korea, kag Thailand.
english: It also has one-day Tinder leave for 300 employees in its offices in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, and Thailand.

text: Paathag sang management, paagi man nila sa pagtatap sa ila empleyado amo ang pag-ulikid sa ila nga healthy social life partikular ang ila relationship goals — pagpakigkita man ini sa iban nga mga tawo, pagpakig-abyan, ukon pagpangita sang life partner.#
english: Management explained that the way they take care of their employees is to take care of their healthy social life particularly their relationship goals — whether it's meeting other people, making friends, or finding a life partner.

text: Kung may isa ka boksingero nga makarelate gid kay Manny Pacquiao sa pagbato sa edad nga lapaw na sa 40 , amo si Bernard Hopkins, ang pinakatigulang nga boxer nga nagdaog sang world title sa edad nga 49.
english: If there is one boxer who can relate to Manny Pacquiao in fighting over the age of 40 , it is Bernard Hopkins, the oldest boxer to win a world title at the age of 49.

text: Subong, si Pacquiao naman ang magahampang sa posibilidad nga mangin ikaduwa nga pinakatigulang nga kampyon sa kasaysayan, sa iya comeback fight kontra WBC welterweight champion Mario Barrios sa Hulyo 19 sa Las Vegas.
english: Now, Pacquiao will face the possibility of becoming the second oldest champion in history, in his comeback fight against WBC welterweight champion Mario Barrios on July 19 in Las Vegas.

text: Bisan si Pacquiao sa edad nga 46 kag sa apat ka tuig nga pahuway, ginasuportahan siya ni Hopkins kag suno sa iya, may speed kag abilidad pa si Pacquiao nga makahatag sang upset.
english: Even with Pacquiao at 46 and on a four-year break, Hopkins supports him and says Pacquiao still has the speed and ability to cause an upset.

text: Pero nagapati si Hopkins nga indi magalab-ot sa stoppage ang ila pagsambuwa sa ring , kag posible pa lang nga si Manny ang magdaog sa decision.
english: But Hopkins believes that their fight will not reach a stoppage in the ring, and it is still possible that Manny will win the decision.

text: Si Hopkins, nga isa ka undisputed middleweight champion, kag nag-untat pag-boxing sang 2016 matapos napirdi kontra kay Joe Smith Jr.
english: Hopkins, who was the undisputed middleweight champion, and retired from boxing in 2016 after losing to Joe Smith Jr.

text: Sang lamharon ang aton edad, nangin hobby ukon kalingawan na naton ang coloring gamit ang aton crayons, colored pencils kag markers.
english: When we were young, coloring with our crayons, colored pencils and markers became our hobby.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, nagakadapat nga bisan tigulang na kita, mas maayo nga ilakip naton ang coloring sa aton pastime ukon libre nga oras.
english: But according to experts, even if we are old, it is better to include coloring in our pastime or free time.

text: Suno sa clinical psychologist nga si Dr. Scott Bea sang Estados Unidos, ang pag-color sa aton paborito nga mga libro, ang nagapakalma sa sentro sang aton utok nga ginatawag ”amygdala” nga nagaresulta sa pagnubo sang stress kag anxiety sang isa ka indibidwal ilabi na ang mga naga-overthink.
english: According to clinical psychologist Dr. Scott Bea of ​​the United States, coloring in our favorite books, calms the center of our brain called ”amygdala” which results in a reduction of stress and anxiety of an individual especially those who overthink.

text: Makapasangkad man sa motor skills kag vision sang isa ka indibidwal ang pag-coloring bangud gina-require sini ang duha ka hemispheres sang utok nga mag-communicate.
english: Coloring can also expand an individual's motor skills and vision because it requires the two hemispheres of the brain to communicate.

text: Pahayag sang doktor, makapasangkad man sang kalidad sang pagtulog ang pag-coloring bangud ginapa-steady sini ang level sang melatonin sa lawas sang isa ka inbdibidwal.
english: The doctor said that coloring can also improve the quality of sleep because it stabilizes the level of melatonin in an individual's body.

text: Nag-file ang House prosecution panel sang entry of appearance nga may upod nga motion to issue summons sa Senado.
english: The House prosecution panel filed an entry of appearance accompanied by a motion to issue summons to the Senate.

text: Ginhingyo sang mga ini kay Senate President Francis Escudero nga magpagwa sang writ of summons para kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: They asked Senate President Francis Escudero to issue a writ of summons for Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Pinaagi sa nasambit nga writ, ginamanduan si Duterte nga magpasa sang sabat sa Articles of Impeachment sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw umpisa nga mabaton ang mando.
english: Through the said writ, Duterte is ordered to file a response to the Articles of Impeachment within 10 days from receipt of the order.

text: Una na nga ginduso ni Escudero ang timeline para sa impeachment trial, sa diin umpisahan ini sa pagbasa sang Articles of Impeachment sa Hunyo 2 kag pagasundan sang approval sang revised impeachment trial rules.
english: Escudero earlier proposed a timeline for the impeachment trial, which will begin with the reading of the Articles of Impeachment on June 2 and will be followed by the approval of the revised impeachment trial rules.

text: Wala gin-mensyonar ni reelected Senator Imee Marcos ang pangalan sang iya utod nga si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Reelected Senator Imee Marcos did not mention the name of her brother, President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: sa iya speech kadungan sang proklamasyon sang mga nagdaog sa 2025 senatorial elections.
english: in his speech during the proclamation of the winners of the 2025 senatorial elections.

text: Ika-12 si Imee sa Senate race.
english: Imee is 12th in the Senate race.

text: Sa imbukada sang iya speech, ginpasalamatan sini ang iya 96-anyos nga iloy nga si former First Lady Imelda Marcos kag iya kabataan nga nagtambong gid sa event sa Manila Hotel kaina sang hapon.
english: In his opening speech, he thanked his 96-year-old mother, former First Lady Imelda Marcos, and her children for attending the event at the Manila Hotel yesterday afternoon.

text: Ginpanglawag man sini ang mga Duterte.
english: He also sought out the Dutertes.

text:
Yari ang kaundan sang speech:

“Sa mga ginagalang naming Commissioner ng COMELEC (Commission on Elections).
english:
Here is the content of the speech:

“To our respected Commissioners of the COMELEC (Commission on Elections).

text: Sa aking nanay na 96 years old na, at kasama ng aking mga anak na kailan man ay hindi nagduda na ako’y mananalo, ‘kay dating Presidente Duterte, ang ating dating pangulo na Oktubre pa lamang itinaas na ang aking kamay, at sa kanyang anak na hanggang sa huling sandali, si VP Inday Sara ay ako’y ikinakampanya.
english: To my mother who is 96 years old, and with my children who never doubted that I will win, because former President Duterte, our former president who raised his hand in October, and to his son who until the last moment, VP Inday Sara campaigned for me.

text: Sa inyong lahat, ang tagumpay na ito, kahit gaano kailap at kahirap, ay isang katibayan na kapag ikaw ay nanindigan para sa tama-mananalo ka.
english: To all of you, this victory, no matter how difficult and difficult, is proof that when you stand up for what is right, you will win.

text: Hindi nagmaliw ang paniniwala ko sa dunong ng sambayanang Pilipino, na dama at alam nila ang ibig sabihin ng sakripisyo at prinsipyo, at gagawaran nila ito ng suporta at pagmamahal.
english: I have never lost faith in the wisdom of the Filipino people, that they feel and know the meaning of sacrifice and principle, and they will repay it with support and love.

text: Mabuhay ang Pilipinas!
english: Long live the Philippines!

text: Ikinararangal kong maging ikalabing-dalawa sa listahan-ang tumapos sa lahat ng ito.
english: I'm honored to be twelfth on the list to finish all of this.

text:
Salamat sa inyong lahat!”

Matandaan nga myembro anay si Imee sang Alyansa senate bets nga gin-endorso sang president, apang nagbiya siya kasunod sang pag-aresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sang Marso 11.
english:
Thank you all!”

Imee was a former member of the Alyansa senate bets endorsed by the president, but he left following the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte on March 11.

text: Antes ang eleksyon, nakuha sini ang endorsement ni Vice President Sara Duterte.#
english: Before the election, it got the endorsement of Vice President Sara Duterte.#

text: Kapin sa 13, 000 ka mga puluy-an sa Iloilo ang makabenepisyo sa tion nga matigayun ang P388 million nga Submarine Cable Inter-connection Project pinaagi sa Department of Energy (DOE) Total Electrification Program.
english: More than 13,000 households in Iloilo will benefit from the P388 million Submarine Cable Inter-connection Project through the Department of Energy (DOE) Total Electrification Program.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, iya ginpahayag nga ang proyekto ang ginalakipan sang Manlot-Calagna-an- Sicogon nga magakonektar sa Estancia, paagi man sa total electrification sang Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) III.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez said the project includes the Manlot-Calagna-an-Sicogon line that will connect to Estancia, also through the total electrification of Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) III.

text: Suno kay Romualdez, mahimo matapos ang proyekto sa 170 calendar days.
english: According to Romualdez, the project can be completed in 170 calendar days.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang proyekto ang isa ka dako nga rural electrification sa idalom sang Department of Energy (DOE) Total Electrification Program.
english: He also said the project is a major rural electrification under the Department of Energy (DOE) Total Electrification Program.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong adlaw, Marso 7, 2025 ginpatigayon ang groundbreaking sang Submarine Cable Inter-connection Project sa San Fernando, Sicogon Island, Carles, Iloilo.
english: It is known that today, March 7, 2025, the groundbreaking of the Submarine Cable Inter-connection Project in San Fernando, Sicogon Island, Carles, Iloilo was held.

text: Kaupod naman ni Speaker Romualdez sa nagtambong ang pila ka mga lokal nga opisyal sang syudad kag probinsiya sang Iloilo.
english: Speaker Romualdez was accompanied by several local officials of the city and province of Iloilo.

text: Daku nga sorpresa ang ginhimo ni United States President Joe Biden sang ginbisita sini ang Ukraine sa labing-una nga tion halin sang natabo ang Russian invasion.
english: United States President Joe Biden pulled off a big surprise when he visited Ukraine for the first time since the Russian invasion.

text: Nagpakigkita si Biden kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky bilang suporta sang nasyon sa Ukraine sa pihak sang pagpang-atake nga ginhimo ni Russian President Vladimir Putin halin sang Pebrero 2022.
english: Biden met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky as the country’s support for Ukraine despite the invasion waged by Russian President Vladimir Putin since February 2022.

text: Nagpromisa si Biden nga maga-release sang dugang nga $500 million nga military aid sa masunod nga inadlaw lakip na ang artillery ammunition, Javelin, kag Howitzers.
english: Biden promised to release an additional $500 million in military aid in the coming days including artillery ammunition, Javelin, and Howitzers.

text: Ini ang una nga bes sa modern history sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga nagtapak ang presidente sang pungsod sa war zone nga wala sang aktibo nga American military presence.
english: This is the first time in the modern history of the United States of America that the president of the country has stepped into a war zone without an active American military presence.

text: Ang pagsulod ni Biden sa Ukraine ang ginapahayag mabaskog nga statement sang pagtindog sang Amerika bilang kaalyado ni Zelenskyy apisar may mga panawagan mismo sa pungsod nga buhinan ang ginahatag nga American aid sa Kyiv.
english: Biden's entry into Ukraine is said to be a strong statement of America's standing as an ally of Zelenskyy despite calls in the country itself to reduce American aid to Kyiv.

text: Nagtipon liwat ang mga anak sang anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte para sa isa ka Thanksgiving gathering nga ginpakigbahin ni Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte sa iya Facebook page.
english: The children of former President Rodrigo Duterte gathered again for a Thanksgiving gathering that Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte shared on his Facebook page.

text: Makita sa litrato nga upod ni Rep.
english: Seen in the photo with Rep.

text: Duterte sanday Vice President Sara Duterte kag Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte.
english: Duterte, Vice President Sara Duterte and Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte.

text: Suno kay Pulong sa iya post: “Not everything will always go the way we want it to, but there is always something to be grateful for.
english: According to Pulong in his post: “Not everything will always go the way we want it to, but there is always something to be grateful for.

text: Family meeting for Thanksgiving!
english: Family meeting for Thanksgiving!

text: See you all soon!
english: See you all soon!

text:
We miss you Pa.”

Ginpakigbahin man ang litrato ni Veronica “Kitty” Duterte sa iya Instagram account.
english:
We miss you Dad.”

A photo of Veronica “Kitty” Duterte was also shared on her Instagram account.

text: Suno kay Rep.
english: According to Rep.

text: Duterte, ang pagtililipon isa ka pamaagi sang ila pamilya sa pagpasalamat sa pihak sang mga ginapangatubang nila nga problema.
english: Duterte, the gathering is a way for their family to express their gratitude despite the problems they are facing.

text: Sa pihak sini, padayon nga yara sa kustodiya sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands ang anay Presidente Duterte bangud sang kaso nga crimes against humanity nga konektado sa madugo nga kampanya kontra ilegal nga droga, ang Oplan Tokhang.
english: Meanwhile, former President Duterte remains in the custody of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands for crimes against humanity connected to the bloody campaign against illegal drugs, Oplan Tokhang.

text: Base sa datos, kapin 6,000 ang napatay sa amo nga kampanya, pero ginakabig nga nagalab-ut sa 20,000 ang kabug-usan suno sa mga human rights groups.
english: According to data, more than 6,000 people were killed in the campaign, but the total is estimated at 20,000, according to human rights groups.

text: Sa nagliligad nga 2025 midterm elections, nagbalik sa lokal nga politika ang pamilya Duterte kun sa diin gindeklarar nga nagdaug si FPRRD bilang alkalde sang Davao City, samtang si Sebastian Duterte ang bise alkalde, kag si Paolo Duterte ang napilian liwat nga representante sang una nga distrito sang Davao City.
english: In the last 2025 midterm elections, the Duterte family returned to local politics where FPRRD was declared the winner as mayor of Davao City, while Sebastian Duterte was vice mayor, and Paolo Duterte was re-elected representative of the first district of Davao City.

text: Ginapa-ilisan na sang central office sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) ang mga firetrucks nga naga-edad sang 30 ka tuig pataas.
english: The central office of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) is replacing firetrucks that are 30 years old and above.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Senior Inspector Michael Lopez, Acting chief, Logistic Division sang BFP Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga nagmando na ang ila central office nga indi na pag-ipakayo ang mga daan nga mga firetrucks sa baylo, magbakal na lang sang bag-o.

Kun isa-isahon, yari ang status sang mga firetrucks sa rehiyon:

Negros Occidental – may 94 ka firetrucks kag 11 ang unserviceable;Aklan – may 24 ka firetrucks kag 6 ang unserviceable;Iloilo – may 97 ka firetrucks kag 14 ang unserviceable;Antique – may 28 ka firetrucks kag 4 ang unserviceable;Capiz – may 29 ka firetrucks kag 1 ang unserviceable;Guimaras – may 7 ka firetrucks kag 1 ang unserviceable;

Suno kay Lopez, sa subong, apisar may mga unserviceable na nga firetrucks, apang bastante man ang mga firetrucks sa kada banwa kag syudad sa rehiyon.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Senior Inspector Michael Lopez, Acting chief, Logistic Division of BFP Region 6, said that their central office has already ordered not to repair the old firetrucks instead, just buy new ones.

Individually, here is the status of firetrucks in the region:

Negros Occidental – has 94 firetrucks and 11 are unserviceable; Aklan – has 24 firetrucks and 6 are unserviceable; Iloilo – has 97 firetrucks and 14 are unserviceable; Antique – has 28 firetrucks and 4 are unserviceable; Capiz – has 29 firetrucks and 1 are unserviceable; – there are 7 firetrucks and 1 is unserviceable;

According to Lopez, at present, although there are unserviceable firetrucks, but there are enough firetrucks in each town and city in the region.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga santo sa BFP Modernization Program, kada tuig, may ginabakal man nga bag-o nga firetrucks.
english: He said that in accordance with the BFP Modernization Program, every year, new firetrucks are also purchased.

text: Sa subong nga 2025, may tatlo ka mga bag-o nga firetrucks nga ginpain para sa Western Visayas.
english: As of 2025, there are three new firetrucks allocated for Western Visayas.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮
english: -Advanced 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗣𝗵𝗮𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗮

text: Wala nagpalingkang ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa Hwasong-15 intercontinental ballistic missile nga ginpalupad sang North Korea.
english: The United States of America did not hesitate to respond to the Hwasong-15 intercontinental ballistic missile launched by North Korea.

text: Sa baylo nga mag-isol sa joint military drills kaupod sa South Korea, nagpatigayon ang Amerika sang joint air exercises kaupod sa South Korea kag Japan kag may gingamit pa nga strategic bombers.
english: Instead of shying away from joint military drills with South Korea, the United States conducted joint air exercises with South Korea and Japan and even used strategic bombers.

text: Suno sa Joint Chiefs of Staff sang South Korea, ini nga exercise nga gin-updan sang F-35A, F-15K sang South Korea kag US F-16 fighters kag American B-1B bombers amo ang nagapakita sang “overwhelming” defense capabilities kag readiness posture sang ila nga mga kaalyado.
english: According to South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff, the exercise, which was accompanied by South Korea's F-35A, F-15K and US F-16 fighters and American B-1B bombers, demonstrated the “overwhelming” defense capabilities and readiness posture of their allies.

text: Ginpahayag nga ini man ang pamatuod sang “ironclad commitment” sang Estados Unidos nga depensahan ang Korean Peninsula.
english: He said this is also proof of the “ironclad commitment” of the United States to defend the Korean Peninsula.

text: Suno naman sa Defense Ministry sang Japan, nagpalupad ang pungsod sang F-15s sa tactical exercises sa ibabaw sang Sea of Japan kaupod sa US Armed Forces’ B-1 bombers kag F-16s.
english: According to Japan's Defense Ministry, the country flew F-15s in tactical exercises over the Sea of ​​Japan alongside the US Armed Forces' B-1 bombers and F-16s.

text: Ini nga air drills ang gintabo isa ka adlaw matapos nagpalupad ang North Korea sang long-range ballistic missile.
english: The air drills took place a day after North Korea launched a long-range ballistic missile.

text: Ang ginhimo sang Pyongyang ang kasunod sang ila man paandam nga magabalos sila kun dayunon sang US kag South Korea ang ila nga joint military drills (nga kun Pyongyang ang pahambalon, isa na ka preparasyon para sa posible nga invasion’.
english: Pyongyang's move follows its own warning that it will retaliate if the US and South Korea continue their joint military drills (which, according to Pyongyang, is a preparation for a possible invasion.

text: Matandaan nga sunod-sunod man nga ginkondenar sang Group of Seven, grupo sang pito ka leading seven world economies, ang ginhimo ni North Korean President Kim Jong-Un.
english: The Group of Seven, a group of seven leading world economies, has also repeatedly condemned the actions of North Korean President Kim Jong-Un.

text: Nagaplano ang Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 (BFP-6) nga magpahamtang sang fire hydrants sa fire prone areas sa Western Visayas.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 (BFP-6) plans to install fire hydrants in fire prone areas in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Senior Inspector Michael Lopez, Acting Chief sang Logistics Division sang Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang may tuyo nga mapa-intensify ang fire prevention campaign sa rehiyon.
english: Fire Senior Inspector Michael Lopez, Acting Chief of the Logistics Division of the Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6, said the move is aimed at intensifying the fire prevention campaign in the region.

text: Suno kay Lopez, luwas sa hydrants, may ginapatuman man sila nga fire information campaign agud ma-edukar ang mga residente sa pagtapna sang kalayo.
english: Lopez said that besides the hydrants, they are also implementing a fire information campaign to educate residents on fire prevention.

text: Nagahiwat man sang fire brigade trainings sa tagsa ka mga barangay agud mahanas ang ikasarang sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Fire brigade trainings are also being conducted in each barangay to train the skills of the residents.

text: Nagakoordinar naman sa tagsa ka Local Government Unit (LGU) ang mga Fire Marshals sang BFP agud nga maplanohan sang maayo ang pagbutang sang mga fire hydrants.
english: Fire Marshals of the BFP are coordinating with each Local Government Unit (LGU) to plan the installation of fire hydrants.

text: Isa na lang sa lima ka mga lider sang House Quad Committee (Quad Comm) ang nabilin samtang ginahandaan ang pagsulod sang 20th Congress.
english: Only one of the five House Quad Committee (Quad Comm) leaders remains as the 20th Congress prepares to enter.

text: Ang “last man standing” sa main panel amo si Antipolo City 2nd district Rep.
english: The “last man standing” in the main panel is Antipolo City 2nd district Rep.

text: Romeo Acop nga amo ang nagpungko nga overall vice chairman.
english: Romeo Acop who is the incumbent overall vice chairman.

text: Isa siya ka anay police brigadier general nga nagdaog sa 2nd district race sa amo nga syudad, apang wala pa sang kasiguruhan kun ano ang mangin papel sini sa masunod nga Congress kun yara pa ang mega-panel.
english: He is a former police brigadier general who won the 2nd district race in the city, but it is uncertain what his role will be in the next Congress if the mega-panel is still in place.

text: Tatlo naman sa mga myembro sang Quad Comm ang naka-“graduate” na matapos nakaserbe na sang tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga termino.
english: Three of the members of the Quad Comm have already graduated after serving three consecutive terms.

text: Ini amo sanday overall chairman Surigao del Norte 2nd district Rep.
english: These are overall chairman Surigao del Norte 2nd district Rep.

text: Robert Ace Barbers, kag co-chairmen sini nga sanday Santa Rosa City lone district Rep.
english: Robert Ace Barbers, and its co-chairmen Santa Rosa City lone district Rep.

text: Dan Fernandez kag Abang Lingkod Party-list Rep.
english: Dan Fernandez and Abang Lingkod Party-list Rep.

text: Joseph Stephen “Caraps” Paduano.
english: Joseph Stephen “Caraps” Paduano.

text: Sila nga tatlo ang nagapamuno sa Committees on Dangerous Drugs, on Public Order and Safety, kag on Public Accounts sa 19th Congress.
english: All three chair the Committees on Dangerous Drugs, on Public Order and Safety, and on Public Accounts in the 19th Congress.

text: Ang isa pa ka co-chairman nga si Manila 6th district Rep.
english: Another co-chairman, Manila 6th district Rep.

text: Bienvenido “Benny” Abante nga chair sang Committee on Human Rights ang indi na makit-an sa 20th congress matapos nalutos sa eleksyon subong nga 2025.
english: Bienvenido “Benny” Abante, chairman of the Committee on Human Rights, will not be seen in the 20th congress after being defeated in the 2025 elections.

text: Kilala ang quad comm bangud sa 13 ka marathon hearings nga ginpatigayon nga naka-sentro sa mga isyu lakip na sa drug war, Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) kag money laundering.
english: The quad comm is known for its 13 marathon hearings focused on issues including the drug war, Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) and money laundering.

text: Nangin matunog man ang mga drama sa sini nga hearings, may dalagku nga mga rebelasyon, may mga gindagdagan sang contempt order, kag ginsundan man bangud sa kontrobersyal nga resource persons lakip na sanday Alice Guo, Cassy Ong, Harry Roque, Kerwin Espinosa, former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Mabilog, kag former president Rodrigo Duterte.#
english: There were also dramas in these hearings, with major revelations, the addition of contempt orders, and followed by controversial resource persons including Alice Guo, Cassy Ong, Harry Roque, Kerwin Espinosa, former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Mabilog, and former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Nagapati si Former Senator Franklin Drilon nga disbentaha sa mga pumuluyo kon ang impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang matabo pagkatapos sang 2025 midterm elections.
english: Former Senator Franklin Drilon believes that it would be a disadvantage for the people if the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte takes place after the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Former Sen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Former Sen.

text: Drilon, iya ginpahayag nga kon matabo naman ang impeachment trial subong antes ang eleksyon, dako ang ‘political pressure’ sa mga incumbent senators.
english: Drilon, he said that if the impeachment trial takes place before the election, there will be a lot of political pressure on the incumbent senators.

text: Suno kay Drilon, matigayon nga magdaog ang panindugan sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: According to Drilon, the position of the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kon matapos gilayon ang trial antes ang eleksyon.
english: if the trial ends immediately before the election.

text: Ginsuspetsahan man sang natungdan ang lihok sang administrasyon nga tubtob subong, wala nagapatawag sang special session.
english: He also suspected the administration's move that so far, has not called a special session.

text: Nahibaluan nga gintalana ni Senate President Francis Escudero ang trial proper sa impeachment ni Duterte sa Hulyo 30, base sa iya ginaduso nga kalendaryo.
english: Senate President Francis Escudero has scheduled the trial proper for Duterte's impeachment on July 30, based on his proposed calendar.

text: Hayag man nga gina-abi-abi ni Escudero ang proposal ni Senate Minority Leader Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III nga magbulig sa pag-draft sang ginaduso nga pagsulundan sa impeachment proceedings batok kay VP Sara Duterte.
english: Escudero also welcomed the proposal of Senate Minority Leader Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III to help draft the proposed rules for the impeachment proceedings against VP Sara Duterte.

text: Indi matupongan ang kalipay sang ginbansagan nga ‘viral mama’ matapos nga nakuha sang iya anak ang bronze medal sa 400-meter low hurdle sa nagapadayon nga Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025 sa Antique.
english: The so-called 'viral mama' was overjoyed after her son won the bronze medal in the 400-meter low hurdle at the ongoing Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025 in Antique.

text: Ini amo si Ray-ray Cordova ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga ‘Mama Rayray’.
english: This is Ray-ray Cordova or better known as 'Mama Rayray'.

text: Samtang ang anak sini amo si Mariah Laudine Cordova sang Tabugon Elementary School, kag residente sang Dingle, Iloilo.
english: Meanwhile, his daughter is Mariah Laudine Cordova of Tabugon Elementary School, and resident of Dingle, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mama Rayray, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang labing-una nga kahigayunan nga nakalab-ot ang iya anak sa regional level.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mama Rayray said this is the first time her son has reached the regional level.

text: Suno kay Cordova, tuman ang iya nga pagpasalamat bangud sa wala sang may malain nga natabo kadungan sang kompetisyon sang iya anak.
english: Cordova said she is very grateful that nothing bad happened during her son's competition.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga Grade 5 sang nagsugod sa paghanas sa amo nga sports ang iya anak kon sa diin, naglab-ot lamang ini sang nagligad nga tuig sa integrated meet.
english: She also said that her son started training in the sport in Grade 5 where, he only reached the integrated meet last year.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang natungdan sa mga manunudlo kag coach sang iya anak nga nagsuporta kag nagbulig agud nga mangibabaw sa amo nga kompetisyon.
english: He also thanked his son's teachers and coaches who supported and helped him to win the competition.

text: Naghiwat sang Regional Fire Olympics 2025 ang Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 (BFP-6) subong nga adlaw sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 (BFP-6) held the Regional Fire Olympics 2025 today at the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Senior Inspector Jasmin Mecenas, Acting Chief sa Fire Safety Enforcement Division, iya ginpahayag nga delayed ang kick off bangud ang ila regional director ang nagtambong man sang amo nga kahiwatan sa Region IV-A sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Senior Inspector Jasmin Mecenas, Acting Chief of the Fire Safety Enforcement Division, said the kick off was delayed because their regional director also attended the same event in Region IV-A the previous day.

text: Suno kay Mecenas, ang aktibidad ang kabahin man sang ginasaulog nga Fire Prevention Month subong nga Marso.
english: According to Mecenas, the activity is also part of the celebration of Fire Prevention Month this March.

text: Lakip sa mga nagpartisipar amo ang probinsya sang Guimaras, Antique, Capiz, Negros Occidental, kag Iloilo.
english: Among the participants were the provinces of Guimaras, Antique, Capiz, Negros Occidental, and Iloilo.

text: Nagpasakop man ang anom ka mga barangay fire brigade sa kahiwatan.
english: Six barangay fire brigades also participated in the event.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga tinutuyo sang programa nga mapasangkad ang abilidad kag ikasarang sang mga bombero sa pagtapna sang sunog.
english: He also explained that the program aims to enhance the skills and abilities of firefighters in fire prevention.

text: Igarepresentar naman sang mga magadaog ang Western Visayas sa hiwaton nga kaangay nga programa sa national nga bahin.
english: The winners will represent Western Visayas in a similar program at the national level.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 sa publiko nga magpabilin nga ‘conscious’ sa mga kagamitan sa panimalay kaangay na lang sang mga appliances.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection Region 6 also reminded the public to remain conscious of household appliances such as appliances.

text: Suno kay Fire Chief Superintendent Felixberto Abrenica, Regional Director sang BFP Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ka importante ang self awareness sa mga bagay nga posible matunaan sang kalayo.
english: According to Fire Chief Superintendent Felixberto Abrenica, Regional Director of BFP Region 6, he said that self awareness of things that can cause fire is very important.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga mahimo mangin factor ang tuman ka init sang panahon rason man nga mas doblehon ang pagbantay sa mga naka-plug in nga kagamitan.
english: He also pointed out that the extreme heat of the weather could be a factor, which is why the monitoring of plugged in devices should be doubled.

text: Madamo ang nagbilib sa moment sang Filipino star nga si Alden Richards sang naka-istorya sini sang malawig ang Hollywood superstar nga si Tom Cruise.
english: Many were impressed by the moment of Filipino star Alden Richards when he had a long conversation with Hollywood superstar Tom Cruise.

text:
Natabo ini sa Seoul, South Korea sa international premiere sang “Mission: Impossible —The Final Reckoning.”

Dashing si Alden sa royal blue jacket kag black pants nga suksok sini sa red carpet.
english:
It happened in Seoul, South Korea at the international premiere of “Mission: Impossible —The Final Reckoning.”

Alden was dashing in the royal blue jacket and black pants he wore on the red carpet.

text: Nagkamustahanay ang duha, naglawig ang pag-istoryahanay, kag naghaksanay pa antes ang pagpa-picture.
english: The two greeted each other, talked for a long time, and even hugged before the picture was taken.

text:
Gin-share pa ni Alden ang amo nga meeting sa social media nga siling niya ‘Ethan Meets Ethan.’

Si Ethan ang pangalan ni Alden sa Filipino blockbuster movie nga “Hello, Love, Again”, samtang si Ethan man ang pangalan ni Tom sa “Mission Impossible — The Final Reckoning.”

Magluwas kay Cruise, nakaupod man sang newly-crowned Philippine Box Office King sa Seoul ang iban pa nga bida sa pelikula lakip sanday Simon Pegg, Hayley Atwell, kag Greg Tarzan Davis.
english:
Alden even shared the meeting on social media saying 'Ethan Meets Ethan.'

Ethan is Alden's name in the Filipino blockbuster movie “Hello, Love, Again”, while Ethan is also Tom's name in “Mission Impossible — The Final Reckoning.”

Besides Cruise, the newly-crowned Philippine Box Office King was also joined in Seoul by other stars of the film including Simon Pegg, Hayley Atwell, and Greg Tarzan Davis.

text: Sarang malantaw ini nga pelikula sa Philippine cinemas umpisa sa Sabado May 17.
english: The film will be available in Philippine cinemas starting Saturday May 17.

text: STRANGE nga ang isa ka presidente nga naga-claim nga kontra niya ang corruption nga pakalainon sini ang isa ka ahensya, katulad sang COA, nga ang constitutional mandate amo ang pagbulig sa gobyerno agud maaway ang corruption.
english: It is STRANGE that a president who claims to be against corruption would criticize an agency, such as the COA, whose constitutional mandate is to help the government fight corruption.

text: Gani indi kita maka-intiende kon ngaa pakalainon ni Presidente Duterte ang COA sa pagkwestyon sini sa mga transaksyon sang mga ahensya sang gobyerno katulad sang DOH, DILG, DPWH, PNP, kag iban pa.
english: So we cannot understand why President Duterte would criticize the COA for questioning the transactions of government agencies such as the DOH, DILG, DPWH, PNP, and others.

text: Aba, ginmando pa niya sa sining mga ahensya nga indi pagsapakon ang panugyan sang COA agud sabton ining pangutana sa ila, sa lugar nga ipatuman sang COA ang iya obligasyon!
english: Why, he even ordered these agencies to ignore the COA's advice to answer this question to them, instead of the COA enforcing its obligation!

text: May pamulitika kuno ini tungod ining report sang COA gin-timing malapit sa eleksyon.
english: It is said to be politically motivated because this COA report was timed close to the election.

text: Sa matuod, ginahimo gid man inang report sang COA sa kada Hunyo tubtub Hulyo, indi bala?
english: In fact, the COA does that report every June to July, doesn't it?

text: Wala man nagasiling ang COA nga may anomaliya gid man nga nahimo ining mga ahensya.
english: The COA also does not say that these agencies have committed any anomalies.

text: Ginapa-explicar lang ang indi maintiendihan nila nga mga transaksyon.
english: They just have to explain the transactions they don't understand.

text: Kag trabaho gid man ina sang COA.
english: And that's the COA's job.

text: Kamo man lang ang nagasiling nga ginpasibangdan na ini nga mga ahensya sing anomaliya, indi bala?
english: You are the only ones who say that these agencies have been blamed for anomalies, right?

text: Pero, may anomaliya gid man bala kon ngaa nagaalburuto gid ang iban, haw?
english: But, is there really an anomaly why some people are so excited, huh?

text:
***

Posible, sunu sa projection sang OCTA Research Group, nga indi pa naton malagas ang kadasig sang panglaton sang COVID paagi sa padayon nga pagpangbakuna sa mga pumuluyo, labi na gid sa pagluntad na sang madasig manglaton nga Delta variant.
english:
***

It is possible, according to the projection of the OCTA Research Group, that we will not be able to catch up with the rate of spread of COVID through continuous vaccination of the population, especially with the emergence of the highly contagious Delta variant.

text: In other words, mapaabot man naton ang possible nga pagsaka sang mga kaso sang COVID.
english: In other words, we can also expect a possible increase in COVID cases.

text: Gina-kwestyon ining projection sang OCTA sang mga employers’ group, apang wala man kita seguro pierdihon kon unahan na naton ang ano man nga pwede matabo.
english: This projection of the OCTA is being questioned by the employers' group, but we probably won't lose if we get ahead of whatever might happen.

text: Basi husto man sila.
english: Maybe they were right.

text: Indi kita malipat nga isa ini ka scientific projection sandig sa recognized pattern of events.
english: We must not forget that this is a scientific projection based on a recognized pattern of events.

text: Kag BETTER READY THAN SORRY, indi bala?
english: And BETTER READY THAN SORRY, right?

text: Especially tungod ang pagpanglaton sang COVID sa karon isa na ka community transmission, ukon lapta na sa komunidad.
english: Especially since the spread of COVID is now a community transmission, or spread in the community.

text: Gani indi kita dapat mag-kampante.
english: So we should not be complacent.

text: Kag dapat pa gani itib-ong ang capacidad sang aton healthcare facilities, personnel, equipment, kag apparatus agud matatapan sing maayo ang nagadugang nga mga kaso, labi na gid ang mga “severe” kag “critical”.
english: And the capacity of our healthcare facilities, personnel, equipment, and apparatus must be strengthened to better handle the increasing number of cases, especially the severe and critical ones.

text:
***

In fact, tungod sa Delta variant, nabutang na sa karon sa mas peligroso nga kahimtangan ang mga kabataan (17 anyos panubo) nga dapat matagaan na naton sing pang-una nga atensyon.
english:
***

In fact, because of the Delta variant, children (under the age of 17) are now in a more dangerous situation that we should give priority to.

text: Salamat kay ginapatuman na ni Mayor Treñas ang pagpanglista sang mga kabataan nga pwede mabakunahan.
english: Thankfully, Mayor Treñas is already implementing the registration of children who can be vaccinated.

text: Bag-o ang Delta variant, wala naton gawa gina-problema ang mahimo sang COVID sa mga kabataan tungod malaka kaayo ang igu sini sa ila, kag tungod masami “mild” ukon “moderate” lang ang mga kaso.
english: Before the Delta variant, we didn't even worry about what COVID could do to children because it was so rare, and because cases were often mild or moderate.

text: Sa pag-abot sang Delta variant, ugaling, nagdaku na ang porsyento sang mga kabataan nga naigu kag mas peligroso na ang kahimtangan nila.
english: With the arrival of the Delta variant, however, the percentage of children affected has increased and their condition is more dangerous.

text: Sunu sa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), magadamo na ang mga kaso sang multisystem inflammatory symdrome in Children (MIS-C) tungod sini.
english: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), cases of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in Children (MIS-C) will increase as a result.

text: Ining MIS-C, sunu sa CDC, nakitaan sa 99% sang kabataan nga naigu sang COVID.
english: This MIS-C, according to the CDC, is found in 99% of children infected with COVID.

text: Life-threatening ining MIS-C. Ginapalala sini ang problema sa tagipusuon kag iban nga organs sang kabataan.
english: MIS-C is life-threatening. This aggravates the problem in the heart and other organs of children.

text:
***

Indi ta man pagkalimtan ang masubo nga kahimtangan nga madangtan sang mga kabataan kon ma-quarantine ukon ma-isolate tungod sa COVID.
english:
***

Let's not forget the sad situation that children face when they are quarantined or isolated because of COVID.

text: Mabulag ini sila sa ila mga ginikanan tungod indi ini sila makaupod sa mga quarantine kag isolation rooms.
english: They will be separated from their parents because they will not be able to accompany them in the quarantine and isolation rooms.

text: Makadulot ini sa mga kabataan sang depression kag anxiety, labi na gid ang kahadlok sa madangtan nila.
english: This can cause children depression and anxiety, especially fear of what will happen to them.

text: Dapat may medyos kita agud may personal gihapon nga relasyon sila sa ila ginikanan, katulad sang pag-provide sa ila sang android cellphone ukon laptop kon diin makasugilanon sila sing personal, bisan paagi lang sa pagpahulam sa ila, indi bala?/PN
english: We should have a way for them to still have a personal relationship with their parents, such as providing them with an android cellphone or laptop where they can talk personally, even just by lending them, right?/PN

text: Kun magsud-an kita sang pinirito, kanami batyagon nga makapuksi lang kita sang suha sa aton ugsaran agud himuon nga sawsawan sa aton nga pagkaon.
english: When we eat fried food, it's nice to feel that we can just pick suha in our yard to make a sauce for our food.
