text: Nahibaluan nga ang citrus fruit nga suha ang bantog na sa kalibutan nga may madamo sang mahatag nga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas sa diin nakaandan naman nga imnon bilang juice ang duga sini.
english: It is known that the citrus fruit suha is famous in the world for its many health benefits and it is common to drink its juice as a juice.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, indi lang ang prutas nga suha ang dapat naton puksion sa puno sini kundi pati ang dahon.
english: But according to experts, we should cut not only the suha fruit from the tree but also the leaves.

text: Suno kay Dr. Michelle Heben sa Michigan USA, ang calamansi leaves ang manggaranon sa anti-viral properties nga makabulong sa makatol nga panit halin sa kinadtan sang insekto.
english: According to Dr. Michelle Heben in Michigan USA, calamansi leaves are rich in anti-viral properties that can heal itchy skin from insect bites.

text: Puno man suno sa doktor sa antifungal properties ang dahon sang suha kag ginagamit man ini bilang herbal medicine agud bulngon ang skin diseases tuga sang fungi.
english: The doctor said the leaves of suha are also full of antifungal properties and are also used as herbal medicine to treat skin diseases caused by fungi.

text: Bentaha man suno kay Heben ang dahon sang suha sa mga allergic sa deodorant bangud ginagamit ini nga natural alternative agud malikawan ang body smell ilabi na sa ilok.
english: Heben said suha leaves are also advantageous for those allergic to deodorant because they are used as a natural alternative to avoid body odor especially in the nose.

text: Nagbalik-ensayo na ang naturalized player sang Gilas Pilipinas nga si Justin Brownlee bilang preparasyon para sa FIBA Asia Cup nga pagahiwaton sa masunod nga bulan sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
english: Gilas Pilipinas naturalized player Justin Brownlee has returned to training in preparation for the FIBA ​​Asia Cup to be held next month in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

text: Malawig man ang nangin pahuway sang 37-anyos nga resident import pagkatapos nga magsuprer sini sang injury sa PBA Commissioner’s Cup finals sa tunga sang Barangay Ginebra kag TNT Tropang Giga.
english: The 37-year-old resident import also had a long break after suffering an injury in the PBA Commissioner's Cup finals between Barangay Ginebra and TNT Tropang Giga.

text: Pagkatapos sang finals, nagpauli ini anay sa Amerika agud nga magpaidalom sa isa ka minor operation.
english: After the finals, he returned to the United States to undergo a minor operation.

text: Sa subong, maayo na ang kondisyon sang iya shooting hand.
english: So far, his shooting hand is in good shape.

text: Samtang yara sa US suno kay Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone, nagpadayon man si Brownlee sa pag-work out agud nga mapabilin nga maayo ang kondisyon sang iya lawas.
english: While in the US, Gilas Pilipinas head coach Tim Cone said, Brownlee also continued to work out to keep his body in good shape.

text: Nagsugod na sang Lunes ang training camp sang Gilas Pilipinas kun sa diin mas maka-focus naman si Cone matapos nga nalutos ang Ginebra sa San Miguel sa Game 7 sang best-of-seven semifinal series sang PBA Philippine Cup.
english: Gilas Pilipinas' training camp started on Monday where Cone will be able to focus more after Ginebra lost to San Miguel in Game 7 of the best-of-seven semifinal series of the PBA Philippine Cup.

text: Luwas kay Brownlee, nag-abot na man sa Manila si AJ Edu nga isa man ka daku nga bulig sa team labi na nga wala sa lineup si Kai Sotto.
english: Besides Brownlee, AJ Edu has also arrived in Manila which is also a big help to the team especially since Kai Sotto is not in the lineup.

text: Nabatyagan na sang pila ka mga foreign companies sa sektor sang konstruksyon ang mahina nga baligyaanay bangud sa epekto sang eskandalo sa flood control projects diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Some foreign companies in the construction sector have already felt the weakness of sales due to the impact of the scandal on flood control projects here in the Philippines.

text: Suno sa European Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines (ECCP), bangud may mga proyekto nga gin-hold, na-eksperyensyahan na nila ang reduction sa sales kag ginalantaw nga magalawig pa ini sang sinemana ukon binulan.
english: According to the European Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines (ECCP), because some projects have been put on hold, they have already experienced a reduction in sales and it is expected to last for weeks or months.

text: “They really are already experiencing it.
english: “They really are already experiencing it.

text: Their sales are going down when it comes to construction materials,” suno kay Florian Gottein, executive director sang ECCP.
english: Their sales are going down when it comes to construction materials,” said Florian Gottein, executive director of ECCP.

text: Wala pa sang nabaton nga inquiries ang chamber halin sa potensyal nga investors, samtang gina-monitor naman sang European investors ang sitwasyon kag ila ini gina-diskusyunan.
english: The chamber has not yet received inquiries from potential investors, while European investors are monitoring the situation and discussing it.

text:
Una na nga gin-ako sang budget officials nga ang pag-repaso sang Department of Public Works and Highways sa mga proyekto lakip na ang flood control projects nga ginadudahan nga may ginaalegar nga kurapsyon ang mahimo mag-resulta sa short-term disruptions sa programa nga pang-imprastraktura sang gobyerno.#

PNA photo by Gil Calinga
english:
Earlier, budget officials acknowledged that the Department of Public Works and Highways' review of projects including flood control projects suspected of alleged corruption could result in short-term disruptions to the government's infrastructure program.

PNA photo by Gil Calinga

text: Gin-utdan sang ulo kag ginhimuslan pa ang isa ka Grade 9 student sa isa ka katubuhan sa Brgy.
english: A Grade 9 student was beheaded and raped in a shop in Brgy.

text: Dagat Kidavao, Valencia City, Bukidnon.
english: Kidavao Sea, Valencia City, Bukidnon.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Ana”, 15-anyos, residente sang amo nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as “Ana”, 15 years old, resident of the said barangay.

text: Suno sa Bukidnon Police Provincial Office, Enero 6 pa na-missing ang dalagita kag Enero 8 na ini sang nakit-an nga wala na sang kabuhi.
english: According to the Bukidnon Police Provincial Office, the girl went missing on January 6 and was found dead on January 8.

text: Padayon naman ang imbestigasyon para makilala ang tawo sa likod sang krimen.
english: Investigation is ongoing to identify the person behind the crime.

text: May gintanyag naman nga P200,000 reward sa sin-o man nga makatudlo sa tawo nga responsable sa pagpatay sa biktima.
english: A P200,000 reward has been offered to anyone who can point out the person responsible for killing the victim.

text: Kun bata gani ang dal-on sa dental clinic, pat-od nga malawig pa nga istoryahanay kag paathag ang kinahanglan antes ini mag-behave samtang ginagabutan sang ngipon.
english: Even if a child is brought to the dental clinic, it will take a long discussion and explanation before he or she behaves while having a tooth extracted.

text: Kun medyo may buot na, syempre wala na ina sang gamo..
english: If you have a little sense, of course there is no trouble.

text: apang daw indi man halandumon nga matabo sa bisan sin-o nga hamtong nga tawo ang kaangay sa na-abtan sang isa ka lalaki sa China.
english: but it seems unlikely that anything like what happened to a man in China would happen to any adult.

text: Ini amo si Huang nga nga nagkadto sa clinic sa Yongkang City, Zhejiang Province, China.
english: This is Huang who went to the clinic in Yongkang City, Zhejiang Province, China.

text: Sa isa lang ka session, 23 sa iya ngipon ang gingabot kag ginbutangan sang 12 ka bag-o nga bulos!
english: In just one session, 23 of his teeth were extracted and 12 new ones were replaced!

text: Natabo ini sang nagligad lamang nga Agusto 15, apang makaligad nga 13 ka adlaw, sa masubo nga bahin, napatay gid ang lalaki.
english: This happened just last August 15, but 13 days later, unfortunately, the man did die.

text: Sunod nga nagpalapit ang iya anak sa Municipal Health Bureau agud mag-file sang reklamo.
english: His son next approached the Municipal Health Bureau to file a complaint.

text: Ginsiling sini nga pagkatapos sang session sa dental clinic, adlaw-adlaw na nga nagapalanakit ang bibig sang amay tubtub nga gin-atake ini sa korason sang Agusto 28 kag nangin rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: He said that after the session at the dental clinic, the father's mouth hurt every day until he suffered a heart attack on August 28 and died.

text: Nagpaathag naman ang dental clinic nga gin-determina sang dentista ang numero sang ngipon nga gabuton paagi sa face-to-face consultation kag physical condition sang pasyente.
english: The dental clinic explained that the dentist determined the number of teeth to be extracted through face-to-face consultation and the physical condition of the patient.

text: Ginsiling man nila nga ang nangamot sa procedure amo ang isa ka dentist nga may lima ka tuig naman nga eksperyensya sa dental practice kag nalakip sa iya nga espesyalisasyon amo ang root canal treatment, removal sang impacted wisdom teeth, kag full dentures.
english: They also said that the procedure was performed by a dentist who has five years of experience in dental practice and whose specialization includes root canal treatment, removal of impacted wisdom teeth, and full dentures.

text: Nagpaathag naman ang Oral Medicine Center sang Wuhan Fourth Hospital nga apisar wala sang specific regulation kun pila ka ngipon ang gabuton sa kada session, maathag nga sobra-sobra ang 23 sa isa lang ka pagpungko.
english: The Oral Medicine Center of Wuhan Fourth Hospital explained that although there is no specific regulation on how many teeth to be extracted in each session, it is clear that 23 in one sitting is too much.

text: Tubtub subong gina-imbestigaran pa ang amo nga kaso ilabi na bangud may nagapanindugan man nga lain ang rason sang kamatayon sang pasyente.
english: The case is still being investigated, especially since there are those who insist that the patient's death was caused by something else.

text:
Ginrason sang iban nga halos duha ka semana pa ang nagligad halin sa kontrobersyal nga dental procedure antes ginbawian sang kabuhi ang amo nga lalaki.#

(Photo courtesy of The Paper)
english:
Others argued that nearly two weeks had passed since the controversial dental procedure before the man died.

(Photo courtesy of The Paper)

text:
Nag-anunsyo ang pila ka mga buluthuan sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo subong nga adlaw Marso 3 nga magasupende ang mga ini sang klase bangud man sang madali apang mabaskog nga linog nga nagluntad kagab-i.

Yari ang listahan sang mga nagdeklarar sang class suspension:

Sa syudad sang Iloilo, nag-kanselar sang klase ang Iloilo National High School, University of San Agustin (all levels) kag ISAT-U Main Campus (all levels).
english:
Several schools in Iloilo City and province announced today, March 3, that they will suspend classes due to a mild but strong earthquake that occurred last night.

Here is a list of those who declared class suspension:

In Iloilo City, Iloilo National High School, University of San Agustin (all levels) and ISAT-U Main Campus (all levels) canceled classes.

text: Sa probinsya naman sang Iloilo nagdeklarar man ang mga banwa sang Oton, Tubungan all levels kag bilog nga adlaw, samtang sa Guimbal, Tigbauan kag ISAT-U Miagao Campus suspende ang klase sa aga lamang kag magabalik ini sa hapon depende sa ila mga Local Government Units.
english: In Iloilo province, the towns of Oton, Tubungan also declared all levels and all day, while in Guimbal, Tigbauan and ISAT-U Miagao Campus, classes will be suspended in the morning only and will resume in the afternoon depending on their Local Government Units.

text: Nahibaluan nga bangud sa linog nga nagtay-og kahapon sa Guimbal Iloilo, ginpakamaayo nalang sang iban nga buluthuan sa syudad kag Probinsya sang Iloilo nga ikanselar anay ang klase kag mag-shift sa Alternative Delivery Mode of Learning.
english: It is known that due to the earthquake that shook Guimbal Iloilo yesterday, some schools in Iloilo City and Province decided to cancel classes and shift to Alternative Delivery Mode of Learning.

text: Sa bahin naman sang syudad sang Iloilo, nagpahayag si Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas sa mga school administrators sa mga pampubliko kag pribado nga mga eskwelahan sa siudad nga magpatigayon sang inspection sa ila mga establisyamento.
english: On the part of Iloilo City, Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas told school administrators in public and private schools in the city to conduct inspections in their establishments.

text: Suno kay Treñas, magadepende man sa assessment sang mga school administrators kun ila isuspende ang mga face-to-face classes sa tagsa ka mga buluthuan sa siudad.
english: Treñas said it will also depend on the assessment of school administrators whether they will suspend face-to-face classes in each school in the city.

text: Nahibaluan nga may ara man sang nakit-an nga mga minor cracks sa pila ka mga establisyamento sa siudad sang Iloilo.
english: Minor cracks were also found in some establishments in Iloilo City.

text: Apisar naga-signal na si United Nations aid chief Martin Griffiths nga nagahilapit na nga magtakop ang rescue operations sa southern Turkey, milagro nga may nagaka-kutkutan gihapon nga mga buhi nga mga tawo isa ka semana matapos gintay-og sang magkasunod nga 7.8 kag 7.6 magnitude nga linog ang Turkey kag Syria.
english: Although United Nations aid chief Martin Griffiths is signaling that rescue operations in southern Turkey are coming to an end, it is a miracle that there are still people buried alive a week after consecutive 7.8 and 7.6 magnitude earthquakes rocked Turkey and Syria.

text: Lakip sa latest nga na-rescue amo ang 10 ka tuig nga bata nga natampukan sang debris sang nag-collapse ang isa apartment building sa Kahramanmaras province.
english: Among the latest rescued was a 10-year-old boy who was trapped in debris when an apartment building collapsed in Kahramanmaras province.

text: Buhi ang bata apisar 183 ka oras na ang nakaligad sang natabo ang linog.
english: The child is alive even though 183 hours have passed since the earthquake.

text: May yara man sang 13 ka tuig nga bata nga nakaluwas matapos ang 175 ka oras nga pagka-trap sa building; kag may yara man sang apat ka tuig nga bata nga babayi sa Adiyaman province nga na-rescue matapos ang 178 ka oras.
english: There was also a 13-year-old who survived after being trapped in the building for 175 hours; and there was also a four-year-old girl in Adiyaman province who was rescued after 178 hours.

text: Ini ginakabig nga milagro ilabi na sang rescuers bangud ginapatihan nga mabuhi ang tawo sa sulod lamang sang tatlo tubtub apat ka adlaw ukon 72-96 ka oras nga wala sang tubig.
english: This is considered a miracle especially by rescuers because it is believed that humans can survive for only three to four days or 72-96 hours without water.

text: Sa subong, lapaw na sa 36,000 ang nagkalamatay sa duha ka pungsod.
english: So far, more than 36,000 people have died in both countries.

text: Suno sa Turkish authorities, masobra 31,640 ang kumpirmado nga patay sa Turkey as of press time samtang masobra naman sa 4,600 sa Syria.
english: According to Turkish authorities, more than 31,640 people have been confirmed dead in Turkey as of press time while more than 4,600 in Syria.

text: Naglapaw na sa 34,000 ang napatay sa Turkey kag Syria kasunod sang mabaskog nga linog.
english: More than 34,000 people have been killed in Turkey and Syria following a powerful earthquake.

text: Suno sa Turkish Emergency Coordination Center, 29,605 na ang nakumpirma nga patay sa sakop pa lamang sang Turkey, samtang 4,574 naman sa Syria.
english: According to the Turkish Emergency Coordination Center, 29,605 people have been confirmed dead in Turkey alone, while 4,574 in Syria.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Syria Civil Defence ukon sang White Helmets nga nagtakop na ang ila nga search and rescue operations sang Byernes, apang ginapanan-aw nga magdugang pa ang numero sang casualties.
english: Earlier, the Syrian Civil Defense or the White Helmets said their search and rescue operations had ended on Friday, but the number of casualties was expected to rise.

text: Mangin ang chief sang United Nations relief ang nagkahangawa man nga posible mag-doble pa ang numero sang mga napatay ukon maglapaw sa 50,000.
english: Even the chief of the United Nations relief agency is concerned that the death toll could double or exceed 50,000.

text: Yara naman sa 50 ka tawo ang ginpang-aresto bangud sa pagpangawat sa tunga sang amo nga sitwasyon sa duha ka pungsod.
english: About 50 people were arrested for robbery amid the situation in the two countries.

text: May duha naman ka daku nga military ships nga gin-deploy sa south sang Turkey agud mag-serbe bilang floating hospitals agud mabulong ang mga injured.##
english: Two large military ships have been deployed in southern Turkey to serve as floating hospitals to treat the injured.##

text: Gindangop sa kapulisan ang report nga lima ka adlaw na nga wala nakapauli sa ila balay ang isa ka barangay kagawad sa Sitio Capinayan, Poblacion, Lemery, Iloilo.
english: Police received a report that a barangay kagawad in Sitio Capinayan, Poblacion, Lemery, Iloilo had not returned home for five days.

text: Ini amo si John Mark Azuela nga ulihi nga nagbiya sa ila puluy-an sang Marso 1, Sabado, alas nueve sang aga.
english: This is John Mark Azuela who last left his home on March 1, Saturday, at 9 am.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain John Robles, hepe sang Lemery Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naka-istorya sa estasyon ang utod sang barangay kagawad kun sa diin ginpakigbahin sini nga naglisensya ang kagawad nga may kadtuan lang nga abyan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain John Robles, chief of the Lemery Municipal Police Station, said the brother of the barangay kagawad spoke to the station where he shared that the kagawad had given permission to go to a friend.

text: Ginpahayag nga masami gid man ini nga nagalagaw sa iya mga abyan sa iban nga mga banwa, apang nagapauli man sa ila nga balay.
english: He reportedly often goes out with his friends in other towns, but also returns home.

text: Nagpadala naman ang police station sang imbestigador agud nga mabuligan ang pamilya.
english: The police station sent an investigator to help the family.

text: Nagapangabay ang mga himata sa may impormasyon sa nahamtangan sang kagawad nga magpakig-angot sa numero nga 0912-765-2004 ukon mag-report sa pinakamalapit nga police station.
english: Relatives are asking anyone with information on the whereabouts of the kagawad to contact 0912-765-2004 or report to the nearest police station.

text: Magadangop si former senator Leila de Lima sa Korte Suprema kun kinahanglan kasunod sang desisyon sang Court of Appeals (CA) nga baliskaron ang nauna na nga pag-acquit sa iya sang Muntinlupa Regional Trial Court (RTC) sa kaso sa iligal nga droga.
english: Former senator Leila de Lima will appeal to the Supreme Court if necessary following the decision of the Court of Appeals (CA) to overturn her earlier acquittal by the Muntinlupa Regional Trial Court (RTC) in the illegal drugs case.

text: Kasunod ini sang 12 ka pahina nga desisyon sang Eighth Division sang CA nga amo ang nag-grant sang petition for certiorari nga gin-file sang Office of the Solicitor General.
english: This followed a 12 page judgment of the Eighth Division of the CA which granted the petition for certiorari filed by the Office of the Solicitor General.

text: Sa amo man nga desisyon, ginbalik ang kaso ni De Lima sa Branch 204 sang Muntinlupa RTC.
english: In the same decision, De Lima's case was remanded to Branch 204 of the Muntinlupa RTC.

text: Suno kay De Lima, makalilibog sang ulo ang desisyon sang CA bangud daw kaangay nga ginahingyo sang appellate court ang RTC nga magsulat sang lain nga desisyon kag gina-alegar nga indi klaro ang una nga desisyon.
english: According to De Lima, the CA's decision is confusing because it seems that the appellate court is asking the RTC to write a different decision and alleges that the first decision is not clear.

text: “Nonetheless, we will appeal the CA’s decision up to the Supreme Court, if necessary.
english: “Nonetheless, we will appeal the CA’s decision up to the Supreme Court, if necessary.

text: In the meantime, this does not mean that my acquittal has lost its legal effect.
english: In the meantime, this does not mean that my acquittal has lost its legal effect.

text: My acquittal is final and unappealable due to the principle of double jeopardy, whereas the CA’s decision is still appealable up to the Supreme Court,” kabahin sang iya nga statement.
english: My acquittal is final and unappealable due to the principle of double jeopardy, whereas the CA’s decision is still appealable up to the Supreme Court,” he said in a statement.

text:
“For now, the RTC’s decision acquitting me still holds greater weight.”

Kabahin pa sang iya pahayag:

“We believe that all the answers to the CA’s questions in their decision can be found in the case records.
english:
“For now, the RTC’s decision acquitting me still holds greater weight.”

Part of his statement:

“We believe that all the answers to the CA’s questions in their decision can be found in the case records.

text:
Perhaps we just need to point out again, through our Motion for Reconsideration, the specific portions of the records where the answers to their questions can be found.”

Dugang sini, “I also wish to clarify that the CA did not say that my acquittal was reversed; rather, it only asked for the RTC decision to be clarified or revised — something we believe is unnecessary because the RTC’s ruling is already clear.”

Nahibaluan nga natalana nga magbalik si De Lima sa Kongreso bilang first nominee sang ML Partylist nga naka-secure sang isa ka pwesto sa 20th Congress.
english:
Perhaps we just need to point out again, through our Motion for Reconsideration, the specific portions of the records where the answers to their questions can be found.”

It added, “I also wish to clarify that the CA did not say that my acquittal was reversed; rather, it only asked for the RTC decision to be clarified or revised — something we believe is unnecessary because the RTC’s ruling is already clear.”

De Lima is scheduled to return to Congress as the first nominee of the ML Partylist who secured a seat in the 20th Congress.

text: Bisan pa sa desisyon sang appellate court, nagpahayag si Congresswoman-elect de Lima nga indi sini maapektuhan ang iya pagbalik sa public office.
english: Despite the appellate court's decision, Congresswoman-elect de Lima said it will not affect her return to public office.

text: Nagpahayag man ang defense team ni De Lima nga bisan sa desisyon sang CA, indi mahimo mabalik si De Lima sa presuhan bangud sa status quo.
english: De Lima's defense team also said that despite the CA's decision, De Lima cannot be returned to jail because of the status quo.

text: Base sa pagsulundan, may layi nga nagaproteher sa defendants sa double jeopardy — buot silingon, indi ma-convict ang tawo nga na-acquit na.
english: Based on the rule, there is a law that protects defendants from double jeopardy — that is, a person who has already been acquitted cannot be convicted.

text: Apang sa pila ka mga kaso, gina-nullify sang appellate court ang acquittals bangud sa pila ka basehan kaangay sang mistrial kag grave abuse of discretion.
english: However, in some cases, the appellate court nullifies acquittals due to certain grounds such as mistrial and grave abuse of discretion.

text: ILOILO – Nagakabalaka ang Iloilo Provincial Government sa serye sang mga ginaalegar abduction sa Iloilo sa diin involve ang mga kabataan.
english: ILOILO – The Iloilo Provincial Government is concerned about a series of alleged abductions in Iloilo involving children.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rapunzel Rara Ganzon, Social Welfare Office IV sang Iloilo Provincial Social Welfare and Development, iya ginpahayag ng apisar ginkumpirma sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) nga wala sang actual kidnappings nga natabo, ginakahangaw-an ang mga potential consequences sang misinformation kag mass hysteria.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rapunzel Rara Ganzon, Social Welfare Office IV of the Iloilo Provincial Social Welfare and Development, said that although the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) confirmed that no actual kidnappings occurred, they are concerned about the potential consequences of misinformation and mass hysteria.

text: Suno kay Ganzon, may yara sang itanyag nga psychosocial suppor sa mga kabataan kag mangin sa ila ginikanan.
english: According to Ganzon, psychosocial support will be offered to the children and their parents.

text: Posible suno kay Ganzon nga ang rason sang paghimo sang istorya sang mga kabataan amo bangud sa hysteria, ang iban mahimo nga nagapangayo lang sang atensyon ukon ang iban ginahimo lang gid rason para sa tabunan ang ila sala.
english: Ganzon said it is possible that the reason for the children's stories is due to hysteria, some may be just asking for attention or others are just making excuses to cover up their sins.

text: Ginapanawagan man sang natungdan sa mga ginikanan nga pabaskugon ang ila relasyon sa ila mga kabataan.
english: He also urged parents to strengthen their relationship with their children.

text: Nagapati ini nga ang mabaskog nga parent-child relationship ang makabulig nga malikawan ang amo nga sahi sang sitwasyon sa diin ang iban nga kabataan ang kinahanglan pa nga maghimo-himo sang mga makaalarma nga istorya.
english: He believes that a strong parent-child relationship can help avoid such situations where some children have to make up alarming stories.

text: Nagpaandam man si Ganzon sang insigida nga pagpalapta sang unverified information sa social media bangud makahatag ini sang panic kag paranoia sa publiko.
english: Ganzon also warned against immediately spreading unverified information on social media as it can cause panic and paranoia among the public.

text: Apisar sa kumpirmasyon nga wala sang abductions nga natatbo, nagpanawagan si Ganzon sa mga ginikanan nga mangin mabinantayon sa gihapon bangud mahimo nga may yara sang mga indibidwal nga gamiton ang sitwasyon subong kag himuon gid ang krimen.
english: Despite the confirmation that no abductions occurred, Ganzon urged parents to remain vigilant as there may be individuals who will use the current situation and commit crimes.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗟𝘆𝗻𝗱-𝗖 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗲
english: -Sugar 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗟𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗵 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗲

text: Iloilo – Magahiwat sang Necrological service ang himata sang Ilongga overseas Filipino worker nga napatay sa magnitude 7.8 nga linog sa Turkey.
english: ILOILO CITY – The relatives of an Ilongga overseas Filipino worker who died in the magnitude 7.8 earthquake in Turkey will hold a necrological service.

text: Ini apisar nga wala ang bangkay sini.
english: This despite the absence of its body.

text: Ang napatay amo si Rosemarie Ga, residente sang Barangay Daragan, Buenavista, Guimaras.
english: The deceased was identified as Rosemarie Ga, resident of Barangay Daragan, Buenavista, Guimaras.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pastor Winston Ga, hinablos ni Rosemarie Ga, iya ginpahayag nga pagahiwaton ang necrological service para sa iya tiya sa Pebrero 19 sa Daragan Terminal Baptist Church sa Buenavista, Guimaras.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pastor Winston Ga, nephew of Rosemarie Ga, said the necrological service for his aunt will be held on February 19 at the Daragan Terminal Baptist Church in Buenavista, Guimaras.

text: Suno kay Pastor Ga, ini agud nga dumdumon ang nabilin nga memorya kag mahatagan sang serbisyo sa ulihi nga palahuwayan ang iya tiya.
english: According to Pastor Ga, this is to remember the remaining memories and provide services at the final resting place of his aunt.

text: Matandaan nga si Ga ang isa sa duha ka mga narekord nga Pilipino nga napatay sa Turkey.
english: Ga is one of two recorded Filipino deaths in Turkey.

text: Sa subong, indi pa maathag kun ipadala sang embahada sang Pilipinas ang bangkay ni Ga ukon ilakip sa mass grave sa Turkey.
english: At present, it is not clear whether the Philippine embassy will send Ga's body or include it in the mass grave in Turkey.

text: Nag-organisar ang Department of Environment and Natural Resources – Environment Management Bureau (EMB) sang isa ka daku nga post-election cleanup drive agud matipon ang mga tarpaulin, streamer, kag iban pa nga mga materyales sa kampanya nga nabilin sa sulod sang 90-adlaw nga panahon sang kampanya.
english: The Department of Environment and Natural Resources – Environment Management Bureau (EMB) organized a massive post-election cleanup drive to collect tarpaulins, streamers, and other campaign materials left behind during the 90-day campaign period.

text: Kasunod ini sang mandu ni DENR Secretary Maria Antonia Yulo-Loyzaga sa diin ginmanduan sini ang EMB nga pangunahan ang pagkolekta, pag-recycle, kag pag-repurpose sang mga campaign materials.
english: This follows the directive of DENR Secretary Maria Antonia Yulo-Loyzaga where she directed the EMB to lead the collection, recycling, and repurposing of campaign materials.

text: Gilayon nga gin-mobilize sang EMB director Jacqueline Caancan ang tanan nga regional offices sang EMB agud magpatigayon sang cleanup drive.
english: EMB director Jacqueline Caancan immediately mobilized all regional offices of EMB to conduct a cleanup drive.

text: Magalawig tubtob sa Mayo 17 ang masangkad nga pagpanglimpyo.
english: The extensive clean-up will last until May 17.

text: Kalakip sa mandu ni Caancan sa tagsa ka EMB regional office amo ang opisyal nga report sa volume sang mga campaign materials nga nakolekta kag kon sa diin ini ipadala para sa recycling kag repurposing projects.
english: Among Caancan's instructions to each EMB regional office is an official report on the volume of campaign materials collected and where they will be sent for recycling and repurposing projects.

text: Isa sa mga sistema nga pagagamiton amo ang mga lokal nga opisina sang EMB nga magbuligay sa mga lokal nga panguluhan para sa nagakaigo nga pag-recycle kag paggamit sang mga materyales sa kampanya sa mas produktibo nga mga proyekto.
english: One of the systems to be used is for local EMB offices to collaborate with local governments for proper recycling and use of campaign materials in more productive projects.

text: Dugang ni DENR Sec.
english: DENR Sec.

text: Loyzaga, pat-od nga mahimo angnapabay-an nga mga materyales sa eleksyon sa kanal, kag bisan diin, ang posible magtuga sang dugang nga polusyon kag halit sa palibot.
english: Loyzaga, it is certain that abandoned election materials in the canal, and anywhere else, can cause more pollution and damage to the environment.

text: Magluwas sa DENR, nagpanawagan man ang grupo sang EcoWaste Coalition sa mga kandidato nga balikan ang ila campaign posters nga ginsab-it kag ginbilin sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar.
english: Besides the DENR, the EcoWaste Coalition also called on the candidates to return their campaign posters that were hung and left in various places.

text: Masobra na sa 20,000 ang na-rekord nga nagkalamatay sa Syria kag Turkey kasunod sang 7.8 magnitude nga linog.
english: More than 20,000 people have been killed in Syria and Turkey following the 7.8 magnitude earthquake.

text: Suno sa Turkish authorities, lapaw sa 17,100 na ang kumpirmado nga napatay nga sakop sang Turkey samtang masobra naman 3,300 sa Syria.
english: According to Turkish authorities, more than 17,100 Turkish citizens have been confirmed dead while more than 3,300 have been killed in Syria.

text: Lapaw na ini nga numero sa 18,000 nga amo ang patay sang natabo ang mabaskog man nga linog sa Turkey sang 1999.
english: This figure is more than 18,000 who died in a similarly powerful earthquake in Turkey in 1999.

text: Ginalantaw nga magasaka pa ang numero bangud nga padayon pa ang rescue operations apisar nagaulan sang snow sa amo nga lugar.
english: The number is expected to rise as rescue operations continue despite snowfall in the area.

text: Nagapadayon man ang pag-abot sang bulig nagikan sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod.
english: Aid also continues to arrive from various countries.

text: Gintawag ni anay presidential spokesperson Harry Roque nga isa ka “lame duck” ukon inutil nga lider si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque called President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. a “lame duck” or useless leader.

text: matapos ang resulta sang 2025 midterm elections.
english: after the results of the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa partial results sang eleksyon, tatlo sa mga nakasulod sa “Magic 12” sang senatorial race ang mga kandidato nga suportado ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: According to the partial results of the election, three of those who entered the “Magic 12” of the senatorial race are candidates supported by former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Bilang sabat, ginpahayag ni Palace Press Officer Claire Castro nga kun lame duck ang presidente kag kun balewala na ang administrasyon, dapat magpauli gilayon si Roque sa pungsod.
english: In response, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said that if the president is a lame duck and if the administration is indifferent, Roque should return to the country immediately.

text: Yara sa Netherlands si Roque agud magpangayo sang political asylum bangud sa ginakabig niya nga political persecution sa Pilipinas.
english: Roque is in the Netherlands to seek political asylum due to what he considers political persecution in the Philippines.

text: Nagapati si Kabataan Partylist Representative Raoul Manuel nga tuman na ka delay ang proseso sang senado sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Kabataan Partylist Representative Raoul Manuel believes that the Senate process in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte is too delayed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Manuel, iya ginpahayag nga possible gid nga masugoran gilayon ang proseso kon gusto sang mga senador.
english: Manuel, he said it is possible to start the process immediately if the senators want.

text: Suno kay Manuel, delayed na ang timeline samtang ang iban nga mga senador ang naga-travel pa sa abroad.
english: Manuel said the timeline has been delayed while some senators are still traveling abroad.

text: Sa amo nga punto, ginkadismaya ini sang natungdan.
english: At that point, the person concerned was disappointed.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa mga senador nga responsibilidad nila nga ubrahon ang ila katungdanan santo sa Konstitusyon.
english: He also reminded the senators that it is their responsibility to perform their duties in accordance with the Constitution.

text: Madumduman nga gintalana ni Senate President Francis Escudero ang trial proper sa impeachment ni Duterte sa Hulyo 30, base sa iya ginaduso nga kalendaryo.
english: Senate President Francis Escudero has scheduled the trial proper for Duterte's impeachment on July 30, based on his proposed calendar.

text: Hayag man nga gina-abi-abi ni Escudero ang proposal ni Senate Minority Leader Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III nga magbulig sa pag-draft sang ginaduso nga pagsulundan sa impeachment proceedings batok kay VP Sara Duterte.
english: Escudero also welcomed the proposal of Senate Minority Leader Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III to help draft the proposed rules for the impeachment proceedings against VP Sara Duterte.

text: Nagamato-mato ang Filipino community sa Turkey agud mabuligan ang ginatos ka mga Pinoy nga apektado sang magkasunod nga 7.8- kag 7.5-magnitude nga linog sa amo nga pungsod kag sa Syria.
english: The Filipino community in Turkey is mobilizing to help hundreds of Filipinos affected by the 7.8- and 7.5-magnitude earthquakes in the country and Syria.

text: Suno kay Bombo Nes Herbo, international correspondent sa Turkey, ginapaagi man sang grupo ang matipon nga mga panapton, pagkaon,kag iban pa nga bulig sa Philippine embassy.
english: According to Bombo Nes Herbo, international correspondent in Turkey, the group also channels the collected clothes, food, and other aid to the Philippine embassy.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) nga 193 ka mga Pinoy ang apektado sang kalamidad sa tatlo ka Turkish provinces: 113 sa Hatay, 51 sa Adana, kag 29 sa Gaziantep.
english: Earlier, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said 193 Filipinos were affected by the disaster in three Turkish provinces: 113 in Hatay, 51 in Adana, and 29 in Gaziantep.

text: Suno kay Herbo, padayon pa subong nga gina-verify ang status sang isa ka Filipino worker sa Hatay ukon ang southernmost province sang Turkey nga reported nga natabunan sang duta.
english: Herbo said the status of a Filipino worker in Hatay, Turkey's southernmost province, is still being verified.

text: May reports man nga may missing pa gid nga duha ka mga Pinay.
english: There are also reports that two more Filipinos are missing.

text: Sa bahin sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), nagpaguwa man ini sang statement nga gina-check pa subong ang pahayag nga may nalakip nga Filipino worker sa mga napatay.
english: On the part of the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), it also issued a statement that it is still checking the statement that there is a Filipino worker among the dead.

text: Suno kay OWWA chief Arnell Ignacio, wala anay sang kumpirmasyon tubtub nga wala pa sang kumpleto nga detalye.
english: According to OWWA chief Arnell Ignacio, there is no confirmation until there are complete details.

text: Ginalauman man sang mga Pinoy sa Turkey ang madasig nga bulig halin sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) lakip na gikan sa 85-person team sang disaster response specialists kag healthcare workers nga ginpromisa nga ipadala sang gobyerno.
english: Filipinos in Turkey are also expecting immediate assistance from the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) as well as from the 85-person team of disaster response specialists and healthcare workers that the government promised to send.

text: Sa subong, tatlo ka bulan nga napaidalom sa state of emergency ang 10 ka mga probinsya sa Turkey samtang lapaw naman sa 12,000 ang tally sang mga nagkalamatay.
english: Currently, 10 provinces in Turkey have been under a state of emergency for three months while the death toll has exceeded 12,000.

text: Nagpaandam ang World Health Organization (WHO) sang posible matabo nga secondary health crisis sa Turkey kag Syria nga mahimo mas malala pa sa natabo nga linog.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) has warned of a possible secondary health crisis in Turkey and Syria that could be worse than the earthquake.

text: Suno sa organisasyon, yara subong sa wayang ang mga residente kag wala sang maayo nga access sa safe nga tubig, fuel, kuryente kag komunikasyon.
english: According to the organization, residents are now in the wayang and do not have good access to safe water, fuel, electricity and communication.

text: Magluwas pa ini nga yara subong ang pungsod sa tunga sang malain nga winter weather.
english: This is in addition to the fact that the country is currently in the midst of bad winter weather.

text: Lakip sa mga ginakahangaw-an nga balatian nga magaatake sa Syria amo ang diarrhea, cholera, respiratory illnesses, leishmaniasis, disability kag secondary wound infections.
english: Among the diseases of concern that will attack Syria are diarrhea, cholera, respiratory illnesses, leishmaniasis, disability and secondary wound infections.

text: Palalaon man sini ang chronic conditions kag non-communicable diseases bangud sa disruption sa healthcare, magluwas nga apektado na ini nga daan bangud sa tinuig nga civil war.
english: It will also exacerbate chronic conditions and non-communicable diseases due to disruption in healthcare, besides already being affected by years of civil war.

text: Mangin si WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ang nag-estimate na nga posible magsaka sa 20,000 ang death toll.
english: Even WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has estimated that the death toll could rise to 20,000.

text: Ang kinahanglan subong sang mga nakaluwas suno sa health body amo ang shelter, food, clean water kag medical care.
english: The health body said the survivors need shelter, food, clean water and medical care.

text: May yara na sang 77 ka national kag 13 ka international emergency medical teams nga gin-deploy sa apektado nga mga lugar.
english: There are already 77 national and 13 international emergency medical teams deployed in the affected areas.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang otoridad nga as of press time, lapaw na sa 12,000 ang death toll.##
english: Authorities also confirmed that as of press time, the death toll has exceeded 12,000.##

text: Hugot sa gihapon nga ginapatuman sang Brgy.
english: Brgy. is still strictly enforcing.

text: East Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City ang ila ordinansa nahanungod sa No parking sa mga dalanon sa ila lugar.
english: East Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City their ordinance regarding No parking on the roads in their area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay John Garry Patnubay sang nasambit nga barangay, iya ginpahayag nga may ara man sila sang ginapatigayon nga road clearing operations agud malikawan ang pag-park sang mga salakyan ilabi na sa mga mayor nga mga karsada sa ila barangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay John Garry Patnubay of the said barangay said they are also conducting road clearing operations to avoid parking vehicles especially on the main roads in their barangay.

text: Suno kay Patnubay, luyag man nila nga magpangayo sang bulig sa Iloilo City Government kun may ara gid sang mga masabad nga mga nagapanag-iya sang salakyan.
english: Patnubay said they also want to seek help from the Iloilo City Government if there are any vehicle owners who are in trouble.

text:
Ginpakigbahin man sang Punong Barangay nga may ara sang penalidad ang magalapas sa ila ordinansa:

1st Offense: 500 pesos2nd Offense: 700 pesos3rd Offense: 1, 000 pesos

Suno pa sa iya, ini nga ordinansa ang may dako nga bulig sa ila barangay in kaso nga may ara sang magluntad nga mga insidente kaangay sunog agud indi mabudlayan ang mga bombero.
english:
The Punong Barangay also shared that there are penalties for violating their ordinance:

1st Offense: 500 pesos2nd Offense: 700 pesos3rd Offense: 1, 000 pesos

He said that this ordinance will be of great help to their barangay in case of incidents such as fire so that the firefighters will not have difficulties.

text: Dugang pa sang Punong Barangay nga mas maayo nga may ara gid sang parking area ang mga private car owners agud nga indi mag-obstruct ang ila nga mga salakyan sa mga dalanon.
english: The Punong Barangay added that it is better for private car owners to have a parking area so that their vehicles do not obstruct the roads.

text: Gina-trace na sang gobyerno ang duha sa mga ginpangalanan nga co-perpetrators ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The government is already tracing two of the named co-perpetrators of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Base sa dokumento sang international tribunal, ang mga co-perpetrators ni Duterte amo sanday Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, Senator Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go, Vitaliano Aguirre II, Vicente Danao, Oscar Albayalde, Dante Gierran, Isidro Lapeña, kag ang napatay na nga si Camilo Cascolan.
english: Based on international tribunal documents, Duterte’s co-perpetrators were Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, Senator Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go, Vitaliano Aguirre II, Vicente Danao, Oscar Albayalde, Dante Gierran, Isidro Lapeña, and the late Camilo Cascolan.

text: Suno kay DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla, bisan wala pa sang arrest warrants, gina-trace na nila ang nasambit nga mga personalidad.
english: According to DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla, although there are no arrest warrants, they are already tracing the said personalities.

text: Pahayag ni Remulla, duha sa co-perpetrators ni Duterte ang ginapatihan nga yara na sa Estados Unidos.
english: Remulla said two of Duterte's co-perpetrators are believed to be in the United States.

text: MAGABATON sing dalagku nga mga premyo ang aton mga atleta nga nagpasakop sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics, nga nagtakop na sadtong Domingo, Agosto 8.
english: OUR athletes who participated in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, which ended on Sunday, August 8, will receive great prizes.

text: Una na dira ang apat (4) nga nagdaug sang gold, silver kag bronze nga mga medal.
english: First of all, four (4) winners of gold, silver and bronze medals.

text: Napulo’g siyam (19) ining aton Olympians nga nagpasakop sa Athletics, Boxing, Golf, Gymnastics, Judo, Rowing, Shooting, Skateboarding, Swimming, Taekwondo, kag weightlifting.
english: Nineteen (19) of our Olympians participated in Athletics, Boxing, Golf, Gymnastics, Judo, Rowing, Shooting, Skateboarding, Swimming, Taekwondo, and weightlifting.

text: Sunu sa RA 10699 (Section 8), ang gold medallist magabaton sin P10 milyon, P5M sa silver medallist, kag P2M sa bronze medallist.
english: According to RA 10699 (Section 8), the gold medalist will receive P10 million, the silver medalist P5M, and the bronze medalist P2M.

text: Ang gobyerno – nasyonal kag LGU – nagpasalig man sang dugang nga mga premyo sa ila.
english: The government – ​​national and LGU – also promised more rewards to them.

text: Nagdugang man diri ang mga private donors.
english: Private donors have also added to this.

text: Ang estimate sang bug-os nga mabaton nga cash ni Hidilyn Diaz, sa pagdaug sing nahauna nga gold sang pungsod sa 55k Women’s weightlifting, magalab-ut sa P50M.
english: The estimate of Hidilyn Diaz's full cash receipt, for winning the country's first gold in the 55k Women's weightlifting, will be around P50M.

text: May house-and-lot kag salakyan pa.
english: There is a house-and-lot and a car.

text: Ang iya ni Nesthy Petecio (Women’s featherweight) kag Carlo Paalam (Men’s flyweight), sa ila pagdaug sing silver medal sa boksing, magalab-ut sa sobra P30M nga cash kada isa sa ila.
english: Nesthy Petecio (Women's featherweight) and Carlo Paalam (Men's flyweight), for their silver medal win in boxing, will reach more than P30M cash each.

text: May dugang pa nga premyo nga house-and-lot kag iban pa halin sa private donors.
english: There will be additional house-and-lot prizes and others from private donors.

text: Ang batunon naman ni Eumir Marcial (Men’s middleweight) sa iya bronze medal magalab-ut sing sobra P10M nga may dugang pa nga iban nga insentibo halin sa gobyerno – nasyonal kag LGU – kag mga private donors.
english: Eumir Marcial (Men's middleweight) will receive more than P10 million for his bronze medal with additional incentives from the government – ​​national and LGU – and private donors.

text: Ang mga wala nagdaug (15 sila tanan) magabaton sing P500,000 kada isa halin sa gobyerno nasyonal kag sing dugang nga mahatag pa sing ila mga probinsya kag siyudad.
english: The winners (15 in all) will receive P500,000 each from the national government and more will be given by their provinces and cities.

text: Si Irish Magno sang Iloilo, nga nalugaw-an maka-bronze, magabaton man sing dugang nga P200,000 halin sa probinsya kag amo man nga kantidad halin sa siyudad.
english: Irish Magno of Iloilo, who missed out on bronze, will also receive an additional P200,000 from the province and the same amount from the city.

text: In fact, mas daku nga mga premyo ang mahatag sang Filipinas sangsa iya sang United States: $37,000 (P1,850,000/P50 per USD) sa gold medal; $22,500 (P1,125,000) sa silver; kag $15,000 (P750,000) sa bronze.
english: In fact, the Philippines will offer larger prizes than the United States: $37,000 (P1,850,000/P50 per USD) for the gold medal; $22,500 (P1,125,000) in silver; and $15,000 (P750,000) in bronze.

text: Pero nga wala, ugaling, sing premyo ang mga training staff sang sining mga atleta haw?
english: But that the training staff of these athletes did not, however, receive a prize?

text: Wala man ini sila seguro nagdaug kon wala ining mga training staff, indi bala?
english: They probably wouldn't have won without these training staff, right?

text:
***

Si Hidilyn Diaz nagpasalig sang daku nga bulig halin sa iya premyo para sa sports development sa iya sports category kag sa sports sa Filipinas, sa kabug-usan.
english:
***

Hidilyn Diaz assured a big boost from her prize for sports development in her sports category and sports in the Philippines, as a whole.

text: Partikular sa training sang mga atleta, kon diin nagreklamo gid siya sang kakulangan sini sa ila para sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: Particularly in the training of athletes, where he complained about the lack of it in them for the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Tani makahatag man sing amot ang iban nga mga atleta nga nakabaton premyo, labi na gid ang nagbaton gold, silver kag bronze medal.
english: I hope other athletes who received prizes, especially those who received gold, silver and bronze medals, can also contribute.

text: Sa Singapore, nga dalagku man ang ginahatag nga mga premyo sa ila international athletes, gina-require ang mga medal winners sa pag-share sang at least 20% sang ila dinag-an para sa ila sports development.
english: In Singapore, which also gives large prizes to its international athletes, medal winners are required to share at least 20% of their winnings for their sports development.

text:
***

By the way, nakibut kita sa balita nga si Hidilyn Diaz, nga isa ka sarhento sa Philippine Air Force, naakusahan nga kabahin sang Oust-Duterte plot, ukon pagpatalsik sa Presidente, sadtong naga-training pa siya para sa Tokyo Olympics.
english:
***

By the way, we are shocked by the news that Hidilyn Diaz, a sergeant in the Philippine Air Force, was accused of being part of the Oust-Duterte plot, or overthrow of the President, while she was training for the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Kag ina tungod gid lang kay nagreklamo siya sa kakulangan nga suporta nga ginahatag sang gobyerno sa ila pagpasakop sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: And that's because he complained about the lack of support the government is giving them to participate in the Tokyo Olympics.

text: In fact, nalista gani siya sa “matrix” sang mga personalidad nga kuno naga-plot agud patalsikon si President Duterte.
english: In fact, he is even listed in the “matrix” of personalities who are allegedly plotting to overthrow President Duterte.

text: Pinahog pa siya nga ipa-court martial.
english: He was even threatened with court martial.

text: Pati gani ang amay ni Hidilyn Diaz ginsuspetsahan man tungod nakitaan ini sang kamiseta sang Magdalo group.
english: Even Hidilyn Diaz's father was suspected because he was found wearing a Magdalo group shirt.

text: Ining Magdalo Group, nga nagapakila nga mga “Bagong Katipuneros”, ginapasakupan sang mga myembro sang Armed Forces of the Philippines.
english: This Magdalo Group, which identifies itself as the “Bagong Katipuneros”, is made up of members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines.

text: Nagatindug ini sila sa kawsa sang pag-reforma sang gobyerno batok sa corruption, kag ang pag-promote sang good governance kag social justice sa pungsod.
english: They stand for the cause of government reform against corruption, and the promotion of good governance and social justice in the country.

text: Pasista nga pamensaron ini ya nga akusasyon kay Hidilyn Diaz nga nagakatabo sadto sa panahon sang martial law ni Diktador Marcos, kon diin sa diutay mo lang nga pagreklamo target ka na sang military surveillance.
english: It is fascist to think that this accusation against Hidilyn Diaz was happening during the martial law of Dictator Marcos, where the slightest complaint was the target of military surveillance.

text: Salamat kay wala pagsapaka ining akusasyon batok kay Sgt.
english: Thankfully, this accusation against Sgt.

text: Hidilyn Diaz sang PAF.
english: Hidilyn Diaz of the PAF.

text: Gin-promote pa gani ini pasaka sa Staff Sergeant (SSgt) tungod sa daku nga kadungganan nga gindala sini sa PAF kag sa pungsod sa iya pagdaug sing gold.
english: He was even promoted to Staff Sergeant (SSgt) for the immense honor he brought to the PAF and the country with his gold win.

text: Well, nag-apologize ang Malakanyang parti sa sining wala pulos nga akusasyon sang kon sin-o nga Herodes dira sa Palasyo batok kay karon SSgt.
english: Well, Malacañang has apologized for this baseless accusation of some Herod here in the Palace against now SSgt.

text: Hidilyn Diaz nga palangga sang PAF.
english: Hidilyn Diaz who is loved by the PAF.

text: Mga hangag nga nalatnan sing pagka-ulianon ining mga Herodes nga mga ini!
english: These Herods are fools infected with greed!

text: Pensar nila martial law gihapon./PN
english: They still think martial law./PN

text: Siyam na araw bago ang inaabangang tapatan sa pagitan nina Manny Pacquiao at Mario Barrios para sa WBC Welterweight title sa Las Vegas, puspusan ang paghahanda ng kampo ng “Pambansang Kamao”.
english: Nine days before the long-awaited fight between Manny Pacquiao and Mario Barrios for the WBC Welterweight title in Las Vegas, the “Pambansang Kamao” camp is in full swing.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Coach Marvin Somodia, assistant trainer ni Pacquiao sa California, ibinahagi nito ang kasalukuyang kondisyon ni Pacquiao habang papalapit ang laban.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Coach Marvin Somodia, Pacquiao's assistant trainer in California, shared Pacquiao's current condition as the fight approaches.

text: Kabilang sa kanyang tungkulin bilang assistant trainer ang pagtutok sa daily performance ni Pacquiao, mula sa stretching, sparring, hanggang sa conditioning drills — upang masiguro kung kailan dapat taasan o bawasan ang intensity ng training.
english: His duties as an assistant trainer include focusing on Pacquiao's daily performance, from stretching, sparring, to conditioning drills — to determine when to increase or decrease the intensity of training.

text: Bagamat 46 anyos na si Pacquiao, ayon sa panayam, nananatiling maayos ang kanyang training routine at patuloy ang tamang nutrisyon, at napanatili rin ang mental at physical preparation.
english: Although Pacquiao is 46 years old, according to reports, he maintains a good training routine and proper nutrition, and also maintains mental and physical preparation.

text: May kaunting adjustments, ngunit buo pa rin ang focus sa bawat aspeto ng preparasyon.
english: There are some adjustments, but the focus is still on every aspect of the preparation.

text: Aminado ang kampo na malaking hamon ang age gap — si Barrios ay 30 anyos, subalit batid nila na ang karanasan ni Pacquiao ay maaaring maging susi sa panalo.
english: The camp admits that the age gap is a big challenge — Barrios is 30 years old, but they know that Pacquiao's experience could be the key to victory.

text: Nakita na rin sa mga nagdaang laban na kaya nitong makipagpuksaan sa mas matatangkad na kalaban tulad nina Oscar De la Hoya at Jessie Vargas.
english: It has also been seen in previous fights that he can defeat stronger opponents like Oscar De la Hoya and Jessie Vargas.

text: Habang papalapit ang July 20, patuloy ang focus ng kampo ni Pacquiao sa paghahanda para sa isang laban na muling susubok sa kanyang legacy sa mundo ng boxing.
english: As July 20 approaches, Pacquiao's camp continues to focus on preparing for a fight that will once again test his legacy in the world of boxing.

text: Isa sa pinaka-ginahadlukan sang tawo nga sapat amo ang buaya.
english: One of the most feared animals by man is the crocodile.

text: Tuman ka makatululublag ang mga balita kaangot sa mga lawas nga ginapangtulon sini nga sapat kag kun ikaw makakita sini, pat-od nga mapaspas ka gid sang dalagan.
english: The news about the bodies that this animal swallows is very disturbing and if you see it, you will surely run faster.

text: Apang paano kun pagbugtaw mo, makit-an mo nga naga-‘chill chill’ ang buaya sa imo balay?
english: But what if you wake up and find a crocodile chilling in your house?

text: Amo sini subong ang sitwasyon sa syudad sang Vadodara sa state sang Gujarat sa India.
english: This is the situation today in the city of Vadodara in the state of Gujarat in India.

text: Natabo ini matapos nga naglapaw ang tubig sa suba kasunod sang sunod-sunod nga inadlaw nga mabaskog ang ulan sang nagligad nga semana.
english: This happened after the river overflowed following consecutive days of heavy rains last week.

text: Ang Vishwamitri River nga nagalaba sang 17-kilometros amo ang puluy-an sang ginatos ka freshwater crocodiles.
english: The 17-kilometer-long Vishwamitri River is home to hundreds of freshwater crocodiles.

text: Ang mga tawo nga nagapuyo sa baba sang suba ang naanad na nga may mga buaya gid man nga nagapalapit malapit sa dalan sa tion sang monsoon season, apang lain pa gid ang sitwasyon subong nga tuig bangud magluwas nga nagdamo sila, mas nagpalapit pa gid ang mga ini sa residential areas.
english: People living at the mouth of the river are used to having crocodiles coming near the road during the monsoon season, but the situation is different this year because besides increasing in number, they have come closer to residential areas.

text: Sang Agusto 27-29, masobra 20 sa ila ang gindakop sang otoridad samtang yara sa mga kabalayan.
english: On August 27-29, more than 20 of them were arrested by the authorities while in the houses.

text: Ang pinakagamay ang nagalaba sang duha ka tapak samtang ang pinakadaku naman ang nagalaba sang 14 ka tapak suno sa Vadodara Range Forest Office.
english: The smallest is two feet long while the largest is 14 feet long, according to the Vadodara Range Forest Office.

text: Halin sang nagligad nga semana, wala sang halos makatulog sang maayo bangud sang mga buaya nga nagakamang sa dalan, nagasaka sa mga atop sang balay, nagalangoy sa mga kanal malapit sa mga balay samtang may ginapang-it nga sapat kaangay sang ido, kuring… kag bisan baka!
english: Since last week, no one has been able to sleep well because of the crocodiles crawling on the road, climbing on the roofs of the houses, swimming in the canals near the houses while there are animals like dogs, cats... and even cows!

text: Tubtub subong, ginapaaligmat ang mga tawo sa pamahog nga dala sini nga mga sapat samtang padayon naman ang otoridad sa pagsipot sa ila.#
english: Until now, people are being warned of the threat posed by these animals while the authorities continue to hunt them.

text: Ginmanduan ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 nga patambungon gid sa pagsinapol si Iloilo City District Engineering Office Head Engineer Roy Pacanan.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ordered the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 to invite Iloilo City District Engineering Office Head Engineer Roy Pacanan to attend the meeting.

text: Ini kaangot man sa mga wala natapos nga proyekto sang nasambit nga talatapan.
english: This is also in connection with the unfinished projects of the said office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nakig-istorya na siya kaupod si DPWH Regional Director Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said he has already spoken with DPWH Regional Director Engr.

text: Sanny Boy Oropel kon sa diin, nag-issue na ini sa memorandum nga kinahanglan magtambong si Pacanan.
english: Sanny Boy Oropel where, it has already issued a memorandum that Pacanan must attend.

text: Suno kay Treñas, tinutuyo sang meeting amo ang mahibaluan kon may pondo pa agud nga mapadayon ang mga wala natapos nga proyekto.
english: According to Treñas, the purpose of the meeting is to find out if there is still funds to continue the unfinished projects.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kon wala na gid man sang pondo, mahimo nga makig-angot ang syudad sa mga engineers, architect, kag city council.
english: He also explained that if funding is ever gone, the city can contact engineers, architects, and the city council.

text: Patigayunon ang meeting sa Byernes, Marso 7, 2025.
english: The meeting will be held on Friday, March 7, 2025.

text: Handa naman ang alkalde nga magpamati sang bahin ni Pacanan apisar pa nga naka-persona non grata ini sa syudad.
english: The mayor is ready to listen to Pacanan's side even though he is persona non grata in the city.

text: Nahibaluan nga may mga multipurpose building sa pila ka mga kabarangayan sa syudad nga tubtob subong, wala natapos ka human.
english: It is known that there are multipurpose buildings in some barangays in the city that until now, have not been completed.

text: Gintawag sang China nga “overreaction” ang ginhimo sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga pag-shoot down sang isa ka gina-alegar Chinese spy balloon nga nakit-an nga nagalupad sa teritoryo nga sakop sang North America.
english: China has called the United States' shooting down of an alleged Chinese spy balloon that was spotted flying over North American territory an “overreaction”.

text:
Suno sa Beijing, ginlapas sang Estados Unidos ang “international practice” bangud naggamit gid ini sang pwersa agud nga atakehon ang balloon nga gintawag sang Beijing nga “unmanned civilian airship.”

Antes ang lihok sang Pentagon, pila ka adlaw man nga nagalupad-lupad sa North America ang amo nga balloon rason nga ginpang-untat ang operasyon sang tatlo ka airports bangud ginkabig ini nga isyu sa national security.
english:
Beijing said the United States violated “international practice” by using force to attack the balloon, which Beijing called an “unmanned civilian airship.”

Before the Pentagon's move, the balloon had been flying in North America for several days, causing the suspension of operations at three airports as it was considered a national security issue.

text: Ginkanselar man ang byahe ni Secretary of State Antony Blinken sa Beijing.
english: Secretary of State Antony Blinken’s trip to Beijing was also cancelled.

text: Gin-igu ini sang Pentagon paagi sa missile shot halin sa F-22 jet — operasyon nga ginlaragway ni US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin nga isa ka “deliberate and lawful action”.
english: The Pentagon hit it with a missile shot from an F-22 jet — an operation US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin described as a “deliberate and lawful action”.

text: Una na nga gin-ako sang China nga ila matuod ang amo nga “airship”, apang indi ini espiya suno sa Beijing kundi isa lamang ka weather balloon nga para sa civilian meteorological kag iban pa nga scientific purposes, apang bangud ginlupad sang hangin kag bangud limitado lang ang control capability, nakalab-ot ini sa teritoryo sang Amerika.
english: China had previously admitted that the airship was theirs, but Beijing said it was not a spy but a weather balloon for civilian meteorological and other scientific purposes, but because it was flown by the wind and because of limited control capability, it reached US territory.

text: Iloilo City – Isa naman ka pasidungog para sa Iloilo City ang nabaton nga award nagikan sa World Resources Ross Center Prize for Cities.
english: Iloilo City – Another honor for Iloilo City was the award received from the World Resources Ross Center Prize for Cities.

text: Ini nga award giving body ang nagakilala sa mga syudad nga may maayo nga inisyatibo para sa housing kag urban development.
english: This award giving body recognizes cities that have good initiatives for housing and urban development.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Sonia Cadornigara, Regional Coordinator of the Homeless People’s Federation of PH, Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Sonia Cadornigara, Regional Coordinator of the Homeless People’s Federation of PH, Inc.

text: for Iloilo City, iya ginpakigbahin ang mga hinimuan sang syudad agud mahatagan sang relocation site ang mga informal settlers.
english: for Iloilo City, he shared the city's efforts to provide relocation sites to informal settlers.

text: Dugang pa ni Cadornigara, nangin madinalag-on ang syudad bangud sa partisipasyon sang Iloilo City Local Government Unit kag iban nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno agud mahatagan sang igtalupangod ang mga flood control projects para sa benepisyo sang urban poor.
english: Cadornigara added that the city was successful because of the participation of the Iloilo City Local Government Unit and other government agencies to give attention to flood control projects for the benefit of the urban poor.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Iloilo City lamang ang awardee sa bilog nga Southeast Asia.
english: Iloilo City is the only awardee in Southeast Asia.

text: Ang iban nga awardee amo ang Paris sa France, Odisha sa India, Peshawar sa Pakistan kag Baranquillo sa Colombia.
english: Other awardees are Paris in France, Odisha in India, Peshawar in Pakistan and Baranquillo in Colombia.

text: ILOILO – Napasakaan na sang kaso ang 26 ka mga indibidwal matapos nga nadakpan nga iligal nga nagapauwak sa Barangay Pandac, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – Twenty-six individuals have been charged after they were caught illegally harvesting crows in Barangay Pandac, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga kaso nga paglapas sa Presidential Decree 1602 ukon Anti-Illegal Gambling Law ang ginpasaka sa mga arestado.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said a case of violation of Presidential Decree 1602 or Anti-Illegal Gambling Law was filed against the arrested.

text: Suno kay Manguera, sa nasambit nga mga arestado, may duha ka mga nakapyansa sa P24,000 kada isa.
english: According to Manguera, among the arrested, two were released on bail of P24,000 each.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin nga preso ang 24 ka iban pa.
english: Currently, 24 others remain in custody.

text: Gin-athag man ni Manguera nga indi na nila matumod kun sa diin na ang iban nga mga nagpa-uwak nga nakapalagyo sang nagpatuman sila sang operasyon.
english: Manguera also explained that they cannot determine the whereabouts of the other crows who escaped when they conducted the operation.

text: Kuntento si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is satisfied.

text: sa resulta sang 2025 midterm elections apisar nga anum lang sang mga kandidato sa iya administrasyon ang nagdaog sa pagka-senador.
english: in the results of the 2025 midterm elections despite only six of the candidates in his administration winning the senatorial seat.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, tama ka kuntento ang Presidente bangud nakita niya nga ang iban nga mga nagdaog ang may kaugalingon nga dignidad kag prinsipyo, kag kadam-an sa ila ang nagaserbisyo para gid sa pungsod.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the President was very satisfied because he saw that some of the winners had their own dignity and principles, and most of them were serving the country.

text: Base sa partial unofficial results sang 2025 midterm elections, upod sa top 12 nga nagdaog sa Senado amo sanday Erwin Tulfo, Ping Lacson, Tito Sotto, Pia Cayetano, Camille Villar, kag Lito Lapid.
english: Based on the partial unofficial results of the 2025 midterm elections, among the top 12 Senate winners are Erwin Tulfo, Ping Lacson, Tito Sotto, Pia Cayetano, Camille Villar, and Lito Lapid.

text: Apang ginpahibalo sang Malacañang nga indi sila magpasugot sa mga “obstructionist” nga mga lawmakers nga ang ginatuyo amo lang ang kaugalingon nga interest.
english: But Malacañang has announced that it will not tolerate obstructionist lawmakers whose only interests are their own.

text: Ginalauman man sang administrasyon ang presensya sang lehitimo nga oppositionists, apang batuan ang mga obstructionists nga nagatago sa ngalan sang oposisyon kun sa diin posible nga kaugaligon lamang nila ang ila nga ipakigbato.
english: The administration also expects the presence of legitimate oppositionists, but will resist obstructionists who hide in the name of the opposition where they may only fight for themselves.

text: Ginklaro man ni Castro nga lain ang “obstructionist” sa mga lehitimo nga oposisyonista.
english: Castro also clarified that “obstructionists” are different from legitimate oppositionists.

text: Gin-athag man niya nga ang lehitimo nga oposisyon ang nagaduso man sa interes sang pungsod samtang ang obstructionist ang nagapangguba lang kag wala sang positibo nga ginahambal ukon ginasuportahan.
english: He also explained that the legitimate opposition is also pushing the interests of the country while the obstructionist is only destroying and does not say or support anything positive.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Malacañang nga ginahingyo sang administrasyon ang tanan nga bag-o nga napilian nga opisyal nga bisan ano pa man ang ila Partido, kinahanglan nga nga magbuligay para sa kaayuhan sang pungsod.
english: Malacañang also said the administration urges all newly elected officials regardless of their party affiliation to work together for the good of the country.

text: Dugang pa ni Castro, ini ang desisyon sang mga pumuluyo, kag dapat lang respetuhon kun sa diin ang tanan nga proyekto ukon programa nga may kaayuhan para sa pungsod, dapat suportahan.
english: Castro added that this is the decision of the people, and should be respected where all projects or programs that are good for the country, should be supported.

text: Nagsaka na sa 48 ang patay kag masobra 150 ang pilason sa suicide bombing sa mosque nga nahamtang sa isa ka police compound sa Peshawar sa Pakistan.
english: At least 48 people have been killed and more than 150 injured in a suicide bombing at a mosque in a police compound in Peshawar, Pakistan.

text: Sa inisyal nga report, mga pulis kag security officials ang kalabanan nga nagkalamatay.
english: According to initial reports, most of the dead were policemen and security officials.

text: Indi pa subong maathag kun paano napalusot sang Taliban nga suspek ang iya dala nga bomba sa amo nga compound kun sa diin yara man mismo ang police headquarters kag ginakabig high-security zone.
english: It is not yet clear how the Taliban suspect managed to sneak his bomb into the compound where the police headquarters is located and is considered a high-security zone.

text: Natabo ang pagsigabong sa sulod sang mosque kun sa diin nagapangamuyo ang ginapahayag masobra 300 ka worshippers lakip na ang personnel sang police kag army and bomb disposal squad.
english: The blast occurred inside the mosque where more than 300 worshipers, including police personnel and the army and bomb disposal squad, were praying.

text: Ginpahayag nga yara ang bomber sa una nga row sang ginpalupok sini ang bomba.
english: The bomber was reportedly in the front row when he detonated the bomb.

text: Nag-collapse ang atop gani nadugayan pa ang rescuers nga makuha ang mga debris nga nagtabon sa iban nga mga biktima.
english: The roof collapsed and it took a while for rescuers to remove the debris that covered the other victims.

text: Sunod nga gin-ako sang Pakistani Taliban nga ila grupo ang responsable sa amo nga krimen.
english: The Pakistani Taliban subsequently claimed responsibility for the crime.

text: Suno sa duha ka opisyal sang Pakistani Taliban ukon mas kilala nga Tehreek-e-Taliban, gintimalos sang ila grupo ang pagpatay sa militant commander nga si Khalid Khorasani sang nagligad nga tuig sa Afghanistan.
english: According to two officials of the Pakistani Taliban or better known as Tehreek-e-Taliban, the group avenged the killing of militant commander Khalid Khorasani last year in Afghanistan.

text: Ang grupo nga Tehreek-e-Taliban isa ka United States-designated foreign terrorist organization nga naga-operate sa Afghanistan kag Pakistan.
english: The Tehreek-e-Taliban group is a United States-designated foreign terrorist organization operating in Afghanistan and Pakistan.

text: Separado ini sa Afghan Taliban apang ginapahayag nga suod nga magkaalyado.
english: It is separate from the Afghan Taliban but is said to be closely allied.

text: Gindayaw sang pila ka coach sang Team Iloilo ang pasilidad sang Antique bangud sa katinlo kag katawhay sa pagdumala sang Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025.
english: Some coaches of Team Iloilo praised the facility of Antique for its cleanliness and order in the conduct of the Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Coach Japeth Buenalatrona, sang Football Secondary Boys -Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga daw sila lang natak-an nga magkaon sa tagsa ka serbe sang mga kalan-on.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Coach Japeth Buenalatrona, of the Football Secondary Boys -Iloilo, said that they are the only ones who are tired of eating every serving of food.

text: Suno kay Buenalatrona, may mga venues lang nga medyo malayo para sa mga atleta apang provided man ang transportasyon.
english: According to Buenalatrona, there are venues that are a bit far for the athletes but transportation is also provided.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginakalipay niya nga wala sang traffic sa lugar kon sa diin, madasig sila makaabot sa playing venue.
english: However, he is happy that there is no traffic in the area where, they can quickly reach the playing venue.

text: Kaangot diri, nakuha sang Iloilo ang duha ka gold medal sa Track and field sa nagapadayon nga Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025.
english: Meanwhile, Iloilo won two gold medals in Track and Field in the ongoing Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2025.

text: Ang una nga medal ang nakuha ni Welmer Jeck Labrador sa 5,000 meter run sa Secondary boys.
english: The first medal was won by Welmer Jeck Labrador in the 5,000 meter run in the Secondary boys.

text: Si Labrador ang tumandok sang Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: Labrador is a native of Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Samtang ang ikaduha naman nga gold medal ang nakuha ni Robbie Aguilar sang Dingle, Iloilo nga may record 6.74 m sa Long Jump sa Secondary boys.
english: Meanwhile, the second gold medal went to Robbie Aguilar of Dingle, Iloilo with a record of 6.74 m in the Long Jump in the Secondary boys.

text: Si Aguilar ang tumandok sang Dingle, Iloilo
english: Aguilar is a native of Dingle, Iloilo

text: Wala ginaduso ni President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr. does not propose.

text: ang impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte sa Senado.
english: the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte in the Senate.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, wala sang ano man nga balita natuhoy sa pag-pursue sang Presidente sa impeachment ukon sa impeachment trial ni VP Sara.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, there is no news regarding the President's pursuit of impeachment or the impeachment trial of VP Sara.

text: Suno sa iya, wala man sang ano man nga statement ang presidente angot sa pagkumpiyansa para mapahalin sa puwesto ang Bise Presidente.
english: He said the president did not make any statement regarding the confidence to remove the Vice President.

text: Sanday Marcos kag Duterte ang runningmates sang 2022 apang naglas-ay ang ila relasyon.
english: Marcos and Duterte were runningmates in 2022 but their relationship soured.

text: Gin-impeach si Duterte sang House of Representatives sang Pebrero kun sa diin masobra sa 200 ka mamalidha ang nag-endorso sang complaint batok sa iya.
english: Duterte was impeached by the House of Representatives in February where more than 200 lawmakers endorsed a complaint against him.

text: Siya ang gin-akusaran sang betrayal of public trust, culpable violation of the Constitution, graft and corruption, kag iban nga high crimes.
english: He was charged with betrayal of public trust, culpable violation of the Constitution, graft and corruption, and other high crimes.

text: Una na nagpagwa si Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero sang inisyal nga timetable para sa proseso sang impeachment trial of Duterte, kun sa diin gintalana ini sa Hulyo 30.
english: Earlier, Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero released the initial timetable for the impeachment trial of Duterte, which is scheduled for July 30.

text: May record nga 128 ka mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) ang Public Employment Services Office (PESO) Province of Iloilo, nga mga apektado sang nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa Middle East.
english: The Public Employment Services Office (PESO) Province of Iloilo has a record of 128 Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs), who are affected by the ongoing unrest in the Middle East.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cynthia Dario, head sang PESO-Iloilo Province, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga mga OFWs amo ang yara sa United Arab Emirates (UAE), Qatar, Dubai, kag Kuwait.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Cynthia Dario, head of PESO-Iloilo Province, said the OFWs are in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Qatar, Dubai, and Kuwait.

text: Suno kay Dario, halin sa mga banwa sang Pototan, Calinog, San Enrique, kag Guimbal ang yara sa ‘Unsafe Status’ bangud sa mga nabatian sang mga ini nga linupok malapit sa ila lugar.
english: According to Dario, from the towns of Pototan, Calinog, San Enrique, and Guimbal are in 'Unsafe Status' because they heard gunshots near their area.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagmando naman si Gov.
english: It is known that Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: nga indi na maghulat sa datos sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) kag Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) kag direkta nalang nga magpakig-angut sa mga pamilya sang OFWs sa probinsya pinaagi sa mga Municipal kag Barangay PESO subong man ang pag-activate sang emergency hotlines.
english: not to wait for the data of the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) and Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and to directly contact the families of OFWs in the province through the Municipal and Barangay PESOs as well as the activation of emergency hotlines.

text: Ginalauman nga magasaka pa ang numero sang mga OFWs nga magapakig-angot sa opisina bangud padayon pa ang pagbaslanay sang mga pungsod sa Middle East.
english: The number of OFWs who will contact the office is expected to increase as the countries in the Middle East continue to trade.

text: Tuman ang kasubo sang asawa sang isa ka Holocaust survivor nga nadulaan sang kabuhi matapos ang terror attack sa Bondi Beach, Australia kahapon nga adlaw.
english: The wife of a Holocaust survivor who lost his life after a terror attack in Bondi Beach, Australia yesterday is deeply saddened.
