text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Demark Suede, Bombo Correspondent sa Australia iya ginpakigbahin nga isa sa napatay amo si Alexander Kleytman nga isa ka Holocaust survivor, kag nagpadulong sa Australia bilang mga imigrante halin sa Ukraine agud magsugod sang panibag-o nga kabuhi kaupod ang iya pamilya, apang sa isa lamang ka pisok nangin masakit nga trahedya ang sa karun pilit nga ginabaton sang iya pamilya, ilabi sa sang iya asawa nga nasaksian ang iya kamatayon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Demark Suede, Bombo Correspondent in Australia, said that one of the dead was Alexander Kleytman, a Holocaust survivor, who came to Australia as immigrants from Ukraine to start a new life with his family. wife who witnessed his death.

text: Sa panaysayon sang asawa ni Kleytman, nagatindog lamang ang mga ini sang may nabatian sila nga gunshot kadungan sang pagkatumba sang pila ka mga indibidwal.Didto kag nagpalapit si Kleytman sa iya asawa agud protektahan ini kag sa malain nga palad ang naigo sang pagpaniro sang duha ka suspek.
english: According to Kleytman's wife, they were standing when they heard gunshots while several individuals fell. Kleytman approached his wife to protect her and unfortunately was hit by the gunfire of the two suspects.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad sa insidente nga nagbilin sang tuman nga kasubo indi lamang sa Jewish community kundi sa bug-os nga pungsod sang Australia.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident, which left a mark on not only the Jewish community but the entire Australian nation.

text: Natalana nga suguran sang House panel ang deliberasyon sa apat ka beripikado nga impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte sa Marso 2.
english: The House panel is scheduled to begin deliberations on the four verified impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte on March 2.

text: Suno kay House Committee on Justice Chairperson kag Batangas 2nd District Rep.
english: According to House Committee on Justice Chairperson and Batangas 2nd District Rep.

text: Gerville Luistro,diri tumuron kun “sufficient in form and substance” ang mga reklamo batok kay VP Duterte.
english: Gerville Luistro, it will not be decided whether the complaints against VP Duterte are “sufficient in form and substance”.

text: Kun matumod nga wala sang basehan kag wala sang pulos ang mga reklamo, ipa-dismiss ini paagi sa botohay sa plenaryo.
english: If the complaints are found to be unfounded and frivolous, they shall be dismissed by a vote of the plenary.

text: Kun mapamatud-ad naman nga ‘sufficient in form and substance’, pagaabisuhan si VP Duterte nga sabton ang mga alegasyon sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw.
english: If proven to be 'sufficient in form and substance', VP Duterte will be notified to respond to the allegations within 10 days.

text: Sa tion naman nga may mapamatud-an nga “probable cause”, ini ang pagabotohan sa plenaryo.
english: In case of proven probable cause, it will be voted on in plenary.

text: Kun makakuha ini sang 1/3 votes, i-transmit ini sa Senate Impeachment Court.
english: If it gets 1/3 of the votes, it will be transmitted to the Senate Impeachment Court.

text: Kun magkinot ikaw sa pagkaon kag maggasto ka lang sang tubtob sa 70 pesos kada adlaw, ano ayhan ang sarang kadtuan sang imo gintipon nga kwarta?
english: If you save on food and spend only up to 70 pesos a day, what can your savings go to?

text: Masarangan mo ayhan magbakal sang balay?
english: Can you afford to buy a house?

text: May yara sang isa ka babaye nga 70 pesos lang ang iya gasto sa pagkaon adlaw-adlaw kag nakabakal sang balay.
english: There was a woman who spent only 70 pesos on food every day and bought a house.

text: Ini amo si Saki Tamogami, isa ka 37-anyos nga real-estate agent, kag kilala siya sa Japan bilang pinakamakinot nga babaye bangud sa iya commitment sa paggasto sang tuman ka gamay sa pagkaon kag mangin sa iya kinahanglanon.
english: This is Saki Tamogami, a 37-year-old real-estate agent, and she is known in Japan as the most frugal woman because of her commitment to spending very little on food and being where she needs to be.

text: Sang 19-anyos siya nag-umpisa sa pagkinot sang kwarta.
english: At the age of 19 he started saving money.

text: Sa edad nga 27, nakasupot ini sang kwarta halin sa iya sweldo kag nagbakal sang balay sa Saitama, north sang Tokyo, sa balor nga 10 million yen ($69,000).
english: At the age of 27, he saved money from his salary and bought a house in Saitama, north of Tokyo, for 10 million yen ($69,000).

text: Makaligad ang pila ka tuig, nagbakal ini sang iya second house sa balor nga 18 million yen ($124,000), kag makaligad pa gid ang lima ka tuig, nabakal niya ang ikatatlo nga balay sa balor nga 37 million yen ($256,000).
english: A few years later, he bought his second house for 18 million yen ($124,000), and five years later, he bought a third house for 37 million yen ($256,000).

text: Sa pihak nga nalab-ot niya ang iya handom, padayon ini nga nagakabuhi nga makinot kag nagasupot sang kwarta agud nga magbulig sa mga gin-rescue nga kuring.
english: Despite achieving her dream, she continues to live frugally and save money to help rescued cats.

text: Nakabukas na ini gani sang cat cafe sa ground floor sang isa sa iya nga mga balay kag plano nga mag- invest sa iban nga properties sa palaabuton.
english: He has even opened a cat cafe on the ground floor of one of his houses and plans to invest in other properties in the future.

text: Sulod ang pambato sang Pilipinas sa Top 10 nga early picks sang prestihiyoso nga Missosology inadlaw antes ang pagpatigayon sang Miss World 2025 pageant.
english: The Philippine contestant is among the Top 10 early picks of the prestigious Missosology pageant days before the Miss World 2025 pageant.

text: Ika-10 sa pwesto ang 24-anyos nga Baguio City native nga si Krishnah Gravidez.
english: 24-year-old Baguio City native Krishnah Gravidez came in 10th place.

text: Sa first hot picks, nagapanguna naman si Suchata Chuangsri sang Thailand; kag ginasundan sang South Africa, Ireland, Brazil, kag Australia.
english: In the first hot picks, Thailand's Suchata Chuangsri leads; and is followed by South Africa, Ireland, Brazil, and Australia.

text: Tinguhaan sini nga madala pauli ang ikaduha nga Miss World crown sa Pilipinas kasunod sang first title sang pungsod nga nadala-pauli ni Megan Young sang 2013.
english: She will try to bring home the Philippines' second Miss World crown following the country's first title won by Megan Young in 2013.

text: Hiwaton ang Miss World 2025 coronation night sa Mayo 31.
english: The Miss World 2025 coronation night will be held on May 31.

text: TUBTUB Marso 2021 ang dominante nga COVID-19 variant sa India amo ang Alpha (UK) variant, nga sa amo nga tion naghatag sing kabalaka sa mga health expert tungod mas madasig ini mag-infect sangsa orihinal nga COVID-19.
english: UNTIL March 2021 the dominant COVID-19 variant in India was the Alpha (UK) variant, which at the time raised concerns among health experts as it was more infectious than the original COVID-19.

text: Wala ugaling malingkang ining pungsod nga may 1.38 ka bilyon nga pumuluyo sa pagsulod sining variant halin sa United Kingdom.
english: However, the country of 1.38 billion people was not affected by the entry of this variant from the United Kingdom.

text: Nga daan kilala ini bilang nagapanguna nga producer sa kalibutan sang mga bulong, labi na gid sang generic drugs, kag bisan sang mga bakuna.
english: It is already known as the world's leading producer of pharmaceuticals, especially generic drugs, and even vaccines.

text: May kaugalingon ini nga produksyon sang Covaxin kag Covishield.
english: It has its own production of Covaxin and Covishield.

text: Sa gihapon napatuman nila ang mas madasig nga pag-immunize (vaccinate) sang ila pumuluyo bisan pa sa padayon man nga pag-infect sining Alpha virus.
english: Still, they have implemented faster immunization (vaccination) of their people despite the continuous infection of this Alpha virus.

text: In fact, madasig na nila sadto malab-ut ang “herd immunity” sa New Delhi, nga dakbanwa sini, bisan pa sa padayon nga pangdalasa sining UK variant.
english: In fact, they were already quickly achieving herd immunity in New Delhi, its capital, despite the continued spread of the UK variant.

text: Tungod sini, ugaling, nangin complacent kag nagpasayang-sayang na ang mga pumuluyo.
english: Because of this, however, the people have become complacent and wasted.

text: Gintugot na gani ang indi paggamit sang face mask kag pagbalewala sa social distancing.
english: Not wearing face masks and ignoring social distancing is even allowed.

text: Gintugot man ang political rallies kag religious festivals.
english: Political rallies and religious festivals were also allowed.

text: Pero nakibut lang sila sang nagtuhaw ang Delta variant dira mismo sa India sadtong Abril 2021.
english: But they were surprised when the Delta variant emerged in India in April 2021.

text: Nadiskubrihan sang mga health experts sa India’s National Centre for Disease Control kag sang CSIR Institute of Genomics and Integrative Biology nga sobra gali kadasig mag-infect ini sangsa Alpha variant.
english: Health experts at India’s National Center for Disease Control and the CSIR Institute of Genomics and Integrative Biology have discovered that it is actually more transmissible than the Alpha variant.

text: Napamatud-an nila sa 878  test samples nga mas madamo ang na-infect sining Delta variant sangsa Alpha variant sing mga 50 ka porsyento.
english: They proved in 878 test samples that the Delta variant infected more people than the Alpha variant by about 50 percent.

text: Ang natabo sang ulihi amo nga indi na malab-ut sang immunization (vaccination) rate ang infection rate sining Delta variant.
english: What happened later was that the immunization (vaccination) rate could not reach the infection rate of this Delta variant.

text: Sa simple nga ejemplo, kon ang nabakunahan mga 100 na ka tawo, sa amo man nga tion 150 na ang na-infect.
english: In a simple example, if about 100 people are vaccinated, at the same time 150 are infected.

text: Tungod sini, nag-alawas na ang mga pasyente sa mga ospital kag ginkulang na ang mga healthcare facility kag mga equipment katulad sang mga oxygen machines kag breathing apparatus, kag mga anti-viral drugs para paayuhon ang mga “severe” kag “critical” cases.
english: As a result, patients have overflowed in hospitals and healthcare facilities and equipment such as oxygen machines and breathing apparatus, and anti-viral drugs to treat severe and critical cases are in short supply.

text: Kulang naman ang mga kinahanglanon nga mga personnel – doctor, nars kag contact tracers kag kinahanglan manglaghap pa sang ma-hire nga tinawo para sa healthcare.
english: There is a shortage of necessary personnel – doctors, nurses and contact tracers and it is necessary to find more personnel to hire for healthcare.

text: Gani napabay-an ang madamo nga pasyente nga bisan ang mga indi “severe” ang kaso nangin malala ang kahimtangan kag upod nga napatay sa mga “critical”.
english: As a result, many patients were neglected and even those who were not “severe” cases became seriously ill and died along with those who were “critical”.

text: Tungod sini, indi na gani ma-cremate ang iban nga mga bangkay kay indi na masarangan sang mga crematorium.
english: As a result, some bodies cannot even be cremated because the crematoriums cannot afford them.

text: Gintutdan na lang gani ang pila ka bangkay sa wayang.
english: Some of the bodies were even burned in the wayang.

text: Ang iban nasapwan na gid lang nga naga-utaw-utaw sa suba.
english: Others were found floating in the river.

text: Liwat ginbalik ang istrikto nga pagpatuman sang health measures lakip na ang lockdown sa mga COVID-19 hotspots kag mga “essential” lang nga hilimuon kag kinahanglanon ang gintugutan.
english: Strict implementation of health measures including lockdown in COVID-19 hotspots was resumed and only essential activities and necessities were allowed.

text: Gin-ban ang mga pagtililipon nga sobra sa lima ka tawo.
english: Gatherings of more than five people were banned.

text: Ginpadasig man ang pag-produce sang bakuna kag ang pagpangbakuna.
english: Vaccine production and vaccination were also accelerated.

text: Sa gihapon gin-prioritize sa pagbakuna ang mga health workers kag mga elderly.
english: Health workers and the elderly were still prioritized for vaccination.

text: Gin-prioritize na ang mga super spreaders katulad sang mga empleyado, nagatinda sa mga merkado kag mga store attendants nga masami nagaatubang sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Priority has been given to super spreaders such as employees, market vendors and store attendants who often face the public.

text: Tubtub nagkalma na ang sobra kadasig nga infection sang Delta variant.
english: Until the rapid infection of the Delta variant subsided.

text: Sa sining ulihi lang, sa Navi Mumbai sa report sadtong Agosto 4, nag-report ini sang 66 lang ka new cases kag 72 ka recoveries kon diin wala sing napatay.
english: Most recently, in Navi Mumbai in the report on August 4, it reported only 66 new cases and 72 recoveries with no deaths.

text: Samtang nakalab-ut na ang Delta variant sa Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, sa Middle East kag tubtub na sa Uropa kag sa Americas sa United States kag Canada.
english: Meanwhile, the Delta variant has reached Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Middle East and as far as Europe and the Americas in the United States and Canada.

text:
***

Ining experyensya sang India nakapamuklat sang mga health authorities sa India kag sang iban nga mga pungsod kon ano ka mahaliton ang Delta variant.
english:
***

This Indian experience has opened the eyes of health authorities in India and other countries to how destructive the Delta variant can be.

text: Maabtik man ang reaksyon sang mga naapektuhan, lakip na ang may mataas na nga vaccination rate.
english: Those affected, including those with high vaccination rates, also reacted quickly.

text: Ginpabakud ang pagpatuman sa mga pumuluyo sang health measures katulad sang paggamit sang face mask, social distancing, paglikaw sa pagginutok (crowd) kag pagtuman sang nagakabagay nga mga personal hygienic practices.
english: The implementation of health measures such as the use of face masks, social distancing, avoiding crowds and observing appropriate personal hygienic practices was strengthened.

text: Tungod bisan ang mga nabakunahan pwede ma-infect man kag maka-infect sang Delta variant, ini sila, without exception, ginapatuman man sining health measures.
english: Because even those who are vaccinated can be infected and infected with the Delta variant, they are, without exception, also subject to these health measures.

text: Ginapatuman man ining istrikto nga health measures diri sa aton pungsod,  samtang ginapadasig man ang aton pagpangbakuna kag ginapabakud pa gid ang aton healthcare agud malagas ang infection rate.
english: These strict health measures are also being implemented here in our country, while accelerating our vaccination and strengthening our healthcare to reduce the infection rate.

text: Na-lockdown man gani ang pila ka COVID-19 hotspots./PN
english: Some COVID-19 hotspots have even been locked down./PN

text: Sang lamharon nga edad, masami kita nagawawaw kun maghibi sa tion nga kita ang bayaan ukon bakulon sang aton ginikanan.
english: When we were young, we often cried when we were abandoned or beaten by our parents.

text: Apang kun naga-edad na, ang iban sa aton sa baylo nga magwawaw kun emosyonal, ginatago-tago na lang ang mga luha.
english: But as we get older, some of us, instead of crying when we are emotional, hide our tears.

text: Suno kay Dr. Timothy Legg, isa ka psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner kag licensed psychologist sa Estados Unidos, wala sang dapat kahuy-an ang pagwawaw kun nagahibi bangud pinaagi sini, mas mabuligan ang lawas nga maka-release sang oxytocin kag endorphins nga nagapabuhin sang physical kag emotional pain.
english: According to Dr. Timothy Legg, a psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner and licensed psychologist in the United States, said there is nothing to be ashamed of when crying because it helps the body release oxytocin and endorphins that reduce physical and emotional pain.

text: Ang ‘all out’ nga paghibi suno sa doktor ang tuman man ka bentaha bangud ang dalagko nga mga luha ang may dala nga lysozyme nga amo ang nagapatay sang mga bacteria sa mga mata.
english: The doctor said the 'all out' crying is also very advantageous because the big tears carry lysozyme which kills bacteria in the eyes.

text: Pahayag niya, ang pagwawaw samtang nagahibi ang makabulig man sa pag-moist sa mga mata agud malikawan ang pagmala sang mucous membranes nga nagaresulta sa blurred vision.
english: She said yawning while crying can also help moisturize the eyes to prevent drying of the mucous membranes resulting in blurred vision.

text: Apang paandam sang doktor, nagakadapat nga magpadulong sa psychiatrist ang mga tawo nga halos adlaw-adlaw kag masami nga nagahibi bangud posible nagasuprer na ang mga ini sang iban pa nga balatian kaangay sang depresyon.
english: However, the doctor warned that people who cry almost every day and often should see a psychiatrist because they may be suffering from other illnesses such as depression.

text: Ginklaro sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga wala sang ginatawag nga “dagdag-bawas” sa resulta sang 2025 senatorial race matapos nga naglapta sa social media ang isyu nga may ginbuhin nga boto sa isa ka kandidato.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has clarified that there is no so-called “addition-subtraction” in the results of the 2025 senatorial race after the issue of a candidate's vote being deducted spread on social media.

text: Ginpahayag ni COMELEC Chairman George Garcia nga may pila ka media outlets nga nagpagwa sang resulta base sa raw data halin sa Comelec server nga wala pa sang “cleansing” ukon proseso nga ginatawag nga machine-readable formatting.
english: COMELEC Chairman George Garcia said there are several media outlets that released results based on raw data from the Comelec server without cleansing or machine-readable formatting.

text: Suno kay kay Garcia gng ginapakita nga real-time data amo ang halin mismo sa Comelec.
english: According to Garcia, the real-time data shown is from the Comelec itself.

text: Ginklaro man ni Garcia nga ang COMELEC wala sang gahom nga mag-total ukon mag-rank sang mga kandidato samtang wala pa sang opisyal nga resulta.
english: Garcia also clarified that the COMELEC does not have the power to total or rank the candidates while there are no official results.

text: Madumduman nga nagsugod ang isyu sang nag-viral ang alleged discrepancy kun sa diin nagbuhin sang lima ka milyon nga boto ang isa ka kandidato sa senado.
english: The issue began when an alleged discrepancy went viral where a senate candidate lost five million votes.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga wala sang dugang, wala sang buhin, kag wala man sang shading nga natabo.
english: He also clarified that there was no addition, no subtraction, and no shading.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpadayon ang session sang National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) kag nakabaton sang 30 ka Certificates of Canvass (COCs), lakip na ang resulta sang Local Absentee Voting (LAV).
english: Meanwhile, the National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) continued its session and received 30 Certificates of Canvass (COCs), including the results of Local Absentee Voting (LAV).

text: Ginproklamar na si Kerwin Espinosa bilang bag-o nga alkalde sang Albuera, Leyte matapos ang midterm elections 2025.
english: Kerwin Espinosa has been proclaimed as the new mayor of Albuera, Leyte after the midterm elections 2025.

text: Nakakuha si Espinosa sang 14,919 ka boto base sa 100% nga election returns sa ila lugar.
english: Espinosa got 14,919 votes based on 100% election returns in their area.

text: Napyerde ang duha niya ka mga kasumpong nga sanday si Vince Rama nga may 9,744 ka boto kag si Sixto dela Victoria nga may 3,842 ka boto.
english: His two opponents, Vince Rama with 9,744 votes and Sixto dela Victoria with 3,842 votes, lost.

text: Nakit-an nga nagasuksok si Espinosa sang bullet-proof vest sa iya proklamasyon bilang pagpangaman matapos nga siya ang ginluthang sang panahon nga siya ang nagakampanya pa.
english: Espinosa was seen wearing a bullet-proof vest during his proclamation as a precaution after he was shot while he was still campaigning.

text: Ginproklamar man ang iya utod nga si RR Espinosa bilang bise alkalde sang Albuera.
english: His brother RR Espinosa was also proclaimed as vice mayor of Albuera.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Espinosa ang iya plano bilang lider sang nasambit nga lugar, kun sa diin ang una gid niya nga tutukam amo ang peace of order.
english: Espinosa also revealed his plan as the leader of the said area, where his first priority is peace of order.

text: Pagahatagan man ni Espinosa sang igtalupangod ang problema sang droga agud nga mahatagan man ini sang nagakaigo nga solusyon.
english: Espinosa will also pay attention to the drug problem so that it can be given a proper solution.

text: Madumduman nga si Espinosa ang kilala nga nag-amin sadto sa Senado sang 2016 nga kabahin siya sa illegal drug trade, pero ginbawi niya ini kag ginpahayag nga ginpwersa lang siya nga magtu-ad apisar nga wala man sang kamatuoran.
english: Espinosa was known to have confessed to the Senate in 2016 that he was involved in the illegal drug trade, but he withdrew it and said he was forced to confess despite the fact that there was no truth.

text: Pormal nga imbitaron sang Britanya si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Britain will formally invite President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: agud magtambong sa koronasyon kay King Charles III sa Mayo 6.
english: to attend the coronation of King Charles III on May 6.

text: Suno kay British envoy Laure Beaufils, nakapadala na ang United Kingdom sang “save the date” notice sa Malacañang.
english: According to British envoy Laure Beaufils, the United Kingdom has already sent a “save the date” notice to Malacañang.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Beaufils nga interesado man ang British businessmen nga magpatukod sang negosyo sa Pilipinas, kag naobserbahan man sini nga kabahin na ang United Kingdom sa top investors sa pungsod.
english: Beaufils also said that British businessmen are also interested in setting up businesses in the Philippines, and he also observed that the United Kingdom is already among the top investors in the country.

text: Yara pa subong ang economic team ni Marcos sa London para sa briefing kaupod sa United Kingdom leaders, bankers, kag businessmen.
english: Marcos' economic team is still in London for a briefing with United Kingdom leaders, bankers, and businessmen.

text: Ang koronasyon naman ni King Charles ang lauman nga patigayunon sa Westminster Abbey.
english: King Charles' coronation is expected to be held at Westminster Abbey.

text: Nakumpiska sang mga operatiba sang Bureau of Customs (BOC) ang anum ka pakete nga may sulod nga ginadudahan nga droga nga nagabalor sang P4.43 milliom sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).
english: Bureau of Customs (BOC) operatives seized six packets containing suspected drugs worth P4.43 million at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA).

text: Suno sa pahayag sang BOC, na-intercept ang shipment sa Central Mail Exchange Center sang airport, kun sa diin nasapwan ang 1,330 ka tableta sang ecstasy kag 362 gramos sang heroin.
english: According to the BOC, the shipment was intercepted at the airport's Central Mail Exchange Center, where 1,330 tablets of ecstasy and 362 grams of heroin were found.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang ahensya nga ang mga ilegal nga droga ang naghalin sa Ireland, Netherlands, kag Thailand.
english: The agency said the illegal drugs came from Ireland, the Netherlands, and Thailand.

text: Ginpanugyan sang BOC nga gintago ang mga droga sa mga pakete nga gin-misdeclare nga mga produkto para sa skincare kag mga gamit sa plumbing.
english: The BOC suggested the drugs were hidden in packages that were misdeclared to be products for skincare and plumbing fixtures.

text: Ang operasyon ginpatigayon upod ang Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) kag ang NAIA Inter-Agency Drug Interdiction Task Group (NAIA-IADITG).
english: The operation was conducted in collaboration with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) and the NAIA Inter-Agency Drug Interdiction Task Group (NAIA-IADITG).

text: Ang mga nakumoiska nga mga droga ang ginturn-over na sa PDEA para sa dugang nga imbestigasyon kag legal nga tikang suno sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 kag Republic Act 10863 ukon Customs Modernization and Tariff Act.
english: The seized drugs have been turned over to the PDEA for further investigation and legal action in accordance with Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 and Republic Act 10863 or Customs Modernization and Tariff Act.

text: Anum ka pakete nga may sulod nga ginadudahan nga droga, nakumpiska sang mga operatiba sang Bureau of Customs
english: Six packets containing suspected drugs, seized by Bureau of Customs operatives

text: Ginbasol sang Malacañang ang Duterte administration kun ngaa nalakip anay ang Pilipinas sa gray list sang Financial Action Task Force (FATF).
english: Malacañang blamed the Duterte administration for including the Philippines in the gray list of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF).

text: Kadungan sini nga statement, nagpasalig ang palasyo nga magapadayon ang administrasyon ni President Bongbong Marcos sa pagpanglimpyo sa lapta nga ginbilin ni anay President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Along with this statement, the palace assured that the administration of President Bongbong Marcos will continue to clean up the mess left by former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa statement ni Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Claire Castro, ginsiling sini nga nalakip anay sa lista ang Pilipinas sang 2021 sa idalom sang liderato ni Duterte.
english: In a statement, Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Claire Castro said the Philippines was previously included in the list in 2021 under Duterte's leadership.

text: Suno sa iya, kulang ang regulatory supervision sang gambling operations kag nagdamo man ang Philippine offshore gaming operators.
english: He said there is a lack of regulatory supervision of gambling operations and the number of Philippine offshore gaming operators has increased.

text: Maluya man suno kay Castro ang implementasyon sang targeted financial sanctions ilabi na sang pandemya kun sa diin may mga report sang anomaliya sa transaksyon.
english: Castro said the implementation of targeted financial sanctions is also weak especially during the pandemic where there are reports of anomalies in transactions.

text: Dugang niya, atrasado ang implementasyon sang Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020 bisan daku ang ginpain nga intelligence kag confidential funds.
english: He added that the implementation of the Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020 is delayed despite the large allocation of intelligence and confidential funds.

text: Ginpasalig ni Castro nga magapadayon ini nga administrasyon sa pagtapna sa mga aktibidad nga naangot sa money laundering kag pagpondo para sa mga terorista.
english: Castro assured that this administration will continue to crack down on activities linked to money laundering and terrorist financing.

text: “Dahil sa pagpupursige ng ating Pangulo ay napatanggal na po natin ang ating bansa sa Financial Action Task Force grey list,” suno sa opisyal.
english: “Because of the persistence of our President, we have removed our country from the Financial Action Task Force gray list,” the official said.

text:
“Hindi titigil ang ating Pangulo na maisaayos at mapigil ang mga gawaing may kinalaman sa money laundering at terrorist financing.”

Sang nagligad nga semana sang ginkumpirma nga nakakas na ang pangalan sang Pilipinas sa sini nga lista sang FATF.
english:
“Our President will not stop to fix and prevent activities related to money laundering and terrorist financing.”

Last week, it was confirmed that the Philippines had been removed from the FATF list.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang black list sa sini nga dirty money watchdog ang nagalakip sang mga pungsod nga may seryoso nga kakulangan sa pagtapna sa money laundering, terrorist financing kag financing of proliferation.
english: The black list of the dirty money watchdog includes countries with serious shortcomings in the prevention of money laundering, terrorist financing and financing of proliferation.

text: Sa nauna nga statement sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), ginsiling nga nakalampuwas ang Pilipinas sa gray list bangud sa maayo nga kooperasyon sa tunga sang gobyerno kag pribado nga sektor.
english: In an earlier statement, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) said the Philippines survived the gray list due to good cooperation between the government and the private sector.

text: Nakaboto lang antes ginbawian sang kabuhi ang isa ka senior citizen sa Oas, Albay.
english: Just voted before a senior citizen died in Oas, Albay.

text: Santo sa kumpirmasyon sang Police Regional Office Bicol (PRO V), na-identify ang tigulang nga si Nestor Rensales, 65.
english: According to the confirmation of the Police Regional Office Bicol (PRO V), the elderly man was identified as Nestor Rensales, 65.

text: Nakatapos si Rensales sa iya pagboto 6:05 kaina sang aga, apang nalipong ini samtang yara sa polling precinct sa Oas South Central School sa Barangay Ilaor Sur.
english: Rensales finished voting at 6:05 this morning, but fainted while at the polling precinct at Oas South Central School in Barangay Ilaor Sur.

text: Suno kay Police Lt.
english: According to Police Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Maria Luisa Calubaquib, spokesperson sang PRO-5, naatake sa korason ang tigulang.
english: Maria Luisa Calubaquib, spokesperson of PRO-5, said the elderly man suffered a heart attack.

text: Naghingagaw pa ang mga medical personnel sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga yara sa area agud mahatagan sang first aid si Rensales kag gindala man ini sa Josefina Belmonte Duran Albay Provincial Hospital sa Ligao City.
english: Commission on Elections (Comelec) medical personnel in the area rushed to give Rensales first aid and brought him to the Josefina Belmonte Duran Albay Provincial Hospital in Ligao City.

text: Apang pag-abot sa ospital, gindeklarar ini nga ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: But on arrival at the hospital, he was declared dead.

text: Nahibaluan nga alas singko tubtub alas syete sa aga ang tion nga ginhatag sang Comelec sa vulnerable sector kaangay sang senior citizens, persons with disability (PWDs), kag pregnant women agud makaboto.
english: It is known that the time given by the Comelec for vulnerable sectors such as senior citizens, persons with disabilities (PWDs), and pregnant women to vote is 5:00 to 7:00 am.

text: Tuman man ka init ang tyempo subong nga adlaw kadungan sang eleksyon rason nga binudlayan ang madamo nga mga botante indi lang sa Albay kundi sa madamo nga parte sang Pilipinas.#
english: The weather is also very hot today during the election, causing many voters to have difficulty not only in Albay but in many parts of the Philippines.

text: Nagapanawagn si anay Presidente Gloria Macapagal Arroyo sa publiko nga magpakita sang aktibo nga partisipasyon subong nga election.
english: Former President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo is calling on the public to show active participation in this election.

text: Ginpahayag ni Arroyo ang ka-importansya sang boto bilang isa ka demokratiko nga katungdanan sang kada Filipino.
english: Arroyo stressed the importance of voting as a democratic duty of every Filipino.

text: Gapanawagan man ini sa mga botante nga magbantay sang kamatuoran, kag magpili sang mga lider nga may integridad kag kapasidad sa pagserbisyo sa pungsod.
english: He also called on voters to guard the truth, and elect leaders with integrity and capacity to serve the country.

text: Bilang isa ka anay lider sang pungsod, ginpanawagan man niya sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga siguraduhon ang matinlo, patas, kag transparent nga proseso sang eleksyon.
english: As a former leader of the country, he also called on government agencies to ensure a clean, fair, and transparent electoral process.

text: Iloilo – Nakahunong na sa Bail for Immigration Detainees Detention Facility sa Bicutan, Taguig, City ang isa ka Japanese National nga gindakop sang otoridad sa Guimbal, Iloilo.
english: Iloilo – A Japanese national arrested by authorities in Guimbal, Iloilo is now detained at the Bail for Immigration Detainees Detention Facility in Bicutan, Taguig, City.

text: Ang arestado amo si Yohhei Yano, 43, naga-istar sa Binanua-an Guimbal, Iloilo kun sa diin may isa ka negosyo sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: The arrested was identified as Yohhei Yano, 43, resident of Binanua-an Guimbal, Iloilo where there is a business in the said town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Reagan Oriña, hepe sang Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nadakpan si Yano sa Guimbal Port sa Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Reagan Oriña, chief of Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station, said Yano was arrested at Guimbal Port in Brgy.

text: Gerona Gimeno, Poblacion Guimbal, Iloilo sang mga operatiba sang Bureau of Immigration, kaupod ang joint collaborative effort nila sang Guimbal Municipal Police Station.
english: Gerona Gimeno, Poblacion Guimbal, Iloilo by the operatives of the Bureau of Immigration, together with the joint collaborative effort of the Guimbal Municipal Police Station.

text: Suno kay Oriña, nakighimbon si Yano sa kaupod nga Japanese nga si Nakamura Sho sa isa ka robbery incident sa Heaven’s Kaitori Center, Kubota, Yokkaichi-city sa Mie prefecture sa Japan sang 2020 paagi sa paggamit sang tear gas kag kutsilyo.
english: According to Oriña, Yano conspired with fellow Japanese Nakamura Sho in a robbery incident at Heaven’s Kaitori Center, Kubota, Yokkaichi-city in Mie prefecture in Japan in 2020 by using tear gas and a knife.

text: Nakuha sang mga ini ang 882,992 yen ukon P369,805.61, kag 2,558,340 yen ukon P1,071,457.61, kag 70 gold items nga lunsay may historical value.
english: They recovered 882,992 yen or P369,805.61, and 2,558,340 yen or P1,071,457.61, and 70 gold items of historical value.

text: Sa arrest warrant nga ginpagwa ni Judge Abe Akihiko sang Yokkaichi Summary Court, si Yano kag Sho ang nagapangatubang sang kaso nga robbery, extortion kag naangot man sa telecommunications fraud.
english: In the arrest warrant issued by Judge Abe Akihiko of the Yokkaichi Summary Court, Yano and Sho are facing charges of robbery, extortion and telecommunications fraud.

text: Nakumpiskar man kay Yano ang iya 9mm caliber kag duha ka assembly magazines nga may 29 rounds sang ammunition
english: Also confiscated from Yano were his 9mm caliber and two assembly magazines containing 29 rounds of ammunition

text: Patay ang 10 ka tawo kag 10 man ang pilason sa mass shooting kadungan sang Lunar New Year celebration sa southern California.
english: Ten people were killed and 10 injured in a mass shooting during the Lunar New Year celebration in southern California.

text: Suno sa Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department, indi pa maathag subong kun ano ang motibo sa amo nga massacre.
english: According to the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department, the motive for the massacre is still unclear.

text: Ginapangita pa gihapon subong ang suspek nga ginpahayag naggamit sang semiautomatic weapon.
english: The suspect who allegedly used a semiautomatic weapon is still being sought.

text: Natabo ang shooting suno sa pulis sa isa ka ballroom dance studio.
english: The shooting happened, police said, at a ballroom dance studio.

text: Gina-review man subong ang closed-circuit TV footage malapit sa crime scene.
english: Closed-circuit TV footage near the crime scene is also currently being reviewed.

text: Sa inisyal pa nga impormasyon, lalaki ang suspek kag madasig ini nga nagpalagyo matapos ginhimo ang krimen.
english: According to initial information, the suspect is a male and quickly fled the scene after committing the crime.

text: Natabo ang insidente kadungan sang pagtilipon sang mga tawo para sa Lunar New Year Festival sa Monterey Park, isa ka syudad nga may 60,000 nga populasyon.
english: The incident occurred at the same time as people gathered for the Lunar New Year Festival in Monterey Park, a city of 60,000 people.

text: Ginadugukan sa duha ka adlaw nga event ang nagkalain-lain nga food boots, amusement rides, kag nanari-sari nga live entertainment.
english: The two-day event features a variety of food booths, amusement rides, and a variety of live entertainment.

text: Kun magsulod gani ang kawatan sa isa ka establisyemento, madasig ang iya hulag para nga indi na siya maabtan sang mga tawo sa palibot.
english: When a thief enters an establishment, he moves quickly so that people around him cannot catch him.

text: Apang lain pa gid ang natabo sa isa ka suspek nga nakasulod na sa iya target nga lugar, apang napurnada pa kag nadakpan pa sang pulis.
english: However, something else happened to a suspect who had already entered his target area, but was caught by the police.

text: Ang rason?
english: The reason?

text: Abaw, nawili siya abi sa pagbasa.
english: Oh, he loves to read.

text: Isa ka 38-anyos nga lalaki ang suspek nga nagsulod sa apartment sa Prati district sa Rome paagi sa balcony.
english: A 38-year-old man is the suspect who entered the apartment in the Prati district of Rome through the balcony.

text: Sang ara na siya sa sulod sang hulot, nakit-an sini ang isa ka lamesa nga may nakatungtong nga libro kaangot sa Greek mythology.
english: When he was inside the room, he saw a table with a book on Greek mythology.

text: Ang title sini amo ang The Gods of Six O’clock nga ginsulat sang Italian author nga si Giovanni Nucci.
english: Its title is The Gods of Six O’clock by Italian author Giovanni Nucci.

text: Bangud may hulag kag kalas sa apartment, nakabugtaw ang 71-anyos nga homeowner kag nadakpan sini ang lalaki nga nagatutok sa pagbasa sang libro.
english: The 71-year-old homeowner woke up and caught the man reading a book.

text: Nagtuyo pa ini nga makapalagyo apang nakatawag na ang homeowner sa pulis.
english: He tried to escape but the homeowner called the police.

text: Nag-rason pa ang lalaki nga nagsaka siya sa building para magbisita sa iya abyan, apang nagpinsar siya nga nagtupa siya sa B&B [bed &breakfast], nakakita sang libro, kag gin-umpisahan niya sa pagbasa.
english: The man even reasoned that he went up to the building to visit his friend, but he thought he landed at the B&B [bed & breakfast], found a book, and started reading it.

text: Indi man ugaling mapatihan ang lalaki bangud nakit-an sa iya dala ang mga malahalon nga gamit nga ginkawat man sini sa lain pa gid nga balay antes siya nadakpan.
english: However, the man was not believed because he was found with valuables that he also stole from another house before he was arrested.

text: Sang nabatian naman sang book author ang balita, naham-ot pa ini kag nagpromisa nga hatagan niya sang libro ang suspek.
english: When the book author heard the news, he was shocked and promised to give the suspect a book.

text: Nakuha pa sini nga i-angot ang suspek sa Greek mythology book.
english: He even managed to link the suspect to the Greek mythology book.

text: Suno sa author nga si Nucci, ang iya paborito nga Greek god amo si Hermes nga amo man ang ginakilala nga god of thieves — pareho sa sirkumstansya kun sa diin nadakpan ang lalaki.#
english: According to author Nucci, his favorite Greek god is Hermes who is also known as the god of thieves — similar to the circumstances in which the man was arrested.#

text: Nagpaathag ang Malacañang nga ang gin-authenticate nga “Cabral files” nga yara sa Ombudsman ang sarang gid lamang gamiton bilang ebidensya sa imbestigasyon sang flood control projects.
english: Malacañang explained that the authenticated “Cabral files” in the Ombudsman can only be used as evidence in the investigation of flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Atty. Claire Castro, tagpamaba sang Malacañang, iya ginpahayg nga ang mga dokumento nga nagalapta online nga wala na-authenticate ang indi importante.
english: According to Atty. Claire Castro, Malacañang spokesperson, said documents circulating online that are not authenticated are not important.

text: Dugang pa ni Castro nga mahimo gihapon magamit ang mga files depende sa intensyon sang mga opisyal nga magahimo sang pag-usisa.
english: Castro added that the files could still be used depending on the intention of the officials who will be conducting the investigation.

text: Sa matandaan nga si Cabral ang naulamid sa flood control corruption case kag natukiban nga patay sang nagligad nga bulan sa Benguet.
english: Cabral was involved in a flood control corruption case and was found dead last month in Benguet.

text: HALOS nataranta ang tanan diri sa Filipinas sa balita sang pagpamintas sang Delta variant sang COVID-19 sa India sadtong nagligad nga bulan sang Hulyo.
english: ALMOST everyone in the Philippines was shocked by the news of the outbreak of the Delta variant of COVID-19 in India last July.

text: Ang balita sa India, kon diin una na-detect ang Delta variant, nagasiling nga mas madasig ini magpanglaton.
english: News in India, where the Delta variant was first detected, says it is more transmissible.

text: Mga 50-60% ang dugang nga kadasig sini ikumparar sa orihinal nga COVID-19.
english: It is about 50-60% more severe than the original COVID-19.

text: In fact, madamo ang nagkalamatay dira sa India.
english: In fact, many people died here in India.

text: Indi na gani ma-akomodar ang tanan nga bangkay sang mga crematorium.
english: Crematoriums cannot even accommodate all the bodies.

text: Ginatutdan na lang gani sa wayang ang pila ka mga bangkay.
english: Some bodies are even burned in the wayang.

text: Ang iban nasapwan na lang nga nagautaw-utaw sa suba ukon nagahuray-ad na gid lang sa dalanon nga indi madala sa ospital.
english: Others were found floating in the river or lying on the road without being taken to the hospital.

text: Nagsaylo na gani  ini sa Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, kag pila pa ka pungsod sa Middle East kon diin may entry ban na gani kita sa ila sa Filipinas.
english: It has even moved to Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, and several other countries in the Middle East where we even have an entry ban on them in the Philippines.

text: Sunu gani sa Philippine Genome Center sa University of the Philippines (UP), as of Hulyo 25, 2021 , ari na ang Delta variant sa Filipinas kag upod pa ang iban nga variant nga madasig man magpanglaton.
english: According to the Philippine Genome Center at the University of the Philippines (UP), as of July 25, 2021, the Delta variant is already in the Philippines along with other variants that are also highly contagious.

text: Nagalakip ini sila sang Alpha, Beta, kag P.3 nga mga variant.
english: They include Alpha, Beta, and P.3 variants.

text: Samtang, ang Delta variant naglab-ut na sa 119 ka kaso, sa kabug-usan.
english: Meanwhile, the Delta variant has reached 119 cases, in total.

text: Ang bag-o nga na-detect nga Delta variant naglab-ut sa 55 ka kaso.
english: The newly detected Delta variant has reached 55 cases.

text: Mga 37 ang local cases, 17 returning Overseas Filipino (ROFs) samtang ang isa gina-verify pa kon local ukon ROF.
english: About 37 are local cases, 17 returning Overseas Filipinos (ROFs) while one is still being verified if local or ROF.

text: Isa sini napatay na samtang ang 54 naka-recover..
english: One of them has died while 54 have recovered.

text: Sa report sa Western Visayas, una na-detect ang duha ka kaso sang Delta variant sa Antique.
english: According to reports in Western Visayas, two cases of the Delta variant were first detected in Antique.

text: May isa naman diri sa Iloilo City kag daw may apat sa probinsya.
english: There is one here in Iloilo City and four in the province.

text: May pila naman ka kaso sa iban nga probinsya sa WV.
english: There have been several cases in other counties in WV.

text: Sa bug-os nga pungsod, nag-declare na sing ECQ ukon lockdown sa NCR kag iban pa nga lugar, lakip ang siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Nationwide, ECQ or lockdown has been declared in the NCR and other areas, including Iloilo City and province.

text:
***

Pero, kinahanglan gid man bala kita mag-panic?
english:
***

But, do we really need to panic?

text: Indi man.
english: Not at all.

text: Luas nga madasig magpanglaton ang Delta variant, indi gid man siya mas mapintas sangsa COVID-19 kag iban nga variant.
english: Besides being more contagious, the Delta variant is no more virulent than COVID-19 and other variants.

text: Sa mga 119 ka kaso sini, as of Hulyo 25, 2021 sunu sa Philippine Genome Center sa UP, sa nasiling ta na, isa lang ang napatay kag 54 ang  naka-recover.
english: Of the 119 cases, as of July 25, 2021 according to the Philippine Genome Center in UP, as we have already mentioned, only one has died and 54 have recovered.

text: Gani, sunu kay Usec Vega, sa gihapon ang naandan lang nga pagpangamlig – facemask kag face shield, paghugas sang kamot upod ang habon, social distancing nga 1-2 ka metro, likaw sa pagginutok (crowd), kag likaw sa pagtandug sang ilong, baba kag mata kay ina gihapon ang best nga proteksyon naton.
english: Therefore, according to Usec Vega, the usual protection - facemask and face shield, hand washing with soap, social distancing of 1-2 meters, avoid crowds, and avoid touching the nose, mouth and eyes because that is still our best protection.

text: Kinahanglan lang ang husto nga pagpangamlig sandig sa health protocol.
english: Proper protection is required according to health protocols.

text:
***

Luyag ta man tagaan sing pagtalupangod ang wala nagakaigu nga pagpamahog ni Presidente Duterte, sining ulihi lang, batok sa mga wala nabakunahan.
english:
***

We would also like to draw attention to President Duterte's recent threats against the unvaccinated.

text: Gin-order niya ang mga pulis nga dakpon ang mga nagagwa nga pumuluyo nga wala pa nabakunahan kag indi gid pagwaon ang mga ini sa ila puluy-an.
english: He ordered police to arrest unvaccinated residents and never let them leave their homes.

text: Ti, ano na lang ang matabo sa luyag maggwa agud magpabakuna?
english: Well, what happens to those who want to go out to get vaccinated?

text: Ano na lang ang matabo sa wala sing masugo agud magbakal sang ila bulong kag ano pa nga “essentials”?
english: What will happen to those who have no one to send to buy their medicine and other “essentials”?

text: Ano ang matabo sa mga tigulang naton nga luyag magpahangin-hangin sa plaza ukon agud maghaklo sang limpyo nga hangin halin sa dagat samtang sakay man sila sa ila mga salakyan?
english: What will happen to our elderly who want to relax in the plaza or to breathe clean air from the sea while they are riding in their cars?

text: Ano naman ya ang luyag lang itugyan sa Diyos ang ila kapalaran sa COVID kag maghulat lang sa “herd immunity” samtang nagasunod man sa health protocol?
english: What about those who just want to leave their fate in COVID to God and wait for herd immunity while following health protocols?

text: Indi bala nga bisan ang nabakunahan pwede man gani manglaton kag malatnan liwat?
english: Isn't it true that even the vaccinated can become infected and reinfected?

text: In fact, kinamatarong sang isa ka pasyente sa iya pamat-ud kon bala sundon ukon indi ang panugyan sang doctor.
english: In fact, it is the right of a patient to decide whether or not to follow the doctor's advice.

text: Sa madumduman ko, ini nga kinamatarong sang pasyente nakapaskil sa dingding sang ospital nga ginsudlan ko sadto.
english: As far as I can remember, this patient right was posted on the wall of the hospital where I was admitted.

text: Gapati kita ugaling nga indi gid man ina ang luyag matabo sang Presidente nga piliton ang pagpabakuna.
english: We believe, however, that this is not what the President wants to happen to force vaccination.

text: Siya mismo ang nagsiling sini, indi bala?
english: He said it himself, didn't he?

text: Ga-panic lang siya seguro sa padayon nga pagsaka sang mga COVID-19 cases, labi na gid sang pag-abot sang Delta variant./PN
english: He is probably just panicking about the continuous increase in COVID-19 cases, especially with the arrival of the Delta variant./PN

text: Ang pagpanghusay sang buhok ang isa sa nangin routine na sang kadam-an kada adlaw.
english: Hairdressing is one of the daily routines of many people.

text: Apang suno sa mga eksperto, wala lang nagapahipid sang buhok ang simple nga pag-brush sang hair strands bangud ini nga routine sa adlaw-adlaw ang nagahatag sang madamo nga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas.
english: However, according to experts, simple brushing of hair strands does more than make hair smooth because this daily routine provides many health benefits.

text:
Suno kay Dr. Cynthia Cobb, nurse practitioner kag espesyalista sa women’s health, aesthetics, cosmetics, kag skin care, yari ang pila ka mga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas nga ma-angkon sang mga indibidwal nga masami nagapanghusay:

Agud malikawan ang breakage ukon pagkaguba sang buhok, ginpanugyan sang doktor ang mahinay nga paghusay sa kada section sang buhok kag likawan ang masami nga pagbutang sang hair color.
english:
According to Dr. Cynthia Cobb, nurse practitioner and specialist in women’s health, aesthetics, cosmetics, and skin care, here are some of the health benefits individuals who groom frequently can enjoy:

To avoid breakage or damage to the hair, the doctor recommended gently straightening each section of hair and avoiding frequent application of hair color.

text: Padayun ang pagmonitor sang Public Employment and Services Office (PESO) Iloilo City sa 119 ka mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) sa mga pungsod sa Middle East nga apektado sang gyera sang Iran, United States of America kag Israel.
english: The Public Employment and Services Office (PESO) Iloilo City continues to monitor 119 Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in Middle Eastern countries affected by the war between Iran, the United States of America and Israel.

text: Base sa ila datos, may ara sang 17 ka mga Ilonggo OFWs sa Israel, 2 sa pungsod sang Oman, 28 sa Qatar, 6 ka OFWs sa United Arab Emirates, 1 sa Bahrain, 32 sa Kuwait, 29 sa Saudi Arabia kag 4 sa Jerusalem.
english: Based on their data, there are 17 Ilonggo OFWs in Israel, 2 in Oman, 28 in Qatar, 6 OFWs in the United Arab Emirates, 1 in Bahrain, 32 in Kuwait, 29 in Saudi Arabia and 4 in Jerusalem.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gab Umadhay, head sang PESO-Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga naga-coordinate sila sa Department of Migrant Workers agud ila mahibaluan ang kahimtangan sang mga OFW sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gab Umadhay, head of PESO-Iloilo City, said they are coordinating with the Department of Migrant Workers to find out the situation of OFWs abroad.

text: Suno kay Umadhay, nagpahayag man ang mga Ilonggo OFW nga yara man sila sa maayo nga sitwasyon bangud ginapasiguro man sang ila nga kompanya kag employer nga hilway sila sa katalagman.
english: According to Umadhay, the Ilonggo OFWs also said that they are in a good situation because their companies and employers are assuring them that they are safe.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagahatag man ang ila opisina sang financial assistance para sa mga distressed OFWs nga nagalab-ot sa P15,000 kag may ara man sang ginahatag nga livelihood programs, start-up programs nga nagakab-ot sa P10,000-30,000 depende sa negosyo nga ila umpisahan.
english: He also said that their office also provides financial assistance for distressed OFWs amounting to P15,000 and also provides livelihood programs, start-up programs amounting to P10,000-30,000 depending on the business they start.

text: Dugang pa ni Umadhay nga nagapasalig sila sa mga apektado nga mga OFWs nga kun mapinsaran sang mga ini nga mag-repatriate, may ara sang mahatag nga bulig ang syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Umadhay added that they assure the affected OFWs that if they think of repatriating, the city of Iloilo will provide assistance.

text: Sa isa ka makasaysayan nga edition sang Met Gala nga puno sang mainit nga isyu kag hitabo, liwat nga naging sentro sang atensyon ang couple nga sanday Rihanna kag A$AP Rocky.
english: In a historic edition of the Met Gala filled with hot issues and events, couple Rihanna and A$AP Rocky once again became the center of attention.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni A$AP Rocky, nga isa sa mga co-chair sang 2025 Met Gala, nga sila ni Rihanna ang nagalaum sang ikatatlo nga anak.
english: A$AP Rocky, who is one of the co-chairs of the 2025 Met Gala, revealed that he and Rihanna are expecting a third child.

text: Madumduman nga gin-anunsyo man sang couple ang ila ikaduha nga bata sang 2023 sa Super Bowl halftime show, kun diin si Rihanna nag-perform nga may baby bump.
english: It can be recalled that the couple also announced their second child in 2023 during the Super Bowl halftime show, where Rihanna performed with a baby bump.

text: Ang ila ikaduha nga anak nga si Riot Rose natawo sadtong tuig man, kag ang ila una nga bata nga si RZA, natawo sang Mayo 2022.
english: Their second child Riot Rose was born that year as well, and their first child RZA, was born in May 2022.

text: Bilang co-chair sang Met Gala nga may tema nga “Superfine: Tailoring Black Style,” ginpabutyag ni Rocky ang iya padayon nga suporta sa fashion industry.
english: As co-chair of the Met Gala themed “Superfine: Tailoring Black Style,” Rocky expressed his continued support for the fashion industry.

text: Nagapadayon ang ila impluwensya sa kalibutan sang moda kag musika, kag subong man sa ila padayon nga pagdako bilang pamilya.
english: Their influence in the world of fashion and music continues, and also as they continue to grow as a family.

text: Kaangay sang father-and-son tandem ang natabo nga mass shooting incident sa Bondi Beach, Australia sa ginpatigayon nga Hanukkah event sang Domingo, Disyembre 14, nga nagresulta sa kamatayon sang indi magnubo sa 16 ka mga tawo.
english: The mass shooting incident in Bondi Beach, Australia during the Hanukkah event on Sunday, December 14, resulted in the deaths of at least 16 people.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Denmark Suede, Bombo Correspondent sa Australia, iya ginpahayag nga ang mga suspek amo ang mag-amay nga lunsay mga Muslims, kag ginapatihan nga ang target sang pag-atake amo ang Jewish community, apang madamo nga mga sibilyan ang nasamaran, lakip na ang pila ka kabataan, nga ginbulong sa nagkalain-lain nga ospital sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Denmark Suede, Bombo Correspondent in Australia, said the suspects were a father and son, both Muslims, and it is believed that the target of the attack was the Jewish community, but many civilians were injured, including several children, who were treated at various hospitals in the area.

text: Ginakondenar sang gobyerno sang Australia ang nasambit nga insidente, pati na sang Muslim community, kag ginpahayag nga wala gid ini nagarepresentar sang ila pagtuo.
english: The Australian government condemns the incident, as does the Muslim community, and says it does not represent their faith.

text: Yara na sa idalom sang kustodiya sang kapulisan ang anak nga suspek, samtang patay naman ang amay nga suspek matapos ini matiruhan sang gin-agawan sang pusil sang isa ka sibilyan, nga nahibaluan man nga isa ka Muslim.
english: The suspect's son is now under police custody, while the suspect's father was shot dead after being robbed of a gun by a civilian, also known to be a Muslim.

text: Ini amo ang pinakaulihi nga mass shooting incident nga narecord sa Australia sa sulod sang 29 ka tuig.
english: This is the latest mass shooting incident recorded in Australia in 29 years.

text: Sa karon, padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad agud matumod ang motibo sang krimen kag kun may iban pa nga persona nga nalakip sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the motive of the crime and whether there were other persons involved in the incident.

text: Kun pakaslan mo ang tawo nga imo ginahigugma, pat-od nga “out of this world” kag “over the moon” gid ang imo nga mabatyagan!
english: When you marry the person you love, you will surely feel “out of this world” and “over the moon”!

text: Pareho sini ang nabatyagan sang former American astronaut nga si Buzz Aldrin nga nagpakasal sa iya long-time girlfriend sa edad nga 93 anyos.
english: Former American astronaut Buzz Aldrin, who married his long-time girlfriend at 93 years old, felt the same way.

text: Ginpatigayon ang kasal nanday Aldrin kag sang 63-anyos nga si Dr. Anca Faur sa Los Angeles, California.
english: The wedding of Aldrin and 63-year-old Dr. Anca Faur in Los Angeles, California.

text: Suno pa sa former US astronaut, tuman sila ka excited nga duha kag daw kasubong lang nga naga-elope nga teenagers ang ila nga nabatyagan.
english: According to the former US astronaut, they were both very excited and felt like teenagers eloping.

text: Si Aldrin amo ang isa sa mga piloto sang legendary nga Apollo 11 spaceflight sang 1969.
english: Aldrin was one of the pilots of the legendary Apollo 11 spaceflight in 1969.

text: Siya ang ikaduha nga tawo nga nakalapak sa bulan, sunod kay Neil Armstrong nga amo ang commander sang amo nga maragtason nga mission.
english: He is the second man to set foot on the moon, after Neil Armstrong who was the commander of that historic mission.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nag-set up sanday Armstrong kag Aldrin sang American flag sa bulan, nagdala sang mga bato, kag nag-set up man sang scientific experiments antes nagbalik sa spacecraft kag gin-abi abi bilang mga baganihan sang nag-abot sa earth.
english: During that time, Armstrong and Aldrin set up an American flag on the moon, transported rocks, and also set up scientific experiments before returning to the spacecraft and were hailed as heroes upon arrival on earth.

text: Sa apat ka mga tawo sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nakatapak sa bulan, siya na lang nagaisahanon nga buhi.
english: Of the four people in the world who have set foot on the moon, he is the only one alive.

text: Ang iya naman nga asawa nga si Dr. Faur may yara sang PhD sa chemical engineering kag amo ang executive vice president sang kumpaniya ni Aldrin nga Buzz Aldrin Ventures.
english: His wife, Dr. Faur holds a PhD in chemical engineering and is the executive vice president of Aldrin’s company Buzz Aldrin Ventures.

text: Indi ini ang una nga tion nga nagsiling sang “I do” ang nasambit nga astronaut sa atubang sang altar.
english: This is not the first time the aforementioned astronaut has said “I do” in front of the altar.

text: Tatlo ka beses na siya nga nagpakasal apang lunsay diborsyo ang gindangatan sang pag-asawahay.
english: He has been married three times but all of them ended in divorce.

text: Naatrasar sang gamay ang pagboto ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez bangud sa pagbisyo sang Automated Counting Machine (ACM).
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez's vote was slightly delayed due to a malfunction of the Automated Counting Machine (ACM).

text: Nagboto siya ala una subong nga hapon sa V&G de la Cruz Memorial School sa Tacloban City.
english: He voted at 1 pm this afternoon at the V&G de la Cruz Memorial School in Tacloban City.

text: Sang gingulo na ang balota sa makina, ginluad ini ukon gin-reject.
english: Once the ballot was tampered with in the machine, it was loaded or rejected.

text: Tatlo ka beses gid nga gintilawan nga i-feed ang balota; kag sang ulihi, gin-request na ang bulig sang technical staff.
english: Three attempts were actually made to feed the ballot; and later, the assistance of the technical staff has been requested.

text: Naghulat pa ang house speaker antes ini ini ginbaton sang balota.
english: The house speaker waited before it was accepted by the ballot.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapadalagan liwat si Romualdez bilang unopposed candidate sa pagka-kongresista sa 1st District sa probinsya sang Leyte subong nga 2025 midterm elections.
english: Romualdez is running again as an unopposed candidate for congressman in the 1st District in Leyte province in the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Kaina sang aga, naka-eksperyensya man si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Yesterday morning, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. also experienced.

text: sang slight technical glitch kun sa diin wala man ginbaton sang ACM ang iya una nga paggulo sang balota.
english: of a slight technical glitch where the ACM did not accept his initial ballot tampering.

text: Syete minutos ang ginlawig antes nakuha sini ang iya voter receipt.
english: It took seven minutes for him to get his voter receipt.

text: Nakaboto na si First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos kag ang iya mga kabataan sa Calayab Elementary School sa Laoag City subong nga adlaw, Mayo 12.
english: First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos and her children voted at Calayab Elementary School in Laoag City today, May 12.

text: Nag-abot ang first lady kag sanday Simon, Vincent, kag Ilocos Norte Rep.
english: The first lady and Simon, Vincent, and Ilocos Norte Rep.

text: Sandro Marcos sa polling precinct antes ang alas nueve subong nga aga.
english: Sandro Marcos at the polling precinct before 9 am this morning.

text: Matapos na-check ang ila pangalan sa voter’s list, naglinya na ang apat kaupod ang iban nga mga botante tubtub nga nakaboto antes ang alas 10:00 sa aga.
english: After checking their names on the voter's list, the four lined up with other voters until they voted before 10:00 am.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala sang kasumpong si Sandro sa iya pagpa-eleher liwat bilang kongresista sa first district sang amo nga probinsya.
english: Sandro has no opponent in his re-election as congressman in the first district of the province.

text: Antes nag-abot sa Laaog, gin-updan man sini ang iya amay nga si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Before arriving in Laaog, he also accompanied his father, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga nagboto sa Mariano Marcos Memorial Elementary School sa Batac.
english: who voted at Mariano Marcos Memorial Elementary School in Batac.

text: Didto man nga eskwelahan nagboto ang Marcos matriarch nga si former First Lady Imelda Marcos kag utod sang president nga si Irene Marcos.#
english: Marcos matriarch former First Lady Imelda Marcos and the president's sister Irene Marcos also voted at the school.

text: Gin-athag sang Korte Suprema nga nga indi na kinahanglan ang Psychiatric records agud pamatud-an ang isa ka legal insanity.
english: The Supreme Court clarified that that Psychiatric records are no longer needed to prove a legal insanity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Alfredo Arungayan III, Bombo Abogado, iya ginpahayag nga wala na nagakinahanglan sang dokumentado nga pamatuod nga may sakit sa panghuna-huna ang isa ka tawo agud magamit sa legal insanity bilang depensa sa isa ka kaso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Alfredo Arungayan III, Bombo Abogado, said that documented proof of mental illness is no longer required to be used in legal insanity as a defense in a case.

text: Suno kay Arungayan, sa idalum sang Article 12 sang Revised Penal Code, ang isa ka tawo nga nakahimo sang krimen kag napamatud-an nga legal nga may sakit sa paminsaron ang exempted sa criminal liability.
english: Arungayan said that under Article 12 of the Revised Penal Code, a person who has committed a crime and is proven to be legally mentally ill is exempt from criminal liability.

text: Dugang pa sang Korte nga mabudlay pamatud-an ang amo nga sakit sa amo nga tion sang krimen, gani mahimo nga binag-binagon sang korte ang pamatasan sang akusado antes ukon pagkatapos sang insidente.
english: The Court added that it is difficult to prove such impairment at the time of the crime, so the court may consider the behavior of the accused before or after the incident.

text: Ginklaro man sang Korte nga samtang ang mga nauna nga rekord medikal mahimo nga may kaangtanan, indi nila kinahanglan nga pamatud-an nga ang medikal nga kondisyon sang akusado amo ang kabangdanan sang krimen.
english: The Court also clarified that while prior medical records may be relevant, they do not necessarily prove that the defendant’s medical condition caused the crime.

text: Samtang, ang wala sang dokumentado nga psychiatric history, indi dapat paggamiton batok sa akusado.
english: The absence of a documented psychiatric history, meanwhile, should not be used against the defendant.

text: Ginduso ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. proposed

text: ang food security paagi sa production sa session sa nutrition security nga ginpatigayon sa World Economic Forum sa Davos, Switzerland.
english: food security through production at the session on nutrition security held at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland.

text: Gin-suggest sang presidente nga pasangkaron pa ang produksyon sa agriculture kag fisheries kag pauswagon pa ang pag-promote sang production bisan sa non-agricultural areas kaangay sang urban kag vertical farming amo man ang community gardening.
english: The president suggested increasing production in agriculture and fisheries and improving the promotion of production even in non-agricultural areas such as urban and vertical farming as well as community gardening.

text: Bilang tiglikom man sang Department of Agriculture (DA), ginpahayag ni Marcos nga ang pagkaon nga gintanum gid ukon ginpatubo gamit ang kaugalingon nga kamot ang pinaka-kinahanglan agud mahatagan sang nutrisyon ang lawas.
english: As the secretary of the Department of Agriculture (DA), Marcos said that food that is actually planted or grown with one's own hands is the most necessary to provide nutrition to the body.

text: Gin-cite pa sini ang 2021 Global Food Security Index kun sa diin pang-64 ang Pilipinas sa 113 ka mga pungsod sa apat ka dimensyon sang food security metrics.
english: He also cited the 2021 Global Food Security Index where the Philippines ranked 64th out of 113 countries in four dimensions of food security metrics.

text: Ginpabugal man sini nga ang prayoridad nga mga intervention sa Pilipinas amo nga himuon nga available ang pagkaon kag accessible sa tunga sang ginapangatubang nga global food kag energy shortage.
english: He also boasted that the priority interventions in the Philippines are to make food available and accessible amid the global food and energy shortage.

text: Matandaan nga antes ang pag-umpisa sang World Economic Forum, todo-depensa si Marcos sa pag-import sang bombay sa pungsod bangud wala na sang choice ang gobyerno suno sa iya.
english: It can be recalled that before the start of the World Economic Forum, Marcos was fully defensive of the importation of bombay in the country because the government has no choice, he said.

text: Una na sini ginpahayag nga nagapangita sang paagi ang iya nga administrasyon agud nga mapasangkad ang production sang bombay kag iban pa nga produkto agud nga malikawan ang padayon nga pag-import.
english: Earlier, he said his administration is looking for ways to expand the production of bombay and other products to avoid continued imports.

text: Mismo si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. himself.

text: ang naka-eksperyensya sang minor technical glitch sang nagboto siya subong nga aga sa isa ka eskwelahan sa Batac, Ilocos Norte.
english: experienced a minor technical glitch when he voted this morning at a school in Batac, Ilocos Norte.

text: Duha ka beses pa nga gin-feed ang iya balota antes ginbaton sang automated counting machine (ACM) sa bulig sang personnel sang Commission on Elections (Comelec).
english: His ballot was fed twice before it was accepted by the automated counting machine (ACM) with the help of Commission on Elections (Comelec) personnel.

text: Sa video sang RTVM Malacañang, nakit-an nga sang wala ginbaton sang ACM ang ballot bangud sa error, may gintawag nga personnel agud buksan ang makina, gin-reclaim ang ballot, kag gingulo liwat sang presidente.
english: In the video of RTVM Malacañang, it was seen that when the ACM did not accept the ballot due to an error, a personnel was called to open the machine, the ballot was reclaimed, and the president messed it up again.

text: Sang na-check na sini ang voter receipt nga ginpaguwa sang machine, ginbutangan na sang ink ang iya nga tudlo.
english: When he checked the voter receipt issued by the machine, he put ink on his finger.

text: Yara sa syete minutos ang ginlawig sang pagboto sang president.
english: The president's vote lasted about seven minutes.

text: Kaupod sini nga nag-abot sa polling center ang iya utod nga si Irene Marcos, iloy nga si former First Lady Liza Marcos, kag bata nga si Rep.
english: He was accompanied by his sister Irene Marcos, mother former First Lady Liza Marcos, and son Rep.

text: Sandro Marcos.
english: Sandro Marcos.

text: Maga-monitor si President Marcos sang election results sa iya pagbalik sa Manila.#
english: President Marcos will monitor the election results when he returns to Manila.

text: Masobra 100 ka myembro sang armed forces ang naghikot agud maaresto ang most wanted Mafia boss sa Italya kag number 1 fugitive sa pungsod nga si Matteo Messina Denaro.
english: More than 100 members of the armed forces operated to arrest Italy's most wanted Mafia boss and number 1 fugitive in the country, Matteo Messina Denaro.

text: Nadakpan si Denaro sa isa ka pribado nga health clinic sa Sicily kun sa diin gina-alegar nga nagabaton ini sang treatment bangud sa cancer.
english: Denaro was arrested at a private health clinic in Sicily where he was allegedly receiving treatment for cancer.

text: 30 ka tuig man nga nagpanago si Denaro sa mga pulis matapos nga na-convict sa dalagku nga mga krimen.
english: Denaro also hid from the police for 30 years after being convicted of serious crimes.

text: Siya ang ginatudlo boss sang notorious nga Cosa Nostra Mafia kag na-sentensyahan sang bilog nga kabuhi nga pagka-preso sang 2002 bangud sang nagkalain-lain nga murders.
english: He is the alleged boss of the notorious Cosa Nostra Mafia and was sentenced to life in prison in 2002 for various murders.

text: Isa siya ka fugitive halin sang 1993 kag gina-konsiderar sang Europol nga isa sa “most wanted men” sa bilog nga Europa.
english: He has been a fugitive since 1993 and is considered by Europol to be one of the “most wanted men” in all of Europe.

text: Lakip sa mga krimen nga iya nahimo amo ang pagpatay sa duha ka anti-Mafia prosecutors sang 1992, fatal bombings sa Milan, Florence kag Rome sang late 1990s, kag pagpatay kag pag-torture sa 11-anyos nga anak nga lalaki sang tawo nga nag-testigo batok sa Sicilian Cosa Nostra.
english: Among the crimes he committed were the murder of two anti-Mafia prosecutors in 1992, fatal bombings in Milan, Florence and Rome in the late 1990s, and the murder and torture of the 11-year-old son of the man who testified against the Sicilian Cosa Nostra.

text: Sang una, matandaan nga ginpadayaw pa sini nga masarangan niya nga pun-on ang patyo sa iya nga mga biktima.
english: In the past, he boasted that he could fill the courtyard with his victims.

text: Ang amo nga Mafia boss ang kilala man sa racketeering, illegal waste dumping, money-laundering kag drug-trafficking para sa Cosa Nostra organised crime syndicate.
english: The Mafia boss is also known for racketeering, illegal waste dumping, money-laundering and drug-trafficking for the Cosa Nostra organized crime syndicate.

text: Para sa police force kag kay Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, kadalag-an ini sang Italya kag pamatuod nga wala naga-untat ang otoridad sa pagpangpapas sang mga Mafia.
english: For the police force and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, this is a victory for Italy and proof that the authorities are not giving up on eradicating the Mafia.

text: Nakaboto na si Vice President Sara Duterte sa Daniel R. Aguinaldo National High School (DRANHS) sa Barangay Matina, Davao City subong nga aga.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte voted at the Daniel R. Aguinaldo National High School (DRANHS) in Barangay Matina, Davao City this morning.

text: Pasado sang alas otso sang aga sang nag-abot ang bise-presidente sa cluster precinct number 352 suksok ang itom nga polo shirt.
english: The vice-president arrived at cluster precinct number 352 around 8 am wearing a black polo shirt.

text: Kaupod sini ang iya bana nga si Atty. Mans Carpio.
english: She was accompanied by her husband, Atty. Carpio Sleeve.

text: Lakip man sa lista sang mga botante sa nasambit nga mga eskwelahan amo si former President Rodrigo Duterte nga nagapadalagan sa pagka-alkalde sa Davao City.
english: Also on the list of voters in these schools is former President Rodrigo Duterte who is running for mayor of Davao City.

text: Didto na-detain sa The Hague, Netherlands ang former mayor bangud sa kaso sini nga crimes against humanity sa International Criminal Court (ICC) nga naangot sa war on drugs.
english: The former mayor is currently detained in The Hague, Netherlands for crimes against humanity at the International Criminal Court (ICC) related to the war on drugs.

text: Ang runningmate ni Duterte subong nga 2025 elections amo ang iya bata nga si incumbent city mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte.
english: Duterte's runningmate in the 2025 elections is his son, incumbent city mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte.

text: Kun lantawon ang nagapadayon nga tensyon sa tunga sang China kag Taiwan kag ang nagalala nga military activity sang North Korea, posible nga ang East Asia na ang masunod nga Ukraine.
english: Given the ongoing tensions between China and Taiwan and North Korea's escalating military activity, it is possible that East Asia will be the next Ukraine.

text: Lakip ini sa ginpalab-ot ni Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida sa mga lider sang Group of Seven (G7) kasunod sang iya naobserbahan nga “strong sense of crisis” kaangot sa security environment sa East Asia nga nagalakip sa China, Hong Kong, Japan, Macau, Mongolia, North Korea, South Korea, kag Taiwan.
english: This is part of what Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida conveyed to the leaders of the Group of Seven (G7) following his observation of a “strong sense of crisis” regarding the security environment in East Asia which includes China, Hong Kong, Japan, Macau, Mongolia, North Korea, South Korea, and Taiwan.

text: “Ukraine may be the East Asia of tomorrow,” pahayag ni Kishida kasunod sang iya meeting kay US President Joe Biden.
english: “Ukraine may be the East Asia of tomorrow,” Kishida said following his meeting with US President Joe Biden.

text: Ginatumod sini ang ginapahayag pagpang-harass sang China sa dagat kun sa diin gina-claim man sang Japan, Pilipinas, kag Vietnam.
english: It refers to China's alleged maritime harassment, which is also claimed by Japan, the Philippines, and Vietnam.
